1: GE FLIP ADVISOR - jar rebuilt 16:19
2: ==================================
3: 
4: This is now an advisor. It does not click, buy, sell or type anything. It
5: watches the OSRS Wiki price feed, works out which items can be bought low and
6: resold high *after* the 2% Grand Exchange tax, and shows you the exact
7: numbers. You place every offer yourself.
8: 
9: 
10: HOW TO OPEN IT
11: --------------
12: RuneLite sidebar -> "RSBuddy Scripts" -> choose "GE Flipper" in the script
13: dropdown -> Start.
14: 
15: A window called "GE Flip Advisor" opens (always on top). If you close it,
16: press Start again to bring it back. If you are not logged in yet the status
17: line says "Waiting for login"; prices start loading as soon as you are in
18: game.
19: 
20: 
21: WHAT TO DO WITH IT
22: ------------------
23: 1. "Starting capital (gp)" - type what you actually have. The window will not
24:    suggest anything you cannot afford, and it sizes each buy to that amount.
25: 
26: 2. "Free to play only" - ticked by default. Leave it ticked and member items
27:    are hidden. Untick it only if you want to see member trades.
28: 
29:    This box re-scans the moment you change it; you do not need Apply.
30: 
31: 3. The orange card is the pick. It reads like this:
32: 
33:        Buy 125 @ 3,403 gp  ->  list them at 3,614 gp
34: 
35:    Those are exact prices. Type those exact numbers into the GE. The line
36:    under it shows total profit after tax, total cost, 24h volume, buy limit,
37:    the break-even price and "never list below".
38: 
39: 4. "Copy name" puts the item name on your clipboard so you can paste it into
40:    the GE search box. "Next pick" cycles through the other candidates.
41: 
42: 5. Buy them, wait for the buy to fill, then sell them at the sell price. Do
43:    not list below the "never list below" number - that is the price that
44:    still covers what you paid plus tax plus your minimum profit.
45: 
46: 6. "Apply filters & rescan" after changing capital, min profit or anything in
47:    the advanced section. The list also refreshes itself every few seconds.
48: 
49: 
50: READING THE LIST
51: ----------------
52: "All picks" is sorted by total profit, biggest first. Columns:
53: 
54:     Item   Buy   Qty   Sell   Profit   ROI   Vol 24h   Limit
55: 
56: Buy and Sell are the exact prices to use. Qty is how many the window thinks
57: you can move: capped by your capital, the item's 4-hour buy limit, and 10% of
58: its daily traded volume so you are not left holding a pile nobody buys.
59: 
60: 
61: ADVANCED FILTERS (hidden by default)
62: ------------------------------------
63: Min ROI %          - profit as a percentage of the buy price
64: Min 24h volume     - ignore items that barely trade
65: Buy offset         - how far above the current low you offer (default +1)
66: Sell offset        - how far below the current high you list (default -1)
67: Max 24h price drift- reject items whose price has moved too far from its
68:                      24-hour average, which is how spikes and crashes get
69:                      filtered out
70: 
71: Defaults are deliberately picky: at least 50 gp profit per item, 1% ROI, 250
72: items traded per day, and no more than 8% drift from the 24h average.
73: 
74: 
75: IF IT SAYS "No pick right now"
76: ------------------------------
77: That is not an error. It means nothing passed every filter at that moment.
78: Usually the market is quiet, or your capital is too small for the items with
79: real volume. Try, in this order:
80: 
81:     1. Lower "Min profit per item" to 20-30 and press Apply.
82:     2. Lower "Min 24h volume" to 100.
83:     3. Raise "Max 24h price drift" to 12-15%.
84:     4. Wait a few minutes; the feed refreshes constantly.
85: 
86: 
87: THE HONEST CAVEATS
88: ------------------
89: - Prices come from the OSRS Wiki, not from your client. They are recent, not
90:   live: the low and high you see already happened. That is why the window
91:   rejects quotes older than 30 minutes and prices far from the daily average.
92: - A flip is only a plan. If the market moves between the scan and your offer,
93:   you may buy and then have to wait, or sell at break-even. The "never list
94:   below" number is what stops a bad sale from turning into a loss.
95: - Tax is always assumed: 2% of the sale price, rounded down, capped at 5m per
96:   item. A few items are exempt in game; assuming tax can only make the
97:   estimate more cautious, never less.
98: - The buy limit is per 4 hours, per item. The quantity already respects it.
99: - Nothing here can guarantee a profit. It cannot see other players' offers,
100:   only what has already traded.
101: 
102: 
103: WHERE THE LOGS GO
104: -----------------
105: Every line the window logs is also written to:
106: 
107:     %USERPROFILE%\.runelite\rsbuddy-flipper.log
108: 
109: If something looks wrong, just say so - I read that file directly, you do not
110: need to copy anything.
111: 
112: 
113: WHAT CHANGED IN THIS BUILD (16:19)
114: ----------------------------------
115: - Rewritten as an advisor: no clicking, no typing, no offers placed for you.
116: - Free to play toggle, on by default.
117: - Pick card with exact buy price, sell price, quantity and a hard floor.
118: - Member filtering now also asks the game client which items are member-only,
119:   so a wrong flag in the price feed cannot put a member item in your list.
120: - Scanning moved onto the game thread, where item data is safe to read.
121: - The old automation code (GeTrader) is still in the plugin but is not
122:   connected to this window.

33: /**
34:  * Example script which finds a nearby object and clicks it.
35:  * <p>
36:  * This is intentionally small. Use it as a template for a state machine:
37:  * find a target, interact, wait for the game to update, then repeat.
38:  */
39: public final class ObjectInteractScript extends Script
40: {
41: 	private static final int CLICK_COOLDOWN_TICKS = 3;
42: 
43: 	private final String objectName;
44: 	private final String requiredAction;
45: 	private final int maxDistance;
46: 
47: 	private int cooldown;
48: 
49: 	public ObjectInteractScript(String objectName, String requiredAction, int maxDistance)
50: 	{
51: 		super("Object Interact", "Finds a nearby object and clicks it", 1);
52: 		this.objectName = objectName;
53: 		this.requiredAction = requiredAction;
54: 		this.maxDistance = maxDistance;
55: 	}
56: 
57: 	@Override
58: 	protected void onStart()
59: 	{
60: 		cooldown = 0;
61: 		setStatus("Looking for " + objectName);
62: 	}
63: 
64: 	@Override
65: 	protected void onGameTick()
66: 	{
67: 		ScriptContext context = getContext();
68: 
69: 		if (!context.isLoggedIn())
70: 		{
71: 			setStatus("Waiting for login");
72: 			return;
73: 		}
74: 
75: 		if (cooldown > 0)
76: 		{
77: 			--cooldown;
78: 			setStatus("Cooldown (" + cooldown + ")");
79: 			return;
80: 		}
81: 
82: 		Player player = context.getPlayer();
83: 		if (player.getAnimation() != -1)
84: 		{
85: 			setStatus("Waiting for player to become idle");
86: 			return;
87: 		}
88: 
89: 		Optional<GameObject> target = context.getTargets()
90: 			.findObject(objectName, requiredAction, maxDistance);
91: 		if (target.isEmpty())
92: 		{
93: 			setStatus("No " + objectName + " within " + maxDistance + " tiles");
94: 			return;
95: 		}
96: 
97: 		if (context.getInput().click(target.get()))
98: 		{
99: 			cooldown = CLICK_COOLDOWN_TICKS;
100: 			setStatus("Clicked " + objectName);
101: 		}
102: 		else
103: 		{
104: 			setStatus("Unable to click " + objectName);
105: 		}
106: 	}
107: }

33: /**
34:  * Owns the currently running script and dispatches game ticks to it.
35:  * <p>
36:  * Lifecycle methods are synchronized so the panel (EDT) and game thread can
37:  * start and stop scripts safely.
38:  */
39: public final class ScriptManager
40: {
41: 	private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ScriptManager.class);
42: 
43: 	private final ScriptContext context;
44: 	private final List<Script> scripts = new ArrayList<>();
45: 
46: 	private Script activeScript;
47: 
48: 	public ScriptManager(ScriptContext context)
49: 	{
50: 		this.context = context;
51: 	}
52: 
53: 	public synchronized void register(Script script)
54: 	{
55: 		if (script != null && !scripts.contains(script))
56: 		{
57: 			scripts.add(script);
58: 		}
59: 	}
60: 
61: 	public synchronized List<Script> getScripts()
62: 	{
63: 		return Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(scripts));
64: 	}
65: 
66: 	public synchronized Script getActiveScript()
67: 	{
68: 		return activeScript;
69: 	}
70: 
71: 	public synchronized boolean isRunning()
72: 	{
73: 		return activeScript != null;
74: 	}
75: 
76: 	public synchronized String getStatus()
77: 	{
78: 		return activeScript == null ? "Idle" : activeScript.getStatus();
79: 	}
80: 
81: 	public synchronized void start(Script script)
82: 	{
83: 		if (script == null)
84: 		{
85: 			return;
86: 		}
87: 
88: 		if (activeScript != null)
89: 		{
90: 			stop();
91: 		}
92: 
93: 		activeScript = script;
94: 
95: 		try
96: 		{
97: 			script.start(context);
98: 		}
99: 		catch (Throwable ex)
100: 		{
101: 			log.error("Unable to start script {}", script.getName(), ex);
102: 			activeScript = null;
103: 			script.setStatus("Error: " + ex.getMessage());
104: 
105: 			try
106: 			{
107: 				script.stop();
108: 			}
109: 			catch (Throwable stopEx)
110: 			{
111: 				log.warn("Unable to stop failed script {}", script.getName(), stopEx);
112: 			}
113: 		}
114: 	}
115: 
116: 	public synchronized void stop()
117: 	{
118: 		Script script = activeScript;
119: 		activeScript = null;
120: 
121: 		context.getInput().stopCamera();
122: 
123: 		if (script == null)
124: 		{
125: 			return;
126: 		}
127: 
128: 		try
129: 		{
130: 			script.stop();
131: 		}
132: 		catch (Throwable ex)
133: 		{
134: 			log.warn("Unable to stop script {}", script.getName(), ex);
135: 			script.setStatus("Error: " + ex.getMessage());
136: 		}
137: 	}
138: 
139: 	public synchronized void onGameTick()
140: 	{
141: 		Script script = activeScript;
142: 		if (script == null)
143: 		{
144: 			return;
145: 		}
146: 
147: 		try
148: 		{
149: 			script.tick();
150: 		}
151: 		catch (Throwable ex)
152: 		{
153: 			log.error("Script {} failed", script.getName(), ex);
154: 			activeScript = null;
155: 
156: 			try
157: 			{
158: 				script.stop();
159: 			}
160: 			catch (Throwable stopEx)
161: 			{
162: 				log.warn("Unable to stop failed script {}", script.getName(), stopEx);
163: 			}
164: 
165: 			script.setStatus("Error: " + ex.getMessage());
166: 		}
167: 	}
168: }

262: 		if (hull != null)
263: 		{
264: 			return hover(hull);
265: 		}
266: 
267: 		Polygon tilePoly = npc.getCanvasTilePoly();
268: 		return tilePoly != null && hover(tilePoly);
269: 	}

273: 	 * path as a click. The point is the widget's centre, matching

276: 	 * @return true if a movement was started
277: 	 */
278: 	public boolean hover(Widget widget)

281: 		{

420: 	/**
421: 	 * Clicks several widgets in quick succession without the animated mouse
422: 	 * path. This is intended for rapid inventory actions such as
423: 	 * power-dropping fish. The clicks are sequenced so each one lands after the
424: 	 * client has processed the move to its target.
425: 	 *
426: 	 * @return the number of clicks scheduled
427: 	 */
428: 	public int fastClick(List<Widget> widgets)
429: 	{
430: 		if (widgets == null || widgets.isEmpty())
431: 		{
432: 			return 0;
433: 		}
434: 
435: 		Canvas canvas = client.getCanvas();
436: 		if (canvas == null)
437: 		{
438: 			return 0;
439: 		}
440: 
441: 		List<Point> gamePoints = new ArrayList<>();
442: 		List<Point> canvasPoints = new ArrayList<>();
443: 
444: 		for (Widget widget : widgets)
445: 		{
446: 			if (widget == null || widget.isHidden())
447: 			{
448: 				continue;
449: 			}
450: 
451: 			Rectangle bounds = widget.getBounds();
452: 			if (bounds == null || bounds.isEmpty())
453: 			{
454: 				continue;
455: 			}
456: 
457: 			Point point = randomPoint(bounds);
458: 			if (point == null)
459: 			{
460: 				continue;
461: 			}
462: 
463: 			Point canvasPoint = toCanvasPoint(point);
464: 			if (!canvas.contains(canvasPoint))
465: 			{
466: 				continue;
467: 			}
468: 
469: 			gamePoints.add(point);
470: 			canvasPoints.add(canvasPoint);
471: 		}
472: 
473: 		if (gamePoints.isEmpty())
474: 		{
475: 			return 0;
476: 		}
477: 
478: 		stopCamera();
479: 		final List<Point> targets = gamePoints;
480: 		final List<Point> canvasTargets = canvasPoints;
481: 		fastClicking = true;
482: 		SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> fastClickNext(canvas, targets, canvasTargets, 0));
483: 		return targets.size();
484: 	}

507: 	 * @return true if the NPC's model is currently inside the game viewport
508: 	 */
509: 	public boolean isVisible(NPC npc)
510: 	{
511: 		if (npc == null)
512: 		{
513: 			return false;
514: 		}
515: 
516: 		Shape hull = npc.getConvexHull();
517: 		if (hull != null && isInViewport(hull))
518: 		{
519: 			return true;
520: 		}

522: 		Polygon tilePoly = npc.getCanvasTilePoly();
523: 		return tilePoly != null && isInViewport(tilePoly);

526: 	/**
527: 	 * @return true if the object is currently inside the game viewport
528: 	 */
529: 	public boolean isVisible(TileObject object)
530: 	{
531: 		if (object == null)
532: 		{
533: 			return false;
534: 		}
535: 
536: 		Shape clickbox = object.getClickbox();
537: 		if (clickbox != null && isInViewport(clickbox))
538: 		{
539: 			return true;
540: 		}
541: 
542: 		Polygon tilePoly = object.getCanvasTilePoly();
543: 		return tilePoly != null && isInViewport(tilePoly);

545: 
546: 	private boolean isInViewport(Shape shape)
547: 	{
548: 		if (shape == null)
549: 		{
550: 			return false;
551: 		}
552: 
553: 		int width = client.getViewportWidth();
554: 		int height = client.getViewportHeight();
555: 		if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
556: 		{
557: 			return true;
558: 		}
559: 
560: 		// Do not use Shape.intersects here. RuneLite's SimplePolygon only
561: 		// reports an intersection when the viewport edges cross the polygon,
562: 		// which is false for a target that is fully inside the viewport.
563: 		Rectangle bounds = shape.getBounds();
564: 		if (bounds == null)
565: 		{
566: 			return false;
567: 		}
568: 
569: 		Rectangle viewport = new Rectangle(
570: 			client.getViewportXOffset(), client.getViewportYOffset(), width, height);
571: 		if (bounds.width <= 0 || bounds.height <= 0)
572: 		{
573: 			return viewport.contains(bounds.getLocation());
574: 		}
575: 
576: 		return viewport.intersects(bounds);
577: 	}
578: 
579: 	private boolean isInViewport(int x, int y)
580: 	{
581: 		int width = client.getViewportWidth();
582: 		int height = client.getViewportHeight();
583: 		if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
584: 		{
585: 			return true;
586: 		}
587: 
588: 		int viewportX = client.getViewportXOffset();
589: 		int viewportY = client.getViewportYOffset();
590: 		return x >= viewportX && x < viewportX + width
591: 			&& y >= viewportY && y < viewportY + height;
592: 	}

605: 	public boolean isZooming()

607: 		return zooming;

610: 	/**
611: 	 * Scrolls the mouse wheel down to zoom the camera out, one notch at a
612: 	 * time with a small human-like delay between notches.
613: 	 *
614: 	 * @param notches number of wheel notches to scroll
615: 	 * @return true if zooming was started
616: 	 */
617: 	public boolean zoomOut(int notches)
618: 	{
619: 		if (notches <= 0)
620: 		{
621: 			return false;
622: 		}
623: 
624: 		if (zooming)
625: 		{
626: 			return true;
627: 		}
628: 
629: 		Canvas canvas = client.getCanvas();
630: 		if (canvas == null)
631: 		{
632: 			return false;
633: 		}
634: 
635: 		Dimension size = canvas.getSize();
636: 		if (size.width <= 0 || size.height <= 0)
637: 		{
638: 			return false;
639: 		}
640: 
641: 		final int x = size.width / 2;
642: 		final int y = size.height / 2;
643: 		zooming = true;
644: 
645: 		SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() ->
646: 		{
647: 			canvas.requestFocusInWindow();
648: 			zoomStep(canvas, x, y, notches);
649: 		});
650: 
651: 		return true;
652: 	}
653: 
654: 	private void zoomStep(Canvas canvas, int x, int y, int remaining)
655: 	{
656: 		if (remaining <= 0)
657: 		{
658: 			zooming = false;
659: 			return;
660: 		}
661: 
662: 		canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseWheelEvent(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_WHEEL,
663: 			System.currentTimeMillis(), 0, x, y, 0, false, MouseWheelEvent.WHEEL_UNIT_SCROLL, 3, 1));
664: 
665: 		Timer timer = new Timer(80 + random.nextInt(70), event -> zoomStep(canvas, x, y, remaining - 1));
666: 		timer.setRepeats(false);
667: 		timer.start();
668: 	}
669: 
670: 	/**
671: 	 * Starts turning the camera toward a world position by holding the
672: 	 * appropriate arrow key, exactly as a player would. The key is released
673: 	 * automatically after a short hold, or immediately with
674: 	 * {@link #stopCamera()}.
675: 	 *
676: 	 * @return true if the camera is already turning or a turn was started,
677: 	 * false if the camera already faces the position
678: 	 */
679: 	public boolean turnCameraToward(WorldPoint worldPoint)
680: 	{
681: 		if (cameraKey != -1)
682: 		{
683: 			return true;
684: 		}
685: 
686: 		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
687: 		if (player == null || worldPoint == null)
688: 		{
689: 			return false;
690: 		}
691: 
692: 		WorldPoint origin = player.getWorldLocation();
693: 		if (origin == null)
694: 		{
695: 			return false;
696: 		}
697: 
698: 		int dx = worldPoint.getX() - origin.getX();
699: 		int dy = worldPoint.getY() - origin.getY();
700: 		if (dx == 0 && dy == 0)
701: 		{
702: 			return false;
703: 		}
704: 
705: 		int desired = (int) Math.round(Math.atan2(-dx, dy) * CAMERA_YAW_UNITS / TAU)
706: 			& (CAMERA_YAW_UNITS - 1);
707: 		return turnCameraToYaw(desired);
708: 	}
709: 
710: 	/**
711: 	 * Starts turning the camera toward an absolute yaw by holding the
712: 	 * appropriate arrow key, using the direction learned from earlier pulses.
713: 	 *
714: 	 * @param desiredYaw target yaw in JAU14 units
715: 	 * @return true if the camera is already turning or a turn was started,
716: 	 * false if the camera already faces the target yaw
717: 	 */
718: 	public boolean turnCameraToYaw(int desiredYaw)
719: 	{
720: 		if (cameraKey != -1)
721: 		{
722: 			return true;
723: 		}
724: 
725: 		int desired = desiredYaw & (CAMERA_YAW_UNITS - 1);
726: 		int current = client.getCameraYawTarget() & (CAMERA_YAW_UNITS - 1);
727: 		int delta = normalizeYaw(desired - current);
728: 		if (Math.abs(delta) <= CAMERA_DEADBAND)
729: 		{
730: 			return false;
731: 		}
732: 
733: 		boolean useLeft = delta > 0 ? cameraLeftSign > 0 : cameraLeftSign < 0;
734: 		cameraPulseYaw = current;
735: 		return holdKey(useLeft ? KeyEvent.VK_LEFT : KeyEvent.VK_RIGHT, CAMERA_HOLD_MS);
736: 	}
737: 
738: 	/**
739: 	 * Releases a held camera arrow key, if any.
740: 	 */
741: 	public void stopCamera()
742: 	{
743: 		int keyCode = cameraKey;
744: 		if (keyCode == -1)
745: 		{
746: 			return;
747: 		}
748: 
749: 		cameraKey = -1;
750: 		Timer timer = cameraKeyTimer;
751: 		cameraKeyTimer = null;
752: 		if (timer != null)
753: 		{
754: 			timer.stop();
755: 		}
756: 
757: 		finishCameraPulse(keyCode);
758: 
759: 		Canvas canvas = client.getCanvas();
760: 		if (canvas != null)
761: 		{
762: 			SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> dispatchKey(canvas, KeyEvent.KEY_RELEASED, keyCode));
763: 		}
764: 	}
765: 
766: 	/**
767: 	 * Holds a key down for the given time and releases it afterwards.
768: 	 */
769: 	public boolean holdKey(int keyCode, int holdMillis)
770: 	{
771: 		Canvas canvas = client.getCanvas();
772: 		if (canvas == null)
773: 		{
774: 			return false;
775: 		}
776: 
777: 		if (cameraKey == keyCode)
778: 		{
779: 			return true;
780: 		}
781: 
782: 		stopCamera();
783: 		cameraKey = keyCode;
784: 		final int duration = Math.max(50, holdMillis);
785: 
786: 		SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() ->
787: 		{
788: 			if (cameraKey != keyCode)
789: 			{
790: 				return;
791: 			}
792: 
793: 			canvas.requestFocusInWindow();
794: 			dispatchKey(canvas, KeyEvent.KEY_PRESSED, keyCode);
795: 
796: 			Timer timer = new Timer(duration, event -> releaseCameraKey(keyCode));
797: 			timer.setRepeats(false);
798: 			cameraKeyTimer = timer;
799: 			timer.start();
800: 		});
801: 
802: 		return true;
803: 	}
804: 
805: 	/**
806: 	 * Sends a key press/release pair to the game canvas.
807: 	 */
808: 	public boolean pressKey(int keyCode)
809: 	{
810: 		Canvas canvas = client.getCanvas();
811: 		if (canvas == null)
812: 		{
813: 			return false;
814: 		}
815: 
816: 		SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() ->
817: 		{
818: 			canvas.requestFocusInWindow();
819: 
820: 			long when = System.currentTimeMillis();
821: 			dispatchKey(canvas, KeyEvent.KEY_PRESSED, keyCode);
822: 
823: 			char keyChar = keyCode == KeyEvent.VK_SPACE ? ' ' : KeyEvent.CHAR_UNDEFINED;
824: 			if (keyChar != KeyEvent.CHAR_UNDEFINED)
825: 			{
826: 				canvas.dispatchEvent(new KeyEvent(canvas, KeyEvent.KEY_TYPED, when, 0,
827: 					KeyEvent.VK_UNDEFINED, keyChar));
828: 			}
829: 
830: 			canvas.dispatchEvent(new KeyEvent(canvas, KeyEvent.KEY_RELEASED, when + 45, 0, keyCode, keyChar));
831: 		});
832: 
833: 		return true;
834: 	}
835: 
836: 	/**
837: 	 * Learns which way each arrow key turns the camera from the actual yaw
838: 	 * change, so the mapping does not have to be assumed.
839: 	 */
840: 	private void finishCameraPulse(int keyCode)
841: 	{
842: 		int change = normalizeYaw(
843: 			(client.getCameraYawTarget() & (CAMERA_YAW_UNITS - 1)) - cameraPulseYaw);
844: 		if (Math.abs(change) < 8)
845: 		{
846: 			return;
847: 		}
848: 
849: 		int sign = change > 0 ? 1 : -1;
850: 		if (keyCode == KeyEvent.VK_LEFT)
851: 		{
852: 			cameraLeftSign = sign;
853: 			cameraRightSign = -sign;
854: 		}
855: 		else if (keyCode == KeyEvent.VK_RIGHT)
856: 		{
857: 			cameraRightSign = sign;
858: 			cameraLeftSign = -sign;
859: 		}
860: 	}
861: 
862: 	private void releaseCameraKey(int keyCode)
863: 	{
864: 		if (cameraKey != keyCode)
865: 		{
866: 			return;
867: 		}
868: 
869: 		cameraKey = -1;
870: 		cameraKeyTimer = null;
871: 		finishCameraPulse(keyCode);
872: 
873: 		Canvas canvas = client.getCanvas();
874: 		if (canvas != null)
875: 		{
876: 			dispatchKey(canvas, KeyEvent.KEY_RELEASED, keyCode);
877: 		}
878: 	}
879: 
880: 	private static void dispatchKey(Canvas canvas, int id, int keyCode)
881: 	{
882: 		char keyChar = keyCode == KeyEvent.VK_SPACE ? ' ' : KeyEvent.CHAR_UNDEFINED;
883: 		canvas.dispatchEvent(new KeyEvent(canvas, id, System.currentTimeMillis(),
884: 			0, keyCode, keyChar));
885: 	}
886: 
887: 	private static int normalizeYaw(int yaw)
888: 	{
889: 		int normalized = yaw & (CAMERA_YAW_UNITS - 1);
890: 		return normalized >= CAMERA_HALF_TURN ? normalized - CAMERA_YAW_UNITS : normalized;
891: 	}
892: 
893: 	public boolean pressSpace()
894: 	{
895: 		return pressKey(KeyEvent.VK_SPACE);

898: 	/**
899: 	 * Types text into whatever currently has chatbox focus, one character at a
900: 	 * time so the game's input handler keeps up. The characters are dispatched
901: 	 * as KEY_TYPED events, which is what the chatbox listens for.
902: 	 */
903: 	public boolean typeText(String text)
904: 	{
905: 		Canvas canvas = client.getCanvas();
906: 		if (canvas == null || text == null || text.isEmpty())
907: 		{
908: 			return false;
909: 		}
910: 
911: 		final char[] characters = text.toCharArray();
912: 
913: 		SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() ->
914: 		{
915: 			canvas.requestFocusInWindow();
916: 
917: 			final int[] index = {0};
918: 			Timer timer = new Timer(60, null);
919: 			timer.addActionListener(event ->
920: 			{
921: 				if (index[0] >= characters.length)
922: 				{
923: 					timer.stop();
924: 					return;
925: 				}
926: 
927: 				char character = characters[index[0]++];
928: 				canvas.dispatchEvent(new KeyEvent(canvas, KeyEvent.KEY_TYPED,
929: 					System.currentTimeMillis(), 0, KeyEvent.VK_UNDEFINED, character));
930: 				timer.setDelay(55 + random.nextInt(45));
931: 			});
932: 			timer.setInitialDelay(0);
933: 			timer.start();
934: 		});
935: 
936: 		return true;
937: 	}

939: 	/**
940: 	 * Submits the active chatbox input.
941: 	 */
942: 	public boolean pressEnter()
943: 	{
944: 		Canvas canvas = client.getCanvas();
945: 		if (canvas == null)
946: 		{
947: 			return false;
948: 		}
949: 
950: 		SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() ->
951: 		{
952: 			canvas.requestFocusInWindow();
953: 			long when = System.currentTimeMillis();
954: 			canvas.dispatchEvent(new KeyEvent(canvas, KeyEvent.KEY_PRESSED, when, 0,
955: 				KeyEvent.VK_ENTER, '\n'));
956: 			canvas.dispatchEvent(new KeyEvent(canvas, KeyEvent.KEY_TYPED, when + 20, 0,
957: 				KeyEvent.VK_UNDEFINED, '\n'));
958: 			canvas.dispatchEvent(new KeyEvent(canvas, KeyEvent.KEY_RELEASED, when + 45, 0,
959: 				KeyEvent.VK_ENTER, '\n'));
960: 		});
961: 
962: 		return true;
963: 	}

977: 		String[] actions = widget.getActions();
978: 		if (actions == null)
979: 		{
980: 			return false;
981: 		}
982: 
983: 		for (int i = 0; i < actions.length; i++)
984: 		{
985: 			if (actions[i] != null && stripTags(actions[i]).equalsIgnoreCase(stripTags(action)))
986: 			{
987: 				client.menuAction(-1, widget.getId(), MenuAction.CC_OP, i + 1, -1, actions[i], "");
988: 				return true;
989: 			}
990: 		}
991: 
992: 		return false;
993: 	}

995: 	private static String stripTags(String value)
996: 	{
997: 		return value.replaceAll("<[^>]*>", "").trim();

1000: 	/**
1001: 	 * Interacts with a tile object by opening its right-click menu and then
1002: 	 * clicking the matching option in that menu. Using the real context menu
1003: 	 * avoids relying on synthesised menu actions, which the client does not
1004: 	 * always resolve for tile objects.
1005: 	 */
1006: 	public boolean interact(TileObject object, String... actions)
1007: 	{
1008: 		if (object == null || actions == null || actions.length == 0)
1009: 		{
1010: 			return false;
1011: 		}
1012: 
1013: 		if (client.isMenuOpen())
1014: 		{
1015: 			MenuEntry entry = findObjectMenuEntry(object, actions);
1016: 			if (entry != null)
1017: 			{
1018: 				return clickMenuEntry(entry);
1019: 			}
1020: 
1021: 			// The menu is open for something else or does not contain the
1022: 			// requested option. Close it so the next attempt can start over.
1023: 			closeMenu();
1024: 			return false;
1025: 		}
1026: 
1027: 		// Right-click the object to open its menu. The next tick picks the
1028: 		// matching option from the menu.
1029: 		return click(object, MouseEvent.BUTTON3);
1030: 	}
1031: 
1032: 	private MenuEntry findObjectMenuEntry(TileObject object, String... actions)
1033: 	{
1034: 		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();
1035: 		MenuEntry[] entries = menu == null ? null : menu.getMenuEntries();
1036: 		if (entries == null)
1037: 		{
1038: 			return null;
1039: 		}
1040: 
1041: 		ObjectComposition composition = client.getObjectDefinition(object.getId());
1042: 		String name = composition == null ? null : composition.getName();
1043: 		int objectId = object.getId() & 0xFFFF;
1044: 		MenuEntry optionOnly = null;
1045: 		boolean multipleOptions = false;
1046: 
1047: 		for (MenuEntry entry : entries)
1048: 		{
1049: 			if (entry == null || !matchesOption(entry.getOption(), actions))
1050: 			{
1051: 				continue;
1052: 			}
1053: 
1054: 			if ((entry.getIdentifier() & 0xFFFF) == objectId)
1055: 			{
1056: 				return entry;
1057: 			}
1058: 
1059: 			String target = entry.getTarget();
1060: 			if (target != null && name != null && target.equalsIgnoreCase(name))
1061: 			{
1062: 				return entry;
1063: 			}
1064: 
1065: 			if (optionOnly == null)
1066: 			{
1067: 				optionOnly = entry;
1068: 			}
1069: 			else if (optionOnly != entry)
1070: 			{
1071: 				multipleOptions = true;
1072: 			}
1073: 		}
1074: 
1075: 		// Some wall objects use a packed identifier rather than the object
1076: 		// id. If there is exactly one entry with the wanted option, use it.
1077: 		return multipleOptions ? null : optionOnly;
1078: 	}

1080: 	public boolean interact(NPC npc, String action)
1081: 	{
1082: 		if (npc == null)
1083: 		{
1084: 			return false;
1085: 		}
1086: 
1087: 		NPCComposition composition = npc.getComposition();
1088: 		if (composition == null)
1089: 		{
1090: 			return false;
1091: 		}
1092: 
1093: 		int actionIndex = findAction(composition.getActions(), action);
1094: 		if (actionIndex < 0)
1095: 		{
1096: 			return false;
1097: 		}
1098: 
1099: 		// The first option is what a normal left click selects. Using a real
1100: 		// click makes the cursor visibly travel to the NPC instead of the
1101: 		// action appearing out of nowhere.
1102: 		if (actionIndex == 0)
1103: 		{
1104: 			return click(npc);
1105: 		}
1106: 
1107: 		// Other options need a right-click menu in game. Move onto the NPC
1108: 		// like a player would, then invoke the exact option. Hovering keeps
1109: 		// the pointer movement visible while avoiding a menu left open
1110: 		// across ticks.
1111: 		hover(npc);
1112: 		client.menuAction(npc.getIndex(), 0, npcMenuAction(actionIndex), npc.getIndex(), -1, action, npc.getName());
1113: 		return true;
1114: 	}

1185: 	private MenuEntry findBankMenuEntry(int itemId, String withdrawOption)
1186: 	{
1187: 		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();
1188: 		MenuEntry[] entries = menu == null ? null : menu.getMenuEntries();
1189: 		if (entries == null)
1190: 		{
1191: 			return null;
1192: 		}
1193: 
1194: 		MenuEntry optionMatch = null;
1195: 		for (MenuEntry entry : entries)
1196: 		{
1197: 			if (entry == null
1198: 				|| (entry.getType() != MenuAction.CC_OP
1199: 					&& entry.getType() != MenuAction.CC_OP_LOW_PRIORITY)
1200: 				|| !matchesOption(entry.getOption(), withdrawOption))
1201: 			{
1202: 				continue;
1203: 			}
1204: 
1205: 			// Bank item entries carry the item id; prefer the entry that
1206: 			// belongs to the slot we right-clicked.
1207: 			if (entry.getItemId() == itemId
1208: 				&& entry.getParam1() == InterfaceID.Bankmain.ITEMS)
1209: 			{
1210: 				return entry;
1211: 			}
1212: 
1213: 			if (optionMatch == null)
1214: 			{
1215: 				optionMatch = entry;
1216: 			}
1217: 		}
1218: 
1219: 		return optionMatch;

1222: 	/**
1223: 	 * Finds the Take entry for a ground item in the currently open menu.
1224: 	 */
1225: 	private MenuEntry findGroundItemMenuEntry(int itemId, int sceneX, int sceneY)
1226: 	{
1227: 		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();
1228: 		MenuEntry[] entries = menu == null ? null : menu.getMenuEntries();
1229: 		if (entries == null)
1230: 		{
1231: 			return null;
1232: 		}
1233: 
1234: 		int id = itemId & 0xFFFF;
1235: 		MenuEntry fallback = null;
1236: 
1237: 		for (MenuEntry entry : entries)
1238: 		{
1239: 			if (entry == null || !isGroundItemAction(entry.getType())
1240: 				|| !matchesOption(entry.getOption(), "Take", "Pick up", "Pickup")
1241: 				|| (entry.getIdentifier() & 0xFFFF) != id)
1242: 			{
1243: 				continue;
1244: 			}
1245: 
1246: 			// The menu only contains items from the tile that was
1247: 			// right-clicked, but prefer an entry with matching coordinates.
1248: 			if (entry.getParam0() == sceneX && entry.getParam1() == sceneY)
1249: 			{
1250: 				return entry;
1251: 			}
1252: 
1253: 			if (fallback == null)
1254: 			{
1255: 				fallback = entry;
1256: 			}
1257: 		}
1258: 
1259: 		return fallback;
1260: 	}

1262: 	private static boolean isGroundItemAction(MenuAction type)
1263: 	{
1264: 		if (type == null)
1265: 		{
1266: 			return false;
1267: 		}
1268: 
1269: 		int id = type.getId();
1270: 		return id >= MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_FIRST_OPTION.getId()
1271: 			&& id <= MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_FIFTH_OPTION.getId();
1272: 	}

1274: 	private static boolean matchesOption(String option, String... actions)
1275: 	{
1276: 		if (option == null)
1277: 		{
1278: 			return false;
1279: 		}
1280: 
1281: 		for (String action : actions)
1282: 		{
1283: 			if (action != null && option.trim().equalsIgnoreCase(action.trim()))
1284: 			{
1285: 				return true;
1286: 			}
1287: 		}
1288: 
1289: 		return false;
1290: 	}

1292: 	/**
1293: 	 * Clicks a row in the client's currently open context menu. The client
1294: 	 * lays the menu out with a 19px header and 15px rows, with the array's
1295: 	 * last entry at the top.
1296: 	 */
1297: 	public boolean clickMenuEntry(MenuEntry entry)
1298: 	{
1299: 		if (entry == null)
1300: 		{
1301: 			return false;
1302: 		}
1303: 
1304: 		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();
1305: 		MenuEntry[] entries = menu == null ? null : menu.getMenuEntries();
1306: 		if (!client.isMenuOpen() || entries == null || entries.length == 0)
1307: 		{
1308: 			return invokeMenuEntry(entry);
1309: 		}
1310: 
1311: 		int index = -1;
1312: 		for (int i = 0; i < entries.length; i++)
1313: 		{
1314: 			if (entries[i] == entry)
1315: 			{
1316: 				index = i;
1317: 				break;
1318: 			}
1319: 		}
1320: 
1321: 		if (index < 0 || client.isMenuScrollable())
1322: 		{
1323: 			return invokeMenuEntry(entry);
1324: 		}
1325: 
1326: 		int row = entries.length - 1 - index;
1327: 		int x = menu.getMenuX() + Math.max(8, menu.getMenuWidth() / 2);
1328: 		int y = menu.getMenuY() + 19 + row * 15 + 7;
1329: 		return clickMenuPoint(new Point(x, y));
1330: 	}
1331: 
1332: 	private boolean invokeMenuEntry(MenuEntry entry)
1333: 	{
1334: 		client.menuAction(entry.getParam0(), entry.getParam1(), entry.getType(),
1335: 			entry.getIdentifier(), entry.getItemId(), entry.getOption(), entry.getTarget());
1336: 		return true;
1337: 	}

1339: 	/**
1340: 	 * Runs a context-menu entry directly. This lets callers use an option that
1341: 	 * is not the default left-click action without opening the menu, and it
1342: 	 * never falls back to a plain click, so nothing unexpected is triggered.
1343: 	 */
1344: 	public boolean invokeMenu(MenuEntry entry)
1345: 	{
1346: 		return entry != null && invokeMenuEntry(entry);
1347: 	}

1349: 	/**
1350: 	 * Finds an entry in the client's current context menu. The menu is built
1351: 	 * from whatever the mouse is hovering, so callers must hover the target and
1352: 	 * wait a frame before asking.
1353: 	 *
1354: 	 * @param option option text, colour tags ignored
1355: 	 * @param itemId item id to require, or -1 to accept any
1356: 	 */
1357: 	public MenuEntry findMenuEntry(String option, int itemId)
1358: 	{
1359: 		if (option == null)
1360: 		{
1361: 			return null;
1362: 		}
1363: 
1364: 		MenuEntry untyped = null;
1365: 		int untypedCount = 0;
1366: 
1367: 		for (MenuEntry entry : currentMenuEntries())
1368: 		{
1369: 			if (entry == null || entry.getOption() == null
1370: 				|| !stripTags(entry.getOption()).equalsIgnoreCase(stripTags(option)))
1371: 			{
1372: 				continue;
1373: 			}
1374: 
1375: 			if (entry.getItemId() == itemId)
1376: 			{
1377: 				return entry;
1378: 			}
1379: 
1380: 			if (entry.getItemId() <= 0)
1381: 			{
1382: 				untyped = entry;
1383: 				untypedCount++;
1384: 			}
1385: 		}
1386: 
1387: 		// Fall back only when there is exactly one candidate, so an ambiguous
1388: 		// menu can never be resolved to the wrong item.
1389: 		return untypedCount == 1 ? untyped : null;
1390: 	}

1392: 	/**
1393: 	 * Lists the options in the current context menu, for logging when an
1394: 	 * expected option is missing.

1396: 	public List<String> describeMenu()
1397: 	{
1398: 		List<String> options = new ArrayList<>();
1399: 
1400: 		for (MenuEntry entry : currentMenuEntries())
1401: 		{
1402: 			if (entry == null || entry.getOption() == null)
1403: 			{
1404: 				continue;
1405: 			}
1406: 
1407: 			String target = stripTags(entry.getTarget() == null ? "" : entry.getTarget());
1408: 			options.add(stripTags(entry.getOption()) + (target.isEmpty() ? "" : " " + target));
1409: 		}
1410: 
1411: 		return options;
1412: 	}

1414: 	private MenuEntry[] currentMenuEntries()
1415: 	{
1416: 		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();
1417: 		if (menu != null)
1418: 		{
1419: 			MenuEntry[] entries = menu.getMenuEntries();
1420: 			if (entries != null && entries.length > 0)
1421: 			{
1422: 				return entries;
1423: 			}
1424: 		}
1425: 
1426: 		MenuEntry[] entries = client.getMenuEntries();
1427: 		return entries == null ? new MenuEntry[0] : entries;
1428: 	}

1489: 	/**
1490: 	 * Clicks a point inside the already-open context menu. The cursor is
1491: 	 * moved there in a single event, because animated movement across the
1492: 	 * game world can close the menu before the click lands.
1493: 	 */
1494: 	private boolean clickMenuPoint(Point gamePoint)
1495: 	{
1496: 		if (gamePoint == null)
1497: 		{
1498: 			return false;
1499: 		}
1500: 
1501: 		Canvas canvas = client.getCanvas();
1502: 		if (canvas == null)
1503: 		{
1504: 			return false;
1505: 		}
1506: 
1507: 		Point canvasPoint = toCanvasPoint(gamePoint);
1508: 		if (!canvas.contains(canvasPoint))
1509: 		{
1510: 			return false;
1511: 		}
1512: 
1513: 		stopCamera();
1514: 		stopMovement();
1515: 		busy = true;
1516: 		SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() ->
1517: 		{
1518: 			canvas.requestFocusInWindow();
1519: 			lastMousePoint = canvasPoint;
1520: 			mouseLocation = new Point(gamePoint);
1521: 			dispatch(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_MOVED, canvasPoint, MouseEvent.NOBUTTON, 0, 0);
1522: 
1523: 			Timer timer = new Timer(45 + random.nextInt(45), event ->
1524: 			{
1525: 				long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
1526: 				clickLocation = new Point(gamePoint);
1527: 				clickStartedAt = now;
1528: 				clickButton = MouseEvent.BUTTON1;
1529: 				addClickEffect(new Point(gamePoint), MouseEvent.BUTTON1, now);
1530: 
1531: 				dispatch(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_PRESSED, canvasPoint, MouseEvent.BUTTON1, 1,
1532: 					InputEvent.BUTTON1_DOWN_MASK);
1533: 				dispatch(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_RELEASED, canvasPoint, MouseEvent.BUTTON1, 1, 0);
1534: 				dispatch(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_CLICKED, canvasPoint, MouseEvent.BUTTON1, 1, 0);
1535: 				busy = false;
1536: 			});
1537: 			timer.setRepeats(false);
1538: 			timer.start();
1539: 		});
1540: 		return true;
1541: 	}
1542: 
1543: 	private boolean click(Point gamePoint, int button)
1544: 	{
1545: 		if (gamePoint == null)
1546: 		{
1547: 			return false;
1548: 		}
1549: 
1550: 		Canvas canvas = client.getCanvas();
1551: 		if (canvas == null)
1552: 		{
1553: 			return false;
1554: 		}
1555: 
1556: 		Point canvasPoint = toCanvasPoint(gamePoint);
1557: 		if (!canvas.contains(canvasPoint))
1558: 		{
1559: 			return false;
1560: 		}
1561: 
1562: 		stopCamera();
1563: 		busy = true;
1564: 		SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> beginClick(canvas, canvasPoint, button));
1565: 		return true;
1566: 	}
1567: 
1568: 	private void fastClickNext(Canvas canvas, List<Point> gamePoints, List<Point> canvasPoints, int index)
1569: 	{
1570: 		if (index >= gamePoints.size())
1571: 		{
1572: 			fastClicking = false;
1573: 			return;
1574: 		}
1575: 
1576: 		Point gamePoint = gamePoints.get(index);
1577: 		Point canvasPoint = canvasPoints.get(index);
1578: 
1579: 		canvas.requestFocusInWindow();
1580: 		lastMousePoint = canvasPoint;
1581: 		mouseLocation = new Point(gamePoint);
1582: 		dispatch(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_MOVED, canvasPoint, MouseEvent.NOBUTTON, 0, 0);
1583: 
1584: 		// Give the client one frame to update its hover target before
1585: 		// pressing, then immediately move on to the next click.
1586: 		Timer timer = new Timer(15 + random.nextInt(20), event ->
1587: 		{
1588: 			long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
1589: 			clickLocation = new Point(gamePoint);
1590: 			clickStartedAt = now;
1591: 			clickButton = MouseEvent.BUTTON1;
1592: 			addClickEffect(gamePoint, MouseEvent.BUTTON1, now);
1593: 
1594: 			dispatch(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_PRESSED, canvasPoint, MouseEvent.BUTTON1, 1,
1595: 				InputEvent.BUTTON1_DOWN_MASK);
1596: 			dispatch(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_RELEASED, canvasPoint, MouseEvent.BUTTON1, 1, 0);
1597: 			dispatch(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_CLICKED, canvasPoint, MouseEvent.BUTTON1, 1, 0);
1598: 
1599: 			fastClickNext(canvas, gamePoints, canvasPoints, index + 1);
1600: 		});
1601: 		timer.setRepeats(false);
1602: 		timer.start();
1603: 	}
1604: 
1605: 	private void addClickEffect(Point gamePoint, int button, long startedAt)
1606: 	{
1607: 		clickEffects.add(new ClickEffect(new Point(gamePoint), button, startedAt));
1608: 
1609: 		long cutoff = System.currentTimeMillis() - CLICK_EFFECT_LIFETIME_MS;
1610: 		clickEffects.removeIf(effect -> effect.startedAt < cutoff);
1611: 	}
1612: 
1613: 	private void beginClick(Canvas canvas, Point target, int button)
1614: 	{

1670: 	private void playSteps(Canvas canvas, List<MouseStep> steps)
1671: 	{
1672: 		final long startedAt = System.nanoTime();
1673: 		final int[] index = {0};
1674: 
1675: 		Timer timer = new Timer(5, null);
1676: 		timer.addActionListener(event ->
1677: 		{
1678: 			long elapsedMs = (System.nanoTime() - startedAt) / 1_000_000L;
1679: 
1680: 			while (index[0] < steps.size() && elapsedMs >= steps.get(index[0]).delayMs)
1681: 			{
1682: 				MouseStep step = steps.get(index[0]++);
1683: 				dispatch(canvas, step.id, step.point, step.button, step.clickCount, step.modifiers);
1684: 				mouseLocation = toGamePoint(step.point);
1685: 
1686: 				if (step.id == MouseEvent.MOUSE_MOVED)
1687: 				{
1688: 					lastMousePoint = step.point;
1689: 				}
1690: 				else if (step.id == MouseEvent.MOUSE_PRESSED)
1691: 				{

1693: 					clickStartedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();

1695: 					addClickEffect(clickLocation, clickButton, clickStartedAt);
1696: 				}
1697: 			}
1698: 
1699: 			if (index[0] >= steps.size())

1701: 				timer.stop();

1703: 				{
1704: 					movementTimer = null;
1705: 					busy = false;

1707: 			}
1708: 		});
1709: 
1710: 		movementTimer = timer;

1714: 	private List<MouseStep> buildMoveSteps(Point start, Point target)
1715: 	{
1716: 		List<MouseStep> steps = new ArrayList<>();
1717: 
1718: 		double dx = target.x - start.x;
1719: 		double dy = target.y - start.y;
1720: 		double distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
1721: 
1722: 		if (distance < 2.0)
1723: 		{
1724: 			steps.add(new MouseStep(MouseEvent.MOUSE_MOVED, target, MouseEvent.NOBUTTON, 0, 0, 0));
1725: 		}
1726: 		else
1727: 		{
1728: 			int moveSteps = Math.max(12, Math.min(50, (int) (distance / 11.0) + 9));
1729: 			double length = Math.max(1.0, distance);
1730: 			double perpX = -dy / length;
1731: 			double perpY = dx / length;
1732: 
1733: 			// A mild curve makes straight-line teleporting look less robotic.
1734: 			double bend = (random.nextDouble() * 2.0 - 1.0) * Math.min(70.0, distance * 0.11);
1735: 			double control1X = start.x + dx * 0.32 + perpX * bend;
1736: 			double control1Y = start.y + dy * 0.32 + perpY * bend;
1737: 			double control2X = start.x + dx * 0.68 + perpX * bend * 0.55;
1738: 			double control2Y = start.y + dy * 0.68 + perpY * bend * 0.55;
1739: 
1740: 			long delay = 0;
1741: 			for (int i = 1; i <= moveSteps; i++)
1742: 			{
1743: 				double progress = (double) i / moveSteps;
1744: 				double eased = 1.0 - Math.pow(1.0 - progress, 2.2);
1745: 
1746: 				if (i < moveSteps && random.nextInt(6) == 0)
1747: 				{
1748: 					eased = Math.min(1.0, Math.max(0.0, eased + (random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 0.035));
1749: 				}
1750: 
1751: 				double x = cubic(start.x, control1X, control2X, target.x, eased);
1752: 				double y = cubic(start.y, control1Y, control2Y, target.y, eased);
1753: 
1754: 				if (i < moveSteps)
1755: 				{
1756: 					double jitter = (1.0 - progress) * Math.min(5.0, Math.max(1.0, distance * 0.012));
1757: 					x += (random.nextDouble() * 2.0 - 1.0) * jitter;
1758: 					y += (random.nextDouble() * 2.0 - 1.0) * jitter;
1759: 				}
1760: 				else
1761: 				{
1762: 					x = target.x;
1763: 					y = target.y;
1764: 				}
1765: 
1766: 				delay += 12 + random.nextInt(10);
1767: 				if (i < moveSteps && random.nextInt(12) == 0)
1768: 				{
1769: 					delay += 25 + random.nextInt(50);
1770: 				}
1771: 
1772: 				steps.add(new MouseStep(MouseEvent.MOUSE_MOVED,
1773: 					new Point((int) Math.round(x), (int) Math.round(y)),
1774: 					MouseEvent.NOBUTTON, 0, 0, delay));
1775: 			}
1776: 		}
1777: 
1778: 		return steps;
1779: 	}

1781: 	private void appendClickSteps(List<MouseStep> steps, Point target, int button)
1782: 	{
1783: 		long pressDelay = steps.get(steps.size() - 1).delayMs + 30 + random.nextInt(70);
1784: 		int downMask = button == MouseEvent.BUTTON3
1785: 			? InputEvent.BUTTON3_DOWN_MASK
1786: 			: InputEvent.BUTTON1_DOWN_MASK;
1787: 
1788: 		steps.add(new MouseStep(MouseEvent.MOUSE_PRESSED, target, button, 1, downMask, pressDelay));
1789: 		long releaseDelay = pressDelay + 45 + random.nextInt(75);
1790: 		steps.add(new MouseStep(MouseEvent.MOUSE_RELEASED, target, button, 1, 0, releaseDelay));
1791: 		steps.add(new MouseStep(MouseEvent.MOUSE_CLICKED, target, button, 1, 0,
1792: 			releaseDelay + 15 + random.nextInt(35)));
1793: 	}

1795: 	private static double cubic(double a, double b, double c, double d, double t)
1796: 	{
1797: 		double u = 1.0 - t;
1798: 		return u * u * u * a + 3.0 * u * u * t * b + 3.0 * u * t * t * c + t * t * t * d;
1799: 	}

1857: 	private Point randomPoint(Shape shape)
1858: 	{

1861: 			return null;
1862: 		}
1863: 
1864: 		Rectangle bounds = shape.getBounds();
1865: 		if (bounds == null || bounds.isEmpty())

1867: 			return null;
1868: 		}
1869: 
1870: 		double centerX = bounds.getCenterX();
1871: 		double centerY = bounds.getCenterY();
1872: 
1873: 		for (int i = 0; i < RANDOM_POINT_ATTEMPTS; i++)
1874: 		{
1875: 			int x = (int) Math.round(centerX + (random.nextDouble() * 2.0 - 1.0) * bounds.width * 0.36);
1876: 			int y = (int) Math.round(centerY + (random.nextDouble() * 2.0 - 1.0) * bounds.height * 0.36);
1877: 			if (shape.contains(x, y) && isInViewport(x, y) && !isCoveredByInterface(x, y))
1878: 			{
1879: 				return new Point(x, y);
1880: 			}
1881: 		}
1882: 
1883: 		int x = (int) Math.round(centerX);
1884: 		int y = (int) Math.round(centerY);
1885: 		return shape.contains(x, y) && isInViewport(x, y) && !isCoveredByInterface(x, y)
1886: 			? new Point(x, y)
1887: 			: null;
1888: 	}

186: 	@Subscribe

224: 	@Subscribe
225: 	public void onCommandExecuted(CommandExecuted event)
226: 	{
227: 		if (!"rsbuddy".equalsIgnoreCase(event.getCommand()))
228: 		{
229: 			return;
230: 		}
231: 
232: 		String[] args = event.getArguments();
233: 		if (args.length == 0 || "status".equalsIgnoreCase(args[0]))
234: 		{
235: 			Script active = scriptManager == null ? null : scriptManager.getActiveScript();
236: 			if (active == null)
237: 			{
238: 				chat("RSBuddy: no script running");
239: 			}
240: 			else
241: 			{
242: 				chat("RSBuddy: " + active.getName() + " - " + active.getStatus());
243: 			}
244: 			return;
245: 		}
246: 
247: 		switch (args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))
248: 		{
249: 			case "start":
250: 				startScriptByName(args.length > 1 ? args[1] : null);
251: 				break;
252: 			case "stop":
253: 				scriptManager.stop();
254: 				chat("RSBuddy: stopped");
255: 				break;
256: 			case "list":
257: 				chat("RSBuddy scripts: " + scriptManager.getScripts().stream()
258: 					.map(Script::getName)
259: 					.reduce((left, right) -> left + ", " + right)
260: 					.orElse("none"));
261: 				break;
262: 			case "widgets":
263: 				dumpWidgets(String.join(" ", java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(args, 1, args.length)));
264: 				break;
265: 			case "watch":
266: 				startWatch(args.length > 1 ? args[1] : null);
267: 				break;
268: 			case "probe":
269: 				startProbe();
270: 				break;
271: 			default:
272: 				chat("Usage: ::rsbuddy [status|list|start [name]|stop|widgets [label]|watch [seconds]]");
273: 				break;
274: 		}
275: 	}

287: 	private String registerCustomScript(String className)
288: 	{
289: 		if (className == null || className.trim().isEmpty())
290: 		{
291: 			return null;
292: 		}
293: 
294: 		try
295: 		{
296: 			Script script = ScriptLoader.load(className, getClass().getClassLoader());
297: 			scriptManager.register(script);
298: 			return null;
299: 		}
300: 		catch (ScriptLoader.ScriptLoadException ex)
301: 		{
302: 			log.warn("Unable to load custom script {}", className, ex);
303: 			return ex.getMessage();
304: 		}
305: 	}
306: 
307: 	private void startScriptByName(String name)
308: 	{
309: 		Optional<Script> script = scriptManager.getScripts().stream()
310: 			.filter(candidate -> name == null
311: 				|| candidate.getName().equalsIgnoreCase(name)
312: 				|| candidate.getClass().getSimpleName().equalsIgnoreCase(name))
313: 			.findFirst();
314: 
315: 		if (script.isEmpty())
316: 		{
317: 			chat("RSBuddy: script not found");
318: 			return;
319: 		}
320: 
321: 		startScript(script.get());
322: 	}
323: 
324: 	void startScript(Script script)
325: 	{
326: 		if (script == null || scriptManager == null)
327: 		{
328: 			return;
329: 		}
330: 
331: 		Script target = script;
332: 
333: 		// Recreate config-backed scripts so changes are picked up when starting from the panel.
334: 		if (script instanceof ObjectInteractScript)
335: 		{
336: 			target = new ObjectInteractScript(
337: 				config.targetObjectName(),
338: 				config.targetAction(),
339: 				config.maxDistance());
340: 		}
341: 
342: 		scriptManager.start(target);
343: 		chat("RSBuddy: started " + target.getName());
344: 	}
345: 
346: 	private void chat(String message)
347: 	{
348: 		clientThread.invokeLater(() ->
349: 			client.addChatMessage(ChatMessageType.GAMEMESSAGE, "", message, null));
350: 	}
351: 
352: 	/**
353: 	 * Starts a timed widget watch. Snapshots are taken automatically whenever
354: 	 * the visible interface changes, so interfaces that grab keyboard focus
355: 	 * (like the GE item search) can be captured without typing a command.
356: 	 */
357: 	private void startWatch(String secondsArg)
358: 	{
359: 		int seconds = 60;
360: 		if (secondsArg != null && !secondsArg.isEmpty())
361: 		{
362: 			try
363: 			{
364: 				seconds = Integer.parseInt(secondsArg.trim());
365: 			}
366: 			catch (NumberFormatException ignored)
367: 			{
368: 				// Keep the default.
369: 			}
370: 		}
371: 
372: 		seconds = Math.max(5, Math.min(300, seconds));
373: 		watcher = new WidgetWatcher(seconds);
374: 
375: 		chat("RSBuddy: watching widgets for " + seconds + "s. Just click through the screens now.");
376: 		chat("RSBuddy: snapshots append to " + WidgetDumper.getLogFile());
377: 	}
378: 
379: 	/**
380: 	 * Runs the sell-screen probe: it opens a sell offer, hovers an inventory
381: 	 * item, records the menu and setup widgets, then backs out without
382: 	 * confirming anything. Used to capture interface details automatically.
383: 	 */
384: 	private void startProbe()
385: 	{
386: 		GameInput currentInput = input;
387: 		if (currentInput == null)
388: 		{
389: 			chat("RSBuddy: input is not ready yet.");
390: 			return;
391: 		}
392: 
393: 		probe = new GeProbe(client, currentInput, new Inventory(client, currentInput),
394: 			message -> chat("RSBuddy: " + message));
395: 		chat("RSBuddy: probing the GE sell screen. Do not click until it says it is done.");
396: 	}
397: 
398: 	/**
399: 	 * Appends a snapshot of the visible interface to the widget dump file so
400: 	 * interface ids and actions can be read off disk instead of hovering each
401: 	 * element in RuneLite's widget inspector.
402: 	 */
403: 	private void dumpWidgets(String label)
404: 	{
405: 		if (label == null || label.isEmpty())
406: 		{
407: 			label = "manual";
408: 		}
409: 
410: 		try
411: 		{
412: 			int count = WidgetDumper.snapshot(client, label);
413: 			chat("RSBuddy: widget snapshot '" + label + "' (" + count + " widgets) -> "
414: 				+ WidgetDumper.getLogFile());
415: 		}
416: 		catch (Exception ex)
417: 		{
418: 			log.warn("Unable to write widget snapshot", ex);
419: 			chat("RSBuddy: widget snapshot failed: " + ex.getClass().getSimpleName()
420: 				+ ": " + ex.getMessage());
421: 		}
422: 	}
423: }

56: /**
57:  * Harpoons sharks at Catherby, banks them when the inventory is full, and walks
58:  * back to the fishing spots to start over.
59:  * <p>
60:  * The harpoon is kept in a blocked inventory slot, so depositing the inventory
61:  * banks only the sharks. The script never deposits on its own; it only clicks
62:  * the bank's "Deposit inventory" button.
63:  */

743: 		long remaining = Math.max(0L, Experience.getXpForLevel(level + 1) - xp);
744: 		return "XP to level " + (level + 1) + ": " + formatNumber(remaining);
745: 	}

747: 	private static String formatPerHour(int amount, long elapsedMs)
748: 	{
749: 		long perHour = elapsedMs <= 0 ? 0 : Math.round(amount * 3_600_000.0 / elapsedMs);
750: 		return formatNumber(perHour);
751: 	}
752: 
753: 	private static String formatDuration(long millis)
754: 	{
755: 		long seconds = Math.max(0L, millis / 1000L);
756: 		long hours = seconds / 3600L;
757: 		long minutes = (seconds % 3600L) / 60L;
758: 		long remainingSeconds = seconds % 60L;
759: 
760: 		if (hours > 0)
761: 		{
762: 			return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%dh %02dm", hours, minutes);
763: 		}
764: 
765: 		if (minutes > 0)
766: 		{
767: 			return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%dm %02ds", minutes, remainingSeconds);
768: 		}
769: 
770: 		return remainingSeconds + "s";
771: 	}
772: 
773: 	private static String formatNumber(long value)
774: 	{
775: 		return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%,d", value);
776: 	}

69: 	private static final WorldPoint HILL_GIANTS = new WorldPoint(3116, 9853, 0);
70: 	private static final WorldPoint DUNGEON_LADDER = new WorldPoint(3116, 9853, 0);
71: 	private static final WorldPoint SURFACE_DOOR = new WorldPoint(3115, 3450, 0);
72: 	private static final WorldPoint SURFACE_LADDER = new WorldPoint(3116, 3453, 0);
73: 	private static final WorldPoint WEST_VARROCK_BANK = new WorldPoint(3186, 3444, 0);
74: 
75: 	private static final int DOOR_ID = 1804;
76: 	private static final int LADDER_ID = 17384;
77: 	private static final int BANK_BOOTH_ID = 10583;
78: 
79: 	private static final int BRASS_KEY_ID = ItemID.EDGEVILLEDUNGEONKEY;
80: 	private static final int SARDINE_ID = ItemID.SARDINE;
81: 	private static final int BRASS_KEY_AMOUNT = 1;
82: 	private static final int SARDINE_AMOUNT = 5;
83: 	private static final int BANK_STAGE_ATTEMPTS = 20;
84: 
85: 	private static final int EAT_THRESHOLD_PERCENT = 50;
86: 
87: 	/**
88: 	 * Hill giants drop big bones, body talismans, giant keys, and a handful
89: 	 * of stackable or herb drops worth picking up.
90: 	 */
91: 	private static boolean isLootItem(int itemId)
92: 	{
93: 		switch (itemId)
94: 		{
95: 			case ItemID.BIG_BONES:
96: 			case ItemID.BODY_TALISMAN:
97: 			case ItemID.TIARA_BODY:
98: 			case ItemID.HILLGIANT_BOSS_KEY:
99: 			case ItemID.DEATHRUNE:
100: 			case ItemID.COSMICRUNE:
101: 			case ItemID.LAWRUNE:
102: 			case ItemID.LIMPWURT_ROOT:
103: 				return true;
104: 			default:
105: 				return false;
106: 		}
107: 	}
108: 
109: 	private enum State
110: 	{
111: 		HUNT,
112: 		LOOT,
113: 		WALK_TO_BANK,
114: 		BANK,
115: 		WALK_TO_GIANTS
116: 	}
117: 
118: 	private enum BankStage
119: 	{
120: 		DEPOSIT,
121: 		WAIT_DEPOSIT,
122: 		WITHDRAW_KEY,
123: 		WITHDRAW_SARDINES,
124: 		LEAVE
125: 	}
126: 
127: 	private static final int[][] WALK_DIRECTIONS = {
128: 		{0, 1}, {1, 0}, {1, 1}, {1, -1},
129: 		{0, -1}, {-1, 0}, {-1, -1}, {-1, 1}
130: 	};
131: 
132: 	private State state;
133: 	private int cooldown;
134: 	private WorldPoint lastWalkLocation;
135: 	private int stationaryTicks;
136: 	private WorldPoint lootTarget;
137: 	private int lootTargetItemId;
138: 	private int lootAttempts;
139: 	private int lootTargetTicks;
140: 	private BankStage bankStage;
141: 	private int bankAttempts;
142: 	private boolean returningFromBank;
143: 	private boolean shedDoorOpen;
144: 	private final java.util.Set<WorldPoint> ignoredLoot = new java.util.HashSet<>();
145: 
146: 	public HillGiantScript()
147: 	{
148: 		super("Hill Giant (Edgeville)", "Kills hill giants in the Edgeville Dungeon and banks loot.");
149: 	}
150: 
151: 	@Override
152: 	protected void onStart()
153: 	{
154: 		// onStart runs on the Swing thread, so it must not touch the client.
155: 		// The initial state is chosen on the first game tick instead.
156: 		cooldown = 0;
157: 		state = null;
158: 		lastWalkLocation = null;
159: 		stationaryTicks = 0;
160: 		lootTarget = null;
161: 		lootTargetItemId = -1;
162: 		lootAttempts = 0;
163: 		lootTargetTicks = 0;
164: 		bankStage = null;
165: 		bankAttempts = 0;
166: 		returningFromBank = false;
167: 		shedDoorOpen = false;
168: 		ignoredLoot.clear();
169: 		setStatus("Ready");
170: 	}
171: 
172: 	@Override
173: 	protected void onGameTick()
174: 	{
175: 		ScriptContext context = getContext();
176: 
177: 		if (!context.isLoggedIn())
178: 		{
179: 			setStatus("Waiting for login");
180: 			return;
181: 		}
182: 
183: 		if (state == null)
184: 		{
185: 			WorldPoint location = context.getPlayerLocation();
186: 			if (location != null && location.getY() < 9000)
187: 			{
188: 				// Starting on the surface means the shed door is between
189: 				// us and the ladder, so approach the door first.
190: 				returningFromBank = true;
191: 				state = State.WALK_TO_GIANTS;
192: 			}
193: 			else
194: 			{
195: 				state = State.HUNT;
196: 			}
197: 		}
198: 
199: 		if (cooldown > 0)
200: 		{
201: 			--cooldown;
202: 			return;
203: 		}
204: 
205: 		eatIfNeeded(context);
206: 
207: 		switch (state)
208: 		{
209: 			case HUNT:
210: 				hunt(context);
211: 				break;
212: 			case LOOT:
213: 				loot(context);
214: 				break;
215: 			case WALK_TO_BANK:
216: 				walkToBank(context);
217: 				break;
218: 			case BANK:
219: 				bank(context);
220: 				break;
221: 			case WALK_TO_GIANTS:
222: 				walkToGiants(context);
223: 				break;
224: 		}
225: 	}
226: 
227: 	private void hunt(ScriptContext context)
228: 	{
229: 		Inventory inventory = context.getInventory();
230: 
231: 		// A menu left over from a previous loot/interaction would block
232: 		// clicking giants and walking. Close it before hunting.
233: 		if (context.getClient().isMenuOpen())
234: 		{
235: 			context.getInput().closeMenu();
236: 			return;
237: 		}
238: 
239: 		if (inventory.isFull())
240: 		{
241: 			state = State.WALK_TO_BANK;
242: 			setStatus("Inventory full");
243: 			return;
244: 		}
245: 
246: 		GroundLoot loot = findGroundLoot(context);
247: 		if (loot != null)
248: 		{
249: 			state = State.LOOT;
250: 			setStatus("Looting");
251: 			return;
252: 		}
253: 
254: 		Player player = context.getPlayer();
255: 		NPC interacting = player != null && player.getInteracting() instanceof NPC
256: 			? (NPC) player.getInteracting()
257: 			: null;
258: 		if (interacting != null)
259: 		{
260: 			// Any active NPC interaction blocks a new attack. Auto-retaliate
261: 			// may have started a fight with something other than a hill
262: 			// giant, so wait for that fight to finish instead of spamming
263: 			// attack clicks that the game will reject.
264: 			String interactingName = getNpcName(interacting);
265: 			setStatus((interacting.isDead() ? "Finishing " : "Fighting ") + interactingName);
266: 			return;
267: 		}
268: 
269: 		GameInput input = context.getInput();
270: 		if (input.isBusy())
271: 		{
272: 			setStatus("Moving mouse");
273: 			return;
274: 		}
275: 
276: 		Optional<NPC> target = findHillGiant(context);
277: 		if (target.isPresent())
278: 		{
279: 			if (input.interact(target.get(), ATTACK_ACTION))
280: 			{
281: 				cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
282: 				setStatus("Attacking " + NPC_NAME);
283: 			}
284: 			else
285: 			{
286: 				cooldown = 2;
287: 				setStatus("Cannot attack " + NPC_NAME);
288: 			}
289: 			return;
290: 		}
291: 
292: 		openDoor(context);
293: 		cooldown = 2;
294: 		setStatus("No " + NPC_NAME + " nearby");
295: 	}
296: 
297: 	private void loot(ScriptContext context)
298: 	{
299: 		Inventory inventory = context.getInventory();
300: 
301: 		if (inventory.isFull())
302: 		{
303: 			state = State.WALK_TO_BANK;
304: 			setStatus("Inventory full");
305: 			return;
306: 		}
307: 
308: 		GroundLoot loot = findGroundLoot(context);
309: 		if (loot == null)
310: 		{
311: 			context.getInput().closeMenu();
312: 			state = State.HUNT;
313: 			setStatus("Hunting");
314: 			return;
315: 		}
316: 
317: 		GameInput input = context.getInput();
318: 		if (input.isBusy())
319: 		{
320: 			setStatus("Moving mouse");
321: 			return;
322: 		}
323: 
324: 		if (!java.util.Objects.equals(lootTarget, loot.worldLocation)
325: 			|| lootTargetItemId != loot.itemId)
326: 		{
327: 			lootTarget = loot.worldLocation;
328: 			lootTargetItemId = loot.itemId;
329: 			lootAttempts = 0;
330: 			lootTargetTicks = 0;
331: 		}
332: 
333: 		if (++lootTargetTicks > LOOT_TARGET_TIMEOUT_TICKS && loot.worldLocation != null)
334: 		{
335: 			// The drop is probably behind an obstacle or otherwise
336: 			// unreachable. Ignore it so the script does not get stuck.
337: 			ignoredLoot.add(loot.worldLocation);
338: 			lootTarget = null;
339: 			lootTargetItemId = -1;
340: 			lootAttempts = 0;
341: 			lootTargetTicks = 0;
342: 			state = State.HUNT;
343: 			setStatus("Skipping unreachable loot");
344: 			return;
345: 		}
346: 
347: 		Player player = context.getPlayer();
348: 		WorldPoint location = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
349: 		if (location != null && loot.worldLocation != null
350: 			&& location.distanceTo(loot.worldLocation) > 2)
351: 		{
352: 			walkTowards(context, loot.worldLocation);
353: 			lootAttempts = 0;
354: 			setStatus("Walking to loot");
355: 			return;
356: 		}
357: 
358: 		Client client = context.getClient();
359: 		String itemName = getItemName(client, loot.itemId);
360: 		input.takeGroundItem(loot.sceneX, loot.sceneY, loot.itemId, itemName);
361: 		cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
362: 
363: 		if (++lootAttempts > LOOT_ATTEMPT_LIMIT && loot.worldLocation != null)
364: 		{
365: 			ignoredLoot.add(loot.worldLocation);
366: 			lootTarget = null;
367: 			lootTargetItemId = -1;
368: 			lootAttempts = 0;
369: 			lootTargetTicks = 0;
370: 			state = State.HUNT;
371: 			setStatus("Skipping unreachable loot");
372: 			return;
373: 		}
374: 
375: 		setStatus(itemName.isEmpty() ? "Looting" : "Looting " + itemName);
376: 	}
377: 
378: 	private void walkToBank(ScriptContext context)
379: 	{
380: 		Player player = context.getPlayer();
381: 		WorldPoint location = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
382: 		if (location == null)
383: 		{
384: 			return;
385: 		}
386: 
387: 		if (!isInDungeon(location))
388: 		{
389: 			if (location.distanceTo(WEST_VARROCK_BANK) <= 8)
390: 			{
391: 				state = State.BANK;
392: 				setStatus("Banking");
393: 				return;
394: 			}
395: 
396: 			// After climbing up we are inside the shed with the brass-key
397: 			// door shut behind us. Open it once, then walk away using the
398: 			// minimap so the walk click cannot hit and toggle the door.
399: 			if (!shedDoorOpen
400: 				&& location.distanceTo(SURFACE_DOOR) <= 10
401: 				&& openDoor(context))
402: 			{
403: 				setStatus("Opening door");
404: 				return;
405: 			}
406: 
407: 			walkTowards(context, WEST_VARROCK_BANK, true);
408: 			setStatus("Walking to bank");
409: 		}
410: 		else
411: 		{
412: 			if (location.distanceTo(DUNGEON_LADDER) <= 8)
413: 			{
414: 				climb(context, true, LADDER_ID);
415: 			}
416: 			else
417: 			{
418: 				walkTowards(context, DUNGEON_LADDER);
419: 			}
420: 			setStatus("Walking to bank");
421: 		}
422: 	}
423: 
424: 	private void bank(ScriptContext context)
425: 	{
426: 		Inventory inventory = context.getInventory();
427: 		GameInput input = context.getInput();
428: 
429: 		Widget bankUniverse = context.getTargets().findWidget(InterfaceID.Bankmain.UNIVERSE).orElse(null);
430: 		if (bankUniverse == null)
431: 		{
432: 			bankStage = null;
433: 			bankAttempts = 0;
434: 
435: 			if (input.isBusy())
436: 			{
437: 				setStatus("Moving mouse");
438: 				return;
439: 			}
440: 
441: 			Optional<GameObject> booth = context.getTargets().findObject(BANK_BOOTH_ID, 10);
442: 			if (booth.isEmpty())
443: 			{
444: 				booth = context.getTargets().findObject("Bank booth", "Bank", 10);
445: 			}
446: 			if (booth.isPresent())
447: 			{
448: 				if (input.interact(booth.get(), "Bank"))
449: 				{
450: 					cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
451: 					setStatus("Opening bank");
452: 				}
453: 				return;
454: 			}
455: 
456: 			Optional<NPC> banker = context.getTargets().findNpc("Banker", "Bank", 10);
457: 			if (banker.isPresent())
458: 			{
459: 				if (input.interact(banker.get(), "Bank"))
460: 				{
461: 					cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
462: 					setStatus("Opening bank");
463: 				}
464: 				return;
465: 			}
466: 
467: 			cooldown = 2;
468: 			setStatus("No bank nearby");
469: 			return;
470: 		}
471: 
472: 		if (bankStage == null)
473: 		{
474: 			bankStage = BankStage.DEPOSIT;
475: 			bankAttempts = 0;
476: 		}
477: 
478: 		if (input.isBusy())
479: 		{
480: 			setStatus("Moving mouse");
481: 			return;
482: 		}
483: 
484: 		// The withdraw stages handle their own context menus. Any other menu
485: 		// would swallow the click on the deposit button.
486: 		if (context.getClient().isMenuOpen()
487: 			&& bankStage != BankStage.WITHDRAW_KEY
488: 			&& bankStage != BankStage.WITHDRAW_SARDINES)
489: 		{
490: 			input.closeMenu();
491: 			return;
492: 		}
493: 
494: 		switch (bankStage)
495: 		{
496: 			case DEPOSIT:
497: 			{
498: 				Widget deposit = context.getTargets()
499: 					.findWidget(InterfaceID.Bankmain.DEPOSITINV)
500: 					.orElse(null);
501: 				if (deposit != null && input.click(deposit))
502: 				{
503: 					bankStage = BankStage.WAIT_DEPOSIT;
504: 					bankAttempts = 0;
505: 					cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
506: 				}
507: 				else
508: 				{
509: 					++bankAttempts;
510: 					cooldown = 1;
511: 				}
512: 				setStatus("Depositing loot");
513: 				return;
514: 			}
515: 			case WAIT_DEPOSIT:
516: 			{
517: 				if (inventory.getEmptySlots() >= Inventory.SIZE)
518: 				{
519: 					bankStage = BankStage.WITHDRAW_KEY;
520: 					bankAttempts = 0;
521: 					setStatus("Withdrawing brass key");
522: 					return;
523: 				}
524: 
525: 				if (++bankAttempts > BANK_STAGE_ATTEMPTS)
526: 				{
527: 					// The deposit click did not register. Try the button
528: 					// again instead of waiting forever.
529: 					bankStage = BankStage.DEPOSIT;
530: 					bankAttempts = 0;
531: 				}
532: 				setStatus("Depositing loot");
533: 				return;
534: 			}
535: 			case WITHDRAW_KEY:
536: 			{
537: 				if (inventory.countItem(BRASS_KEY_ID) >= BRASS_KEY_AMOUNT)
538: 				{
539: 					bankStage = BankStage.WITHDRAW_SARDINES;
540: 					bankAttempts = 0;
541: 					setStatus("Withdrawing sardines");
542: 					return;
543: 				}
544: 
545: 				if (++bankAttempts > BANK_STAGE_ATTEMPTS)
546: 				{
547: 					// No key available in the bank. Continue with the food
548: 					// instead of retrying forever.
549: 					bankStage = BankStage.WITHDRAW_SARDINES;
550: 					bankAttempts = 0;
551: 					setStatus("No brass key in bank");
552: 					return;
553: 				}
554: 
555: 				if (input.withdrawBankItem(BRASS_KEY_ID, "Withdraw-1"))
556: 				{
557: 					cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
558: 				}
559: 				else
560: 				{
561: 					cooldown = 1;
562: 				}
563: 				setStatus("Withdrawing brass key");
564: 				return;
565: 			}
566: 			case WITHDRAW_SARDINES:
567: 			{
568: 				if (inventory.countItem(SARDINE_ID) >= SARDINE_AMOUNT)
569: 				{
570: 					bankStage = BankStage.LEAVE;
571: 					bankAttempts = 0;
572: 					setStatus("Leaving bank");
573: 					return;
574: 				}
575: 
576: 				if (++bankAttempts > BANK_STAGE_ATTEMPTS)
577: 				{
578: 					bankStage = BankStage.LEAVE;
579: 					bankAttempts = 0;
580: 					setStatus("No sardines in bank");
581: 					return;
582: 				}
583: 
584: 				if (input.withdrawBankItem(SARDINE_ID, "Withdraw-5"))
585: 				{
586: 					cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
587: 				}
588: 				else
589: 				{
590: 					cooldown = 1;
591: 				}
592: 				setStatus("Withdrawing sardines");
593: 				return;
594: 			}
595: 			case LEAVE:
596: 			{
597: 				if (context.getClient().isMenuOpen())
598: 				{
599: 					input.closeMenu();
600: 					return;
601: 				}
602: 
603: 				input.pressKey(java.awt.event.KeyEvent.VK_ESCAPE);
604: 				cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
605: 				ignoredLoot.clear();
606: 				bankStage = null;
607: 				bankAttempts = 0;
608: 				returningFromBank = true;
609: 				shedDoorOpen = false;
610: 				state = State.WALK_TO_GIANTS;
611: 				setStatus("Returning to hill giants");
612: 				return;
613: 			}
614: 		}
615: 	}

617: 
618: 	private void walkToGiants(ScriptContext context)
619: 	{
620: 		Player player = context.getPlayer();
621: 		WorldPoint location = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
622: 		if (location == null)
623: 		{
624: 			return;
625: 		}
626: 
627: 		if (isInDungeon(location))
628: 		{
629: 			returningFromBank = false;
630: 
631: 			if (location.distanceTo(HILL_GIANTS) <= 8)
632: 			{
633: 				state = State.HUNT;
634: 				setStatus("Hunting");
635: 				return;
636: 			}
637: 			walkTowards(context, HILL_GIANTS);
638: 			setStatus("Walking to hill giants");
639: 		}
640: 		else
641: 		{
642: 			boolean nearShed = location.distanceTo(SURFACE_DOOR) <= 3
643: 				|| location.distanceTo(SURFACE_LADDER) <= 3;
644: 
645: 			// Coming back from the bank the shed door is normally shut and
646: 			// blocks the ladder inside. Always open it before targeting the
647: 			// ladder, even when the collision map still looks walkable.
648: 			if (!shedDoorOpen && returningFromBank && nearShed && openDoor(context))
649: 			{
650: 				setStatus("Opening door");
651: 				return;
652: 			}
653: 
654: 			boolean ladderReachable = canReach(context, SURFACE_LADDER);
655: 			boolean canClimb = ladderReachable || shedDoorOpen
656: 				|| location.distanceTo(SURFACE_LADDER) <= 2;
657: 
658: 			if (location.distanceTo(SURFACE_LADDER) <= 8 && canClimb)
659: 			{
660: 				climb(context, false, LADDER_ID);
661: 				setStatus("Climbing down");
662: 				return;
663: 			}
664: 
665: 			if (!shedDoorOpen
666: 				&& !ladderReachable
667: 				&& location.distanceTo(SURFACE_DOOR) <= 10
668: 				&& openDoor(context))
669: 			{
670: 				setStatus("Opening door");
671: 				return;
672: 			}
673: 
674: 			// Walk to the open door with the minimap so the walk click
675: 			// cannot toggle it, then approach the ladder inside.
676: 			WorldPoint target = !shedDoorOpen && (returningFromBank || !ladderReachable)
677: 				? SURFACE_DOOR
678: 				: SURFACE_LADDER;
679: 			walkTowards(context, target, true);
680: 			setStatus("Walking to hill giants");
681: 		}
682: 	}
683: 
684: 	private void eatIfNeeded(ScriptContext context)
685: 	{
686: 		Client client = context.getClient();
687: 		Inventory inventory = context.getInventory();
688: 
689: 		int current = client.getBoostedSkillLevel(Skill.HITPOINTS);
690: 		int max = client.getRealSkillLevel(Skill.HITPOINTS);
691: 		if (max <= 0 || current * 100 > max * EAT_THRESHOLD_PERCENT)
692: 		{
693: 			return;
694: 		}
695: 
696: 		int slot = inventory.findSlot(ItemID.SARDINE);
697: 		if (slot < 0)
698: 		{
699: 			return;
700: 		}
701: 
702: 		// Clicking a sardine while the bank is open deposits it instead of
703: 		// eating it, so wait until the bank is closed. A context menu also
704: 		// swallows the first click, so wait for it to close as well.
705: 		if (context.getTargets().findWidget(InterfaceID.Bankmain.UNIVERSE).isPresent()
706: 			|| context.getClient().isMenuOpen())
707: 		{
708: 			return;
709: 		}
710: 
711: 		GameInput input = context.getInput();
712: 		if (input.isBusy())
713: 		{
714: 			return;
715: 		}
716:

812: 	private void walkTowards(ScriptContext context, WorldPoint target, boolean useMinimap)
813: 	{
814: 		GameInput input = context.getInput();
815: 		if (input.isBusy())
816: 		{
817: 			return;
818: 		}
819: 
820: 		Player player = context.getPlayer();
821: 		WorldPoint location = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
822: 		if (location == null || location.distanceTo(target) <= 2)
823: 		{
824: 			lastWalkLocation = location;
825: 			stationaryTicks = 0;
826: 			return;
827: 		}
828: 
829: 		// Do not click again while the player is still moving. Re-clicking
830: 		// every tick interrupts the client's own path and makes it run into
831: 		// walls.
832: 		if (lastWalkLocation == null || !lastWalkLocation.equals(location))
833: 		{
834: 			lastWalkLocation = location;
835: 			stationaryTicks = 0;
836: 			return;
837: 		}
838: 
839: 		if (++stationaryTicks < 2)
840: 		{
841: 			return;
842: 		}
843: 
844: 		List<WorldPoint> path = findPath(context, target);
845: 		if (path.size() <= 1)
846: 		{
847: 			stationaryTicks = 0;
848: 			return;
849: 		}
850: 
851: 		// Click a point a few tiles along the collision-checked path.
852: 		int index = Math.min(path.size() - 1, 10);
853: 
854: 		// Minimap clicks never hit objects, so routes that pass a door
855: 		// (the shed door in particular) cannot accidentally toggle it.
856: 		if (useMinimap && clickMinimap(context, path.get(index)))
857: 		{
858: 			stationaryTicks = 0;
859: 			return;
860: 		}
861: 
862: 		for (int i = index; i >= 1; i--)
863: 		{
864: 			if (input.walkTo(path.get(i)))
865: 			{
866: 				stationaryTicks = 0;
867: 				return;
868: 			}
869: 		}
870: 
871: 		clickMinimap(context, path.get(index));
872: 		stationaryTicks = 0;
873: 	}

875: 	private boolean clickMinimap(ScriptContext context, WorldPoint point)
876: 	{
877: 		Client client = context.getClient();
878: 		net.runelite.api.coords.LocalPoint localPoint = net.runelite.api.coords.LocalPoint.fromWorld(client, point);
879: 		if (localPoint == null)
880: 		{
881: 			return false;
882: 		}
883: 
884: 		net.runelite.api.Point minimapPoint = net.runelite.api.Perspective.localToMinimap(client, localPoint);
885: 		if (minimapPoint == null)
886: 		{
887: 			return false;
888: 		}
889: 
890: 		return context.getInput().click(new java.awt.Point(minimapPoint.getX(), minimapPoint.getY()));
891: 	}

893: 	private List<WorldPoint> findPath(ScriptContext context, WorldPoint goal)
894: 	{
895: 		Client client = context.getClient();
896: 		Player player = context.getPlayer();
897: 		WorldPoint start = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
898: 		WorldView worldView = client.getTopLevelWorldView();
899: 		if (start == null || worldView == null)
900: 		{
901: 			return Collections.emptyList();
902: 		}
903: 
904: 		Scene scene = worldView.getScene();
905: 		CollisionData[] collisionMaps = worldView.getCollisionMaps();
906: 		int plane = worldView.getPlane();
907: 		if (scene == null || collisionMaps == null || plane < 0 || plane >= collisionMaps.length
908: 			|| collisionMaps[plane] == null)
909: 		{
910: 			return Collections.emptyList();
911: 		}
912: 
913: 		int[][] flags = collisionMaps[plane].getFlags();
914: 		if (flags == null || flags.length == 0)
915: 		{
916: 			return Collections.emptyList();
917: 		}
918: 
919: 		int width = flags.length;
920: 		int height = flags[0].length;
921: 		int baseX = scene.getBaseX();
922: 		int baseY = scene.getBaseY();
923: 		int startX = start.getX() - baseX;
924: 		int startY = start.getY() - baseY;
925: 		if (!inBounds(startX, startY, width, height))
926: 		{
927: 			return Collections.emptyList();
928: 		}
929: 
930: 		int goalX = goal.getX() - baseX;
931: 		int goalY = goal.getY() - baseY;
932: 		boolean goalInScene = inBounds(goalX, goalY, width, height);
933: 
934: 		int total = width * height;
935: 		int[] previous = new int[total];
936: 		Arrays.fill(previous, -1);
937: 		boolean[] visited = new boolean[total];
938: 		int[] queue = new int[total];
939: 		int head = 0;
940: 		int tail = 0;
941: 		int startIndex = startY * width + startX;
942: 		visited[startIndex] = true;
943: 		queue[tail++] = startIndex;
944: 
945: 		int bestIndex = startIndex;
946: 		long bestDistance = distanceSquared(baseX + startX, baseY + startY, goal);
947: 		int expansions = 0;
948: 
949: 		while (head < tail && expansions++ < total)
950: 		{
951: 			int current = queue[head++];
952: 			int x = current % width;
953: 			int y = current / width;
954: 
955: 			if (goalInScene && x == goalX && y == goalY)
956: 			{
957: 				bestIndex = current;
958: 				break;
959: 			}
960: 
961: 			long distance = distanceSquared(baseX + x, baseY + y, goal);
962: 			if (distance < bestDistance)
963: 			{
964: 				bestDistance = distance;
965: 				bestIndex = current;
966: 			}
967: 
968: 			for (int[] direction : WALK_DIRECTIONS)
969: 			{
970: 				int nextX = x + direction[0];
971: 				int nextY = y + direction[1];
972: 				if (!inBounds(nextX, nextY, width, height))
973: 				{
974: 					continue;
975: 				}
976: 
977: 				int nextIndex = nextY * width + nextX;
978: 				if (visited[nextIndex] || !canMove(flags, x, y, direction[0], direction[1]))
979: 				{
980: 					continue;
981: 				}
982: 
983: 				visited[nextIndex] = true;
984: 				previous[nextIndex] = current;
985: 				queue[tail++] = nextIndex;
986: 			}
987: 		}
988: 
989: 		List<WorldPoint> path = new ArrayList<>();
990: 		for (int index = bestIndex; index != -1; index = previous[index])
991: 		{
992: 			int x = index % width;
993: 			int y = index / width;
994: 			path.add(new WorldPoint(baseX + x, baseY + y, plane));
995: 			if (index == startIndex)
996: 			{
997: 				break;
998: 			}
999: 		}
1000: 
1001: 		Collections.reverse(path);
1002: 		return path;
1003: 	}

1005: 	private boolean canReach(ScriptContext context, WorldPoint goal)
1006: 	{
1007: 		List<WorldPoint> path = findPath(context, goal);
1008: 		if (path.isEmpty())
1009: 		{
1010: 			return false;
1011: 		}
1012: 
1013: 		WorldPoint end = path.get(path.size() - 1);
1014: 		return end.distanceTo(goal) <= 1;
1015: 	}

1017: 	private static boolean inBounds(int x, int y, int width, int height)
1018: 	{
1019: 		return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < width && y < height;
