1022: 	private static boolean canMove(int[][] flags, int x, int y, int dx, int dy)
1023: 	{
1024: 		int source = flags[x][y];
1025: 		int destination = flags[x + dx][y + dy];
1026: 
1027: 		// Solid objects, water, and similar tiles block movement into them.
1028: 		if ((destination & CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_FULL) != 0)
1029: 		{
1030: 			return false;
1031: 		}
1032: 
1033: 		int flag;
1034: 		int reverseFlag;
1035: 
1036: 		if (dx == 0)
1037: 		{
1038: 			flag = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH
1039: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH;
1040: 			reverseFlag = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH
1041: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH;
1042: 		}
1043: 		else if (dy == 0)
1044: 		{
1045: 			flag = dx > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_EAST
1046: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_WEST;
1047: 			reverseFlag = dx > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_WEST
1048: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_EAST;
1049: 		}
1050: 		else if (dx > 0)
1051: 		{
1052: 			flag = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH_EAST
1053: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH_EAST;
1054: 			reverseFlag = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH_WEST
1055: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH_WEST;
1056: 		}
1057: 		else
1058: 		{
1059: 			flag = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH_WEST
1060: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH_WEST;
1061: 			reverseFlag = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH_EAST
1062: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH_EAST;
1063: 		}
1064: 
1065: 		if ((source & flag) != 0 || (destination & reverseFlag) != 0)
1066: 		{
1067: 			return false;
1068: 		}
1069: 
1070: 		// Do not cut diagonally through the corner of a wall.
1071: 		if (dx != 0 && dy != 0)
1072: 		{
1073: 			int horizontal = dx > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_EAST
1074: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_WEST;
1075: 			int vertical = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH
1076: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH;
1077: 			if ((source & horizontal) != 0 || (source & vertical) != 0)
1078: 			{
1079: 				return false;
1080: 			}
1081: 		}
1082: 
1083: 		return true;
1084: 	}
1085: 
1086: 	private static long distanceSquared(int x, int y, WorldPoint target)
1087: 	{
1088: 		long dx = (long) x - target.getX();
1089: 		long dy = (long) y - target.getY();
1090: 		return dx * dx + dy * dy;
1091: 	}

54: /**
55:  * Fishes trout and salmon at Barbarian Village, cooks them on the nearby fire,
56:  * and drops the results.
57:  * <p>
58:  * The script expects the player to already be at the Barbarian Village fishing
59:  * spot. It never walks. If the fishing spot or fire is off screen, the camera
60:  * is turned toward it before clicking.
61:  */
62: public final class BarbarianFisherCookerScript extends Script
63: {
64: 	private static final int FISHING_SPOT_ID = NpcID._0_48_53_FRESHFISH;
65: 	private static final int FIRE_ID = ObjectID.FIRE_COOK;
66: 
67: 	private static final String FISH_ACTION = "Lure";
68: 	private static final String COOK_ACTION = "Cook";
69: 
70: 	// How many ticks to wait for a drop to show up in the inventory before
71: 	// trying it again.
72: 	private static final int DROP_RETRY_TICKS = 3;
73: 
74: 	private static final int FISHING_DISTANCE = 20;
75: 	private static final int FIRE_DISTANCE = 20;
76: 
77: 	private static final int CLICK_COOLDOWN = 3;
78: 	private static final int MAX_CAMERA_PULSES = 60;
79: 	private static final int COOK_STABLE_TICKS = 2;
80: 
81: 	// Default camera: fully zoomed out, pitched all the way up, facing west.
82: 	// The camera is moved with the same keys and mouse wheel a player uses.
83: 	private static final int CAMERA_ZOOM_NOTCHES = 60;
84: 	private static final int CAMERA_MAX_PITCH = 383;
85: 	private static final int CAMERA_PITCH_TOLERANCE = 4;
86: 	private static final int CAMERA_HOLD_MS = 800;
87: 	private static final int CAMERA_WEST_YAW = 4096;
88: 	private static final int CAMERA_YAW_TOLERANCE = 256;
89: 	private static final int CAMERA_SCALE_TOLERANCE = 4;
90: 	private static final long CAMERA_IDLE_RESET_MS = 10_000L;
91: 
92: 	// After clicking a fishing spot, wait for the fishing animation instead of
93: 	// clicking again while the player is still walking to the spot.
94: 	private static final long FISHING_START_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000L;
95: 	private static final long FISHING_ANIMATION_GAP_MS = 4000L;
96: 
97: 	// After clicking the fire, wait for the cooking interface or animation
98: 	// instead of clicking the fire again while the player is walking to it.
99: 	private static final long FIRE_INTERACTION_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000L;
100:

113: 	private int pitchKey = KeyEvent.VK_UP;
114: 	private int pitchBeforeHold = -1;
115: 	private boolean pitchHoldPending;
116: 	private boolean pitchDirectionLearned;
117:

120: 	private long lastFishingClickAt;
121: 	private long lastFishingAnimationAt;
122: 
123: 	private boolean awaitingFireInteraction;
124: 	private long lastFireClickAt;
125: 
126: 	private int pendingDropSlot = -1;
127: 	private int pendingDropItemId = -1;
128: 	private int pendingDropTicks;

141: 	public BarbarianFisherCookerScript()
142: 	{
143: 		super("Barbarian Fisher & Cooker",
144: 			"Fishes trout and salmon at Barbarian Village, cooks them on the fire, and drops them.");
145: 	}

147: 	@Override
148: 	protected void onStart()
149: 	{
150: 		cooldown = 0;
151: 		lastRawFish = -1;
152: 		rawStableTicks = 0;
153: 		spacePressed = false;
154: 		cameraAttempts = 0;
155: 		lastCameraTarget = -1;
156: 		cameraSetupActive = true;
157: 		cameraPhase = 0;
158: 		zoomStarted = false;
159: 		defaultCameraScale = 0;
160: 		lastCameraMaintenanceAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
161: 		pitchKey = KeyEvent.VK_UP;
162: 		pitchBeforeHold = -1;
163: 		pitchHoldPending = false;
164: 		pitchDirectionLearned = false;
165: 		resetFishingAttempt();
166: 		resetFireInteraction();
167: 		resetPendingDrop();
168: 		resetStats();
169: 		setStatus("Ready");
170: 	}

172: 	@Override
173: 	protected void onGameTick()
174: 	{
175: 		ScriptContext context = getContext();
176: 		Inventory inventory = context.getInventory();
177: 
178: 		if (!context.isLoggedIn())
179: 		{
180: 			setStatus("Waiting for login");
181: 			return;
182: 		}
183: 
184: 		updateStats();
185: 
186: 		if (cooldown > 0)
187: 		{
188: 			--cooldown;
189: 			return;
190: 		}
191: 
192: 		/*if (!ensureCamera(context))
193: 		{
194: 			return;
195: 		}
196: 
197: 		if (isIdleForCameraReset(context))
198: 		{
199: 			if (!ensureDefaultCamera(context))
200: 			{
201: 				return;
202: 			}
203: 		}*/
204: 
205: 		int rawFish = inventory.countRawFish();
206: 		int droppableFish = inventory.countDroppableFish();
207: 		int emptySlots = inventory.getEmptySlots();
208: 
209: 		if (rawFish == 0)
210: 		{
211: 			lastRawFish = 0;
212: 			rawStableTicks = 0;
213: 			spacePressed = false;
214: 			cameraAttempts = 0;
215: 			lastCameraTarget = -1;
216: 		}
217: 
218: 		if (rawFish > 0 && (emptySlots == 0 || inventory.hasCookedFish()))
219: 		{
220: 			cook(context, rawFish);
221: 		}
222: 		else if (rawFish > 0)
223: 		{
224: 			fish(context);
225: 		}
226: 		else if (droppableFish > 0)
227: 		{
228: 			drop(context, inventory);
229: 		}
230: 		else
231: 		{
232: 			fish(context);
233: 		}
234: 	}

236: 	@Override
237: 	public List<String> getOverlayLines()
238: 	{
239: 		if (!statsInitialized)
240: 		{
241: 			return Collections.emptyList();
242: 		}
243: 
244: 		Client client = getContext().getClient();
245: 		long elapsed = Math.max(1L, System.currentTimeMillis() - statsStartedAt);
246: 
247: 		List<String> lines = new ArrayList<>();
248: 		lines.add("");
249: 		lines.add("Fishing");
250: 		lines.add("Total fish: " + formatNumber(fishCaught) + " (" + formatPerHour(fishCaught, elapsed) + "/hr)");
251: 		lines.add(formatXpToNextLevel(client, Skill.FISHING));
252: 		lines.add("XP per hour: " + formatNumber(fishingXpPerHour));
253: 		lines.add(formatTimeToNextLevel(client, Skill.FISHING, startFishingXp, elapsed));
254: 		lines.add("Actions to next level: " + formatActions(fishingActionsToNextLevel(client, Skill.FISHING)));
255: 		lines.add("");
256: 		lines.add("Cooking");
257: 		lines.add("Total cooked: " + formatNumber(fishCooked) + " (" + formatPerHour(fishCooked, elapsed) + "/hr)");
258: 		lines.add(formatXpToNextLevel(client, Skill.COOKING));
259: 		lines.add("XP per hour: " + formatNumber(cookingXpPerHour));
260: 		lines.add(formatTimeToNextLevel(client, Skill.COOKING, startCookingXp, elapsed));
261: 		lines.add("Actions to next level: " + formatActions(cookingActionsToNextLevel(client, Skill.COOKING)));
262: 		lines.add("");
263: 		lines.add("Total time: " + formatDuration(elapsed));
264: 		return lines;
265: 	}

267: 	@Override
268: 	public List<ProgressBar> getProgressBars()
269: 	{
270: 		if (!statsInitialized)
271: 		{
272: 			return Collections.emptyList();
273: 		}
274: 
275: 		Client client = getContext().getClient();
276: 
277: 		List<ProgressBar> bars = new ArrayList<>();

283: 	private Script.ProgressBar fishingProgressBar(Client client)
284: 	{
285: 		int level = client.getRealSkillLevel(Skill.FISHING);
286: 		if (level >= Experience.MAX_REAL_LEVEL)
287: 		{
288: 			return new Script.ProgressBar("Fishing", 1.0, "Max level", Color.GREEN);
289: 		}
290: 
291: 		long xp = client.getSkillExperience(Skill.FISHING);
292: 		long currentLevelXp = Experience.getXpForLevel(level);
293: 		long nextLevelXp = Experience.getXpForLevel(level + 1);
294: 		long progressXp = Math.max(0L, xp - currentLevelXp);
295: 		long totalXp = Math.max(1L, nextLevelXp - currentLevelXp);
296: 		double progress = (double) progressXp / totalXp;
297: 		String value = formatNumber(xp) + " / " + formatNumber(nextLevelXp);
298: 		return new Script.ProgressBar("Fishing", progress, value, Color.GREEN);
299: 	}
300: 
301: 	private Script.ProgressBar cookingProgressBar(Client client)
302: 	{
303: 		int level = client.getRealSkillLevel(Skill.COOKING);
304: 		if (level >= Experience.MAX_REAL_LEVEL)
305: 		{
306: 			return new Script.ProgressBar("Cooking", 1.0, "Max level", Color.CYAN);
307: 		}
308: 
309: 		long xp = client.getSkillExperience(Skill.COOKING);
310: 		long currentLevelXp = Experience.getXpForLevel(level);
311: 		long nextLevelXp = Experience.getXpForLevel(level + 1);
312: 		long progressXp = Math.max(0L, xp - currentLevelXp);
313: 		long totalXp = Math.max(1L, nextLevelXp - currentLevelXp);
314: 		double progress = (double) progressXp / totalXp;
315: 		String value = formatNumber(xp) + " / " + formatNumber(nextLevelXp);
316: 		return new Script.ProgressBar("Cooking", progress, value, Color.CYAN);
317: 	}

319: 	private int fishingActionsToNextLevel(Client client, Skill skill)
320: 	{
321: 		int level = client.getRealSkillLevel(skill);
322: 		if (level >= Experience.MAX_REAL_LEVEL)
323: 		{
324: 			return 0;
325: 		}
326: 
327: 		long xp = client.getSkillExperience(skill);
328: 		long remaining = Math.max(0L, Experience.getXpForLevel(level + 1) - xp);
329: 		long gained = Math.max(0L, xp - startFishingXp);
330: 		if (fishCaught <= 0 || gained <= 0)
331: 		{
332: 			return -1;
333: 		}
334: 
335: 		long xpPerFish = gained / fishCaught;
336: 		if (xpPerFish <= 0)
337: 		{
338: 			return -1;
339: 		}
340: 
341: 		long actions = remaining / xpPerFish;
342: 		return actions > Integer.MAX_VALUE ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : (int) actions;
343: 	}
344: 
345: 	private int cookingActionsToNextLevel(Client client, Skill skill)
346: 	{
347: 		int level = client.getRealSkillLevel(skill);
348: 		if (level >= Experience.MAX_REAL_LEVEL)
349: 		{
350: 			return 0;
351: 		}
352: 
353: 		long xp = client.getSkillExperience(skill);
354: 		long remaining = Math.max(0L, Experience.getXpForLevel(level + 1) - xp);
355: 		long gained = Math.max(0L, xp - startCookingXp);
356: 		if (fishCooked <= 0 || gained <= 0)
357: 		{
358: 			return -1;
359: 		}
360: 
361: 		long xpPerCook = gained / fishCooked;
362: 		if (xpPerCook <= 0)
363: 		{
364: 			return -1;
365: 		}
366: 
367: 		long actions = remaining / xpPerCook;
368: 		return actions > Integer.MAX_VALUE ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : (int) actions;
369: 	}

371: 	private void fish(ScriptContext context)
372: 	{
373: 		GameInput input = context.getInput();
374: 		Player player = context.getPlayer();
375: 
376: 		long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
377: 
378: 		if (player.getAnimation() != -1)
379: 		{
380: 			// Fishing has actually started. Do not click the spot again until
381: 			// the animation has been gone for a while.
382: 			fishingAnimationSeen = true;
383: 			awaitingFishingStart = false;
384: 			lastFishingAnimationAt = now;
385: 			hoverFishingSpot(context);
386: 			setStatus("Fishing");
387: 			return;
388: 		}
389: 
390: 		if (awaitingFishingStart)
391: 		{
392: 			// The click was just made. The player may still be walking to the
393: 			// spot, so give it time to start fishing before clicking again.
394: 			if (now - lastFishingClickAt < FISHING_START_TIMEOUT_MS)
395: 			{
396: 				hoverFishingSpot(context);
397: 				setStatus("Fishing");
398: 				return;
399: 			}
400: 
401: 			awaitingFishingStart = false;
402: 		}
403: 		else if (fishingAnimationSeen)
404: 		{
405: 			// The animation briefly disappears between fishing cycles. Only
406: 			// treat a longer gap as the end of the fishing session.
407: 			if (now - lastFishingAnimationAt < FISHING_ANIMATION_GAP_MS)
408: 			{
409: 				hoverFishingSpot(context);
410: 				setStatus("Fishing");
411: 				return;
412: 			}
413: 
414: 			fishingAnimationSeen = false;
415: 		}
416: 
417: 		if (input.isBusy())
418: 		{
419: 			setStatus("Moving mouse");
420: 			return;
421: 		}
422: 
423: 		Optional<NPC> visibleSpot = context.getTargets().findVisibleNpc(FISHING_SPOT_ID, FISHING_DISTANCE);
424: 		if (visibleSpot.isPresent())
425: 		{
426: 			NPC spot = visibleSpot.get();
427: 			input.stopCamera();
428: 			cameraAttempts = 0;
429: 			lastCameraTarget = -1;
430: 
431: 			boolean clicked;
432: 			if (isActionFirst(spot, FISH_ACTION))
433: 			{
434: 				clicked = input.click(spot);
435: 			}
436: 			else
437: 			{
438: 				clicked = input.interact(spot, FISH_ACTION);
439: 			}
440: 
441: 			if (clicked)
442: 			{
443: 				noteFishingClick();
444: 				cooldown = CLICK_COOLDOWN;
445: 				setStatus("Fishing");
446: 			}
447: 			else
448: 			{
449: 				cooldown = 1;
450: 				setStatus("Waiting for fishing spot");
451: 			}
452: 
453: 			return;
454: 		}
455: 
456: 		Optional<NPC> spot = context.getTargets().findNpc(FISHING_SPOT_ID, FISHING_DISTANCE);
457: 		if (spot.isPresent())
458: 		{
459: 			NPC fishingSpot = spot.get();
460: 			int target = worldHash(fishingSpot.getWorldLocation());
461: 			if (target != lastCameraTarget)
462: 			{
463: 				lastCameraTarget = target;
464: 				cameraAttempts = 0;
465: 			}
466: 
467: 			if (cameraAttempts < MAX_CAMERA_PULSES
468: 				&& (input.isCameraBusy() || input.turnCameraToward(fishingSpot.getWorldLocation())))
469: 			{
470: 				// Hold an arrow key to rotate toward the spot, and re-check
471: 				// visibility every tick while the camera turns.
472: 				++cameraAttempts;
473: 				setStatus("Turning camera to fishing spot");
474: 				return;
475: 			}
476: 
477: 			if (cameraAttempts >= MAX_CAMERA_PULSES)
478: 			{
479: 				input.stopCamera();
480: 			}
481: 
482: 			if (input.interact(fishingSpot, FISH_ACTION))
483: 			{
484: 				noteFishingClick();
485: 				cameraAttempts = 0;
486: 				cooldown = CLICK_COOLDOWN;
487: 				setStatus("Fishing");
488: 			}
489: 			else
490: 			{
491: 				cooldown = 2;
492: 				setStatus("Cannot see fishing spot");
493: 			}
494: 
495: 			return;
496: 		}
497: 
498: 		cameraAttempts = 0;
499: 		lastCameraTarget = -1;
500: 		cooldown = 2;
501: 		setStatus("No fishing spot nearby");
502: 	}
503: 
504: 	/**
505: 	 * Keeps the mouse over the fishing spot while the player is fishing. The
506: 	 * spot drifts around, so this moves the mouse back whenever it is no longer
507: 	 * over the spot.
508: 	 */
509: 	private void hoverFishingSpot(ScriptContext context)
510: 	{
511: 		GameInput input = context.getInput();
512: 		if (input.isBusy())
513: 		{
514: 			return;
515: 		}
516: 
517: 		Optional<NPC> spot = context.getTargets().findVisibleNpc(FISHING_SPOT_ID, FISHING_DISTANCE);
518: 		if (!spot.isPresent())
519: 		{
520: 			return;
521: 		}
522: 
523: 		NPC fishingSpot = spot.get();
524: 
525: 		if (!input.isMouseOver(fishingSpot))
526: 		{
527: 			input.hover(fishingSpot);
528: 		}
529: 	}
530: 
531: 	/**
532: 	 * Keeps the mouse over the fire while the player is cooking, including
533: 	 * after the cooking interface has been dismissed.
534: 	 */
535: 	private void hoverFire(ScriptContext context)
536: 	{
537: 		GameInput input = context.getInput();
538: 		if (input.isBusy())
539: 		{
540: 			return;
541: 		}
542: 
543: 		Optional<TileObject> fire = context.getTargets().findVisibleTileObject(FIRE_ID, FIRE_DISTANCE);
544: 		if (!fire.isPresent())
545: 		{
546: 			return;
547: 		}
548: 
549: 		TileObject cookingFire = fire.get();
550: 
551: 		if (!input.isMouseOver(cookingFire))
552: 		{
553: 			input.hover(cookingFire);
554: 		}
555: 	}

557: 	private void cook(ScriptContext context, int rawFish)
558: 	{
559: 		// Any fishing session is over once cooking starts.
560: 		resetFishingAttempt();
561: 
562: 		GameInput input = context.getInput();
563: 		Widget skillMulti = context.getTargets().findWidget(InterfaceID.Skillmulti.UNIVERSE).orElse(null);
564: 
565: 		if (skillMulti != null)
566: 		{
567: 			// The interface opened, so the fire click worked. Keep the guard
568: 			// alive until cooking actually starts, so the fire is not clicked
569: 			// again the moment the interface closes.
570: 			extendFireInteraction();
571: 
572: 			// The cooking interface lists the raw fish and quantity buttons.
573: 			// Space selects the first fish. If the interface is still open on
574: 			// the next tick, press the All quantity button to finish the batch.
575: 			if (!spacePressed)
576: 			{
577: 				if (input.pressSpace())
578: 				{
579: 					spacePressed = true;
580: 					cooldown = 1;
581: 					setStatus("Pressing space to select fish");
582: 				}
583: 				return;
584: 			}
585: 
586: 			Widget allButton = context.getTargets().findWidget(InterfaceID.Skillmulti.ALL).orElse(null);
587: 			if (allButton != null && input.click(allButton))
588: 			{
589: 				cooldown = 2;
590: 				setStatus("Choosing Cook All");
591: 			}
592: 			return;
593: 		}
594: 
595: 		Widget options = context.getTargets().findWidget(InterfaceID.Chatmenu.OPTIONS).orElse(null);
596: 
597: 		if (options != null)
598: 		{
599: 			// The cooking dialog opened, so the fire click worked. Keep the
600: 			// guard alive until the fish selection actually starts cooking.
601: 			extendFireInteraction();
602: 			handleCookDialog(context, options);
603: 			return;
604: 		}
605: 
606: 		spacePressed = false;
607: 
608: 		if (rawFish != lastRawFish)
609: 		{
610: 			awaitingFireInteraction = false;
611: 			lastRawFish = rawFish;
612: 			rawStableTicks = 0;
613: 			hoverFire(context);
614: 			setStatus("Cooking (" + rawFish + " raw left)");
615: 			return;
616: 		}
617: 
618: 		if (rawStableTicks < Integer.MAX_VALUE)
619: 		{
620: 			++rawStableTicks;
621: 		}
622: 
623: 		if (context.getPlayer().getAnimation() != -1)
624: 		{
625: 			awaitingFireInteraction = false;
626: 			hoverFire(context);
627: 			setStatus("Cooking (" + rawFish + " raw left)");
628: 			return;
629: 		}
630: 
631: 		if (rawStableTicks < COOK_STABLE_TICKS)
632: 		{
633: 			hoverFire(context);
634: 			setStatus("Waiting for cooking");
635: 			return;
636: 		}
637: 
638: 		if (input.isBusy())
639: 		{
640: 			setStatus("Moving mouse");
641: 			return;
642: 		}
643: 
644: 		if (awaitingFireInteraction)
645: 		{
646: 			// The fire was just clicked. It may take a moment for the player
647: 			// to walk over or for the cooking interface to open, so give it
648: 			// time before clicking the fire again.
649: 			if (System.currentTimeMillis() - lastFireClickAt < FIRE_INTERACTION_TIMEOUT_MS)
650: 			{
651: 				hoverFire(context);
652: 				setStatus("Waiting for fire");
653: 				return;
654: 			}
655: 
656: 			awaitingFireInteraction = false;
657: 		}
658: 
659: 		Optional<TileObject> visibleFire = context.getTargets().findVisibleTileObject(FIRE_ID, FIRE_DISTANCE);
660: 		if (visibleFire.isPresent())
661: 		{
662: 			TileObject fire = visibleFire.get();
663: 			input.stopCamera();
664: 			cameraAttempts = 0;
665: 			lastCameraTarget = -1;
666: 
667: 			boolean clicked;
668: 			if (isActionFirst(fire, COOK_ACTION, context.getClient()))
669: 			{
670: 				clicked = input.click(fire);
671: 			}
672: 			else
673: 			{
674: 				clicked = input.interact(fire, COOK_ACTION);
675: 			}
676: 
677: 			if (clicked)
678: 			{
679: 				noteFireClick();
680: 				lastRawFish = rawFish;
681: 				rawStableTicks = 0;
682: 				spacePressed = false;
683: 				cooldown = CLICK_COOLDOWN;
684: 				hoverFire(context);
685: 				setStatus("Clicking fire");
686: 			}
687: 			else
688: 			{
689: 				cooldown = 1;
690: 				setStatus("Waiting for fire");
691: 			}
692: 
693: 			return;
694: 		}
695: 
696: 		Optional<TileObject> fire = context.getTargets().findTileObject(FIRE_ID, FIRE_DISTANCE);
697: 		if (fire.isPresent())
698: 		{
699: 			TileObject cookingFire = fire.get();
700: 			int target = worldHash(cookingFire.getWorldLocation());
701: 			if (target != lastCameraTarget)
702: 			{
703: 				lastCameraTarget = target;
704: 				cameraAttempts = 0;
705: 			}
706: 
707: 			if (cameraAttempts < MAX_CAMERA_PULSES
708: 				&& (input.isCameraBusy() || input.turnCameraToward(cookingFire.getWorldLocation())))
709: 			{
710: 				++cameraAttempts;
711: 				setStatus("Turning camera to fire");
712: 				return;
713: 			}
714: 
715: 			if (cameraAttempts >= MAX_CAMERA_PULSES)
716: 			{
717: 				input.stopCamera();
718: 			}
719: 
720: 			if (input.interact(cookingFire, COOK_ACTION))
721: 			{
722: 				noteFireClick();
723: 				cameraAttempts = 0;
724: 				lastRawFish = rawFish;
725: 				rawStableTicks = 0;
726: 				spacePressed = false;
727: 				cooldown = CLICK_COOLDOWN;
728: 				hoverFire(context);
729: 				setStatus("Clicking fire");
730: 			}
731: 			else
732: 			{
733: 				cooldown = 2;
734: 				setStatus("Cannot see fire");
735: 			}
736: 
737: 			return;
738: 		}
739: 
740: 		cameraAttempts = 0;
741: 		lastCameraTarget = -1;
742: 		cooldown = 2;
743: 		setStatus("No fire nearby");
744: 	}

746: 	private void handleCookDialog(ScriptContext context, Widget options)
747: 	{
748: 		GameInput input = context.getInput();
749: 		Widget[] children = options.getChildren();
750: 		Widget firstOption = null;
751: 		Widget allOption = null;
752: 
753: 		if (children != null)
754: 		{
755: 			for (Widget child : children)
756: 			{
757: 				if (child == null || child.isHidden())
758: 				{
759: 					continue;
760: 				}
761: 
762: 				Rectangle bounds = child.getBounds();
763: 				String text = cleanText(child.getText());
764: 				if (bounds == null || bounds.isEmpty() || text.isEmpty())
765: 				{
766: 					continue;
767: 				}
768: 
769: 				if (firstOption == null)
770: 				{
771: 					firstOption = child;
772: 				}
773: 
774: 				if (text.toLowerCase().contains("all"))
775: 				{
776: 					allOption = child;
777: 					break;
778: 				}
779: 			}
780: 		}
781: 
782: 		if (firstOption == null)
783: 		{
784: 			cooldown = 1;
785: 			setStatus("Waiting for cooking options");
786: 			return;
787: 		}
788: 
789: 		if (allOption != null)
790: 		{
791: 			// If Cook All is the first option, the space bar selects it. If it
792: 			// is not first, click it directly so we do not cook one fish at a
793: 			// time.
794: 			if (allOption == firstOption && !spacePressed)
795: 			{
796: 				if (input.pressSpace())
797: 				{
798: 					spacePressed = true;
799: 					cooldown = 1;
800: 					setStatus("Pressing space for Cook All");
801: 				}
802: 				return;
803: 			}
804: 
805: 			if (input.click(allOption))
806: 			{
807: 				spacePressed = true;
808: 				cooldown = 2;
809: 				setStatus("Choosing Cook All");
810: 			}
811: 			return;
812: 		}
813: 
814: 		// No All option yet. Press space to advance to the next selection
815: 		// dialog (for example, choosing which raw fish to cook).
816: 		if (input.pressSpace())
817: 		{
818: 			spacePressed = true;
819: 			cooldown = 1;
820: 			setStatus("Pressing space");
821: 		}
822: 	}
823: 
824: 	private void drop(ScriptContext context, Inventory inventory)
825: 	{
826: 		// Dropping happens after fishing, so start fresh next time.
827: 		resetFishingAttempt();
828: 
829: 		GameInput input = context.getInput();
830: 
831: 		if (!inventory.isOpen())
832: 		{
833: 			if (inventory.open())
834: 			{
835: 				cooldown = 2;
836: 				setStatus("Opening inventory");
837: 			}
838: 			else
839: 			{
840: 				cooldown = 2;
841: 				setStatus("Open your inventory");
842: 			}
843: 			return;
844: 		}
845: 
846: 		// Wait for the previous fish to leave the inventory before clicking the
847: 		// next one, so the same fish is never clicked twice. Retry after a few
848: 		// ticks in case the click did not register.
849: 		if (pendingDropSlot >= 0)
850: 		{
851: 			if (itemIdAt(inventory, pendingDropSlot) == pendingDropItemId
852: 				&& ++pendingDropTicks < DROP_RETRY_TICKS)
853: 			{
854: 				// Start moving onto the next fish while the current drop is
855: 				// processed, the way a player keeps the mouse ahead of the
856: 				// drops. Waiting for the click to finish first keeps the click
857: 				// from being cut short by the movement.
858: 				if (!input.isBusy())
859: 				{
860: 					hoverNextFish(input, inventory);
861: 				}
862: 
863: 				setStatus("Dropping fish");
864: 				return;
865: 			}
866: 
867: 			resetPendingDrop();
868: 		}
869: 
870: 		if (input.isBusy())
871: 		{
872: 			setStatus("Moving mouse");
873: 			return;
874: 		}
875: 
876: 		// Click the first fish, then move on to the next one.
877: 		int slot = inventory.findDroppableFishSlot();
878: 		int itemId = itemIdAt(inventory, slot);
879: 		Widget item = inventory.getSlotWidget(slot);
880: 
881: 		if (itemId < 0 || item == null || item.isHidden())
882: 		{
883: 			cooldown = 1;
884: 			setStatus("Waiting for inventory");
885: 			return;
886: 		}
887: 
888: 		Rectangle bounds = item.getBounds();
889: 		if (bounds == null || bounds.isEmpty())
890: 		{
891: 			cooldown = 1;
892: 			setStatus("Waiting for inventory");
893: 			return;
894: 		}
895: 
896: 		// The click animates the mouse onto the fish and then presses, so the
897: 		// cursor visibly travels from fish to fish instead of dropping them
898: 		// without any mouse movement.
899: 		if (!input.click(item))
900: 		{
901: 			cooldown = 1;
902: 			setStatus("Waiting for inventory");
903: 			return;
904: 		}
905: 
906: 		pendingDropSlot = slot;
907: 		pendingDropItemId = itemId;
908: 		pendingDropTicks = 0;
909: 		cooldown = 0;
910: 		setStatus("Dropping fish");
911: 	}
912: 
913: 	/**
914: 	 * Moves the mouse onto a fish that is still waiting to be dropped, so the
915: 	 * cursor arrives on the next fish while the current drop is being
916: 	 * processed.
917: 	 */
918: 	private void hoverNextFish(GameInput input, Inventory inventory)
919: 	{
920: 		for (int slot : inventory.findDroppableFishSlots())
921: 		{
922: 			if (slot == pendingDropSlot)
923: 			{
924: 				continue;
925: 			}
926: 
927: 			Widget next = inventory.getSlotWidget(slot);
928: 			if (next == null || next.isHidden())
929: 			{
930: 				continue;
931: 			}
932: 
933: 			Rectangle bounds = next.getBounds();
934: 			if (bounds != null && !bounds.isEmpty() && !input.isMouseOver(bounds))
935: 			{
936: 				input.hover(next);
937: 			}
938: 
939: 			return;
940: 		}
941: 	}
942: 
943: 	private static int itemIdAt(Inventory inventory, int slot)
944: 	{
945: 		Item[] items = inventory.getItems();
946: 		if (slot < 0 || slot >= items.length)
947: 		{
948: 			return -1;
949: 		}
950: 
951: 		Item item = items[slot];
952: 		return item == null ? -1 : item.getId();
953: 	}
954: 
955: 	private void resetPendingDrop()
956: 	{
957: 		pendingDropSlot = -1;
958: 		pendingDropItemId = -1;
959: 		pendingDropTicks = 0;
960: 	}

997: 	/**
998: 	 * Sets up the default camera angle on startup and keeps it there while
999: 	 * idle: fully zoomed out, pitched all the way up, facing west. Uses the
1000: 	 * same inputs a real player would (mouse wheel for zoom, arrow keys for
1001: 	 * rotation).
1002: 	 */
1003: 	private boolean ensureCamera(ScriptContext context)
1004: 	{
1005: 		GameInput input = context.getInput();
1006: 		Client client = context.getClient();
1007: 
1008: 		if (!cameraSetupActive)
1009: 		{
1010: 			return true;
1011: 		}
1012: 
1013: 		if (!zoomStarted)
1014: 		{
1015: 			setStatus("Zooming camera out");
1016: 			zoomStarted = input.zoomOut(CAMERA_ZOOM_NOTCHES);
1017: 			return false;
1018: 		}
1019: 
1020: 		if (input.isZooming())
1021: 		{
1022: 			setStatus("Zooming camera out");
1023: 			return false;
1024: 		}
1025: 
1026: 		if (cameraPhase == 0)
1027: 		{
1028: 			setStatus("Pitching camera up");
1029: 			if (input.isCameraBusy())
1030: 			{
1031: 				return false;
1032: 			}
1033: 
1034: 			if (client.getCameraPitchTarget() < CAMERA_MAX_PITCH - CAMERA_PITCH_TOLERANCE)
1035: 			{
1036: 				holdPitchUp(input, client);
1037: 				return false;
1038: 			}
1039: 
1040: 			cameraPhase = 1;
1041: 			return true;
1042: 		}
1043: 
1044: 		if (cameraPhase == 1)
1045: 		{
1046: 			setStatus("Facing camera west");
1047: 			if (input.isCameraBusy())
1048: 			{
1049: 				return false;
1050: 			}
1051: 
1052: 			if (Math.abs(normalizeYaw(CAMERA_WEST_YAW - client.getCameraYawTarget())) > CAMERA_YAW_TOLERANCE)
1053: 			{
1054: 				input.turnCameraToYaw(CAMERA_WEST_YAW);
1055: 				return false;
1056: 			}
1057: 
1058: 			cameraSetupActive = false;
1059: 			defaultCameraScale = client.getScale();
1060: 			lastCameraMaintenanceAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
1061: 			setStatus("Camera ready");
1062: 			return true;
1063: 		}
1064: 
1065: 		return true;
1066: 	}
1067: 
1068: 	/**
1069: 	 * When the script has been idle for a while, reset the camera back to the
1070: 	 * default angle so it doesn't drift.
1071: 	 */
1072: 	private boolean isIdleForCameraReset(ScriptContext context)
1073: 	{
1074: 		Player player = context.getPlayer();
1075: 		if (cameraSetupActive || (player != null && player.getAnimation() != -1))
1076: 		{
1077: 			lastCameraMaintenanceAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
1078: 			return false;
1079: 		}
1080: 
1081: 		return System.currentTimeMillis() - lastCameraMaintenanceAt >= CAMERA_IDLE_RESET_MS;
1082: 	}
1083: 
1084: 	private boolean ensureDefaultCamera(ScriptContext context)
1085: 	{
1086: 		GameInput input = context.getInput();
1087: 		Client client = context.getClient();
1088: 
1089: 		if (input.isCameraBusy() || input.isZooming())
1090: 		{
1091: 			return false;
1092: 		}
1093: 
1094: 		int pitch = client.getCameraPitchTarget();
1095: 		boolean pitchLow = pitch < CAMERA_MAX_PITCH - CAMERA_PITCH_TOLERANCE;
1096: 		boolean yawOff = Math.abs(normalizeYaw(CAMERA_WEST_YAW - client.getCameraYawTarget())) > CAMERA_YAW_TOLERANCE;
1097: 		boolean zoomedIn = defaultCameraScale > 0
1098: 			&& client.getScale() > defaultCameraScale + CAMERA_SCALE_TOLERANCE;
1099: 
1100: 		if (!pitchLow && !yawOff && !zoomedIn)
1101: 		{
1102: 			lastCameraMaintenanceAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
1103: 			return true;
1104: 		}
1105: 
1106: 		setStatus("Resetting camera");
1107: 		if (zoomedIn)
1108: 		{
1109: 			input.zoomOut(CAMERA_ZOOM_NOTCHES);
1110: 			return false;
1111: 		}
1112: 
1113: 		if (pitchLow)
1114: 		{
1115: 			holdPitchUp(input, client);
1116: 			return false;
1117: 		}
1118: 
1119: 		input.turnCameraToYaw(CAMERA_WEST_YAW);
1120: 		return false;
1121: 	}
1122: 
1123: 	/**
1124: 	 * Holds the arrow key that raises the camera pitch. The key direction is
1125: 	 * confirmed from the resulting pitch change, so the script still works if
1126: 	 * the client maps the arrows the other way around.
1127: 	 */
1128: 	private void holdPitchUp(GameInput input, Client client)
1129: 	{
1130: 		int pitch = client.getCameraPitchTarget();
1131: 
1132: 		if (pitchHoldPending)
1133: 		{
1134: 			pitchHoldPending = false;
1135: 			if (!pitchDirectionLearned && pitchBeforeHold >= 0)
1136: 			{
1137: 				int change = pitch - pitchBeforeHold;
1138: 				if (change < -2)
1139: 				{
1140: 					pitchKey = pitchKey == KeyEvent.VK_UP ? KeyEvent.VK_DOWN : KeyEvent.VK_UP;
1141: 				}
1142: 				else if (change > 2)
1143: 				{
1144: 					pitchDirectionLearned = true;
1145: 				}
1146: 			}
1147: 		}
1148: 
1149: 		pitchBeforeHold = pitch;
1150: 		pitchHoldPending = true;
1151: 		input.holdKey(pitchKey, CAMERA_HOLD_MS);
1152: 	}
1153: 
1154: 	private static int normalizeYaw(int yaw)
1155: 	{
1156: 		int normalized = yaw & 16383;
1157: 		return normalized >= 8192 ? normalized - 16384 : normalized;
1158: 	}

1160: 	private void resetStats()
1161: 	{
1162: 		statsInitialized = false;
1163: 		statsStartedAt = 0;
1164: 		lastRawCount = 0;
1165: 		lastCookedCount = 0;
1166: 		fishCaught = 0;
1167: 		fishCooked = 0;
1168: 		startFishingXp = 0;
1169: 		startCookingXp = 0;
1170: 		fishingXpPerHour = 0;
1171: 		cookingXpPerHour = 0;
1172: 	}
1173: 
1174: 	private void updateStats()
1175: 	{
1176: 		Inventory inventory = getContext().getInventory();
1177: 		Client client = getContext().getClient();
1178: 		long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
1179: 		long elapsed = Math.max(1L, now - statsStartedAt);
1180: 
1181: 		if (!statsInitialized)
1182: 		{
1183: 			statsInitialized = true;
1184: 			statsStartedAt = now;
1185: 			lastRawCount = inventory.countRawFish();
1186: 			lastCookedCount = inventory.countCookedFish();
1187: 			startFishingXp = client.getSkillExperience(Skill.FISHING);
1188: 			startCookingXp = client.getSkillExperience(Skill.COOKING);
1189: 			return;
1190: 		}
1191: 
1192: 		int rawCount = inventory.countRawFish();
1193: 		int cookedCount = inventory.countCookedFish();
1194: 
1195: 		if (rawCount > lastRawCount)
1196: 		{
1197: 			fishCaught += rawCount - lastRawCount;
1198: 		}
1199: 
1200: 		if (cookedCount > lastCookedCount)
1201: 		{
1202: 			fishCooked += cookedCount - lastCookedCount;
1203: 		}
1204: 
1205: 		lastRawCount = rawCount;
1206: 		lastCookedCount = cookedCount;
1207: 
1208: 		long fishingXp = client.getSkillExperience(Skill.FISHING);
1209: 		long cookingXp = client.getSkillExperience(Skill.COOKING);
1210: 
1211: 		fishingXpPerHour = (int) Math.round((fishingXp - startFishingXp) * 3_600_000.0 / elapsed);
1212: 		cookingXpPerHour = (int) Math.round((cookingXp - startCookingXp) * 3_600_000.0 / elapsed);
1213: 	}
1214: 
1215: 	private static String formatActions(int actions)
1216: 	{
1217: 		return actions < 0 ? "--" : formatNumber(actions);
1218: 	}
1219: 
1220: 	private static String formatPerHour(int amount, long elapsedMs)
1221: 	{
1222: 		long perHour = elapsedMs <= 0 ? 0 : Math.round(amount * 3_600_000.0 / elapsedMs);
1223: 		return formatNumber(perHour);
1224: 	}
1225: 
1226: 	private static String formatXpToNextLevel(Client client, Skill skill)
1227: 	{
1228: 		int level = client.getRealSkillLevel(skill);
1229: 		if (level >= Experience.MAX_REAL_LEVEL)
1230: 		{
1231: 			return "XP to level 99: max";
1232: 		}
1233: 
1234: 		long xp = client.getSkillExperience(skill);
1235: 		long remaining = Math.max(0L, Experience.getXpForLevel(level + 1) - xp);
1236: 		return "XP to level " + (level + 1) + ": " + formatNumber(remaining);
1237: 	}
1238: 
1239: 	private static String formatTimeToNextLevel(Client client, Skill skill, long startXp, long elapsedMs)
1240: 	{
1241: 		int level = client.getRealSkillLevel(skill);
1242: 		if (level >= Experience.MAX_REAL_LEVEL)
1243: 		{
1244: 			return "Time to level 99: max";
1245: 		}
1246: 
1247: 		long xp = client.getSkillExperience(skill);
1248: 		long remaining = Math.max(0L, Experience.getXpForLevel(level + 1) - xp);
1249: 		long gained = Math.max(0L, xp - startXp);
1250: 		if (gained <= 0 || elapsedMs < 10_000L)
1251: 		{
1252: 			return "Time to level " + (level + 1) + ": --";
1253: 		}
1254: 
1255: 		long xpPerHour = Math.round(gained * 3_600_000.0 / elapsedMs);
1256: 		if (xpPerHour <= 0)
1257: 		{
1258: 			return "Time to level " + (level + 1) + ": --";
1259: 		}
1260: 
1261: 		long millis = Math.round(remaining * 3_600_000.0 / xpPerHour);
1262: 		return "Time to level " + (level + 1) + ": " + formatDuration(millis);
1263: 	}
1264: 
1265: 	private static String formatDuration(long millis)
1266: 	{
1267: 		long seconds = Math.max(0L, millis / 1000L);
1268: 		long hours = seconds / 3600L;
1269: 		long minutes = (seconds % 3600L) / 60L;
1270: 		long remainingSeconds = seconds % 60L;
1271: 
1272: 		if (hours > 0)
1273: 		{
1274: 			return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%dh %02dm", hours, minutes);
1275: 		}
1276: 
1277: 		if (minutes > 0)
1278: 		{
1279: 			return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%dm %02ds", minutes, remainingSeconds);
1280: 		}
1281: 
1282: 		return remainingSeconds + "s";
1283: 	}
1284: 
1285: 	private static String formatNumber(long value)
1286: 	{
1287: 		return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%,d", value);
1288: 	}
1289: 
1290: 	private static boolean isActionFirst(TileObject object, String action, Client client)
1291: 	{

1293: 		return composition != null && isActionFirst(composition.getActions(), action);
1294: 	}

1296: 	private static boolean isActionFirst(NPC npc, String action)
1297: 	{
1298: 		NPCComposition composition = npc.getComposition();
1299: 		return composition != null && isActionFirst(composition.getActions(), action);
1300: 	}

1302: 	private static boolean isActionFirst(String[] actions, String action)
1303: 	{
1304: 		if (actions == null)
1305: 		{
1306: 			return false;
1307: 		}
1308: 
1309: 		for (String candidate : actions)
1310: 		{
1311: 			if (candidate == null || candidate.trim().isEmpty())
1312: 			{
1313: 				continue;
1314: 			}
1315: 
1316: 			return cleanText(candidate).equalsIgnoreCase(action);
1317: 		}
1318: 
1319: 		return false;
1320: 	}
1321: 
1322: 	private static String cleanText(String text)
1323: 	{
1324: 		if (text == null)
1325: 		{

/**
 * Trains combat on a player-selected list of nearby NPCs. When the script
 * starts it opens a configuration window with the attackable NPCs around the
 * player and an HP percentage at which to eat food. Pressing Start in that
 * window minimises it, and the script attacks the chosen NPCs until stopped.
 */
public final class CombatTrainerScript extends Script
{
	private static final String ATTACK_ACTION = "Attack";
	private static final int ATTACK_COOLDOWN_TICKS = 3;
	private static final int SCAN_RADIUS = 20;
	private static final int MAX_TARGET_DISTANCE = 20;
	private static final Pattern TAGS = Pattern.compile("<[^>]*>");

	private final Set<String> targetNames = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
	private volatile int eatAtHpPercent = 50;
	private volatile boolean training;
	private volatile boolean refreshRequested;
	private volatile CombatTrainerWindow window;

	private int cooldown;
	private boolean loggingOut;

	public CombatTrainerScript()
	{
		super("Combat Trainer", "Attacks chosen nearby NPCs and eats food below a chosen HP percentage.");
	}

	@Override
	protected void onStart()
	{
		// onStart may run on the game thread or the EDT. It must not touch
		// the client, and the configuration window is opened on the EDT.
		cooldown = 0;
		refreshRequested = true;
		training = false;
		loggingOut = false;
		setStatus("Choose NPCs in the Combat Trainer window");

		SwingUtilities.invokeLater(this::showWindow);
	}

	@Override
	protected void onStop()
	{
		training = false;
		CombatTrainerWindow current = window;
		window = null;

		if (current != null)
		{
			SwingUtilities.invokeLater(current::dispose);
		}
	}

	@Override
	protected void onGameTick()
	{
		ScriptContext context = getContext();

		if (!context.isLoggedIn())
		{
			setStatus("Waiting for login");
			return;
		}

		// If the player logged back in with food, cancel the safety logout
		// instead of immediately logging out again.

228: 		}

230: 		Script script = findLoadedScript(className);

232: 		{
233: 			try
234: 			{
235: 				script = ScriptLoader.load(className, TestPluginPanel.class.getClassLoader());
236: 			}

238: 			{
239: 				setCustomScriptError(ex.getMessage());
240: 				return;
241: 			}
242: 
243: 			scriptManager.register(script);
244: 			scriptSelector.addItem(script);
245: 		}
246: 
247: 		customClassField.setText(className);
248: 		scriptSelector.setSelectedItem(script);
249: 		configManager.setConfiguration(TestConfig.GROUP, "customScriptClass", className);
250: 		setCustomScriptError(null);
251: 	}

43: /**
44:  * Walks the player toward a world position using the collision map.
45:  * <p>
46:  * A breadth-first search over the scene's collision flags finds a walkable
47:  * route, and a point a few tiles along that route is clicked, either on the
48:  * minimap or on the game tile itself. The route is re-checked and the next
49:  * waypoint clicked while the player is still running, the way a player keeps
50:  * clicking ahead of themselves on the minimap.
51:  */

55: 		{0, 1}, {1, 0}, {1, 1}, {1, -1},

89: 		lastLocation = null;

91: 		ticksSinceClick = CLICK_INTERVAL_TICKS;
92: 	}

94: 	/**
95: 	 * Walks toward the target, clicking the game tile when it is on screen and
96: 	 * the minimap when it is not.

99: 	 */
100: 	public boolean walkTo(WorldPoint target)
101: 	{

103: 	}

105: 	/**
106: 	 * Walks toward the target.
107: 	 *
108: 	 * @param useMinimap always prefer a minimap click, which can never hit a
109: 	 *                   game object such as a door
110: 	 * @return true if a click was sent
111: 	 */
112: 	public boolean walkTo(WorldPoint target, boolean useMinimap)
113: 	{
114: 		if (target == null || input.isBusy())
115: 		{
116: 			return false;
117: 		}
118: 
119: 		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
120: 		WorldPoint location = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
121: 		if (location == null || location.distanceTo(target) <= 2)

123: 			reset();
124: 			return false;
125: 		}
126: 
127: 		// Count how long the player has been stuck in place. A moving player
128: 		// resets this every tick.
129: 		if (lastLocation != null && lastLocation.equals(location))
130: 		{

132: 		}
133: 		else
134: 		{
135: 			stallTicks = 0;
136: 		}
137: 
138: 		lastLocation = location;
139:

145: 		}

151: 		}
152: 
153: 		int lookahead = stallTicks >= STALL_TICKS ? NEAR_LOOKAHEAD : PATH_LOOKAHEAD;
154: 		int index = Math.min(path.size() - 1, lookahead);
155: 		if (useMinimap && clickMinimap(path.get(index)))

159: 		}
160: 
161: 		for (int i = index; i >= 1; i--)
162: 		{
163: 			if (input.walkTo(path.get(i)))

165: 				ticksSinceClick = 0;
166: 				return true;
167: 			}
168: 		}
169: 
170: 		if (clickMinimap(path.get(index)))
171: 		{

174: 		}
175: 
176: 		return false;
177: 	}

219: 	public List<WorldPoint> findPath(WorldPoint goal)
220: 	{
221: 		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
222: 		WorldPoint start = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
223: 		WorldView worldView = client.getTopLevelWorldView();
224: 		if (start == null || goal == null || worldView == null)

226: 			return Collections.emptyList();

235: 			return Collections.emptyList();
236: 		}
237: 
238: 		int[][] flags = collisionMaps[plane].getFlags();
239: 		if (flags == null || flags.length == 0)
240: 		{
241: 			return Collections.emptyList();
242: 		}
243: 
244: 		int width = flags.length;
245: 		int height = flags[0].length;
246: 		int baseX = scene.getBaseX();
247: 		int baseY = scene.getBaseY();
248: 		int startX = start.getX() - baseX;
249: 		int startY = start.getY() - baseY;
250: 		if (!inBounds(startX, startY, width, height))
251: 		{
252: 			return Collections.emptyList();
253: 		}
254: 
255: 		int goalX = goal.getX() - baseX;
256: 		int goalY = goal.getY() - baseY;
257: 		boolean goalInScene = inBounds(goalX, goalY, width, height);
258: 
259: 		int total = width * height;
260: 		int[] previous = new int[total];
261: 		Arrays.fill(previous, -1);
262: 		boolean[] visited = new boolean[total];
263: 		int[] queue = new int[total];
264: 		int head = 0;
265: 		int tail = 0;
266: 		int startIndex = startY * width + startX;
267: 		visited[startIndex] = true;
268: 		queue[tail++] = startIndex;
269: 
270: 		int bestIndex = startIndex;
271: 		long bestDistance = distanceSquared(baseX + startX, baseY + startY, goal);
272: 		int expansions = 0;
273: 
274: 		while (head < tail && expansions++ < total)
275: 		{
276: 			int current = queue[head++];
277: 			int x = current % width;
278: 			int y = current / width;
279: 
280: 			if (goalInScene && x == goalX && y == goalY)
281: 			{
282: 				bestIndex = current;
283: 				break;
284: 			}
285: 
286: 			long distance = distanceSquared(baseX + x, baseY + y, goal);
287: 			if (distance < bestDistance)
288: 			{
289: 				bestDistance = distance;
290: 				bestIndex = current;
291: 			}
292: 
293: 			for (int[] direction : WALK_DIRECTIONS)
294: 			{
295: 				int nextX = x + direction[0];
296: 				int nextY = y + direction[1];
297: 				if (!inBounds(nextX, nextY, width, height))
298: 				{
299: 					continue;
300: 				}
301: 
302: 				int nextIndex = nextY * width + nextX;
303: 				if (visited[nextIndex] || !canMove(flags, x, y, direction[0], direction[1]))

305: 					continue;
306: 				}
307: 
308: 				visited[nextIndex] = true;
309: 				previous[nextIndex] = current;
310: 				queue[tail++] = nextIndex;
311: 			}
312: 		}
313: 
314: 		List<WorldPoint> path = new ArrayList<>();
315: 		for (int index = bestIndex; index != -1; index = previous[index])
316: 		{
317: 			int x = index % width;
318: 			int y = index / width;
319: 			path.add(new WorldPoint(baseX + x, baseY + y, plane));
320: 			if (index == startIndex)
321: 			{
322: 				break;
323: 			}
324: 		}
325: 
326: 		Collections.reverse(path);
327: 		return path;
328: 	}

330: 	private static boolean inBounds(int x, int y, int width, int height)
331: 	{
332: 		return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < width && y < height;
333: 	}
334: 
335: 	private static boolean canMove(int[][] flags, int x, int y, int dx, int dy)
336: 	{
337: 		int source = flags[x][y];
338: 		int destination = flags[x + dx][y + dy];
339: 
340: 		// Solid objects, water, and similar tiles block movement into them.
341: 		if ((destination & CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_FULL) != 0)
342: 		{
343: 			return false;
344: 		}
345: 
346: 		int flag;
347: 		int reverseFlag;
348: 
349: 		if (dx == 0)
350: 		{
351: 			flag = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH
352: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH;
353: 			reverseFlag = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH
354: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH;
355: 		}
356: 		else if (dy == 0)
357: 		{
358: 			flag = dx > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_EAST
359: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_WEST;
360: 			reverseFlag = dx > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_WEST
361: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_EAST;
362: 		}
363: 		else if (dx > 0)
364: 		{
365: 			flag = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH_EAST
366: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH_EAST;
367: 			reverseFlag = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH_WEST
368: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH_WEST;
369: 		}
370: 		else
371: 		{
372: 			flag = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH_WEST
373: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH_WEST;
374: 			reverseFlag = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH_EAST
375: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH_EAST;
376: 		}
377: 
378: 		if ((source & flag) != 0 || (destination & reverseFlag) != 0)
379: 		{
380: 			return false;
381: 		}
382: 
383: 		// Do not cut diagonally through the corner of a wall.
384: 		if (dx != 0 && dy != 0)
385: 		{
386: 			int horizontal = dx > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_EAST
387: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_WEST;
388: 			int vertical = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH
389: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH;
390: 			if ((source & horizontal) != 0 || (source & vertical) != 0)
391: 			{
392: 				return false;
393: 			}
394: 		}
395: 
396: 		return true;
397: 	}
398: 
399: 	private static long distanceSquared(int x, int y, WorldPoint target)
400: 	{
401: 		long dx = (long) x - target.getX();
402: 		long dy = (long) y - target.getY();
403: 		return dx * dx + dy * dy;
404: 	}

### Ardougne Bakery Stall

There are two bakery stalls in the marketplace. This one owned by the baker is located to the east and sells bread, cakes, 1/3 chocolate cakes and chocolate bars. Level 5 Thieving is required to steal from a bakery stall. Players can steal cakes, bread, and slices from the stall.

Bakers run bakery stalls in the East Ardougne market as well as in the Great Kourend market. Players can purchase or steal cakes, bread, and chocolate cake slices from their stalls. Stealing, however, may attract the attention of nearby guards, who will attack the player. If a player attempts to steal from the stall while in the bakers' view, that player will be unsuccessful. One Ardougne baker has a daughter named Ramara du Croissant.

{{External|rs=Ardougne Baker's Stall|rsc=Bakers Stall}}
{{Infobox Shop
|name = Ardougne Baker's Stall.
|image = [[File:Ardougne Baker's Stall..png|300px]]
|release = [[30 April]] [[2002]]
|update = Latest RuneScape News (30 April 2002)
|members = Yes
|icon = [[File:Food shop icon.png]]
|location = [[East Ardougne]]
|owner = [[Baker]]
|special = Food shop
|map = {{Map|2656,3310|r=3|mtype=square|bucket=yes}}
|leagueRegion = Kandarin

The '''Ardougne Baker's Stall''' is a store located on the east side of the [[East Ardougne]] market that sells [[bread]], [[cake]], [[chocolate slice]]s, and [[chocolate bar]]s. It is run by a [[baker]]. It requires 5 [[Thieving]] to steal from. 

Stealing a cake from one of the [[bakery stall]]s is an [[easy Ardougne Diary]] task.

The two bakers do not share the same stock.

==Stock==
===Eastern Baker===
{{StoreTableHead|sellmultiplier=1000|buymultiplier=800|delta=20|namenotes=(east)|column1=Heals}}
{{StoreLine|name=Bread|stock=10|restock=150|column1=5}}
{{StoreLine|name=Cake|stock=3|restock=1000|column1=12 (4x3)}}
{{StoreLine|name=Chocolate slice|bucketname=Chocolate cake#Slice|stock=6|restock=400|gemw=no|column1=5}}
{{StoreLine|name=Chocolate bar|stock=9|restock=250|column1=3}}
{{StoreTableBottom}}

===Western Baker===
{{StoreTableHead|sellmultiplier=1000|buymultiplier=800|delta=20|namenotes=(west)|column1=Heals}}
{{StoreLine|name=Bread|stock=10|restock=100|column1=5}}
{{StoreLine|name=Cake|stock=3|restock=800|column1=12 (4x3)}}
{{StoreLine|name=Chocolate slice|bucketname=Chocolate cake#Slice|restock=200|stock=8|gemw=no|column1=5}}
{{StoreLine|name=Chocolate bar|stock=7|restock=200|column1=3}}
{{StoreTableBottom}}

==Trivia==
* In ''[[RuneScape Classic]]'', there was only one baker's stall, located towards the south-east corner of the market. While in ''RuneScape 2'' two stalls existed, these originally both shared the stock of the Western Baker. The Eastern Baker's shop was added in a hidden update c. December 2005.

25: package net.runelite.rsbuddy.scripts;
26: 
27: import java.awt.Color;
28: import java.awt.Rectangle;
29: import java.util.ArrayList;
30: import java.util.Collections;
31: import java.util.List;
32: import java.util.Locale;
33: import java.util.Optional;
34: import net.runelite.api.Client;
35: import net.runelite.api.Experience;
36: import net.runelite.api.Item;
37: import net.runelite.api.ObjectComposition;
38: import net.runelite.api.Skill;
39: import net.runelite.api.TileObject;
40: import net.runelite.api.coords.WorldPoint;
41: import net.runelite.api.gameval.ObjectID;
42: import net.runelite.api.widgets.Widget;
43: import net.runelite.rsbuddy.input.GameInput;
44: import net.runelite.rsbuddy.inventory.Inventory;
45: import net.runelite.rsbuddy.script.Script;
46: import net.runelite.rsbuddy.script.ScriptContext;
47: 
48: /**
49:  * Steals from the eastern baker's stall in the East Ardougne market, waits for
50:  * the empty stall to turn back into the baker's stall, and repeats. When the
51:  * inventory fills up, every item is dropped with the inventory's left-click
52:  * action before stealing continues.
53:  * <p>
54:  * The player is expected to stand at the stall, around {@code 2669, 3310}.
55:  * There is a second baker's stall further west, so the target is restricted to
56:  * the stall at that spot instead of simply taking the nearest one.
57:  */
58: public final class ArdougneBakerStallStealerScript extends Script
59: {
60: 	private static final int BAKER_STALL_ID = ObjectID.CAKETHIEFSTALL;
61: 	private static final int EMPTY_STALL_ID = ObjectID.MARKET;
62: 
63: 	private static final String STEAL_ACTION = "Steal-from";
64: 
65: 	/**
66: 	 * The eastern baker's stall. The object sits on or right next to the tile
67: 	 * the player stands on.
68: 	 */
69: 	private static final WorldPoint STALL_LOCATION = new WorldPoint(2669, 3310, 0);
70: 
71: 	// The empty market stall is on the same tile as the baker's stall. A small
72: 	// radius allows for the stall model sitting one tile away from the tile the
73: 	// player was told to stand on, while still excluding the other bakery stall
74: 	// fourteen tiles west.
75: 	private static final int STALL_RADIUS = 3;
76: 
77: 	// Only look for stalls close to the player. At the target stall this is more
78: 	// than enough, and it avoids picking up a bakery stall elsewhere in the
79: 	// market if the player has wandered off.
80: 	private static final int STALL_DISTANCE = 10;
81: 
82: 	// After a steal click, give the game a few ticks to turn the stall into the
83: 	// empty market stall. This also stops a second click being sent while the
84: 	// first one is still being processed.
85: 	private static final int STEAL_COOLDOWN_TICKS = 3;
86: 
87: 	private enum State
88: 	{
89: 		STEAL,
90: 		DROP
91: 	}
92: 
93: 	private State state;
94: 	private int cooldown;
95: 
96: 	private int lastItemCount;
97: 	private int steals;
98: 	private int itemsDropped;
99: 
100: 	private boolean statsInitialized;
101: 	private long statsStartedAt;
102: 	private long startThievingXp;
103: 
104: 	public ArdougneBakerStallStealerScript()
105: 	{
106: 		super("Ardougne Baker Stall Stealer",
107: 			"Steals from the East Ardougne baker's stall and drops the inventory when full.");
108: 	}
109: 
110: 	@Override
111: 	protected void onStart()
112: 	{
113: 		// onStart runs on the Swing thread, so it must not touch the client.
114: 		state = State.STEAL;
115: 		cooldown = 0;
116: 		lastItemCount = 0;
117: 		steals = 0;
118: 		itemsDropped = 0;
119: 		statsInitialized = false;
120: 		statsStartedAt = 0;
121: 		startThievingXp = 0;
122: 		setStatus("Ready");
123: 	}
124: 
125: 	@Override
126: 	protected void onGameTick()
127: 	{
128: 		ScriptContext context = getContext();
129: 
130: 		if (!context.isLoggedIn())
131: 		{
132: 			setStatus("Waiting for login");
133: 			return;
134: 		}
135: 
136: 		updateStats();
137: 
138: 		if (cooldown > 0)
139: 		{
140: 			--cooldown;
141: 			return;
142: 		}
143: 
144: 		if (state == null)
145: 		{
146: 			state = State.STEAL;
147: 		}
148: 
149: 		switch (state)
150: 		{
151: 			case STEAL:
152: 				steal(context);
153: 				break;
154: 			case DROP:
155: 				drop(context);
156: 				break;
157: 		}
158: 	}
159: 
160: 	@Override
161: 	public List<String> getOverlayLines()
162: 	{
163: 		if (!statsInitialized)
164: 		{
165: 			return Collections.emptyList();
166: 		}
167: 
168: 		long elapsed = Math.max(1L, System.currentTimeMillis() - statsStartedAt);
169: 		Client client = getContext().getClient();
170: 		long gainedXp = Math.max(0L, client.getSkillExperience(Skill.THIEVING) - startThievingXp);
171: 
172: 		List<String> lines = new ArrayList<>();
173: 		lines.add("");
174: 		lines.add("Ardougne baker's stall");
175: 		lines.add("Steals: " + formatNumber(steals) + " (" + formatPerHour(steals, elapsed) + "/hr)");
176: 		lines.add("Dropped: " + formatNumber(itemsDropped));
177: 		lines.add("XP per hour: " + formatNumber(perHour(gainedXp, elapsed)));
178: 		lines.add("Total time: " + formatDuration(elapsed));
179: 		return lines;
180: 	}
181: 
182: 	@Override
183: 	public List<ProgressBar> getProgressBars()
184: 	{
185: 		if (!statsInitialized)
186: 		{
187: 			return Collections.emptyList();
188: 		}
189: 
190: 		Client client = getContext().getClient();
191: 		int level = client.getRealSkillLevel(Skill.THIEVING);
192: 		if (level >= Experience.MAX_REAL_LEVEL)
193: 		{
194: 			return Collections.singletonList(new ProgressBar("Thieving", 1.0, "Max level", Color.GREEN));
195: 		}
196: 
197: 		long xp = client.getSkillExperience(Skill.THIEVING);
198: 		long currentLevelXp = Experience.getXpForLevel(level);
199: 		long nextLevelXp = Experience.getXpForLevel(level + 1);
200: 		long progressXp = Math.max(0L, xp - currentLevelXp);
201: 		long totalXp = Math.max(1L, nextLevelXp - currentLevelXp);
202: 
203: 		return Collections.singletonList(new ProgressBar("Thieving",
204: 			(double) progressXp / totalXp,
205: 			formatNumber(xp) + " / " + formatNumber(nextLevelXp),
206: 			Color.GREEN));
207: 	}
208: 
209: 	private void steal(ScriptContext context)
210: 	{
211: 		Inventory inventory = context.getInventory();
212: 		GameInput input = context.getInput();
213: 		Client client = context.getClient();
214: 
215: 		if (inventory.isFull())
216: 		{
217: 			state = State.DROP;
218: 			setStatus("Inventory full, dropping items");
219: 			return;
220: 		}
221: 
222: 		if (input.isBusy())
223: 		{
224: 			setStatus("Moving mouse");
225: 			return;
226: 		}
227: 
228: 		Optional<TileObject> target = findBakerStall(context);
229: 
230: 		// If a right-click menu is already open (for example because the stall's
231: 		// steal option is not its default action), finish the interaction by
232: 		// clicking the steal entry instead of closing the menu and starting over.
233: 		if (client.isMenuOpen())
234: 		{
235: 			if (target.isPresent() && input.interact(target.get(), STEAL_ACTION))
236: 			{
237: 				cooldown = STEAL_COOLDOWN_TICKS;
238: 				setStatus("Stealing from baker's stall");
239: 			}
240: 			else
241: 			{
242: 				input.closeMenu();
243: 				cooldown = 1;
244: 				setStatus("Closing menu");
245: 			}
246: 			return;
247: 		}
248: 
249: 		if (target.isEmpty())
250: 		{
251: 			if (findEmptyStall(context).isPresent())
252: 			{
253: 				setStatus("Waiting for baker's stall to respawn");
254: 			}
255: 			else
256: 			{
257: 				setStatus("No baker's stall at 2669, 3310");
258: 			}
259: 			return;
260: 		}
261: 
262: 		TileObject stall = target.get();
263: 		if (!input.isVisible(stall))
264: 		{
265: 			if (input.isCameraBusy() || input.turnCameraToward(stall.getWorldLocation()))
266: 			{
267: 				setStatus("Turning camera to baker's stall");
268: 				return;
269: 			}
270: 		}
271: 
272: 		input.stopCamera();
273: 
274: 		// Steal-from is the stall's only action, so a normal left click is both
275: 		// the fastest and the least conspicuous way to start the steal. If the
276: 		// action has been rearranged, fall back to the context menu.
277: 		boolean clicked;
278: 		if (isFirstAction(client, stall, STEAL_ACTION))
279: 		{
280: 			clicked = input.click(stall);
281: 		}
282: 		else
283: 		{
284: 			clicked = input.interact(stall, STEAL_ACTION);
285: 		}
286: 
287: 		if (clicked)
288: 		{
289: 			cooldown = STEAL_COOLDOWN_TICKS;
290: 			setStatus("Stealing from baker's stall");
291: 		}
292: 		else
293: 		{
294: 			cooldown = 1;
295: 			setStatus("Waiting for baker's stall");
296: 		}
297: 	}
298: 
299: 	private void drop(ScriptContext context)
300: 	{
301: 		Inventory inventory = context.getInventory();
302: 		GameInput input = context.getInput();
303: 
304: 		if (!inventory.isOpen())
305: 		{
306: 			if (input.isBusy())
307: 			{
308: 				setStatus("Opening inventory");
309: 				return;
310: 			}
311: 
312: 			if (inventory.open())
313: 			{
314: 				cooldown = 1;
315: 				setStatus("Opening inventory");
316: 			}
317: 			else
318: 			{
319: 				cooldown = 2;
320: 				setStatus("Open your inventory");
321: 			}
322: 			return;
323: 		}
324: 
325: 		if (context.getClient().isMenuOpen())
326: 		{
327: 			if (!input.isBusy())
328: 			{
329: 				input.closeMenu();
330: 			}
331: 			setStatus("Closing menu");
332: 			return;
333: 		}
334: 
335: 		int itemCount = countItems(inventory);
336: 		if (itemCount == 0)
337: 		{
338: 			state = State.STEAL;
339: 			cooldown = 1;
340: 			setStatus("Inventory empty, stealing again");
341: 			return;
342: 		}
343: 
344: 		if (input.isBusy())
345: 		{
346: 			setStatus("Dropping inventory (" + itemCount + " left)");
347: 			return;
348: 		}
349: 
350: 		List<Widget> itemWidgets = new ArrayList<>();
351: 		Item[] items = inventory.getItems();
352: 
353: 		for (int slot = 0; slot < Math.min(items.length, Inventory.SIZE); slot++)
354: 		{
355: 			Item item = items[slot];
356: 			if (item == null || item.getId() == -1)
357: 			{
358: 				continue;
359: 			}
360: 
361: 			Widget widget = inventory.getSlotWidget(slot);
362: 			if (widget == null || widget.isHidden())
363: 			{
364: 				continue;
365: 			}
366: 
367: 			Rectangle bounds = widget.getBounds();
368: 			if (bounds == null || bounds.isEmpty())
369: 			{
370: 				continue;
371: 			}
372: 
373: 			itemWidgets.add(widget);
374: 		}
375: 
376: 		if (itemWidgets.isEmpty())
377: 		{
378: 			cooldown = 1;
379: 			setStatus("Waiting for inventory");
380: 			return;
381: 		}
382: 
383: 		// The inventory is configured for left-click drop. Fast-clicking the
384: 		// occupied slots clears the whole inventory in one quick pass.
385: 		int clicked = input.fastClick(itemWidgets);
386: 		cooldown = 1;
387: 
388: 		if (clicked > 0)
389: 		{
390: 			setStatus("Dropping inventory (" + clicked + " items)");
391: 		}
392: 		else
393: 		{
394: 			setStatus("Waiting for inventory");
395: 		}
396: 	}
397: 
398: 	private Optional<TileObject> findBakerStall(ScriptContext context)
399: 	{
400: 		return context.getTargets()
401: 			.findTileObject(BAKER_STALL_ID, STALL_DISTANCE)
402: 			.filter(this::isTargetStall);
403: 	}
404: 
405: 	private Optional<TileObject> findEmptyStall(ScriptContext context)
406: 	{
407: 		return context.getTargets()
408: 			.findTileObject(EMPTY_STALL_ID, STALL_DISTANCE)
409: 			.filter(this::isTargetStall);
410: 	}
411: 
412: 	private boolean isTargetStall(TileObject object)
413: 	{
414: 		WorldPoint location = object.getWorldLocation();
415: 		return location != null
416: 			&& location.getPlane() == STALL_LOCATION.getPlane()
417: 			&& location.distanceTo(STALL_LOCATION) <= STALL_RADIUS;
418: 	}
419: 
420: 	private static boolean isFirstAction(Client client, TileObject object, String action)
421: 	{
422: 		ObjectComposition composition = client.getObjectDefinition(object.getId());
423: 		return composition != null && isFirstAction(composition.getActions(), action);
424: 	}
425: 
426: 	private static boolean isFirstAction(String[] actions, String action)
427: 	{
428: 		if (actions == null)
429: 		{
430: 			return false;
431: 		}
432: 
433: 		for (String candidate : actions)
434: 		{
435: 			if (candidate == null || candidate.trim().isEmpty())
436: 			{
437: 				continue;
438: 			}
439: 
440: 			return cleanText(candidate).equalsIgnoreCase(action);
441: 		}
442: 
443: 		return false;
444: 	}
445: 
446: 	private static int countItems(Inventory inventory)
447: 	{
448: 		int count = 0;
449: 		for (Item item : inventory.getItems())
450: 		{
451: 			if (item != null && item.getId() != -1)
452: 			{
453: 				++count;
454: 			}
455: 		}
456: 
457: 		return count;
458: 	}
459: 
460: 	private void updateStats()
461: 	{
462: 		Inventory inventory = getContext().getInventory();
463: 		Client client = getContext().getClient();
464: 		long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
465: 		int itemCount = countItems(inventory);
466: 
467: 		if (!statsInitialized)
468: 		{
469: 			statsInitialized = true;
470: 			statsStartedAt = now;
471: 			lastItemCount = itemCount;
472: 			startThievingXp = client.getSkillExperience(Skill.THIEVING);
473: 			return;
474: 		}
475: 
476: 		if (itemCount > lastItemCount)
477: 		{
478: 			steals += itemCount - lastItemCount;
479: 		}
480: 		else if (itemCount < lastItemCount)
481: 		{
482: 			itemsDropped += lastItemCount - itemCount;
483: 		}
484: 
485: 		lastItemCount = itemCount;
486: 	}
487: 
488: 	private static String cleanText(String text)
489: 	{
490: 		if (text == null)
491: 		{
492: 			return "";
493: 		}
494: 
495: 		return text.replaceAll("<[^>]*>", "")
496: 			.replace('\u00a0', ' ')
497: 			.trim();
498: 	}
499: 
500: 	private static String formatPerHour(int amount, long elapsedMs)
501: 	{
502: 		return formatNumber(perHour(amount, elapsedMs));
503: 	}
504: 
505: 	private static long perHour(long amount, long elapsedMs)
506: 	{
507: 		return elapsedMs <= 0 ? 0L : Math.round(amount * 3_600_000.0 / elapsedMs);
508: 	}
509: 
510: 	private static String formatDuration(long millis)
511: 	{
512: 		long seconds = Math.max(0L, millis / 1000L);
513: 		long hours = seconds / 3600L;
514: 		long minutes = (seconds % 3600L) / 60L;
515: 		long remainingSeconds = seconds % 60L;
516: 
517: 		if (hours > 0)
518: 		{
519: 			return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%dh %02dm", hours, minutes);
520: 		}
521: 
522: 		if (minutes > 0)
523: 		{
524: 			return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%dm %02ds", minutes, remainingSeconds);
525: 		}
526: 
527: 		return remainingSeconds + "s";
528: 	}
529: 
530: 	private static String formatNumber(long value)
531: 	{
532: 		return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%,d", value);
533: 	}
534: }

	private Optional<TileObject> findEmptyStall(ScriptContext context)
	{
		return context.getTargets()
			.findTileObject(EMPTY_STALL_ID, STALL_DISTANCE)
			.filter(this::isTargetStall);
	}

	private boolean isTargetStall(TileObject object)
	{
		WorldPoint location = object.getWorldLocation();
		return location != null
			&& location.getPlane() == STALL_LOCATION.getPlane()
			&& location.distanceTo(STALL_LOCATION) <= STALL_RADIUS;
	}

	/**

	private static Point centerOf(TileObject object)
	{
		Shape clickbox = object.getClickbox();
		Rectangle bounds = clickbox == null ? null : clickbox.getBounds();

		}

		return new Point((int) Math.round(bounds.getCenterX()), (int) Math.round(bounds.getCenterY()));
	}

55:  * action before stealing continues.

58:  * There is a second baker's stall further west, so the target is restricted to
59:  * the stall at that spot instead of simply taking the nearest one.
60:  */

568: 		long remainingSeconds = seconds % 60L;
569: 
570: 		if (hours > 0)
571: 		{
572: 			return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%dh %02dm", hours, minutes);
573: 		}
574: 
575: 		if (minutes > 0)
576: 		{

578: 		}
579: 
580: 		return remainingSeconds + "s";

## Assistant

Added the stall hover check and rebuilt/installed the plugin.

What it does now:
- Before every steal click, it checks whether the saved click point is still inside the stall’s clickable hull.
- If the camera moved and that point is no longer on the stall, it re-aims at the stall’s current center and verifies the new point is actually inside the hull before clicking.
- It also guarantees the chosen center point is inside the stall shape, not just the center of its bounding box, so a click can’t land on empty ground beside the stall.

**Restart the RuneLite client to load the updated plugin.**

43: /**
44:  * Walks the player toward a world position using the collision map.
45:  * <p>
46:  * A breadth-first search over the scene's collision flags finds a walkable
47:  * route, and a point a few tiles along that route is clicked, either on the
48:  * minimap or on the game tile itself. The route is re-checked and the next
49:  * waypoint clicked while the player is still running, the way a player keeps
50:  * clicking ahead of themselves on the minimap.
51:  */
52: public final class Walker
53: {
54: 	private static final int[][] WALK_DIRECTIONS = {
55: 		{0, 1}, {1, 0}, {1, 1}, {1, -1},
56: 		{0, -1}, {-1, 0}, {-1, -1}, {-1, 1}
57: 	};
58: 
59: 	// How far along the path a single click should reach.
60: 	private static final int PATH_LOOKAHEAD = 10;
61: 
62: 	// When the player stops making progress, click closer to them so the client
63: 	// can path around whatever is blocking the route.
64: 	private static final int NEAR_LOOKAHEAD = 3;
65: 	private static final int STALL_TICKS = 3;
66: 
67: 	// Ticks between walk clicks while the player is still moving. Players keep
68: 	// clicking the next waypoint as they run instead of waiting to stop.
69: 	private static final int CLICK_INTERVAL_TICKS = 2;
70: 
71: 	private final Client client;
72: 	private final GameInput input;
73: 
74: 	private WorldPoint lastLocation;
75: 	private int stallTicks;
76: 	private int ticksSinceClick;
77: 
78: 	public Walker(Client client, GameInput input)
79: 	{
80: 		this.client = client;
81: 		this.input = input;
82: 	}
83: 
84: 	/**
85: 	 * Forgets the last walk click, so the next call can click immediately.
86: 	 */
87: 	public void reset()
88: 	{
89: 		lastLocation = null;
90: 		stallTicks = 0;
91: 		ticksSinceClick = CLICK_INTERVAL_TICKS;
92: 	}
93: 
94: 	/**
95: 	 * Walks toward the target, clicking the game tile when it is on screen and
96: 	 * the minimap when it is not.
97: 	 *
98: 	 * @return true if a click was sent
99: 	 */
100: 	public boolean walkTo(WorldPoint target)
101: 	{
102: 		return walkTo(target, false);
103: 	}
104: 
105: 	/**
106: 	 * Walks toward the target.
107: 	 *
108: 	 * @param useMinimap always prefer a minimap click, which can never hit a
109: 	 *                   game object such as a door
110: 	 * @return true if a click was sent
111: 	 */
112: 	public boolean walkTo(WorldPoint target, boolean useMinimap)
113: 	{
114: 		if (target == null || input.isBusy())
115: 		{
116: 			return false;
117: 		}
118: 
119: 		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
120: 		WorldPoint location = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
121: 		if (location == null || location.distanceTo(target) <= 2)
122: 		{
123: 			reset();
124: 			return false;
125: 		}
126: 
127: 		// Count how long the player has been stuck in place. A moving player
128: 		// resets this every tick.
129: 		if (lastLocation != null && lastLocation.equals(location))
130: 		{
131: 			++stallTicks;
132: 		}
133: 		else
134: 		{
135: 			stallTicks = 0;
136: 		}
137: 
138: 		lastLocation = location;
139: 
140: 		// Keep clicking the route ahead while the player is running instead of
141: 		// waiting for them to stop, but no faster than a player would.
142: 		if (++ticksSinceClick < CLICK_INTERVAL_TICKS)
143: 		{
144: 			return false;
145: 		}
146: 
147: 		List<WorldPoint> path = findPath(target);
148: 		if (path.size() <= 1)
149: 		{
150: 			return false;
151: 		}
152: 
153: 		int lookahead = stallTicks >= STALL_TICKS ? NEAR_LOOKAHEAD : PATH_LOOKAHEAD;
154: 		int index = Math.min(path.size() - 1, lookahead);
155: 		if (useMinimap && clickMinimap(path.get(index)))
156: 		{

213: 	/**
214: 	 * Finds a walkable route from the player to the goal. When the goal cannot
215: 	 * be reached, the route ends at the reachable tile closest to it.
216: 	 *
217: 	 * @return the route, including the player's current tile
218: 	 */
219: 	public List<WorldPoint> findPath(WorldPoint goal)
220: 	{
221: 		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
222: 		WorldPoint start = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
223: 		WorldView worldView = client.getTopLevelWorldView();
224: 		if (start == null || goal == null || worldView == null)
225: 		{
226: 			return Collections.emptyList();
227: 		}
228: 
229: 		Scene scene = worldView.getScene();
230: 		CollisionData[] collisionMaps = worldView.getCollisionMaps();
231: 		int plane = worldView.getPlane();
232: 		if (scene == null || collisionMaps == null || plane < 0 || plane >= collisionMaps.length
233: 			|| collisionMaps[plane] == null)
234: 		{
235: 			return Collections.emptyList();
236: 		}
237: 
238: 		int[][] flags = collisionMaps[plane].getFlags();
239: 		if (flags == null || flags.length == 0)
240: 		{
241: 			return Collections.emptyList();
242: 		}
243: 
244: 		int width = flags.length;
245: 		int height = flags[0].length;
246: 		int baseX = scene.getBaseX();
247: 		int baseY = scene.getBaseY();
248: 		int startX = start.getX() - baseX;
249: 		int startY = start.getY() - baseY;
250: 		if (!inBounds(startX, startY, width, height))
251: 		{
252: 			return Collections.emptyList();
253: 		}
254: 
255: 		int goalX = goal.getX() - baseX;
256: 		int goalY = goal.getY() - baseY;
257: 		boolean goalInScene = inBounds(goalX, goalY, width, height);
258: 
259: 		int total = width * height;
260: 		int[] previous = new int[total];
261: 		Arrays.fill(previous, -1);
262: 		boolean[] visited = new boolean[total];
263: 		int[] queue = new int[total];
264: 		int head = 0;
265: 		int tail = 0;
266: 		int startIndex = startY * width + startX;
267: 		visited[startIndex] = true;
268: 		queue[tail++] = startIndex;
269: 
270: 		int bestIndex = startIndex;
271: 		long bestDistance = distanceSquared(baseX + startX, baseY + startY, goal);
272: 		int expansions = 0;
273: 
274: 		while (head < tail && expansions++ < total)
275: 		{
276: 			int current = queue[head++];
277: 			int x = current % width;
278: 			int y = current / width;
279: 
280: 			if (goalInScene && x == goalX && y == goalY)
281: 			{
282: 				bestIndex = current;
283: 				break;
284: 			}
285: 
286: 			long distance = distanceSquared(baseX + x, baseY + y, goal);
287: 			if (distance < bestDistance)
288: 			{
289: 				bestDistance = distance;
290: 				bestIndex = current;
291: 			}
292: 
293: 			for (int[] direction : WALK_DIRECTIONS)
294: 			{
295: 				int nextX = x + direction[0];
296: 				int nextY = y + direction[1];
297: 				if (!inBounds(nextX, nextY, width, height))
298: 				{
299: 					continue;
300: 				}
301: 
302: 				int nextIndex = nextY * width + nextX;
303: 				if (visited[nextIndex] || !canMove(flags, x, y, direction[0], direction[1]))
304: 				{
305: 					continue;
306: 				}
307: 
308: 				visited[nextIndex] = true;
309: 				previous[nextIndex] = current;
310: 				queue[tail++] = nextIndex;
311: 			}
312: 		}
313: 
314: 		List<WorldPoint> path = new ArrayList<>();
315: 		for (int index = bestIndex; index != -1; index = previous[index])
316: 		{
317: 			int x = index % width;
318: 			int y = index / width;
319: 			path.add(new WorldPoint(baseX + x, baseY + y, plane));
320: 			if (index == startIndex)
321: 			{
322: 				break;
323: 			}
324: 		}
325: 
326: 		Collections.reverse(path);
327: 		return path;
328: 	}

330: 	private static boolean inBounds(int x, int y, int width, int height)
331: 	{
332: 		return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < width && y < height;
333: 	}
334: 
335: 	private static boolean canMove(int[][] flags, int x, int y, int dx, int dy)
336: 	{
337: 		int source = flags[x][y];
338: 		int destination = flags[x + dx][y + dy];
339: 
340: 		// Solid objects, water, and similar tiles block movement into them.
341: 		if ((destination & CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_FULL) != 0)
342: 		{
343: 			return false;
344: 		}
345: 
346: 		int flag;
347: 		int reverseFlag;
348: 
349: 		if (dx == 0)
350: 		{
351: 			flag = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH
352: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH;
353: 			reverseFlag = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH
354: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH;
355: 		}
356: 		else if (dy == 0)
357: 		{
358: 			flag = dx > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_EAST
359: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_WEST;
360: 			reverseFlag = dx > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_WEST
361: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_EAST;
362: 		}
363: 		else if (dx > 0)
364: 		{
365: 			flag = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH_EAST
366: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH_EAST;
367: 			reverseFlag = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH_WEST
368: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH_WEST;
369: 		}
370: 		else
371: 		{
372: 			flag = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH_WEST
373: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH_WEST;
374: 			reverseFlag = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH_EAST
375: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH_EAST;
376: 		}
377: 
378: 		if ((source & flag) != 0 || (destination & reverseFlag) != 0)
379: 		{
380: 			return false;
381: 		}
382: 
383: 		// Do not cut diagonally through the corner of a wall.
384: 		if (dx != 0 && dy != 0)
385: 		{
386: 			int horizontal = dx > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_EAST
387: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_WEST;
388: 			int vertical = dy > 0 ? CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_NORTH
389: 				: CollisionDataFlag.BLOCK_MOVEMENT_SOUTH;
390: 			if ((source & horizontal) != 0 || (source & vertical) != 0)
391: 			{
392: 				return false;
393: 			}
394: 		}
395: 
396: 		return true;
397: 	}
398: 
399: 	private static long distanceSquared(int x, int y, WorldPoint target)
400: 	{
401: 		long dx = (long) x - target.getX();
402: 		long dy = (long) y - target.getY();
403: 		return dx * dx + dy * dy;
404: 	}
405: }

Fruit stalls are a type of stall found in the Hosidius farmer's market, near Logava. They can also be found in the Kourend Castle courtyard's south side. In addition, two can be found inside a building just east of Hosidius market (with magic trees by its entrance). 

Stealing from the fruit stalls requires level 25 Thieving. Successfully stealing from the fruit stall grants the player 28.5 Thieving experience and a produce. Fruit stalls are notable as a source of strange fruits, which restore 30% run energy and cure poison/venom when consumed; as well as golovanova fruit tops, which can only be obtained from fruit stalls and are an ingredient in botanical pies, a food item used to boost Herblore by 4 levels. 

The fruit stalls found in the main square are guarded by level 44 guard dogs, who will attack the player should they see the player attempting to steal from the stall. This can be avoided by attacking them to lure them between the wooden supports, allowing players to steal safely.

## [Fruit Stall](https://oldschoolrunescape.fandom.com/wiki/Fruit_Stall)

The fruit stall is a stall that can be found in front of Logava Gricoller's Cooking Supplies in the southern coast of Great Kourend's Hosidius House, or in the Great Kourend marketplace that surrounds the Statue of King Rada. In order to steal from the fruit stalls, players require 15% favour with the Hosidius House, along with level 25 in Thieving. Successfully stealing from the fruit stall grants the player 28.5 Thieving experience.
