Wet markets are the more traditional retail outlets for fresh fruits, but their market share has decreased from 80 percent of retail sales a decade ago to the prevailing 60 percent today. There are two fresh fruit wholesale markets in Hong Kong. Some importers might own stalls in the wholesale market are engaged in wholesale business as well. Most wet market fruit retail operators source their supplies in one of the wholesale markets every day before dawn making sure that their fruits are fresh. However, wet markets are losing business to supermarkets.

...

The fruit industry has a number of growth drivers. Hong Kong consumers are increasingly health conscious and the Hong Kong government’s public health campaign encouraging the public to eat more produce is supporting the growth trend. Drawing the public’s attention to health concerns, some restaurants are blending more produce into the menu for both main dishes and desserts, particularly during summer. Fruits are also widely used in the baking industry. In addition, freshly squeezed fruit juices are available for sale in small stalls around the street corner or in fruit stores city-wide. Such fruit stalls are a city feature echoing consumers’ quest for health and Hong Kong’s fast pace causing consumers to seek convenience.

...

Counterfeiting products do occur for premium products because the profit margin is so attractive. There are anecdotes that empty Tasmania cherry boxes had a market price of HKD50 (USD6.50) each in wholesale markets. Industry people ... Brand counterfeiting would be too easily detected if Tasmania ones are mixed/replaced with Chilean cherries. Reportedly, the packaging of Tasmania cherries for the 2020 season will include chips for easy identification.

'''Fruit stalls''' are a type of [[stall]] found in the [[Hosidius]] farmer's market, near [[Logava]]. They can also be found in the [[Kourend Castle]] courtyard's south side. In addition, two can be found inside a building just east of Hosidius market (with [[magic tree]]s by its entrance).

Stealing from the fruit stalls requires level 25 [[Thieving]]. Successfully stealing from the fruit stall grants the player 28.5 Thieving [[experience]] and a produce. Fruit stalls are notable as a source of [[strange fruit]]s, which restore 30% run energy and cure poison/venom when consumed; as well as [[golovanova fruit top]]s, which can only be obtained from fruit stalls and are an ingredient in [[botanical pies]], a food item used to boost [[Herblore]] by 4 levels.

The fruit stalls found in the main square are guarded by level 44 [[guard dog]]s, who will attack the player should they see the player attempting to steal from the stall. This can be avoided by attacking them to lure them between the wooden supports, allowing players to steal safely.

There are two more stalls found in a building to the east, just north of the two Magic Trees, which are not guarded at all, and are close enough from each other that players can run back and forth stealing from both stalls faster than a single stall regenerates, increasing XP/h provided that the player has means to continually restore run energy.

Stealing fruit from a fruit stall is a task in the [[Easy Kourend & Kebos Diary]].
[[File:Fruit Stall - trapping guard dogs.png|right|thumb|250px|The fruit stall found in front of Logava, with the guard dogs trapped between the wooden supports.]]

==Training==
Stealing from the fruit stalls yields approximately 12,000 [[Thieving]] [[experience]] per hour, including trips to and from the bank. Utilising [[basket]]s to store [[Strawberry|strawberries]], [[Cooking apple|apples]], and [[banana]]s as well as dropping cheap unwanted fruits (such as [[redberries]], [[lime]]s, and [[lemon]]s) will increase [[experience]] rates to about 25,000 experience per hour while still banking valuable items (whilst using excess [[Strange fruit]] to replenish run energy). Banking the full baskets, which are common payments for [[fruit tree]]s, and valuable [[Golovanova fruit top|Golovanova]] and [[Papaya fruit|papaya]] will make in excess of 250,000 [[coins]] per hour profit depending on the current [[Grand Exchange]] [[market price]]s.

If a player drops all fruits, it is possible to achieve about 34,200 experience per hour. However, if a player loots from both stalls as fast as possible and drops fruit while running between them, you can achieve a rate of 42,750 experience per hour. This is because you can only steal from a single stall once every 5 [[game tick]]s, but if you steal from both stalls you will receive XP every 4 game ticks.

Ironmen can bring empty [[Basket|baskets]] and fill them with fruits for tree and fruit tree payment.

223: 			{
224: 				objects.add(tile.getGroundObject());

227: 			{

229: 			}

239: 	private Stream<Tile> tiles()
240: 	{
241: 		WorldView worldView = client.getTopLevelWorldView();
242: 		if (worldView == null)
243: 		{
244: 			return Stream.empty();
245: 		}
246: 
247: 		Scene scene = worldView.getScene();
248: 		if (scene == null)
249: 		{
250: 			return Stream.empty();
251: 		}
252: 
253: 		Tile[][][] tiles = scene.getTiles();
254: 		int plane = worldView.getPlane();
255: 		if (tiles == null || plane < 0 || plane >= tiles.length)
256: 		{
257: 			return Stream.empty();
258: 		}
259: 
260: 		Tile[][] planeTiles = tiles[plane];
261: 		if (planeTiles == null)
262: 		{
263: 			return Stream.empty();
264: 		}
265: 
266: 		return Arrays.stream(planeTiles)
267: 			.filter(Objects::nonNull)
268: 			.flatMap(row -> Arrays.stream(row))
269: 			.filter(Objects::nonNull);
270: 	}

293: 		return composition != null && clean(composition.getName()).equalsIgnoreCase(clean(name));
294: 	}

297: 	{
298: 		if (name == null || name.isEmpty())
299: 		{
300: 			return true;
301: 		}
302: 
303: 		NPCComposition composition = npc.getComposition();
304: 		String npcName = composition == null ? npc.getName() : composition.getName();
305: 		return clean(npcName).equalsIgnoreCase(clean(name));
306: 	}

309: 	{

311: 		return composition != null && hasAction(composition.getActions(), action);

315: 	{

317: 		return composition != null && hasAction(composition.getActions(), action);
318: 	}

320: 	private static boolean hasAction(String[] actions, String action)
321: 	{
322: 		return actions != null && Arrays.stream(actions).filter(Objects::nonNull)
323: 			.anyMatch(candidate -> clean(candidate).equalsIgnoreCase(clean(action)));
324: 	}
325: 
326: 	private boolean isVisible(TileObject object)
327: 	{
328: 		Shape clickbox = object.getClickbox();
329: 		if (clickbox != null && isInViewport(clickbox))
330: 		{
331: 			return true;
332: 		}
333: 
334: 		Polygon tilePoly = object.getCanvasTilePoly();
335: 		return tilePoly != null && isInViewport(tilePoly);
336: 	}
337: 
338: 	private boolean isVisible(NPC npc)
339: 	{
340: 		Shape hull = npc.getConvexHull();
341: 		if (hull != null && isInViewport(hull))
342: 		{
343: 			return true;
344: 		}
345: 
346: 		Polygon tilePoly = npc.getCanvasTilePoly();
347: 		return tilePoly != null && isInViewport(tilePoly);
348: 	}
349: 
350: 	private boolean isInViewport(Shape shape)
351: 	{
352: 		if (shape == null)
353: 		{
354: 			return false;
355: 		}
356: 
357: 		int width = client.getViewportWidth();
358: 		int height = client.getViewportHeight();
359: 		if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
360: 		{
361: 			return true;
362: 		}
363: 
364: 		// Shape.intersects is unreliable here: RuneLite's SimplePolygon only
365: 		// returns true when the viewport border crosses the polygon, not when
366: 		// the whole polygon is inside the viewport. Compare bounds instead.
367: 		Rectangle bounds = shape.getBounds();
368: 		if (bounds == null)
369: 		{
370: 			return false;
371: 		}
372: 
373: 		Rectangle viewport = new Rectangle(
374: 			client.getViewportXOffset(), client.getViewportYOffset(), width, height);
375: 		if (bounds.width <= 0 || bounds.height <= 0)
376: 		{
377: 			return viewport.contains(bounds.getLocation());
378: 		}
379: 
380: 		return viewport.intersects(bounds);
381: 	}
382: 
383: 	private static boolean withinDistance(WorldPoint point, WorldPoint origin, int maxDistance)
384: 	{
385: 		return maxDistance <= 0 || origin == null || distance(point, origin) <= maxDistance;
386: 	}
387: 
388: 	private static int distance(WorldPoint point, WorldPoint origin)
389: 	{
390: 		return point == null || origin == null ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : point.distanceTo(origin);
391: 	}
392: 
393: 	private static String clean(String value)
394: 	{
395: 		return value == null ? "" : TAGS.matcher(value).replaceAll("").trim();
396: 	}
397: }

55:  * action before stealing continues.

486: 	/**
487: 	 * The centre of a hull's bounding box can fall outside a non-rectangular
488: 	 * hull. Start at that centre and search outwards for the nearest point
489: 	 * that is actually inside the shape.
490: 	 */
491: 	private static Point pointInside(Shape shape)
492: 	{
493: 		Rectangle bounds = shape == null ? null : shape.getBounds();
494: 		if (bounds == null || bounds.isEmpty())
495: 		{
496: 			return null;
497: 		}
498: 
499: 		int centerX = (int) Math.round(bounds.getCenterX());
500: 		int centerY = (int) Math.round(bounds.getCenterY());
501: 
502: 		if (shape.contains(centerX, centerY))
503: 		{
504: 			return new Point(centerX, centerY);
505: 		}
506: 
507: 		int maxRadius = Math.max(bounds.width, bounds.height) / 2;
508: 		for (int radius = 1; radius <= maxRadius; radius++)
509: 		{
510: 			for (int dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++)
511: 			{
512: 				for (int dy = -radius; dy <= radius; dy++)
513: 				{
514: 					if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) != radius)
515: 					{
516: 						continue;
517: 					}
518: 
519: 					int x = centerX + dx;
520: 					int y = centerY + dy;
521: 					if (shape.contains(x, y))
522: 					{
523: 						return new Point(x, y);
524: 					}
525: 				}
526: 			}
527: 		}
528: 
529: 		return null;
530: 	}

643: 	private static String formatDuration(long millis)
644: 	{
645: 		long seconds = Math.max(0L, millis / 1000L);
646: 		long hours = seconds / 3600L;
647: 		long minutes = (seconds % 3600L) / 60L;
648: 		long remainingSeconds = seconds % 60L;
649: 
650: 		if (hours > 0)
651: 		{
652: 			return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%dh %02dm", hours, minutes);
653: 		}
654: 
655: 		if (minutes > 0)
656: 		{

658: 		}
659: 
660: 		return remainingSeconds + "s";

Both use the normal fruit stall object; the extra id is\n\t// included because the client has reported the left stall with it.\n\tprivate static final WorldPoint[] STALL_LOCATIONS = {\n\t\tnew WorldPoint(1795, 3607, 0),\n\t\tnew WorldPoint(1801, 3607, 0)\n\t};\n\n\tprivate static final int LEFT_STALL_ID = 28832;\n\tprivate static final int RIGHT_STALL_ID = 28823;\n\n\tprivate static final String STEAL_ACTION = \"Steal-from\";\n\tprivate static final String STALL_NAME = \"Fruit Stall\";\n\n\t// Both stalls are six tiles apart, so this radius can never pick up the\n\t// other stall.\n\tprivate static final int STALL_RADIUS = 2;\n\n\t// Stalls are stolen from while standing next to them.\n\tprivate static final int STALL_INTERACT_DISTANCE = 1;\n\n\t// After a steal click, give the game a few ticks to process the steal and\n\t// turn the stall into its empty version.\n\tprivate static final int STEAL_COOLDOWN_TICKS = 3;\n\n\t// Drop two items per game tick. Each batch uses the normal animated mouse\n\t// path at double speed, so the inventory empties exactly twice as fast as\n\t// clicking one item per tick.\n\tprivate static final int DROP_BATCH_SIZE = 2;\n\tprivate static final double DROP_SPEED_MULTIPLIER = 2.0;\n\n\tprivate enum State\n\t{\n\t\tSTEAL,\n\t\tDROP\n\t}\n\n\tprivate State state;\n\tprivate int cooldown;\n\n\t/**\n\t * Index of the stall currently being stolen from.\n\t */\n\tprivate int stallIndex = -1;\n\n\t/**\n\t * Centre of the current stall's clickbox, computed when arriving at the\n\t * stall and reused for its clicks.\n\t */\n\tprivate Point stallClickPoint;\n\n\tprivate Walker walker;\n\n\tprivate int lastItemCount;\n\tprivate int steals;\n\tprivate int itemsDropped;\n\n\tprivate boolean statsInitialized;\n\tprivate long statsStartedAt;\n\tprivate long startThievingXp;\n\n\tpublic FruitStallStealerScript()\n\t{\n\t\tsuper(\"Fruit Stall Stealer\",\n\t\t\t\"Runs between the two Hosidius fruit stalls, stealing until the inventory is full, then drops it.\");\n\t}\n\n\t@Override\n\tprotected void onStart()\n\t{\n\t\t// onStart runs on the Swing thread, so it must not touch the client.\n\t\tstate = State.STEAL;\n\t\tcooldown = 0;\n\t\tstallIndex = -1;\n\t\tstallClickPoint = null;\n\t\twalker = null;\n\t\tlastItemCount = 0;\n\t\tsteals = 0;\n\t\titemsDropped = 0;\n\t\tstatsInitialized = false;\n\t\tstatsStartedAt = 0;\n\t\tstartThievingXp = 0;\n\t\tsetStatus(\"Ready\");\n\t}\n\n\t@Override\n\tprotected void onGameTick()\n\t{\n\t\tScriptContext context = getContext();\n\n\t\tif (!context.isLoggedIn())\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tsetStatus(\"Waiting for login\");\n\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif (walker == null)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\twalker = new Walker(context.getClient(), context.getInput());\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tupdateStats();\n\n\t\tif (state == null)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tstate = State.STEAL;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif (state == State.DROP)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tif (cooldown > 0)\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\t--cooldown;\n\t\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tdrop(context);\n\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// The cooldown only prevents another steal click. Walking is still\n\t\t// allowed so the player can start moving to the other stall straight\n\t\t// after stealing.\n\t\tif (cooldown > 0)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\t--cooldown;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tsteal(context);\n\t}\n\n\t@Override\n\tpublic List<String> getOverlayLines()\n\t{\n\t\tif (!statsInitialized)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\treturn Collections.emptyList();\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tlong elapsed = Math.max(1L, System.currentTimeMillis() - statsStartedAt);\n\t\tClient client = getContext().getClient();\n\t\tlong gainedXp = Math.max(0L, client.getSkillExperience(Skill.THIEVING) - startThievingXp);\n\n\t\tList<String> lines = new ArrayList<>();\n\t\tlines.add(\"\");\n\t\tlines.add(\"Hosidius fruit stalls\");\n\t\tlines.add(\"Steals: \" + formatNumber(steals) + \" (\" + formatPerHour(steals, elapsed) + \"/hr)\");\n\t\tlines.add(\"Dropped: \" + formatNumber(itemsDropped));\n\t\tlines.add(\"XP per hour: \" + formatNumber(perHour(gainedXp, elapsed)));\n\t\tlines.add(\"Total time: \" + formatDuration(elapsed));\n\t\treturn lines;\n\t}\n\n\t@Override\n\tpublic List<ProgressBar> getProgressBars()\n\t{\n\t\tif (!statsInitialized)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\treturn Collections.emptyList();\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tClient client = getContext().getClient();\n\t\tint level = client.getRealSkillLevel(Skill.THIEVING);\n\t\tif (level >= Experience.MAX_REAL_LEVEL)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\treturn Collections.singletonList(new ProgressBar(\"Thieving\", 1.0, \"Max level\", Color.GREEN));\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tlong xp = client.getSkillExperience(Skill.THIEVING);\n\t\tlong currentLevelXp = Experience.getXpForLevel(level);\n\t\tlong nextLevelXp = Experience.getXpForLevel(level + 1);\n\t\tlong progressXp = Math.max(0L, xp - currentLevelXp);\n\t\tlong totalXp = Math.max(1L, nextLevelXp - currentLevelXp);\n\n\t\treturn Collections.singletonList(new ProgressBar(\"Thieving\",\n\t\t\t(double) progressXp / totalXp,\n\t\t\tformatNumber(xp) + \" / \" + formatNumber(nextLevelXp),\n\t\t\tColor.GREEN));\n\t}\n\n\tprivate void steal(ScriptContext context)\n\t{\n\t\tInventory inventory = context.getInventory();\n\t\tGameInput input = context.getInput();\n\t\tClient client = context.getClient();\n\n\t\tif (inventory.isFull())\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tstate = State.DROP;\n\t\t\tsetStatus(\"Inventory full, dropping items\");\n\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif (input.isBusy())\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tsetStatus(\"Moving\");\n\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif (stallIndex < 0)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tstallIndex = nearestStall(context);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tWorldPoint stallLocation = STALL_LOCATIONS[stallIndex];\n\t\tOptional<TileObject> target = findFullStall(context, stallLocation);\n\n\t\t// If the stall we were heading to is still empty, use the other one so\n\t\t// the player keeps stealing instead of standing around.\n\t\tif (target.isEmpty())\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tint otherIndex = 1 - stallIndex;\n\t\t\tOptional<TileObject> other = findFullStall(context, STALL_LOCATIONS[otherIndex]);\n\t\t\tif (other.isPresent())\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tstallIndex = otherIndex;\n\t\t\t\tstallLocation = STALL_LOCATIONS[stallIndex];\n\t\t\t\tstallClickPoint = null;\n\t\t\t\ttarget = other;\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif (target.isEmpty())\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tsetStatus(\"Waiting for fruit stall to respawn\");\n\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tTileObject stall = target.get();\n\n\t\t// If a right-click menu is already open (for example because the\n\t\t// stall's steal option is not its default action), finish the\n\t\t// interaction by clicking the steal entry instead of closing it.\n\t\tif (client.isMenuOpen())\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tif (input.interact(stall, STEAL_ACTION))\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tnoteSteal();\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\telse\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tcooldown = 1;\n\t\t\t\tsetStatus(\"Closing menu\");\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tWorldPoint playerLocation = context.getPlayerLocation();\n\t\tWorldPoint objectLocation = stall.getWorldLocation();\n\t\tif (playerLocation == null || objectLocation == null\n\t\t\t|| playerLocation.distanceTo(objectLocation) > STALL_INTERACT_DISTANCE)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tif (objectLocation != null)\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\twalker.walkTo(objectLocation, false, STALL_INTERACT_DISTANCE);\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tsetStatus(\"Walking to fruit stall\");\n\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif (cooldown > 0)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tsetStatus(\"Waiting for fruit stall\");\n\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Lock onto the middle of this stall, then reuse that exact point. If\n\t\t// the camera moves, the point is re-aimed before the next click.\n\t\tif (stallClickPoint == null || !isPointOnStall(stall, stallClickPoint))\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tif (!input.isVisible(stall))\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tif (input.isCameraBusy() || input.turnCameraToward(stall.getWorldLocation()))\n\t\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\t\tsetStatus(\"Turning camera to fruit stall\");\n\t\t\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tinput.stopCamera();\n\n\t\t\tPoint point = centerOf(stall);\n\t\t\tif (point == null || !isPointOnStall(stall, point))\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tstallClickPoint = null;\n\t\t\t\tcooldown = 1;\n\t\t\t\tsetStatus(\"Waiting for fruit stall\");\n\t\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tstallClickPoint = point;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Steal-from is the stall's only action, so a normal left click is the\n\t\t// fastest way to start the steal. Fall back to the context menu if the\n\t\t// action has been rearranged.\n\t\tboolean clicked;\n\t\tif (isFirstAction(client, stall, STEAL_ACTION))\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tclicked = input.click(stallClickPoint);\n\t\t}\n\t\telse\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tclicked = input.interact(stall, STEAL_ACTION);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif (clicked)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tnoteSteal();\n\t\t}\n\t\telse\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tcooldown = 1;\n\t\t\tsetStatus(\"Waiting for fruit stall\");\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tprivate void noteSteal()\n\t{\n\t\tcooldown = STEAL_COOLDOWN_TICKS;\n\t\tstallClickPoint = null;\n\t\tstallIndex = 1 - stallIndex;\n\n\t\tif (walker != null)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\twalker.reset();\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tsetStatus(\"Stealing from fruit stall\");\n\t}\n\n\tprivate Optional<TileObject> findFullStall(ScriptContext context, WorldPoint location)\n\t{\n\t\tClient client = context.getClient();\n\t\tTileObject best = null;\n\t\tint bestDistance = Integer.MAX_VALUE;\n\n\t\tfor (TileObject object : context.getTargets().getTileObjects(location, STALL_RADIUS))\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tif (!hasAction(client, object, STEAL_ACTION) || !isFruitStall(client, object))\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tcontinue;\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tWorldPoint objectLocation = object.getWorldLocation();\n\t\t\tif (objectLocation == null)\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tcontinue;\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tint distance = objectLocation.distanceTo(location);\n\t\t\tif (distance < bestDistance)\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tbestDistance = distance;\n\t\t\t\tbest = object;\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn Optional.ofNullable(best);\n\t}\n\n\tprivate static int nearestStall(ScriptContext context)\n\t{\n\t\tWorldPoint playerLocation = context.getPlayerLocation();\n\t\tif (playerLocation == null)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\treturn 0;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tint leftDistance = playerLocation.distanceTo(STALL_LOCATIONS[0]);\n\t\tint rightDistance = playerLocation.distanceTo(STALL_LOCATIONS[1]);\n\t\treturn rightDistance < leftDistance ? 1 : 0;\n\t}\n\n\tprivate static boolean isFruitStall(Client client, TileObject object)\n\t{\n\t\tif (object.getId() == LEFT_STALL_ID || object.getId() == RIGHT_STALL_ID)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\treturn true;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tObjectComposition composition = client.getObjectDefinition(object.getId());\n\t\treturn composition != null && cleanText(composition.getName()).equalsIgnoreCase(STALL_NAME);\n\t}\n\n\tprivate static boolean hasAction(Client client, TileObject object, String action)\n\t{\n\t\tObjectComposition composition = client.getObjectDefinition(object.getId());\n\t\tString[] actions = composition == null ? null : composition.getActions();\n\n\t\tif (actions == null)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\treturn false;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tfor (String candidate : actions)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tif (candidate != null && cleanText(candidate).equalsIgnoreCase(action))\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\treturn true;\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn false;\n\t}\n\n\tprivate void drop(ScriptContext context)\n\t{\n\t\tInventory inventory = context.getInventory();\n\t\tGameInput input = context.getInput();\n\n\t\tif (!inventory.isOpen())\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tif (input.isBusy())\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tsetStatus(\"Opening inventory\");\n\t\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tif (inventory.open())\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tcooldown = 1;\n\t\t\t\tsetStatus(\"Opening inventory\");\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\telse\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tcooldown = 2;\n\t\t\t\tsetStatus(\"Open your inventory\");\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif (context.getClient().isMenuOpen())\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tif (!input.isBusy())\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tinput.closeMenu();\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tsetStatus(\"Closing menu\");\n\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tint itemCount = countItems(inventory);\n\t\tif (itemCount == 0)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tstate = State.STEAL;\n\t\t\tcooldown = 1;\n\t\t\tsetStatus(\"Inventory empty, stealing again\");\n\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif (input.isBusy())\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tsetStatus(\"Dropping inventory (\" + itemCount + \" left)\");\n\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tList<Widget> itemsToDrop = new ArrayList<>();\n\t\tItem[] items = inventory.getItems();\n\n\t\tfor (int slot = 0; slot < Math.min(items.length, Inventory.SIZE)\n\t\t\t&& itemsToDrop.size() < DROP_BATCH_SIZE; slot++)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tItem item = items[slot];\n\t\t\tif (item == null || item.getId() == -1)\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tcontinue;\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tWidget widget = inventory.getSlotWidget(slot);\n\t\t\tif (widget == null || widget.isHidden())\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tcontinue;\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tRectangle bounds = widget.getBounds();\n\t\t\tif (bounds == null || bounds.isEmpty())\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tcontinue;\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\titemsToDrop.add(widget);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif (itemsToDrop.isEmpty())\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tcooldown = 1;\n\t\t\tsetStatus(\"Waiting for inventory\");\n\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Queue the items into one animated sequence that runs at double the\n\t\t// normal mouse speed. Two items fit inside a single game tick, so the\n\t\t// inventory empties in half the time while the cursor still visibly\n\t\t// moves from item to item.\n\t\tif (!input.clickEach(itemsToDrop, DROP_SPEED_MULTIPLIER))\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tcooldown = 1;\n\t\t\tsetStatus(\"Waiting for inventory\");\n\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tcooldown = 0;\n\t\tsetStatus(\"Dropping inventory (\" + itemCount + \" left)\");\n\t}\n\n\t/**\n\t * @return a point inside the stall's clickable hull, as close to its centre\n\t * as possible, or its canvas location when the hull is unavailable\n\t */\n\tprivate static Point centerOf(TileObject object)\n\t{\n\t\tShape clickbox = object.getClickbox();\n\t\tif (clickbox != null)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tPoint point = pointInside(clickbox);\n\t\t\tif (point != null)\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\treturn point;\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tPolygon tilePoly = object.getCanvasTilePoly();\n\t\tif (tilePoly != null)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tPoint point = pointInside(tilePoly);\n\t\t\tif (point != null)\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\treturn point;\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tnet.runelite.api.Point location = object.getCanvasLocation();\n\t\treturn location == null ? null : new Point(location.getX(), location.getY());\n\t}\n\n\t/**\n\t * The centre of a hull's bounding box can fall outside a non-rectangular\n\t * hull. Start at that centre and search outwards for the nearest point\n\t * that is actually inside the shape.\n\t */\n\tprivate static Point pointInside(Shape shape)\n\t{\n\t\tRectangle bounds = shape == null ? null : shape.getBounds();\n\t\tif (bounds == null || bounds.isEmpty())\n\t\t{\n\t\t\treturn null;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tint centerX = (int) Math.round(bounds.getCenterX());\n\t\tint centerY = (int) Math.round(bounds.getCenterY());\n\n\t\tif (shape.contains(centerX, centerY))\n\t\t{\n\t\t\treturn new Point(centerX, centerY);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tint maxRadius = Math.max(bounds.width, bounds.height) / 2;\n\t\tfor (int radius = 1; radius <= maxRadius; radius++)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tfor (int dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++)\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tfor (int dy = -radius; dy <= radius; dy++)\n\t\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\t\tif (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) != radius)\n\t\t\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcontinue;\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\t\tint x = centerX + dx;\n\t\t\t\t\tint y = centerY + dy;\n\t\t\t\t\tif (shape.contains(x, y))\n\t\t\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\t\t\treturn new Point(x, y);\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn null;\n\t}\n\n\tprivate static boolean isPointOnStall(TileObject stall, Point point)\n\t{\n\t\tif (point == null)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\treturn false;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tShape clickbox = stall.getClickbox();\n\t\tif (clickbox != null)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\treturn clickbox.contains(point);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tPolygon tilePoly = stall.getCanvasTilePoly();\n\t\treturn tilePoly != null && tilePoly.contains(point);\n\t}\n\n\tprivate static boolean isFirstAction(Client client, TileObject object, String action)\n\t{\n\t\tObjectComposition composition = client.getObjectDefinition(object.getId());\n\t\treturn composition != null && isFirstAction(composition.getActions(), action);\n\t}\n\n\tprivate static boolean isFirstAction(String[] actions, String action)\n\t{\n\t\tif (actions == null)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\treturn false;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tfor (String candidate : actions)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tif (candidate == null || candidate.trim().isEmpty())\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tcontinue;\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\treturn cleanText(candidate).equalsIgnoreCase(action);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn false;\n\t}\n\n\tprivate static int countItems(Inventory inventory)\n\t{\n\t\tint count = 0;\n\t\tfor (Item item : inventory.getItems())\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tif (item != null && item.getId() != -1)\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\t++count;\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn count;\n\t}\n\n\tprivate void updateStats()\n\t{\n\t\tInventory inventory = getContext().getInventory();\n\t\tClient client = getContext().getClient();\n\t\tlong now = System.currentTimeMillis();\n\t\tint itemCount = countItems(inventory);\n\n\t\tif (!statsInitialized)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tstatsInitialized = true;\n\t\t\tstatsStartedAt = now;\n\t\t\tlastItemCount = itemCount;\n\t\t\tstartThievingXp = 33: /**
34:  * Example script which finds a nearby object and clicks it.
35:  * <p>
36:  * This is intentionally small. Use it as a template for a state machine:
37:  * find a target, interact, wait for the game to update, then repeat.
38:  */
39: public final class ObjectInteractScript extends Script
40: {
41: 	private static final int CLICK_COOLDOWN_TICKS = 3;
42: 
43: 	private final String objectName;
44: 	private final String requiredAction;
45: 	private final int maxDistance;
46: 
47: 	private int cooldown;
48: 
49: 	public ObjectInteractScript(String objectName, String requiredAction, int maxDistance)
50: 	{
51: 		super("Object Interact", "Finds a nearby object and clicks it", 1);
52: 		this.objectName = objectName;
53: 		this.requiredAction = requiredAction;
54: 		this.maxDistance = maxDistance;
55: 	}
56: 
57: 	@Override
58: 	protected void onStart()
59: 	{
60: 		cooldown = 0;
61: 		setStatus("Looking for " + objectName);
62: 	}
63: 
64: 	@Override
65: 	protected void onGameTick()
66: 	{
67: 		ScriptContext context = getContext();
68: 
69: 		if (!context.isLoggedIn())
70: 		{
71: 			setStatus("Waiting for login");
72: 			return;
73: 		}
74: 
75: 		if (cooldown > 0)
76: 		{
77: 			--cooldown;
78: 			setStatus("Cooldown (" + cooldown + ")");
79: 			return;
80: 		}
81: 
82: 		Player player = context.getPlayer();
83: 		if (player.getAnimation() != -1)
84: 		{
85: 			setStatus("Waiting for player to become idle");
86: 			return;
87: 		}
88: 
89: 		Optional<GameObject> target = context.getTargets()
90: 			.findObject(objectName, requiredAction, maxDistance);
91: 		if (target.isEmpty())
92: 		{
93: 			setStatus("No " + objectName + " within " + maxDistance + " tiles");
94: 			return;
95: 		}
96: 
97: 		if (context.getInput().click(target.get()))
98: 		{
99: 			cooldown = CLICK_COOLDOWN_TICKS;
100: 			setStatus("Clicked " + objectName);
101: 		}
102: 		else
103: 		{
104: 			setStatus("Unable to click " + objectName);
105: 		}
106: 	}
107: }

package net.runelite.rsbuddy.script;

import java.lang.reflect.Constructor;
import java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException;
import java.lang.reflect.Modifier;

/**
 * Creates scripts from a class name.
 * <p>
 * Custom script classes must extend {@link Script} and have a no-argument
 * constructor. The class is loaded from the plugin's class loader.
 */
public final class ScriptLoader
{
	private ScriptLoader()
	{
	}

	public static Script load(String className, ClassLoader classLoader) throws ScriptLoadException
	{
		if (className == null || className.trim().isEmpty())
		{
			throw new ScriptLoadException("Enter a script class name");
		}

		String name = className.trim();
		Class<?> type;

		try
		{
			type = Class.forName(name, true, classLoader);
		}
		catch (ClassNotFoundException ex)
		{
			throw new ScriptLoadException("Class not found: " + name, ex);
		}
		catch (LinkageError ex)
		{
			throw new ScriptLoadException("Unable to load " + name + ": " + ex.getMessage(), ex);
		}

		if (!Script.class.isAssignableFrom(type))
		{
			throw new ScriptLoadException(name + " does not extend " + Script.class.getName());
		}

		if (Modifier.isAbstract(type.getModifiers()))
		{
			throw new ScriptLoadException(name + " is abstract");
		}

		try
		{
			Constructor<?> constructor = type.getDeclaredConstructor();
			constructor.setAccessible(true);
			return (Script) constructor.newInstance();
		}
		catch (NoSuchMethodException ex)
		{
			throw new ScriptLoadException(name + " needs a no-arg constructor", ex);
		}
		catch (InvocationTargetException ex)
		{
			Throwable cause = ex.getCause() == null ? ex : ex.getCause();
			throw new ScriptLoadException("Constructor failed: " + cause, cause);
		}
		catch (ReflectiveOperationException | SecurityException ex)
		{
			throw new ScriptLoadException("Unable to create " + name + ": " + ex, ex);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Thrown when a custom script class cannot be loaded.
	 */
	public static final class ScriptLoadException extends Exception
	{
		public ScriptLoadException(String message)
		{
			super(message);
		}

		public ScriptLoadException(String message, Throwable cause)
		{
			super(message, cause);
		}
	}
}

package net.runelite.rsbuddy.script;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

/**
 * Owns the currently running script and dispatches game ticks to it.
 * <p>
 * Lifecycle methods are synchronized so the panel (EDT) and game thread can
 * start and stop scripts safely.
 */
public final class ScriptManager
{
	private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ScriptManager.class);

	private final ScriptContext context;
	private final List<Script> scripts = new ArrayList<>();

	private Script activeScript;

	public ScriptManager(ScriptContext context)
	{
		this.context = context;
	}

	public synchronized void register(Script script)
	{
		if (script != null && !scripts.contains(script))
		{
			scripts.add(script);
		}
	}

	public synchronized List<Script> getScripts()
	{
		return Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(scripts));
	}

	public synchronized Script getActiveScript()
	{
		return activeScript;
	}

	public synchronized boolean isRunning()
	{
		return activeScript != null;
	}

	public synchronized String getStatus()
	{
		return activeScript == null ? "Idle" : activeScript.getStatus();
	}

	public synchronized void start(Script script)
	{
		if (script == null)
		{
			return;
		}

		if (activeScript != null)
		{
			stop();
		}

		activeScript = script;

		try
		{
			script.start(context);
		}
		catch (Throwable ex)
		{
			log.error("Unable to start script {}", script.getName(), ex);
			activeScript = null;
			script.setStatus("Error: " + ex.getMessage());

			try
			{
				script.stop();
			}
			catch (Throwable stopEx)
			{
				log.warn("Unable to stop failed script {}", script.getName(), stopEx);
			}
		}
	}

	public synchronized void stop()
	{
		Script script = activeScript;
		activeScript = null;

		context.getInput().stopCamera();

		if (script == null)
		{
			return;
		}

		try
		{
			script.stop();
		}
		catch (Throwable ex)
		{
			log.warn("Unable to stop script {}", script.getName(), ex);
			script.setStatus("Error: " + ex.getMessage());
		}
	}

	public synchronized void onGameTick()
	{
		Script script = activeScript;
		if (script == null)
		{
			return;
		}

		try
		{
			script.tick();
		}
		catch (Throwable ex)
		{
			log.error("Script {} failed", script.getName(), ex);
			activeScript = null;

			try
			{
				script.stop();
			}
			catch (Throwable stopEx)
			{
				log.warn("Unable to stop failed script {}", script.getName(), stopEx);
			}

			script.setStatus("Error: " + ex.getMessage());
		}
	}
}

package net.runelite.rsbuddy.plugin;

import com.google.inject.Provides;
import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Optional;
import javax.inject.Inject;
import net.runelite.api.ChatMessageType;
import net.runelite.api.Client;
import net.runelite.api.events.CommandExecuted;
import net.runelite.api.events.GameTick;
import net.runelite.client.callback.ClientThread;
import net.runelite.client.config.ConfigManager;
import net.runelite.client.eventbus.Subscribe;
import net.runelite.client.input.MouseManager;
import net.runelite.client.plugins.Plugin;
import net.runelite.client.plugins.PluginDescriptor;
import net.runelite.client.ui.ClientToolbar;
import net.runelite.client.ui.NavigationButton;
import net.runelite.client.ui.overlay.OverlayManager;
import net.runelite.client.util.ImageUtil;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.debug.GeProbe;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.debug.WidgetDumper;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.debug.WidgetWatcher;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.input.GameInput;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.inventory.Inventory;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.script.Script;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.script.ScriptContext;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.script.ScriptLoader;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.script.ScriptManager;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.scripts.ArdougneBakerStallStealerScript;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.scripts.BarbarianFisherCookerScript;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.scripts.CatherbySharkFisherScript;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.scripts.CombatTrainerScript;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.scripts.FruitStallStealerScript;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.scripts.GrandExchangeFlipperScript;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.scripts.HillGiantScript;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.scripts.ObjectInteractScript;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.target.TargetLocator;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

@PluginDescriptor(
	name = "Test Plugin",
	description = "RSBuddy script development scaffold with a script panel",
	tags = {"test", "example", "dev", "script", "rsbuddy"},
	developerPlugin = true
)
public class TestPlugin extends Plugin
{
	private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(TestPlugin.class);

	@Inject
	private Client client;

	@Inject
	private ClientThread clientThread;

	@Inject
	private TestConfig config;

	@Inject
	private ConfigManager configManager;

	@Inject
	private OverlayManager overlayManager;

	@Inject
	private MouseManager mouseManager;

	@Inject
	private ClientToolbar clientToolbar;

	@Inject
	private TestOverlay overlay;

	@Inject
	private XpProgressOverlay xpProgressOverlay;

	@Inject
	private XpLoggerOverlay xpLoggerOverlay;

	@Inject
	private MouseOverlay mouseOverlay;

	private volatile GameInput input;
	private volatile ScriptManager scriptManager;
	private volatile WidgetWatcher watcher;
	private volatile GeProbe probe;
	private TestPluginPanel panel;
	private NavigationButton navButton;

	@Provides
	TestConfig provideConfig(ConfigManager configManager)
	{
		return configManager.getConfig(TestConfig.class);
	}

	@Override
	protected void startUp()
	{
		input = new GameInput(client);
		ScriptContext scriptContext = new ScriptContext(client, input, new TargetLocator(client), new Inventory(client, input));
		scriptManager = new ScriptManager(scriptContext);
		scriptManager.register(new ObjectInteractScript(
			config.targetObjectName(),
			config.targetAction(),
			config.maxDistance()));
		scriptManager.register(new ArdougneBakerStallStealerScript());
		scriptManager.register(new BarbarianFisherCookerScript());
		scriptManager.register(new CatherbySharkFisherScript());
		scriptManager.register(new CombatTrainerScript());
		scriptManager.register(new FruitStallStealerScript(config.fruitStallStayAtOneStall()));
		scriptManager.register(new HillGiantScript());
		scriptManager.register(new GrandExchangeFlipperScript());

		String customScriptError = registerCustomScript(config.customScriptClass());

		panel = new TestPluginPanel(scriptManager, config, configManager, this::startScript);
		panel.setCustomScriptError(customScriptError);

		BufferedImage icon = ImageUtil.loadImageResource(getClass(), "rsbuddy_icon.png");
		navButton = NavigationButton.builder()
			.tooltip("RSBuddy Scripts")
			.icon(icon)
			.priority(1)
			.panel(panel)
			.build();

		clientToolbar.addNavigation(navButton);
		overlayManager.add(overlay);
		overlayManager.add(xpProgressOverlay);
		overlayManager.add(xpLoggerOverlay);
		overlayManager.add(mouseOverlay);
		mouseManager.registerMouseListener(mouseOverlay);
		log.info("RSBuddy started");
	}

	@Override
	protected void shutDown()
	{
		if (scriptManager != null)
		{
			scriptManager.stop();
		}

		if (navButton != null)
		{
			clientToolbar.removeNavigation(navButton);
		}

		if (panel != null)
		{
			panel.shutdown();
		}

		overlayManager.remove(overlay);
		overlayManager.remove(xpProgressOverlay);
		overlayManager.remove(xpLoggerOverlay);
		overlayManager.remove(mouseOverlay);
		mouseManager.unregisterMouseListener(mouseOverlay);
		input = null;
		log.info("RSBuddy stopped");
	}

	@Subscribe
	public void onGameTick(GameTick event)
	{
		WidgetWatcher current = watcher;
		if (current != null)
		{
			if (current.isExpired())
			{
				watcher = null;
				String error = current.getLastError();
				chat("RSBuddy: watch finished after " + current.getSnapshots() + " snapshot(s)"
					+ (error == null || error.isEmpty() ? "" : " (last error: " + error + ")"));
			}
			else
			{
				current.tick(client);
			}
		}

		GeProbe currentProbe = probe;
		if (currentProbe != null)
		{
			if (currentProbe.isFinished())
			{
				probe = null;
			}
			else
			{
				currentProbe.tick();
			}
		}

		if (scriptManager != null)
		{
			scriptManager.onGameTick();
		}
	}

	@Subscribe
	public void onCommandExecuted(CommandExecuted event)
	{
		if (!"rsbuddy".equalsIgnoreCase(event.getCommand()))
		{
			return;
		}

		String[] args = event.getArguments();
		if (args.length == 0 || "status".equalsIgnoreCase(args[0]))
		{
			Script active = scriptManager == null ? null : scriptManager.getActiveScript();
			if (active == null)
			{
				chat("RSBuddy: no script running");
			}
			else
			{
				chat("RSBuddy: " + active.getName() + " - " + active.getStatus());
			}
			return;
		}

		switch (args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))
		{
			case "start":
				startScriptByName(args.length > 1 ? args[1] : null);
				break;
			case "stop":
				scriptManager.stop();
				chat("RSBuddy: stopped");
				break;
			case "list":
				chat("RSBuddy scripts: " + scriptManager.getScripts().stream()
					.map(Script::getName)
					.reduce((left, right) -> left + ", " + right)
					.orElse("none"));
				break;
			case "widgets":
				dumpWidgets(String.join(" ", java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(args, 1, args.length)));
				break;
			case "watch":
				startWatch(args.length > 1 ? args[1] : null);
				break;
			case "probe":
				startProbe();
				break;
			default:
				chat("Usage: ::rsbuddy [status|list|start [name]|stop|widgets [label]|watch [seconds]]");
				break;
		}
	}

	ScriptManager getScriptManager()
	{
		return scriptManager;
	}

	GameInput getInput()
	{
		return input;
	}

	private String registerCustomScript(String className)
	{
		if (className == null || className.trim().isEmpty())
		{
			return null;
		}

		try
		{
			Script script = ScriptLoader.load(className, getClass().getClassLoader());
			scriptManager.register(script);
			return null;
		}
		catch (ScriptLoader.ScriptLoadException ex)
		{
			log.warn("Unable to load custom script {}", className, ex);
			return ex.getMessage();
		}
	}

	private void startScriptByName(String name)
	{
		Optional<Script> script = scriptManager.getScripts().stream()
			.filter(candidate -> name == null
				|| candidate.getName().equalsIgnoreCase(name)
				|| candidate.getClass().getSimpleName().equalsIgnoreCase(name))
			.findFirst();

		if (script.isEmpty())
		{
			chat("RSBuddy: script not found");
			return;
		}

		startScript(script.get());
	}

	void startScript(Script script)
	{
		if (script == null || scriptManager == null)
		{
			return;
		}

		Script target = script;

		// Recreate config-backed scripts so changes are picked up when starting from the panel.
		if (script instanceof ObjectInteractScript)
		{
			target = new ObjectInteractScript(
				config.targetObjectName(),
				config.targetAction(),
				config.maxDistance());
		}
		else if (script instanceof FruitStallStealerScript)
		{
			target = new FruitStallStealerScript(config.fruitStallStayAtOneStall());
		}

		scriptManager.start(target);
		chat("RSBuddy: started " + target.getName());
	}

	private void chat(String message)
	{
		clientThread.invokeLater(() ->
			client.addChatMessage(ChatMessageType.GAMEMESSAGE, "", message, null));
	}

	/**
	 * Starts a timed widget watch. Snapshots are taken automatically whenever
	 * the visible interface changes, so interfaces that grab keyboard focus
	 * (like the GE item search) can be captured without typing a command.
	 */
	private void startWatch(String secondsArg)
	{
		int seconds = 60;
		if (secondsArg != null && !secondsArg.isEmpty())
		{
			try
			{
				seconds = Integer.parseInt(secondsArg.trim());
			}
			catch (NumberFormatException ignored)
			{
				// Keep the default.
			}
		}

		seconds = Math.max(5, Math.min(300, seconds));
		watcher = new WidgetWatcher(seconds);

		chat("RSBuddy: watching widgets for " + seconds + "s. Just click through the screens now.");
		chat("RSBuddy: snapshots append to " + WidgetDumper.getLogFile());
	}

	/**
	 * Runs the sell-screen probe: it opens a sell offer, hovers an inventory
	 * item, records the menu and setup widgets, then backs out without
	 * confirming anything. Used to capture interface details automatically.
	 */
	private void startProbe()
	{
		GameInput currentInput = input;
		if (currentInput == null)
		{
			chat("RSBuddy: input is not ready yet.");
			return;
		}

		probe = new GeProbe(client, currentInput, new Inventory(client, currentInput),
			message -> chat("RSBuddy: " + message));
		chat("RSBuddy: probing the GE sell screen. Do not click until it says it is done.");
	}

	/**
	 * Appends a snapshot of the visible interface to the widget dump file so
	 * interface ids and actions can be read off disk instead of hovering each
	 * element in RuneLite's widget inspector.
	 */
	private void dumpWidgets(String label)
	{
		if (label == null || label.isEmpty())
		{
			label = "manual";
		}

		try
		{
			int count = WidgetDumper.snapshot(client, label);
			chat("RSBuddy: widget snapshot '" + label + "' (" + count + " widgets) -> "
				+ WidgetDumper.getLogFile());
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			log.warn("Unable to write widget snapshot", ex);
			chat("RSBuddy: widget snapshot failed: " + ex.getClass().getSimpleName()
				+ ": " + ex.getMessage());
		}
	}

package net.runelite.rsbuddy.plugin;

import java.awt.BorderLayout;

/**
 * Sidebar panel used to pick and control RSBuddy scripts.
 */
public final class TestPluginPanel extends PluginPanel
{
	private static final int REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS = 500;

	private final ScriptManager scriptManager;
	private final TestConfig config;
	private final ConfigManager configManager;
	private final Consumer<Script> startScript;
	private final JComboBox<Script> scriptSelector;
	private final JButton startButton;
	private final JButton stopButton;
	private final JLabel activeLabel;
	private final JLabel statusLabel;
	private final JTextArea description;
	private final JLabel scriptSettingsTitle;
	private final JPanel scriptSettingsPanel;
	private final JLabel scriptSettingsHint;
	private final JTextField customClassField;
	private final JLabel customErrorLabel;
	private final Timer refreshTimer;

	private Script settingsScript;

	public TestPluginPanel(ScriptManager scriptManager, TestConfig config, ConfigManager configManager,
		Consumer<Script> startScript)
	{
		this.scriptManager = scriptManager;
		this.config = config;
		this.configManager = configManager;
		this.startScript = startScript;

		setLayout(new DynamicGridLayout(0, 1, 0, 6));
		setBackground(ColorScheme.DARK_GRAY_COLOR);

		JLabel title = new JLabel("RSBuddy");
		title.setForeground(ColorScheme.BRAND_ORANGE);
		title.setFont(FontManager.getRunescapeBoldFont());

		hint.setForeground(ColorScheme.LIGHT_GRAY_COLOR);

		scriptSettingsTitle.setForeground(ColorScheme.TEXT_COLOR);
		scriptSettingsTitle.setFont(FontManager.getRunescapeBoldFont());

			settingsScript = null;
			refresh();
		});
		refresh();
		refreshTimer.start();
	}

	@Override
	public void onActivate()
	{
		// Pick up any changes made in the plugin config while the panel was
		// hidden.
		settingsScript = null;
		refresh();
		refreshTimer.start();
	}

	@Override
	public void onDeactivate()
	{
		refreshTimer.stop();
	}

	void shutdown()
	{
		refreshTimer.stop();
	}

	void setCustomScriptError(String message)
	{
		if (message == null || message.trim().isEmpty())
		{
			customErrorLabel.setText(" ");
			customErrorLabel.setToolTipText(null);
		}
		else
		{
			customErrorLabel.setText(message);
			customErrorLabel.setToolTipText(message);
		}
	}

	private void loadCustomScript()
	{
		String className = customClassField.getText().trim();
		if (className.isEmpty())
		{
			setCustomScriptError("Enter a script class name");
			return;
		}

		Script script = findLoadedScript(className);
		if (script == null)
		{
			try
			{
				script = ScriptLoader.load(className, TestPluginPanel.class.getClassLoader());
			}
			catch (ScriptLoader.ScriptLoadException ex)
			{
				setCustomScriptError(ex.getMessage());
				return;
			}

			scriptManager.register(script);
			scriptSelector.addItem(script);
		}

		customClassField.setText(className);
		scriptSelector.setSelectedItem(script);
		configManager.setConfiguration(TestConfig.GROUP, "customScriptClass", className);
		setCustomScriptError(null);
	}

	private Script findLoadedScript(String className)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < scriptSelector.getItemCount(); i++)
		{
			Script candidate = scriptSelector.getItemAt(i);
			if (candidate.getClass().getName().equals(className))
			{
				return candidate;
			}
		}

		return null;
	}

	private void startSelectedScript()
	{
		Script selected = (Script) scriptSelector.getSelectedItem();
		if (selected != null)
		{
			startScript.accept(selected);
			refresh();
		}
	}

	private void refresh()
	{
		Script active = scriptManager.getActiveScript();
		if (active == null)
		{
			activeLabel.setText("Running: none");
			statusLabel.setText("Status: idle");
		}
		else
		{
			activeLabel.setText("Running: " + active.getName());
			statusLabel.setText("Status: " + active.getStatus());
		}

		startButton.setEnabled(scriptSelector.getItemCount() > 0);
		stopButton.setEnabled(active != null);

		Script selected = (Script) scriptSelector.getSelectedItem();
		description.setText(selected == null ? "No scripts registered." : selected.getDescription());

		if (selected != settingsScript)
		{
			settingsScript = selected;
			rebuildScriptSettings(selected);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Builds the settings for the selected script. Scripts with their own
	 * configurable options add their controls here.
	 */
	private void rebuildScriptSettings(Script script)

		scriptSettingsPanel.removeAll();

package net.runelite.rsbuddy.script;

import java.awt.Color;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Base class for RSBuddy scripts.
 * <p>
 * Scripts are driven by game ticks via {@link ScriptManager}. They should keep
 * each tick short and leave longer waits to their cooldown/state machine.
 */
public abstract class Script
{
	private final String name;
	private final String description;
	private final int tickDelay;

	private ScriptContext context;
	private String status = "Idle";
	private int ticks;

	protected Script(String name, String description)
	{
		this(name, description, 1);
	}

	protected Script(String name, String description, int tickDelay)
	{
		this.name = name;
		this.description = description;
		this.tickDelay = Math.max(1, tickDelay);
	}

	final void start(ScriptContext context)
	{
		this.context = context;
		this.ticks = 0;
		setStatus("Starting");
		onStart();
	}

	final void stop()
	{
		try
		{
			onStop();
		}
		finally
		{
			setStatus("Stopped");
		}
	}

	final void tick()
	{
		if (++ticks < tickDelay)
		{
			return;
		}

		ticks = 0;
		onGameTick();
	}

	protected abstract void onGameTick();

	protected void onStart()
	{
	}

	protected void onStop()
	{
	}

	protected final ScriptContext getContext()
	{
		return context;
	}

	protected final void setStatus(String status)
	{
		this.status = status;
	}

	public final String getName()
	{
		return name;
	}

	public final String getDescription()
	{
		return description;
	}

	public final String getStatus()
	{
		return status;
	}

	/**
	 * Extra lines rendered by the status overlay while this script is running.
	 * Scripts can override this to expose their own counters and progress.
	 */
	public List<String> getOverlayLines()
	{
		return Collections.emptyList();
	}

	/**
	 * Progress bars rendered by the XP overlay while this script is running.
	 * Each bar represents progress from the current level to the next level.
	 */
	public List<ProgressBar> getProgressBars()
	{
		return Collections.emptyList();
	}

	public static final class ProgressBar
	{
		private final String label;
		private final double progress;
		private final String value;
		private final Color color;

		public ProgressBar(String label, double progress, String value, Color color)
		{
			this.label = label;
			this.progress = Math.max(0.0, Math.min(1.0, progress));
			this.value = value;
			this.color = color == null ? Color.CYAN : color;
		}

		public String getLabel()
		{
			return label;
		}

		public double getProgress()
		{
			return progress;
		}

		public String getValue()
		{
			return value;
		}

		public Color getColor()
		{
			return color;
		}
	}
}

@Slf4j
public class PluginManager
{
	/**
	 * Base package where the core plugins are
	 */
	private static final String PLUGIN_PACKAGE = "net.runelite.client.plugins";
	private static final File SIDELOADED_PLUGINS = new File(RuneLite.RUNELITE_DIR, "sideloaded-plugins");

	private final boolean developerMode;
	private final boolean safeMode;
	private final EventBus eventBus;
	private final Scheduler scheduler;
	private final ConfigManager configManager;
	private final Provider<GameEventManager> sceneTileManager;
	private final PluginModuleFactory pluginModuleFactory;
	private final List<Plugin> plugins = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
	private final List<Plugin> activePlugins = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();

	@Inject
	@VisibleForTesting
	PluginManager(
		@Named("developerMode") final boolean developerMode,
		@Named("safeMode") final boolean safeMode,
		final EventBus eventBus,
		final Scheduler scheduler,
		final ConfigManager configManager,
		final Provider<GameEventManager> sceneTileManager,
		final PluginModuleFactory pluginModuleFactory)
	{
		this.developerMode = developerMode;
		this.safeMode = safeMode;
		this.eventBus = eventBus;
		this.scheduler = scheduler;
		this.configManager = configManager;
		this.sceneTileManager = sceneTileManager;
		this.pluginModuleFactory = pluginModuleFactory;
	}

	@Subscribe
	public void onProfileChanged(ProfileChanged profileChanged)
	{
		refreshPlugins();
	}

	private void refreshPlugins()
	{
		loadDefaultPluginConfiguration(null);
		SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() ->
		{
			for (Plugin plugin : getPlugins())
			{
				try
				{
					if (isPluginEnabled(plugin) != activePlugins.contains(plugin))
					{
						if (activePlugins.contains(plugin))
						{
							stopPlugin(plugin);
						}
						else
						{
							startPlugin(plugin);
						}
					}
				}
				catch (PluginInstantiationException e)
				{
					log.error("Error during starting/stopping plugin {}", plugin.getClass().getSimpleName(), e);
				}
			}
		});
	}

	public Config getPluginConfigProxy(Plugin plugin)
	{
		try
		{
			final Injector injector = plugin.getInjector();

			for (Key<?> key : injector.getBindings().keySet())
			{
				Class<?> type = key.getTypeLiteral().getRawType();
				if (Config.class.isAssignableFrom(type))
				{
					return (Config) injector.getInstance(key);
				}
			}
		}
		catch (ThreadDeath e)
		{
			throw e;
		}
		catch (Throwable e)
		{
			log.error("Unable to get plugin config", e);
		}
		return null;
	}

	public List<Config> getPluginConfigProxies(Collection<Plugin> plugins)
	{
		List<Injector> injectors = new ArrayList<>();
		if (plugins == null)
		{
			injectors.add(RuneLite.getInjector());
			plugins = getPlugins();
		}
		plugins.forEach(pl -> injectors.add(pl.getInjector()));

		List<Config> list = new ArrayList<>();
		for (Injector injector : injectors)
		{
			for (Key<?> key : injector.getBindings().keySet())
			{
				Class<?> type = key.getTypeLiteral().getRawType();
				if (Config.class.isAssignableFrom(type))
				{
					Config config = (Config) injector.getInstance(key);
					list.add(config);
				}
			}
		}

		return list;
	}

	public void loadDefaultPluginConfiguration(Collection<Plugin> plugins)
	{
		try
		{
			for (Config config : getPluginConfigProxies(plugins))
			{
				configManager.setDefaultConfiguration(config, false);
			}
		}
		catch (ThreadDeath e)
		{
			throw e;
		}
		catch (Throwable ex)
		catch (Throwable ex)
		{
			log.error("Unable to reset plugin configuration", ex);
		}
	}

	public void startPlugins()
	{
		List<Plugin> scannedPlugins = new ArrayList<>(plugins);
		int loaded = 0;
		for (Plugin plugin : scannedPlugins)
		{
			try
			{
				SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() ->
				{
					try
					{
						startPlugin(plugin);
					}
					catch (PluginInstantiationException ex)
					{
						log.error("Unable to start plugin {}", plugin.getClass().getSimpleName(), ex);
					}
				});
			}
			catch (InterruptedException | InvocationTargetException e)
			{
				throw new RuntimeException(e);
			}

			loaded++;
			SplashScreen.stage(.80, 1, null, "Starting plugins", loaded, scannedPlugins.size(), false);
		}

		for (Plugin plugin : plugins)
		{
			ReflectUtil.queueInjectorAnnotationCacheInvalidation(plugin.injector);
		}
	}

	public void loadCorePlugins() throws IOException, PluginInstantiationException
	{
		SplashScreen.stage(.59, null, "Loading plugins");
		ClassPath classPath = ClassPath.from(getClass().getClassLoader());

		List<Class<?>> plugins = classPath.getTopLevelClassesRecursive(PLUGIN_PACKAGE).stream()
			.map(ClassInfo::load)
			.collect(Collectors.toList());

		loadPlugins(plugins, (loaded, total) ->
			SplashScreen.stage(.60, .70, null, "Loading plugins", loaded, total, false));
	}

	public void loadSideLoadPlugins()
	{
		if (!developerMode)
		{
			return;
		}

		File[] files = SIDELOADED_PLUGINS.listFiles();
		if (files == null)
		{
			return;
		}

		for (File f : files)
		{
			if (f.getName().endsWith(".jar"))
			{
				log.info("Side-loading plugin {}", f);

				try
				{
					ClassLoader classLoader = new PluginClassLoader(f, getClass().getClassLoader());

					List<Class<?>> plugins = ClassPath.from(classLoader)
						.getAllClasses()
						.stream()
						.map(ClassInfo::load)
						.collect(Collectors.toList());

					loadPlugins(plugins, null);
				}
				catch (PluginInstantiationException | IOException ex)
				{
					log.error("error sideloading plugin", ex);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public List<Plugin> loadPlugins(List<Class<?>> plugins, BiConsumer<Integer, Integer> onPluginLoaded) throws PluginInstantiationException
	{
		MutableGraph<Class<? extends Plugin>> graph = GraphBuilder
			.directed()
			.build();

		for (Class<?> clazz : plugins)
		{
			PluginDescriptor pluginDescriptor = clazz.getAnnotation(PluginDescriptor.class);

			if (pluginDescriptor == null)
			{
				if (clazz.getSuperclass() == Plugin.class)
				{
					log.error("Class {} is a plugin, but has no plugin descriptor", clazz);
				}
				continue;
			}

			if (clazz.getSuperclass() != Plugin.class)
			{
				log.error("Class {} has plugin descriptor, but is not a plugin", clazz);
				continue;
			}

			if (pluginDescriptor.developerPlugin() && !developerMode)
			{
				continue;
			}

			if (safeMode && !pluginDescriptor.loadInSafeMode())
			{
				log.debug("Disabling {} due to safe mode", clazz);
				// also disable the plugin from autostarting later
				configManager.setConfiguration(RuneLiteConfig.GROUP_NAME,
					(Strings.isNullOrEmpty(pluginDescriptor.configName()) ? clazz.getSimpleName() : pluginDescriptor.configName()).toLowerCase(),
					false);
				continue;
			}

			graph.addNode((Class<Plugin>) clazz);
		}

		// Build plugin graph
		for (Class<? extends Plugin> pluginClazz : graph.nodes())
		{
			PluginDependency[] pluginDependencies = pluginClazz.getAnnotationsByType(PluginDependency.class);

			for (PluginDependency pluginDependency : pluginDependencies)
			{
				if (graph.nodes().contains(pluginDependency.value()))
				{
					graph.putEdge(pluginDependency.value(), pluginClazz);
				}
			}
		}

		if (Graphs.hasCycle(graph))
		{
			throw new PluginInstantiationException("Plugin dependency graph contains a cycle!");
		}

		List<Class<? extends Plugin>> sortedPlugins = topologicalSort(graph);

		int loaded = 0;
		List<Plugin> newPlugins = new ArrayList<>();
		for (Class<? extends Plugin> pluginClazz : sortedPlugins)
		{
			Plugin plugin;
			try
			{
				plugin = instantiate(this.plugins, (Class<Plugin>) pluginClazz);
				newPlugins.add(plugin);
				this.plugins.add(plugin);
			}
			catch (PluginInstantiationException ex)
			{
				log.error("Error instantiating plugin {}!", pluginClazz, ex);
			}

			loaded++;
			if (onPluginLoaded != null)
			{
				onPluginLoaded.accept(loaded, sortedPlugins.size());
			}
		}

		return newPlugins;
	}

	public boolean startPlugin(Plugin plugin) throws PluginInstantiationException
	{
		// plugins always start in the EDT
		assert SwingUtilities.isEventDispatchThread();

		if (activePlugins.contains(plugin) || !isPluginEnabled(plugin))

			return false;
		}

		List<Plugin> conflicts = conflictsForPlugin(plugin);
		for (Plugin conflict : conflicts)
		{
			if (isPluginEnabled(conflict))
			{

package net.runelite.client.plugins;

import java.io.File;
import java.net.MalformedURLException;
import java.net.URL;
import java.net.URLClassLoader;

class PluginClassLoader extends URLClassLoader
{
	private final ClassLoader parent;

	PluginClassLoader(File plugin, ClassLoader parent) throws MalformedURLException
	{
		// null parent classloader, or else class path scanning includes everything from the main class loader
		super(new URL[]{plugin.toURI().toURL()}, null);

		this.parent = parent;
	}

	@Override
	public Class<?> loadClass(String name) throws ClassNotFoundException
	{
		try
		{
			return super.loadClass(name);
		}
		catch (ClassNotFoundException ex)
		{
			// fall back to main class loader
			return parent.loadClass(name);
		}
	}
}

	private void addTextSetting(String label, String value, Consumer<String> save)
	{
		JLabel title = new JLabel(label);
		title.setForeground(ColorScheme.TEXT_COLOR);
		scriptSettingsPanel.add(title);

		JTextField field = new JTextField(value);
		field.setToolTipText(label);

		Runnable apply = () -> save.accept(field.getText().trim());
		field.addActionListener(event -> apply.run());
		field.addFocusListener(new FocusAdapter()
		{
			@Override
			public void focusLost(FocusEvent event)
			{
				apply.run();
			}
		});

		scriptSettingsPanel.add(field);
	}

package net.runelite.rsbuddy.scripts;

import java.util.Optional;
import net.runelite.api.NPC;
import net.runelite.api.Player;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.script.Script;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.script.ScriptContext;

/**
 * Starter script for you to edit.
 * <p>
 * Set {@link #TARGET_NPC} to an NPC name to see the example in action. The
 * other examples at the bottom of {@link #onGameTick()} show how to interact
 * with objects and widgets, and how to walk to a tile.
 */
public final class CustomScript extends Script
{
	// TODO: set this to the NPC you want to interact with, for example "Cow".
	private static final String TARGET_NPC = "";
	private static final String TARGET_ACTION = "Attack";
	private static final int MAX_DISTANCE = 10;
	private static final int COOLDOWN_TICKS = 3;

	private int cooldown;

	public CustomScript()
	{
		super("Custom Script", "Edit CustomScript.java to add your own logic.");
	}

	@Override
	protected void onStart()
	{
		cooldown = 0;
		setStatus("Ready");
	}

	@Override
	protected void onGameTick()
	{
		ScriptContext context = getContext();

		if (!context.isLoggedIn())
		{
			setStatus("Waiting for login");
			return;
		}

		if (cooldown > 0)
		{
			--cooldown;
			setStatus("Cooldown (" + cooldown + ")");
			return;
		}

		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		if (player.getAnimation() != -1)
		{
			setStatus("Waiting for player to become idle");
			return;
		}

		if (TARGET_NPC.isEmpty())
		{
			setStatus("Set TARGET_NPC in CustomScript.java");
			return;
		}

		Optional<NPC> target = context.getTargets()
			.findNpc(TARGET_NPC, TARGET_ACTION, MAX_DISTANCE);

		if (target.isPresent() && context.getInput().interact(target.get(), TARGET_ACTION))
		{
			cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
			setStatus("Interacting with " + TARGET_NPC);
			return;
		}

		setStatus("No " + TARGET_NPC + " within " + MAX_DISTANCE + " tiles");

		// Other examples:
		//
		// context.getTargets().findObject("Tree", "Chop down", MAX_DISTANCE)
		//     .ifPresent(object -> context.getInput().click(object));
		//
		// context.getTargets().findWidget(componentId)
		//     .ifPresent(widget -> context.getInput().click(widget));
		//
		// context.getInput().walkTo(new WorldPoint(3200, 3200, context.getClient().getPlane()));
	}
}

package net.runelite.rsbuddy.plugin;

import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.Dimension;
import java.awt.FontMetrics;
import java.awt.Graphics2D;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import javax.inject.Inject;
import net.runelite.api.Client;
import net.runelite.api.Player;
import net.runelite.client.ui.FontManager;
import net.runelite.client.ui.overlay.Overlay;
import net.runelite.client.ui.overlay.OverlayLayer;
import net.runelite.client.ui.overlay.OverlayPosition;
import net.runelite.client.util.Text;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.script.Script;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.script.ScriptManager;

/**
 * Displays plugin state and the status of the active script.
 */
public class TestOverlay extends Overlay
{
	private static final int PADDING = 6;
	private static final int LINE_GAP = 2;
	private static final int PANEL_WIDTH = 280;
	private static final Color BACKGROUND = new Color(56, 43, 28, 220);
	private static final Color BORDER = new Color(120, 95, 62, 255);

	private final Client client;
	private final TestConfig config;
	private final TestPlugin plugin;

	@Inject
	private TestOverlay(Client client, TestConfig config, TestPlugin plugin)
	{
		this.client = client;
		this.config = config;
		this.plugin = plugin;

		setPosition(OverlayPosition.TOP_LEFT);
		setLayer(OverlayLayer.ABOVE_WIDGETS);
	}

	@Override
	public Dimension render(Graphics2D graphics)
	{
		List<String> lines = new ArrayList<>();
		lines.add(config.greeting());

		if (config.showPlayerInfo())
		{
			Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
			if (player != null)
			{
				lines.add("Player: " + Text.removeTags(player.getName()));
			}

			lines.add("World: " + client.getWorld());
		}

		ScriptManager scriptManager = plugin.getScriptManager();
		Script active = scriptManager == null ? null : scriptManager.getActiveScript();
		lines.add(active == null ? "Script: none" : "Script: " + active.getName());
		lines.add("Status: " + (active == null ? "Idle" : active.getStatus()));

		if (active != null)
		{
			lines.addAll(active.getOverlayLines());
		}

		graphics.setFont(FontManager.getRunescapeSmallFont());
		FontMetrics metrics = graphics.getFontMetrics();

		int width = PANEL_WIDTH;
		int textWidth = width - PADDING * 2;

		int lineHeight = metrics.getHeight() + LINE_GAP;
		int height = lines.size() * lineHeight - LINE_GAP + PADDING * 2;

		graphics.setColor(BACKGROUND);
		graphics.fillRoundRect(0, 0, width, height, 6, 6);
		graphics.setColor(BORDER);
		graphics.drawRoundRect(0, 0, width - 1, height - 1, 6, 6);

		Color textColor = config.textColor() == null ? Color.WHITE : config.textColor();
		int y = PADDING + metrics.getAscent();
		for (String line : lines)
		{
			String text = fitText(metrics, line, textWidth);
			graphics.setColor(Color.BLACK);
			graphics.drawString(text, PADDING + 1, y + 1);
			graphics.setColor(textColor);
			graphics.drawString(text, PADDING, y);
			y += lineHeight;
		}

		return new Dimension(width, height);
	}

	private static String fitText(FontMetrics metrics, String text, int maxWidth)
	{
		if (text == null)
		{
			return "";
		}

		if (metrics.stringWidth(text) <= maxWidth)
		{
			return text;
		}

		String ellipsis = "...";
		int ellipsisWidth = metrics.stringWidth(ellipsis);
		int end = text.length();
		while (end > 0 && metrics.stringWidth(text.substring(0, end)) + ellipsisWidth > maxWidth)
		{
			--end;
		}

		return text.substring(0, end) + ellipsis;
	}
}

package net.runelite.rsbuddy.plugin;

import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.Dimension;
import java.awt.Font;
import java.awt.FontMetrics;
import java.awt.GradientPaint;
import java.awt.Graphics2D;
import java.awt.Shape;
import java.awt.geom.RoundRectangle2D;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import javax.inject.Inject;
import net.runelite.client.ui.FontManager;
import net.runelite.client.ui.overlay.Overlay;
import net.runelite.client.ui.overlay.OverlayLayer;
import net.runelite.client.ui.overlay.OverlayPosition;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.script.Script;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.script.ScriptManager;

/**
 * Draws animated level progress bars for the active script.
 */
public class XpProgressOverlay extends Overlay
{
	private static final int PADDING = 8;
	private static final int WIDTH = 250;
	private static final int BAR_HEIGHT = 12;
	private static final int LABEL_GAP = 4;
	private static final int BAR_GAP = 12;

	private static final Color BACKGROUND = new Color(56, 43, 28, 220);
	private static final Color BORDER = new Color(120, 95, 62, 255);
	private static final Color TITLE = new Color(255, 222, 170);
	private static final Color TEXT = new Color(235, 235, 235);
	private static final Color TRACK = new Color(28, 22, 16, 220);
	private static final Color TRACK_BORDER = new Color(92, 73, 49, 255);

	private final TestPlugin plugin;
	private final Map<String, Double> displayedProgress = new HashMap<>();

	private long lastFrameAt;

	@Inject
	private XpProgressOverlay(TestPlugin plugin)
	{
		this.plugin = plugin;

		setPosition(OverlayPosition.TOP_RIGHT);
		setLayer(OverlayLayer.ABOVE_WIDGETS);
	}

	@Override
	public Dimension render(Graphics2D graphics)
	{
		ScriptManager scriptManager = plugin.getScriptManager();
		Script active = scriptManager == null ? null : scriptManager.getActiveScript();
		if (active == null)
		{
			resetAnimation();
			return null;
		}

		List<Script.ProgressBar> bars = active.getProgressBars();
		if (bars == null || bars.isEmpty())
		{
			resetAnimation();
			return null;
		}

		long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
		double deltaSeconds = lastFrameAt == 0 ? 0.2 : Math.min(0.5, (now - lastFrameAt) / 1000.0);
		lastFrameAt = now;
		double ease = 1.0 - Math.exp(-deltaSeconds * 7.0);

		Font titleFont = FontManager.getRunescapeBoldFont();
		Font smallFont = FontManager.getRunescapeSmallFont();
		graphics.setFont(smallFont);
		FontMetrics metrics = graphics.getFontMetrics();
		graphics.setFont(titleFont);
		FontMetrics titleMetrics = graphics.getFontMetrics();

		int width = WIDTH;
		int barWidth = width - PADDING * 2;
		int rowHeight = metrics.getHeight() + LABEL_GAP + BAR_HEIGHT + BAR_GAP;
		int height = PADDING * 2 + titleMetrics.getHeight() + 4 + bars.size() * rowHeight - BAR_GAP;

		graphics.setColor(BACKGROUND);
		graphics.fillRoundRect(0, 0, width, height, 6, 6);
		graphics.setColor(BORDER);
		graphics.drawRoundRect(0, 0, width - 1, height - 1, 6, 6);

		graphics.setFont(titleFont);
		graphics.setColor(TITLE);
		graphics.drawString("XP Progress", PADDING, PADDING + titleMetrics.getAscent());

		int y = PADDING + titleMetrics.getHeight() + 4;
		for (Script.ProgressBar bar : bars)
		{
			double target = bar.getProgress();
			double current = displayedProgress.getOrDefault(bar.getLabel(), 0.0);
			current += (target - current) * ease;
			if (Math.abs(target - current) < 0.0005)
			{
				current = target;
			}
			displayedProgress.put(bar.getLabel(), current);

			graphics.setFont(smallFont);
			graphics.setColor(TEXT);
			graphics.drawString(bar.getLabel(), PADDING, y + metrics.getAscent());

			String value = bar.getValue();
			if (value != null)
			{
				int valueWidth = metrics.stringWidth(value);
				graphics.setColor(new Color(215, 215, 215));
				graphics.drawString(value, width - PADDING - valueWidth, y + metrics.getAscent());
			}

			y += metrics.getHeight() + LABEL_GAP;

			graphics.setColor(TRACK);
			graphics.fillRoundRect(PADDING, y, barWidth, BAR_HEIGHT, BAR_HEIGHT, BAR_HEIGHT);
			graphics.setColor(TRACK_BORDER);
			graphics.drawRoundRect(PADDING, y, barWidth, BAR_HEIGHT, BAR_HEIGHT, BAR_HEIGHT);

			int fillWidth = (int) Math.round(barWidth * current);
			if (fillWidth > 0)
			{
				Shape oldClip = graphics.getClip();
				Shape fill = new RoundRectangle2D.Double(
					PADDING, y, fillWidth, BAR_HEIGHT, BAR_HEIGHT, BAR_HEIGHT);
				graphics.setClip(fill);

				Color base = bar.getColor();
				graphics.setPaint(new GradientPaint(
					PADDING, y, base.darker(),
					PADDING, y + BAR_HEIGHT, base.brighter()));
				graphics.fillRect(PADDING, y, fillWidth, BAR_HEIGHT);

				// A soft highlight sweeps across the filled section.
				double phase = (now % 2200L) / 2200.0;
				int shimmerX = PADDING - 24 + (int) Math.round((barWidth + 48) * phase);
				graphics.setPaint(new GradientPaint(
					shimmerX, 0, new Color(255, 255, 255, 0),
					shimmerX + 16, 0, new Color(255, 255, 255, 90)));
				graphics.fillRect(shimmerX, y, 16, BAR_HEIGHT);
				graphics.setPaint(new GradientPaint(
					shimmerX + 16, 0, new Color(255, 255, 255, 90),
					shimmerX + 32, 0, new Color(255, 255, 255, 0)));
				graphics.fillRect(shimmerX + 16, y, 16, BAR_HEIGHT);

				graphics.setClip(oldClip);
				graphics.setColor(new Color(base.getRed(), base.getGreen(), base.getBlue(), 130));
				graphics.drawRoundRect(PADDING, y, fillWidth, BAR_HEIGHT, BAR_HEIGHT, BAR_HEIGHT);
			}

			graphics.setFont(smallFont);
			String percent = String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.1f%%", current * 100.0);
			int percentWidth = metrics.stringWidth(percent);
			int percentX = PADDING + (barWidth - percentWidth) / 2;
			int percentY = y + (BAR_HEIGHT + metrics.getAscent()) / 2 - 1;
			graphics.setColor(new Color(0, 0, 0, 160));
			graphics.drawString(percent, percentX + 1, percentY + 1);
			graphics.setColor(Color.WHITE);
			graphics.drawString(percent, percentX, percentY);

			y += BAR_HEIGHT + BAR_GAP;
		}

		return new Dimension(width, height);
	}

	private void resetAnimation()
	{
		displayedProgress.clear();
		lastFrameAt = 0;
	}
}

public final class ObjectInteractScript extends Script
{
	private static final int CLICK_COOLDOWN_TICKS = 3;

	private final String objectName;
	private final String requiredAction;
	private final int maxDistance;

	private int cooldown;

	public ObjectInteractScript(String objectName, String requiredAction, int maxDistance)
	{
		super("Object Interact", "Finds a nearby object and clicks it", 1);
		this.objectName = objectName;
		this.requiredAction = requiredAction;
		this.maxDistance = maxDistance;
	}

	@Override
	protected void onStart()
	{
		cooldown = 0;
		setStatus("Looking for " + objectName);
	}

	@Override
	protected void onGameTick()
	{
		ScriptContext context = getContext();

		if (!context.isLoggedIn())
		{
			setStatus("Waiting for login");
			return;
		}

		if (cooldown > 0)
		{
			--cooldown;
			setStatus("Cooldown (" + cooldown + ")");
			return;
		}

		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		if (player.getAnimation() != -1)
		{
			setStatus("Waiting for player to become idle");
			return;
		}

		Optional<GameObject> target = context.getTargets()
			.findObject(objectName, requiredAction, maxDistance);
		if (target.isEmpty())
		{
			setStatus("No " + objectName + " within " + maxDistance + " tiles");
			return;
		}

		if (context.getInput().click(target.get()))
		{
			cooldown = CLICK_COOLDOWN_TICKS;
			setStatus("Clicked " + objectName);
		}
		else
		{
			setStatus("Unable to click " + objectName);
		}

+	/**
+	 * Loads the selected script again from the newest compiled classes and

+	Script reloadScript(Script script)
+	{
+		if (script == null || scriptManager == null)
+		{
+			return script;
+		}
+
+		File classesRoot = resolveScriptClassesDirectory();
+		if (classesRoot == null || !classesRoot.isDirectory())
+		{
+			throw new IllegalStateException("Compiled script classes not found. Build the rsbuddy module first.");
+		}
+
+		String className = script.getClass().getName();
+		File classFile = new File(classesRoot, className.replace('.', '/') + ".class");
+		if (!classFile.isFile())
+		{
+			throw new IllegalStateException("No compiled class for " + className + " in " + classesRoot);
+		}
+
+		Script replacement;
+		try
+		{
+			ClassLoader loader = new ReloadingClassLoader(classesRoot, getClass().getClassLoader());
+			replacement = createScript(className, loader);
+		}
+		catch (MalformedURLException ex)
+		{
+			throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid script classes directory: " + classesRoot, ex);
+		}
+		catch (ScriptLoader.ScriptLoadException ex)
+		{
+			throw new IllegalStateException(ex.getMessage(), ex);
+		}
+
+		scriptManager.replace(script, replacement);

+		return replacement;

+	private File resolveScriptClassesDirectory()

+		}
+
+		String property = System.getProperty("rsbuddy.scriptClasses");
+		if (property != null && !property.trim().isEmpty())
+		{
+			return resolveAgainstWorkingDirectory(property.trim());
+		}
+
+		File workingDirectory = new File(System.getProperty("user.dir", "."));
+		for (File directory = workingDirectory; directory != null; directory = directory.getParentFile())
+		{
+			File candidate = new File(directory, "rsbuddy/build/classes/java/main");
+			if (isScriptClassesDirectory(candidate))
+			{
+				return candidate;
+			}
+
+			if ("rsbuddy".equals(directory.getName()))
+			{
+				candidate = new File(directory, "build/classes/java/main");
+				if (isScriptClassesDirectory(candidate))
+				{
+					return candidate;
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		try

+			{
+				return codeSource;
+			}
+
+			if (codeSource.isFile())
+			{
+				File buildDirectory = codeSource.getParentFile() == null
+					? null
+					: codeSource.getParentFile().getParentFile();
+				if (buildDirectory != null)
+				{
+					File candidate = new File(buildDirectory, "classes/java/main");
+					if (isScriptClassesDirectory(candidate))
+					{

+					}
+				}
+			}

	private void loadCustomScript()
	{
		String className = customClassField.getText().trim();
		if (className.isEmpty())
		{
			setCustomScriptError("Enter a script class name");
			return;
		}

		Script script = findLoadedScript(className);
		if (script == null)
		{
			try
			{
				script = ScriptLoader.load(className, TestPluginPanel.class.getClassLoader());
			}
			catch (ScriptLoader.ScriptLoadException ex)
			{
				setCustomScriptError(ex.getMessage());
				return;
			}

			scriptManager.register(script);
			scriptSelector.addItem(script);
		}

		customClassField.setText(className);
		scriptSelector.setSelectedItem(script);
		configManager.setConfiguration(TestConfig.GROUP, "customScriptClass", className);
		setCustomScriptError(null);
	}

	private Script findLoadedScript(String className)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < scriptSelector.getItemCount(); i++)
		{
			Script candidate = scriptSelector.getItemAt(i);
			if (candidate.getClass().getName().equals(className))
			{
				return candidate;
			}
		}

		return null;
	}

	private void startSelectedScript()
	{
		Script selected = (Script) scriptSelector.getSelectedItem();
		if (selected == null)
		{
			return;
		}

		try
		{
			Script target = startScript.apply(selected);
			if (target != null && target != selected)
			{
				replaceSelectedScript(selected, target);
			}
			setCustomScriptError(null);
		}
		catch (RuntimeException ex)
		{
			setCustomScriptError(ex.getMessage());
		}

		refresh();
	}

	private void reloadSelectedScript()
	{
		final Script selected = (Script) scriptSelector.getSelectedItem();
		if (selected == null)
		{
			return;
		}

		reloadButton.setEnabled(false);
		reloadStatusLabel.setText("Rebuilding and reloading...");
		setCustomScriptError(null);

		new SwingWorker<Script, Void>()
		{
			@Override
			protected Script doInBackground()
			{
				return reloadScript.apply(selected);
			}

			@Override
			protected void done()
			{
				reloadButton.setEnabled(true);

				try
				{
					Script replacement = get();
					if (replacement != null && replacement != selected)
					{
						replaceSelectedScript(selected, replacement);
					}

					reloadStatusLabel.setText("Reloaded " + selected.getName() + ".");
				}
				catch (InterruptedException ex)
				{
					Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
					reloadStatusLabel.setText("Reload interrupted.");
				}
				catch (ExecutionException ex)
				{
					Throwable cause = ex.getCause() == null ? ex : ex.getCause();

					setCustomScriptError(cause.getMessage());
