	private void startScriptByName(String name)
	{
		Optional<Script> script = scriptManager.getScripts().stream()
			.filter(candidate -> name == null
				|| candidate.getName().equalsIgnoreCase(name)
				|| candidate.getClass().getSimpleName().equalsIgnoreCase(name))
			.findFirst();

		if (script.isEmpty())
		{
			chat("RSBuddy: script not found");
			return;
		}

		startScript(script.get());
	}

	Script startScript(Script script)
	{
		if (script == null || scriptManager == null)
		{
			return script;
		}

		Script target = script;

		// Recreate the script with the current config. Reloaded scripts are
		// created through their own class loader so the new code is kept.
		try
		{
			target = createScript(script.getClass().getName(), script.getClass().getClassLoader());
		}
		catch (ScriptLoader.ScriptLoadException ex)
		{
			log.warn("Unable to recreate script {}, keeping the existing instance",
				script.getClass().getName(), ex);
			chat("RSBuddy: could not recreate " + script.getName() + ": " + ex.getMessage());
		}

		scriptManager.replace(script, target);
		scriptManager.start(target);
		chat("RSBuddy: started " + target.getName());
		return target;
	}

	/**
	 * Loads the selected script again from the newest compiled classes and
	 * replaces the registered instance. The running script is stopped if it is
	 * the one being reloaded.
	 */
	Script reloadScript(Script script)
	{
		if (script == null || scriptManager == null)
		{
			return script;
		}

		// When the client is running from the source tree, rebuild the module
		// first so the reload always picks up the latest edits.
		File projectDirectory = resolveProjectDirectory();
		if (projectDirectory != null)
		{
			rebuildScripts(projectDirectory);
		}

		File classesRoot = resolveScriptClassesDirectory();
		if (classesRoot == null || !classesRoot.isDirectory())
		{
			throw new IllegalStateException("Compiled script classes not found. Build the rsbuddy module first.");
		}

		String className = script.getClass().getName();
		File classFile = new File(classesRoot, className.replace('.', '/') + ".class");
		if (!classFile.isFile())
		{
			throw new IllegalStateException("No compiled class for " + className + " in " + classesRoot);
		}

		Script replacement;
		try
		{
			ClassLoader loader = new ReloadingClassLoader(classesRoot, getClass().getClassLoader());
			replacement = createScript(className, loader);
		}
		catch (MalformedURLException ex)
		{
			throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid script classes directory: " + classesRoot, ex);
		}
		catch (ScriptLoader.ScriptLoadException ex)
		{
			throw new IllegalStateException(ex.getMessage(), ex);
		}

		scriptManager.replace(script, replacement);
		log.info("Reloaded script {} from {}", className, classesRoot);
		return replacement;
	}

	private Script createScript(String className, ClassLoader classLoader)
		throws ScriptLoader.ScriptLoadException
	{
		if (ObjectInteractScript.class.getName().equals(className))
		{
			return ScriptLoader.load(className, classLoader,
				config.targetObjectName(), config.targetAction(), config.maxDistance());
		}

		if (FruitStallStealerScript.class.getName().equals(className))
		{
			return ScriptLoader.load(className, classLoader, config.fruitStallStayAtOneStall());
		}

		return ScriptLoader.load(className, classLoader);
	}

	private File resolveProjectDirectory()
	{
		File workingDirectory = new File(System.getProperty("user.dir", "."));
		for (File directory = workingDirectory; directory != null; directory = directory.getParentFile())
		{
			if (new File(directory, "gradlew").isFile()
				&& new File(directory, "rsbuddy/build.gradle.kts").isFile())
			{
				return directory;
			}
		}

		return null;
	}

	private void rebuildScripts(File projectDirectory)
	{
		File wrapper = new File(projectDirectory, "gradlew");
		if (!wrapper.isFile())
		{
			return;
		}

		List<String> command = new ArrayList<>();
		if (wrapper.canExecute())
		{
			command.add(wrapper.getAbsolutePath());
		}
		else
		{
			command.add("sh");
			command.add(wrapper.getAbsolutePath());
		}
		command.add(":rsbuddy:classes");
		command.add("--console=plain");

		ProcessBuilder builder = new ProcessBuilder(command);
		builder.directory(projectDirectory);
		builder.redirectErrorStream(true);

		try
		{
			Process process = builder.start();
			StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder();
			try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(
				new InputStreamReader(process.getInputStream(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)))
			{
				String line;
				while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null)
				{
					output.append(line).append('\n');
				}
			}

			int exitCode = process.waitFor();
			if (exitCode != 0)
			{
				log.warn("Script rebuild failed:\n{}", output);
				throw new IllegalStateException("Build failed: " + lastLines(output.toString(), 4));
			}

			log.info("Rebuilt scripts in {}", projectDirectory);
		}
		catch (IOException ex)
		{
			throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to run Gradle: " + ex.getMessage(), ex);
		}
		catch (InterruptedException ex)
		{
			Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
			throw new IllegalStateException("Build interrupted", ex);
		}
	}

	private static String lastLines(String output, int count)
	{
		if (output == null || output.trim().isEmpty())
		{
			return "(no output)";
		}

		String[] lines = output.trim().split("\\R");
		int start = Math.max(0, lines.length - count);
		return String.join(" | ", java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(lines, start, lines.length));
	}

## Assistant

Implemented an in-game script reload system.

**How it works**
- The RSBuddy tab now has a **Reload** button next to Start/Stop.
- Reload runs `./gradlew :rsbuddy:classes` in the background, then loads the selected script from the freshly compiled class files using a new classloader.
- If the reloaded script was running, it is stopped first.
- Config settings are reapplied on both **Start** and **Reload**.

**Workflow**
1. Restart the client once to load this updated plugin.
2. Edit a script file.
3. Select that script in the RSBuddy tab and click **Reload**.
4. Click **Start**.

After the initial restart, you should not need to restart the client for script changes.

**Caveat**
Hot reload applies to classes in `net.runelite.rsbuddy.scripts`. If you change shared framework classes like `Script`, `GameInput`, `Walker`, or other non-script internals, a full client restart is still required.

Build and checkstyle both pass, and the plugin is installed.

	private static final WorldPoint[] STALL_LOCATIONS = {

	private static final int RIGHT_STALL_ID = 28823;

	private static final String STALL_NAME = "Fruit Stall";

	// Both stalls are six tiles apart, so this radius can never pick up the
	// other stall.
	private static final int STALL_RADIUS = 2;

	// Stalls are stolen from while standing next to them.
	private static final int STALL_INTERACT_DISTANCE = 1;

	// After a steal click, give the game a few ticks to process the steal and
	// turn the stall into its empty version.
	private static final int STEAL_COOLDOWN_TICKS = 3;

	// Drop two items per game tick. Each batch uses the normal animated mouse
	// path at double speed, so the inventory empties exactly twice as fast as

	private static final int DROP_BATCH_SIZE = 2;

	}

	private int stallIndex = -1;

	private Point stallClickPoint;

	private Walker walker;

	public FruitStallStealerScript(boolean stayAtOneStall)
	{
		super("Fruit Stall Stealer",
			"Steals from the Hosidius fruit stalls and drops unwanted fruit when the inventory is full.");
		this.stayAtOneStall = stayAtOneStall;

	private void noteSteal()
	{
		cooldown = STEAL_COOLDOWN_TICKS;
		setStatus("Stealing from fruit stall");

		if (stayAtOneStall)
		{
			// Keep the same stall and the same click point, then wait for it to
			// turn back into a full stall.
			return;
		}

		stallClickPoint = null;
		stallIndex = 1 - stallIndex;

		if (walker != null)
		{
			walker.reset();
		}
	}

	private Optional<TileObject> findFullStall(ScriptContext context, WorldPoint location)
	{
		Client client = context.getClient();
		TileObject best = null;
		int bestDistance = Integer.MAX_VALUE;

		for (TileObject object : context.getTargets().getTileObjects(location, STALL_RADIUS))
		{
			if (!hasAction(client, object, STEAL_ACTION) || !isFruitStall(client, object))
			{
				continue;
			}

			WorldPoint objectLocation = object.getWorldLocation();
			if (objectLocation == null)
			{
				continue;
			}

			int distance = objectLocation.distanceTo(location);
			if (distance < bestDistance)
			{
				bestDistance = distance;
				best = object;
			}
		}

		return Optional.ofNullable(best);
	}

	private static int nearestStall(ScriptContext context)
	{
		WorldPoint playerLocation = context.getPlayerLocation();
		if (playerLocation == null)
		{
			return 0;
		}

		int leftDistance = playerLocation.distanceTo(STALL_LOCATIONS[0]);
		int rightDistance = playerLocation.distanceTo(STALL_LOCATIONS[1]);
		return rightDistance < leftDistance ? 1 : 0;
	}

	private static boolean isFruitStall(Client client, TileObject object)
	{
		if (object.getId() == LEFT_STALL_ID || object.getId() == RIGHT_STALL_ID)
		{
			return true;
		}

		ObjectComposition composition = client.getObjectDefinition(object.getId());
		return composition != null && cleanText(composition.getName()).equalsIgnoreCase(STALL_NAME);
	}

	private static boolean hasAction(Client client, TileObject object, String action)
	{
		ObjectComposition composition = client.getObjectDefinition(object.getId());
		String[] actions = composition == null ? null : composition.getActions();

		if (actions == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		for (String candidate : actions)
		{
			if (candidate != null && cleanText(candidate).equalsIgnoreCase(action))
			{
				return true;
			}
		}

		return false;
	}

	private void drop(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Inventory inventory = context.getInventory();
		GameInput input = context.getInput();

		if (!inventory.isOpen())
		{
			if (input.isBusy())
			{
				setStatus("Opening inventory");
				return;
			}

			if (inventory.open())
			{

	private void reloadSelectedScript()
	{
		final Script selected = (Script) scriptSelector.getSelectedItem();
		if (selected == null)
		{
			return;
		}

		reloadButton.setEnabled(false);
		reloadStatusLabel.setText("Rebuilding and reloading...");
		setCustomScriptError(null);

		new SwingWorker<Script, Void>()
		{
			@Override
			protected Script doInBackground()
			{
				return reloadScript.apply(selected);
			}

			@Override
			protected void done()
			{
				reloadButton.setEnabled(true);

				try
				{
					Script replacement = get();
					if (replacement != null && replacement != selected)
					{
						replaceSelectedScript(selected, replacement);
					}

					reloadStatusLabel.setText("Reloaded " + selected.getName() + ".");
				}
				catch (InterruptedException ex)
				{
					Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
					reloadStatusLabel.setText("Reload interrupted.");
				}
				catch (ExecutionException ex)
				{
					Throwable cause = ex.getCause() == null ? ex : ex.getCause();
					reloadStatusLabel.setText("Reload failed.");
					setCustomScriptError(cause.getMessage());
				}

				refresh();
			}
		}.execute();
	}

	private void replaceSelectedScript(Script oldScript, Script newScript)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < scriptSelector.getItemCount(); i++)
		{
			if (scriptSelector.getItemAt(i) == oldScript)
			{
				scriptSelector.removeItemAt(i);
				scriptSelector.insertItemAt(newScript, i);
				scriptSelector.setSelectedIndex(i);
				settingsScript = null;
				return;
			}
		}

		scriptSelector.addItem(newScript);
		scriptSelector.setSelectedItem(newScript);
		settingsScript = null;
	}

	private void refresh()
	{
		Script active = scriptManager.getActiveScript();
		if (active == null)
		{
			activeLabel.setText("Running: none");
			statusLabel.setText("Status: idle");
		}
		else
		{
			activeLabel.setText("Running: " + active.getName());
			statusLabel.setText("Status: " + active.getStatus());
		}

		startButton.setEnabled(scriptSelector.getItemCount() > 0);
		stopButton.setEnabled(active != null);

		Script selected = (Script) scriptSelector.getSelectedItem();
		description.setText(selected == null ? "No scripts registered." : selected.getDescription());

		if (selected != settingsScript)
		{
			settingsScript = selected;
			rebuildScriptSettings(selected);
		}
	}

		List<Widget> itemsToDrop = new ArrayList<>();

		for (int slot = 0; slot < Math.min(items.length, Inventory.SIZE)
			&& itemsToDrop.size() < DROP_BATCH_SIZE; slot++)
		{
			Item item = items[slot];
			if (item == null || item.getId() == -1 || isKeptItem(item.getId()))
			{
				continue;
			}

			Widget widget = inventory.getSlotWidget(slot);
			if (widget == null || widget.isHidden())
			{
				continue;
			}

			Rectangle bounds = widget.getBounds();
			if (bounds == null || bounds.isEmpty())
			{
				continue;
			}

			itemsToDrop.add(widget);
		}

		if (itemsToDrop.isEmpty())
		{
			cooldown = 1;
			setStatus("Waiting for inventory");
			return;
		}

		// Queue the items into one animated sequence that runs at double the
		// normal mouse speed. Two items fit inside a single game tick, so the
		// inventory empties in half the time while the cursor still visibly
		// moves from item to item.
		if (!input.clickEach(itemsToDrop, DROP_SPEED_MULTIPLIER))
		{
			cooldown = 1;
			setStatus("Waiting for inventory");
			return;
		}

		cooldown = 0;
		setStatus("Dropping inventory (" + droppableCount + " left)");
	}

	/**
	 * @return a point inside the stall's clickable hull, as close to its centre
	 * as possible, or its canvas location when the hull is unavailable
	 */
	private static Point centerOf(TileObject object)
	{
		Shape clickbox = object.getClickbox();
		if (clickbox != null)
		{
			Point point = pointInside(clickbox);
			if (point != null)
			{
				return point;
			}
		}

		Polygon tilePoly = object.getCanvasTilePoly();
		if (tilePoly != null)
		{
			Point point = pointInside(tilePoly);
			if (point != null)
			{
				return point;
			}
		}

		net.runelite.api.Point location = object.getCanvasLocation();
		return location == null ? null : new Point(location.getX(), location.getY());
	}

	private void addTextSetting(String label, String value, Consumer<String> save)
	{
		JLabel title = new JLabel(label);
		title.setForeground(ColorScheme.TEXT_COLOR);
		scriptSettingsPanel.add(title);

		JTextField field = new JTextField(value);
		field.setToolTipText(label);

		Runnable apply = () -> save.accept(field.getText().trim());
		field.addActionListener(event -> apply.run());
		field.addFocusListener(new FocusAdapter()
		{
			@Override
			public void focusLost(FocusEvent event)
			{
				apply.run();
			}
		});

		scriptSettingsPanel.add(field);
	}

	private static boolean isFirstAction(Client client, TileObject object, String action)
	{
		ObjectComposition composition = client.getObjectDefinition(object.getId());
		return composition != null && isFirstAction(composition.getActions(), action);
	}

	private static boolean isFirstAction(String[] actions, String action)
	{
		if (actions == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		for (String candidate : actions)
		{
			if (candidate == null || candidate.trim().isEmpty())
			{
				continue;
			}

			return cleanText(candidate).equalsIgnoreCase(action);
		}

		return false;
	}

	private static int countItems(Inventory inventory)
	{
		int count = 0;
		for (Item item : inventory.getItems())
		{
			if (item != null && item.getId() != -1)
			{
				++count;
			}
		}

		return count;
	}

	private static int countDroppableItems(Inventory inventory)
	{
		int count = 0;
		for (Item item : inventory.getItems())
		{
			if (item != null && item.getId() != -1 && !isKeptItem(item.getId()))
			{
				++count;
			}
		}

		return count;
	}

	private static boolean isKeptItem(int itemId)
	{
		return itemId == ItemID.PAPAYA
			|| itemId == ItemID.GOLOVANOVA_TOP
			|| itemId == ItemID.MACRO_TRIFFIDFRUIT // Strange fruit
			|| itemId == ItemID.JANGERBERRIES;
	}

	private void updateStats()
	{
		Inventory inventory = getContext().getInventory();
		Client client = getContext().getClient();
		long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
		int itemCount = countItems(inventory);

		if (!statsInitialized)
		{
			statsInitialized = true;
			statsStartedAt = now;
			lastItemCount = itemCount;
			startThievingXp = client.getSkillExperience(Skill.THIEVING);
			return;
		}

		if (itemCount > lastItemCount)
		{
			steals += itemCount - lastItemCount;
		}
		else if (itemCount < lastItemCount)
		{
			itemsDropped += lastItemCount - itemCount;
		}

		lastItemCount = itemCount;
	}

import net.runelite.rsbuddy.inventory.Inventory;

/**
 * Steals from the two fruit stalls in the Hosidius house east of the market,
 * running back and forth between them until the inventory is full, then drops
 * everything and repeats.
 * <p>
 * The stalls are six tiles apart, so a single click point cannot cover both.
 * The script walks to one stall, steals from it, immediately heads to the
 * other, and only goes back once the first stall has had time to respawn.
 */

package net.runelite.rsbuddy.scripts;

import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Map;

import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;

import net.runelite.api.Item;

import net.runelite.rsbuddy.inventory.Inventory;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.script.Script;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.script.ScriptContext;

/**
 * Trains combat on a player-selected list of nearby NPCs. When the script
 * starts it opens a configuration window with the attackable NPCs around the
 * player and an HP percentage at which to eat food. Pressing Start in that
 * window minimises it, and the script attacks the chosen NPCs until stopped.
 */
public final class CombatTrainerScript extends Script
{
	private static final String ATTACK_ACTION = "Attack";
	private static final int ATTACK_COOLDOWN_TICKS = 3;
	private static final int SCAN_RADIUS = 20;
	private static final int MAX_TARGET_DISTANCE = 20;
	private static final Pattern TAGS = Pattern.compile("<[^>]*>");

	private final Set<String> targetNames = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
	private volatile int eatAtHpPercent = 50;
	private volatile boolean training;
	private volatile boolean refreshRequested;
	private volatile CombatTrainerWindow window;

	private int cooldown;
	private boolean loggingOut;

	public CombatTrainerScript()
	{
		super("Combat Trainer", "Attacks chosen nearby NPCs and eats food below a chosen HP percentage.");
	}

	@Override
	protected void onStart()
	{
		// onStart may run on the game thread or the EDT. It must not touch
		// the client, and the configuration window is opened on the EDT.
		cooldown = 0;
		refreshRequested = true;
		training = false;
		loggingOut = false;
		setStatus("Choose NPCs in the Combat Trainer window");

		SwingUtilities.invokeLater(this::showWindow);
	}

	@Override
	protected void onStop()
	{
		training = false;
		CombatTrainerWindow current = window;
		window = null;

		if (current != null)
		{
			SwingUtilities.invokeLater(current::dispose);
		}
	}

	@Override
	protected void onGameTick()
	{
		ScriptContext context = getContext();

		if (!context.isLoggedIn())
		{
			setStatus("Waiting for login");
			return;
		}

		// If the player logged back in with food, cancel the safety logout
		// instead of immediately logging out again.
		if (loggingOut && hasFood(context))
		{
			loggingOut = false;
		}

		// The nearby NPC list is refreshed on demand from the configuration
		// window. Scans happen here because reading the world is only safe
		// on the game thread.
		if (refreshRequested)
		{
			refreshRequested = false;
			refreshWindow(scanNearbyNpcs(context));
		}

		if (!training)
		{
			setStatus("Choose NPCs and press Start");
			return;
		}

		if (targetNames.isEmpty())
		{
			setStatus("No NPCs selected");
			return;
		}

		eatIfNeeded(context);

		if (loggingOut)
		{
			logout(context);
			return;
		}

		if (cooldown > 0)
		{
			--cooldown;
			return;
		}

		fight(context);
	}

	private void fight(ScriptContext context)
	{
		GameInput input = context.getInput();

		if (context.getClient().isMenuOpen())
		{
			input.closeMenu();
			return;
		}

		if (input.isBusy())
		{
			setStatus("Moving mouse");
			return;
		}

		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		Actor interacting = player == null ? null : player.getInteracting();
		if (interacting instanceof NPC)
		{
			// Auto-retaliate can already have us in combat with an NPC that
			// is not in the selected list, and the game refuses a new attack
			// until the current interaction ends. Keep fighting whatever we
			// are already on instead of clicking another NPC every tick.
			NPC current = (NPC) interacting;
			String currentName = getNpcName(current);
			setStatus((current.isDead() ? "Finishing " : "Fighting ") + currentName);
			return;
		}

		// Once the current fight is over, do not start another one without
		// food. Logging out is safer than dying while waiting for a kill.
		if (!hasFood(context))
		{
			beginLogout();
			return;
		}

		Optional<NPC> target = findTarget(context);
		if (target.isEmpty())
		{
			cooldown = 2;
			setStatus("Waiting for " + describeTargets());
			return;
		}

		NPC npc = target.get();
		String name = getNpcName(npc);
		if (input.interact(npc, ATTACK_ACTION))
		{
			cooldown = ATTACK_COOLDOWN_TICKS;
			setStatus("Attacking " + name);
		}
		else if (input.walkTo(npc.getWorldLocation()))
		{
			cooldown = 2;
			setStatus("Walking to " + name);
		}
		else
		{
			cooldown = 2;
			setStatus("Cannot attack " + name);
		}
	}

	private Optional<NPC> findTarget(ScriptContext context)
	{
		WorldPoint playerLocation = context.getPlayerLocation();
		NPC best = null;
		int bestDistance = Integer.MAX_VALUE;

		for (String name : targetNames)
		{
			Optional<NPC> candidate = context.getTargets()
				.findNpc(name, ATTACK_ACTION, MAX_TARGET_DISTANCE);
			if (candidate.isEmpty())
			{
				continue;
			}

			NPC npc = candidate.get();
			WorldPoint npcLocation = npc.getWorldLocation();
			int distance = playerLocation == null || npcLocation == null
				? Integer.MAX_VALUE
				: npcLocation.distanceTo(playerLocation);

			if (distance < bestDistance)
			{
				bestDistance = distance;
				best = npc;
			}
		}

		return Optional.ofNullable(best);
	}

	private void eatIfNeeded(ScriptContext context)

package net.runelite.rsbuddy.target;

import java.awt.Polygon;
import java.awt.Rectangle;
import java.awt.Shape;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import java.util.stream.Stream;
import net.runelite.api.Client;
import net.runelite.api.GameObject;
import net.runelite.api.NPC;
import net.runelite.api.NPCComposition;
import net.runelite.api.ObjectComposition;
import net.runelite.api.Player;
import net.runelite.api.Scene;
import net.runelite.api.Tile;
import net.runelite.api.TileObject;
import net.runelite.api.WorldView;
import net.runelite.api.coords.WorldPoint;
import net.runelite.api.widgets.Widget;

/**
 * Finds nearby game objects, NPCs, and widgets by name or id.
 */
public final class TargetLocator
{
	private static final Pattern TAGS = Pattern.compile("<[^>]*>");

	private final Client client;

	public TargetLocator(Client client)
	{
		this.client = client;
	}

	public Optional<GameObject> findObject(String name, int maxDistance)
	{
		return findObject(name, null, maxDistance);
	}

	public Optional<GameObject> findObject(String name, String action, int maxDistance)
	{
		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
		WorldPoint playerLocation = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();

		return objects()
			.filter(object -> matchesName(object, name))
			.filter(object -> action == null || action.isEmpty() || hasAction(object, action))
			.filter(object -> withinDistance(object.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation, maxDistance))
			.min(Comparator.comparingInt(object -> distance(object.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation)));
	}

	public Optional<GameObject> findObject(int objectId, int maxDistance)
	{
		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
		WorldPoint playerLocation = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();

		return objects()
			.filter(object -> object.getId() == objectId)
			.filter(object -> withinDistance(object.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation, maxDistance))
			.min(Comparator.comparingInt(object -> distance(object.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation)));
	}

	/**
	 * Finds the nearest matching object that is currently visible on screen.
	 */
	public Optional<GameObject> findVisibleObject(int objectId, int maxDistance)
	{
		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
		WorldPoint playerLocation = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();

		return objects()
			.filter(object -> object.getId() == objectId)
			.filter(object -> withinDistance(object.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation, maxDistance))
			.filter(this::isVisible)
			.min(Comparator.comparingInt(object -> distance(object.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation)));
	}

	/**
	 * Finds the nearest matching object of any tile-object type. This includes
	 * game objects, ground objects such as fires, wall objects, and decorative
	 * objects.
	 */
	public Optional<TileObject> findTileObject(int objectId, int maxDistance)
	{
		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
		WorldPoint playerLocation = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();

		return tileObjects()
			.filter(object -> object.getId() == objectId)
			.filter(object -> withinDistance(object.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation, maxDistance))
			.min(Comparator.comparingInt(object -> distance(object.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation)));
	}

	/**
	 * Finds the nearest matching tile object that is currently visible on
	 * screen.
	 */
	public Optional<TileObject> findVisibleTileObject(int objectId, int maxDistance)
	{
		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
		WorldPoint playerLocation = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();

		return tileObjects()
			.filter(object -> object.getId() == objectId)
			.filter(object -> withinDistance(object.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation, maxDistance))
			.filter(this::isVisible)
			.min(Comparator.comparingInt(object -> distance(object.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation)));
	}

	/**
	 * Finds every tile object within the given radius of a world position.
	 */
	public List<TileObject> getTileObjects(WorldPoint location, int radius)
	{
		if (location == null)
		{
			return Collections.emptyList();
		}

		return tileObjects()
			.filter(object ->
			{
				WorldPoint objectLocation = object.getWorldLocation();
				return objectLocation != null
					&& objectLocation.getPlane() == location.getPlane()
					&& objectLocation.distanceTo(location) <= Math.max(0, radius);
			})
			.collect(Collectors.toList());
	}

	public List<GameObject> getObjects(String name)
	{
		return objects().filter(object -> matchesName(object, name)).collect(Collectors.toList());
	}

	public Optional<NPC> findNpc(String name, int maxDistance)
	{
		return findNpc(name, null, maxDistance);
	}

	public Optional<NPC> findNpc(String name, String action, int maxDistance)
	{
		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
		WorldPoint playerLocation = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();

		return npcs()
			.filter(npc -> matchesName(npc, name))
			.filter(npc -> action == null || action.isEmpty() || hasAction(npc, action))
			.filter(npc -> withinDistance(npc.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation, maxDistance))
			.min(Comparator.comparingInt(npc -> distance(npc.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation)));
	}

	public Optional<NPC> findNpc(int npcId, int maxDistance)
	{
		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
		WorldPoint playerLocation = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();

		return npcs()
			.filter(npc -> npc.getId() == npcId)
			.filter(npc -> withinDistance(npc.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation, maxDistance))
			.min(Comparator.comparingInt(npc -> distance(npc.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation)));
	}

	/**
	 * Finds the nearest matching NPC that is currently visible on screen.
	 */
	public Optional<NPC> findVisibleNpc(int npcId, int maxDistance)
	{
		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
		WorldPoint playerLocation = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();

		return npcs()
			.filter(npc -> npc.getId() == npcId)
			.filter(npc -> withinDistance(npc.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation, maxDistance))
			.filter(this::isVisible)
			.min(Comparator.comparingInt(npc -> distance(npc.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation)));
	}

	public Optional<Widget> findWidget(int componentId)
	{
		return Optional.ofNullable(client.getWidget(componentId))
			.filter(widget -> !widget.isHidden());
	}

	public Optional<Widget> findWidget(int interfaceId, int childId)
	{
		return Optional.ofNullable(client.getWidget(interfaceId, childId))
			.filter(widget -> !widget.isHidden());

package net.runelite.rsbuddy.scripts;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;
import net.runelite.api.Actor;
import net.runelite.api.Client;
import net.runelite.api.NPC;
import net.runelite.api.ObjectComposition;
import net.runelite.api.Player;
import net.runelite.api.Skill;
import net.runelite.api.TileObject;
import net.runelite.api.WorldView;
import net.runelite.api.coords.WorldPoint;
import net.runelite.api.gameval.ItemID;
import net.runelite.api.gameval.NpcID;
import net.runelite.api.widgets.Widget;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.input.GameInput;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.inventory.Inventory;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.script.Script;
import net.runelite.rsbuddy.script.ScriptContext;

/**
 * Kills the Gemstone Crab (NPC 14779), then crawls through the nearby cave to
 * the crab's next spawn location, waits for it to appear, and repeats.
 * <p>
 * Start the script next to the crab or the cave. It never walks on its own
 * except for the walking the game does when a crab or the cave is clicked.
 */
public final class GemCrabKillerScript extends Script
{
	private static final int CRAB_ID = NpcID.GEMSTONE_CRAB; // 14779
	private static final String ATTACK_ACTION = "Attack";
	private static final String CAVE_NAME = "Cave";
	private static final String CAVE_ACTION = "Crawl-through";

	private static final int CRAB_SEARCH_DISTANCE = 20;
	private static final int CAVE_SEARCH_DISTANCE = 20;

	/** Ticks to wait after an attack click before re-evaluating. */
	private static final int ATTACK_COOLDOWN_TICKS = 3;
	/** Ticks with no interaction while the crab is alive before re-attacking. */
	private static final int REATTACK_IDLE_TICKS = 4;
	/** Ticks after the crab dies before heading for the cave. */
	private static final int POST_KILL_DELAY_TICKS = 2;
	/** Ticks to wait for the crawl to move us before clicking the cave again. */
	private static final int CRAWL_TIMEOUT_TICKS = 25;
	/** A location change at least this large means we went through the cave. */
	private static final int CRAWL_TELEPORT_DISTANCE = 10;
	/** Ticks (about 36 seconds) to wait for the crab to spawn after crawling. */
	private static final int SPAWN_TIMEOUT_TICKS = 60;

	/** Anti-idle camera nudges happen every 30 to 60 seconds. */
	private static final long ANTI_IDLE_MIN_MS = 30_000L;
	private static final long ANTI_IDLE_MAX_MS = 60_000L;
	/** Arrow-key hold range for a small camera nudge. */
	private static final int ANTI_IDLE_MIN_HOLD_MS = 150;
	private static final int ANTI_IDLE_MAX_HOLD_MS = 450;

	/** Drink another strength potion once the boost has dropped to this. */
	private static final int STRENGTH_BOOST_THRESHOLD = 3;
	/** Ticks to wait for a drink to register before trying again. */
	private static final int DRINK_TIMEOUT_TICKS = 5;

	/**
	 * Strength potions in the order they are drunk: regular strength
	 * potions lowest dose first, then super strength as a fallback.
	 */
	private static final int[] STRENGTH_POTIONS = {
		ItemID._1DOSE1STRENGTH,  // Strength potion(1)
		ItemID._2DOSE1STRENGTH,  // Strength potion(2)
		ItemID._3DOSE1STRENGTH,  // Strength potion(3)
		ItemID.STRENGTH4,        // Strength potion(4)
		ItemID._1DOSE2STRENGTH,  // Super strength(1)
		ItemID._2DOSE2STRENGTH,  // Super strength(2)
		ItemID._3DOSE2STRENGTH,  // Super strength(3)
		ItemID._4DOSE2STRENGTH   // Super strength(4)
	};

	private enum State
	{
		FIND_CRAB,
		FIGHT,
		GO_TO_CAVE,
		WAIT_FOR_SPAWN
	}

	private State state;
	private int cooldown;
	private NPC target;
	private int idleTicks;
	private int waitTicks;
	private boolean crawlClicked;
	private WorldPoint crawlStartLocation;
	private int kills;
	private long startedAt;
	private long nextAntiIdleAt;
	private int drinkWaitTicks;
	private int boostBeforeDrink;
	private int potionsDrunk;

	public GemCrabKillerScript()
	{
		super("Gem Crab Killer", "Kills the Gemstone Crab (14779), crawls through the cave, and repeats.");
	}

	@Override
	protected void onStart()
	{
		// onStart runs on the Swing thread, so it must not touch the client.
		state = State.FIND_CRAB;
		cooldown = 0;
		target = null;
		idleTicks = 0;
		waitTicks = 0;
		crawlClicked = false;
		crawlStartLocation = null;
		kills = 0;
		startedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
		scheduleAntiIdle();
		drinkWaitTicks = 0;
		boostBeforeDrink = 0;
		potionsDrunk = 0;
		setStatus("Ready");
	}

	@Override
	protected void onGameTick()
	{
		ScriptContext context = getContext();
		if (!context.isLoggedIn())
		{
			setStatus("Waiting for login");
			return;
		}

		drinkStrengthIfNeeded(context);
		antiIdle(context);

		if (cooldown > 0)
		{
			--cooldown;
			return;
		}

		switch (state)
		{
			case FIND_CRAB:
				findCrab(context);
				break;
			case FIGHT:
				fight(context);
				break;
			case GO_TO_CAVE:
				goToCave(context);
				break;
			case WAIT_FOR_SPAWN:
				waitForSpawn(context);
				break;
		}
	}

	private void findCrab(ScriptContext context)
	{
		GameInput input = context.getInput();

		// A menu left over from the cave would swallow the attack click.
		if (context.getClient().isMenuOpen())
		{
			input.closeMenu();
			return;
		}

		NPC fighting = getInteractingCrab(context);
		if (fighting != null)
		{
			target = fighting;
			idleTicks = 0;
			state = State.FIGHT;
			setStatus("Fighting Gemstone Crab");
			return;
		}

		Optional<NPC> crab = context.getTargets().findNpc(CRAB_ID, CRAB_SEARCH_DISTANCE);
		if (crab.isEmpty())
		{
			// No live crab here. It has either already died or not spawned
			// yet, so take the cave to the next location.
			state = State.GO_TO_CAVE;
			setStatus("No crab, heading to cave");
			return;
		}

		if (input.isBusy() || input.isCameraBusy())
		{
			setStatus("Moving mouse");
			return;
		}

		attack(context, crab.get());
	}

	private void fight(ScriptContext context)
	{
		if (isCrabDead(context, target))
		{
			++kills;
			target = null;
			idleTicks = 0;
			cooldown = POST_KILL_DELAY_TICKS;
			state = State.GO_TO_CAVE;
			setStatus("Crab dead, heading to cave");
			return;
		}

		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		Actor interacting = player == null ? null : player.getInteracting();
		if (interacting == target || isAnimating(player) || isMoving(player))
		{
			// Still attacking (or walking up to it). Do not click again.
			idleTicks = 0;
			setStatus("Fighting Gemstone Crab");
			return;
		}

		// The crab is alive but we stopped attacking it, for example after
		// being knocked out of combat. Re-attack after a short grace period.
		if (++idleTicks < REATTACK_IDLE_TICKS)
		{
			setStatus("Fighting Gemstone Crab");
			return;
		}

		GameInput input = context.getInput();
		if (input.isBusy() || input.isCameraBusy())
		{
			setStatus("Moving mouse");
			return;
		}

		idleTicks = 0;
		attack(context, target);
	}

	private void attack(ScriptContext context, NPC crab)
	{
		GameInput input = context.getInput();

		if (!input.isVisible(crab))
		{
			input.turnCameraToward(crab.getWorldLocation());
			cooldown = 2;
			setStatus("Turning camera to crab");
			return;
		}

		if (input.interact(crab, ATTACK_ACTION))
		{
			target = crab;
			idleTicks = 0;
			cooldown = ATTACK_COOLDOWN_TICKS;
			state = State.FIGHT;
			setStatus("Attacking Gemstone Crab");
		}
		else
		{
			cooldown = 2;
			setStatus("Cannot attack Gemstone Crab");
		}
	}

	private void goToCave(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		WorldPoint location = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
		GameInput input = context.getInput();

		if (crawlClicked)
		{
			if (hasTeleported(location))
			{
				crawlClicked = false;
				crawlStartLocation = null;
				waitTicks = 0;
				state = State.WAIT_FOR_SPAWN;
				setStatus("Waiting for crab to spawn");
				return;
			}

			// Walking to the cave and the crawl animation take a few ticks.
			if (++waitTicks < CRAWL_TIMEOUT_TICKS)
			{
				setStatus("Crawling through cave");
				return;
			}

			// The click did not take. Try the cave again.
			crawlClicked = false;
			crawlStartLocation = null;
		}

		// A new crab may already be up at this location (e.g. the script was
		// started while one was alive). Fight it instead of leaving.
		if (!context.getClient().isMenuOpen()
			&& context.getTargets().findNpc(CRAB_ID, CRAB_SEARCH_DISTANCE).isPresent())
		{
			state = State.FIND_CRAB;
			return;
		}

		if (input.isBusy() || input.isCameraBusy())
		{
			setStatus("Moving mouse");
			return;
		}

		Optional<TileObject> cave = findCave(context);
		if (cave.isEmpty())
		{
			if (context.getClient().isMenuOpen())
			{
				input.closeMenu();
			}
			cooldown = 2;
			setStatus("Looking for cave");
			return;
		}

		TileObject object = cave.get();
		boolean menuOpen = context.getClient().isMenuOpen();
		if (!menuOpen && !input.isVisible(object))
		{
			input.turnCameraToward(object.getWorldLocation());
			cooldown = 2;
			setStatus("Turning camera to cave");
			return;
		}

		// interact() right-clicks the cave first, then picks Crawl-through
		// from the opened menu on the next call.
		if (input.interact(object, CAVE_ACTION))
		{
			if (menuOpen)
			{
				crawlClicked = true;
				crawlStartLocation = location;
				waitTicks = 0;
				cooldown = 1;
				setStatus("Crawling through cave");
			}
			else
			{
				setStatus("Opening cave menu");
			}
			return;
		}

		cooldown = 2;
		setStatus("Cannot crawl through cave");
	}

	private void waitForSpawn(ScriptContext context)
	{
		if (context.getClient().isMenuOpen())
		{
			context.getInput().closeMenu();
			return;
		}

		Optional<NPC> crab = context.getTargets().findNpc(CRAB_ID, CRAB_SEARCH_DISTANCE);
		if (crab.isPresent())
		{
			waitTicks = 0;
			state = State.FIND_CRAB;
			setStatus("Crab spawned");
			return;
		}

		if (++waitTicks >= SPAWN_TIMEOUT_TICKS)
		{
			// No crab showed up. Move on through the cave again.
			waitTicks = 0;
			state = State.GO_TO_CAVE;
			setStatus("No spawn, heading to cave");
			return;
		}

		setStatus("Waiting for crab to spawn (" + waitTicks + ")");
	}

	/**
	 * Drinks a strength potion whenever the Strength boost (boosted level
	 * minus real level) is {@value #STRENGTH_BOOST_THRESHOLD} or less, which
	 * includes being unboosted. Does nothing when no strength potions are in
	 * the inventory. Drinking does not interrupt combat, so this runs in
	 * every state, but never while the mouse is moving, the camera is
	 * turning, or a menu is open.
	 */
	private void drinkStrengthIfNeeded(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Client client = context.getClient();
		int boost = client.getBoostedSkillLevel(Skill.STRENGTH) - client.getRealSkillLevel(Skill.STRENGTH);

		if (drinkWaitTicks > 0)
		{
			// Wait for the last drink to show up in the boosted level so the
			// same potion is not drunk twice.
			if (boost > boostBeforeDrink)
			{
				drinkWaitTicks = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				--drinkWaitTicks;
				return;
			}
		}

		if (boost > STRENGTH_BOOST_THRESHOLD)
		{
			return;
		}

		Inventory inventory = context.getInventory();
		int slot = findStrengthPotionSlot(inventory);
		if (slot < 0)
		{
			return;
		}

		GameInput input = context.getInput();
		if (input.isBusy() || input.isCameraBusy() || client.isMenuOpen())
		{
			return;
		}

		// The potion slot has no widget until the inventory tab is open.
		if (!inventory.isOpen())
		{
			if (inventory.open())
			{
				setStatus("Opening inventory");
			}
			return;
		}

		// Drink is the potion's left-click option.
		Widget widget = inventory.getSlotWidget(slot);
		if (widget != null && input.click(widget))
		{
			boostBeforeDrink = boost;
			drinkWaitTicks = DRINK_TIMEOUT_TICKS;
			++potionsDrunk;
			setStatus("Drinking strength potion");
		}
	}

	private static int findStrengthPotionSlot(Inventory inventory)
	{
		for (int potion : STRENGTH_POTIONS)
		{
			int slot = inventory.findSlot(potion);
			if (slot >= 0)
			{
				return slot;
			}
		}
		return -1;
	}

	/**
	 * Keeps the client from idling out by rotating the camera a small random
	 * amount left or right every 30 to 60 seconds. It only fires while the
	 * mouse is idle and no menu is open, so it never interrupts a click; the
	 * held arrow key also makes the attack and cave logic wait until the
	 * nudge has finished.
	 */
	private void antiIdle(ScriptContext context)
	{
		if (System.currentTimeMillis() < nextAntiIdleAt)
		{
			return;
		}

		GameInput input = context.getInput();
		if (input.isBusy() || input.isCameraBusy() || context.getClient().isMenuOpen())
		{
			// Try again on a later tick once the current action is done.
			return;
		}

		ThreadLocalRandom random = ThreadLocalRandom.current();
		boolean left = random.nextBoolean();
		int holdMillis = random.nextInt(ANTI_IDLE_MIN_HOLD_MS, ANTI_IDLE_MAX_HOLD_MS + 1);
		if (input.nudgeCamera(left, holdMillis))
		{
			scheduleAntiIdle();
		}
	}

	private void scheduleAntiIdle()
	{
		nextAntiIdleAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
			+ ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextLong(ANTI_IDLE_MIN_MS, ANTI_IDLE_MAX_MS + 1);
	}

		}

		return location.getPlane() != crawlStartLocation.getPlane()
			|| location.distanceTo(crawlStartLocation) >= CRAWL_TELEPORT_DISTANCE;
	}

	private State state;
	private int cooldown;
	private WorldPoint lastWalkLocation;
	private int stationaryTicks;
	private WorldPoint lootTarget;

	public HillGiantScript()
	{
		super("Hill Giant (Edgeville)", "Kills hill giants in the Edgeville Dungeon and banks loot.");
	}

	@Override
	protected void onStart()
	{
		// onStart runs on the Swing thread, so it must not touch the client.
		// The initial state is chosen on the first game tick instead.
		cooldown = 0;
		state = null;
		lastWalkLocation = null;
		stationaryTicks = 0;
		lootTarget = null;
		lootTargetItemId = -1;
		lootAttempts = 0;
		lootTargetTicks = 0;
		bankStage = null;
		bankAttempts = 0;
		returningFromBank = false;
		shedDoorOpen = false;
		ignoredLoot.clear();
		setStatus("Ready");
	}

	@Override
	protected void onGameTick()
	{
		ScriptContext context = getContext();

		if (!context.isLoggedIn())
		{
			setStatus("Waiting for login");
			return;
		}

		if (state == null)
		{
			WorldPoint location = context.getPlayerLocation();
			if (location != null && location.getY() < 9000)
			{
				// Starting on the surface means the shed door is between
				// us and the ladder, so approach the door first.
				returningFromBank = true;
				state = State.WALK_TO_GIANTS;
			}
			else
			{
				state = State.HUNT;
			}
		}

		if (cooldown > 0)
		{
			--cooldown;
			return;
		}

		eatIfNeeded(context);

		switch (state)
		{
			case HUNT:
				hunt(context);
				break;
			case LOOT:
				loot(context);
				break;
			case WALK_TO_BANK:
				walkToBank(context);
				break;
			case BANK:
				bank(context);
				break;
			case WALK_TO_GIANTS:
				walkToGiants(context);
				break;
		}
	}

	private void hunt(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Inventory inventory = context.getInventory();

		// A menu left over from a previous loot/interaction would block
		// clicking giants and walking. Close it before hunting.
		if (context.getClient().isMenuOpen())
		{
			context.getInput().closeMenu();
			return;
		}

		if (inventory.isFull())
		{
			state = State.WALK_TO_BANK;
			setStatus("Inventory full");
			return;
		}

		GroundLoot loot = findGroundLoot(context);
		if (loot != null)
		{
			state = State.LOOT;
			setStatus("Looting");
			return;
		}

		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		NPC interacting = player != null && player.getInteracting() instanceof NPC
			? (NPC) player.getInteracting()
			: null;
		if (interacting != null)
		{
			// Any active NPC interaction blocks a new attack. Auto-retaliate
			// may have started a fight with something other than a hill
			// giant, so wait for that fight to finish instead of spamming
			// attack clicks that the game will reject.
			String interactingName = getNpcName(interacting);
			setStatus((interacting.isDead() ? "Finishing " : "Fighting ") + interactingName);
			return;
		}

		GameInput input = context.getInput();
		if (input.isBusy())
		{
			setStatus("Moving mouse");
			return;
		}

		Optional<NPC> target = findHillGiant(context);
		if (target.isPresent())
		{
			if (input.interact(target.get(), ATTACK_ACTION))
			{
				cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
				setStatus("Attacking " + NPC_NAME);
			}
			else
			{
				cooldown = 2;
				setStatus("Cannot attack " + NPC_NAME);
			}
			return;
		}

		openDoor(context);
		cooldown = 2;
		setStatus("No " + NPC_NAME + " nearby");
	}

	private void loot(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Inventory inventory = context.getInventory();

		if (inventory.isFull())
		{
			state = State.WALK_TO_BANK;
			setStatus("Inventory full");
			return;
		}

		GroundLoot loot = findGroundLoot(context);
		if (loot == null)
		{
			context.getInput().closeMenu();
			state = State.HUNT;
			setStatus("Hunting");
			return;
		}

		GameInput input = context.getInput();
		if (input.isBusy())
		{
			setStatus("Moving mouse");
			return;
		}

		if (!java.util.Objects.equals(lootTarget, loot.worldLocation)
			|| lootTargetItemId != loot.itemId)
		{
			lootTarget = loot.worldLocation;
			lootTargetItemId = loot.itemId;
			lootAttempts = 0;
			lootTargetTicks = 0;
		}

		if (++lootTargetTicks > LOOT_TARGET_TIMEOUT_TICKS && loot.worldLocation != null)
		{
			// The drop is probably behind an obstacle or otherwise
			// unreachable. Ignore it so the script does not get stuck.
			ignoredLoot.add(loot.worldLocation);
			lootTarget = null;
			lootTargetItemId = -1;
			lootAttempts = 0;
			lootTargetTicks = 0;
			state = State.HUNT;
			setStatus("Skipping unreachable loot");
			return;
		}

		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		WorldPoint location = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
		if (location != null && loot.worldLocation != null
			&& location.distanceTo(loot.worldLocation) > 2)
		{
			walkTowards(context, loot.worldLocation);
			lootAttempts = 0;
			setStatus("Walking to loot");
			return;
		}

		Client client = context.getClient();
		String itemName = getItemName(client, loot.itemId);
		input.takeGroundItem(loot.sceneX, loot.sceneY, loot.itemId, itemName);
		cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;

		if (++lootAttempts > LOOT_ATTEMPT_LIMIT && loot.worldLocation != null)
		{
			ignoredLoot.add(loot.worldLocation);
			lootTarget = null;
			lootTargetItemId = -1;
			lootAttempts = 0;
			lootTargetTicks = 0;
			state = State.HUNT;
			setStatus("Skipping unreachable loot");
			return;
		}

		setStatus(itemName.isEmpty() ? "Looting" : "Looting " + itemName);
	}

	private void walkToBank(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		WorldPoint location = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
		if (location == null)
		{
			return;
		}

		if (!isInDungeon(location))
		{
			if (location.distanceTo(WEST_VARROCK_BANK) <= 8)
			{
				state = State.BANK;
				setStatus("Banking");
				return;
			}

			// After climbing up we are inside the shed with the brass-key
			// door shut behind us. Open it once, then walk away using the
			// minimap so the walk click cannot hit and toggle the door.
			if (!shedDoorOpen
				&& location.distanceTo(SURFACE_DOOR) <= 10
				&& openDoor(context))
			{
				setStatus("Opening door");
				return;
			}

			walkTowards(context, WEST_VARROCK_BANK, true);
			setStatus("Walking to bank");
		}
		else
		{
			if (location.distanceTo(DUNGEON_LADDER) <= 8)
			{
				climb(context, true, LADDER_ID);
			}
			else
			{
				walkTowards(context, DUNGEON_LADDER);
			}
			setStatus("Walking to bank");
		}
	}

	private void walkToGiants(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		WorldPoint location = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
		if (location == null)
		{
			return;
		}

		if (isInDungeon(location))
		{
			returningFromBank = false;

			if (location.distanceTo(HILL_GIANTS) <= 8)
			{
				state = State.HUNT;
				setStatus("Hunting");
				return;
			}
			walkTowards(context, HILL_GIANTS);
			setStatus("Walking to hill giants");
		}
		else
		{
			boolean nearShed = location.distanceTo(SURFACE_DOOR) <= 3
				|| location.distanceTo(SURFACE_LADDER) <= 3;

			// Coming back from the bank the shed door is normally shut and
			// blocks the ladder inside. Always open it before targeting the
			// ladder, even when the collision map still looks walkable.
			if (!shedDoorOpen && returningFromBank && nearShed && openDoor(context))
			{
				setStatus("Opening door");
				return;
			}

			boolean ladderReachable = canReach(context, SURFACE_LADDER);
			boolean canClimb = ladderReachable || shedDoorOpen
				|| location.distanceTo(SURFACE_LADDER) <= 2;

			if (location.distanceTo(SURFACE_LADDER) <= 8 && canClimb)
			{
				climb(context, false, LADDER_ID);
				setStatus("Climbing down");
				return;
			}

			if (!shedDoorOpen
				&& !ladderReachable
				&& location.distanceTo(SURFACE_DOOR) <= 10
				&& openDoor(context))
			{
				setStatus("Opening door");
				return;
			}

			// Walk to the open door with the minimap so the walk click
			// cannot toggle it, then approach the ladder inside.
			WorldPoint target = !shedDoorOpen && (returningFromBank || !ladderReachable)
				? SURFACE_DOOR
				: SURFACE_LADDER;
			walkTowards(context, target, true);
			setStatus("Walking to hill giants");
		}
	}

	private void eatIfNeeded(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Client client = context.getClient();
		Inventory inventory = context.getInventory();

		int current = client.getBoostedSkillLevel(Skill.HITPOINTS);
		int max = client.getRealSkillLevel(Skill.HITPOINTS);
		if (max <= 0 || current * 100 > max * EAT_THRESHOLD_PERCENT)
		{
			return;
		}

		int slot = inventory.findSlot(ItemID.SARDINE);
		if (slot < 0)
		{
			return;
		}

		// Clicking a sardine while the bank is open deposits it instead of
		// eating it, so wait until the bank is closed. A context menu also
		// swallows the first click, so wait for it to close as well.
		if (context.getTargets().findWidget(InterfaceID.Bankmain.UNIVERSE).isPresent()
			|| context.getClient().isMenuOpen())
		{
			return;
		}

		GameInput input = context.getInput();
		if (input.isBusy())
		{
			return;
		}

		// The inventory tab might not be open; the food slot has no widget
		// until it is, which would otherwise make the player stand there and
		// die without eating.
		if (!inventory.isOpen())
		{
			if (inventory.open())
			{
				setStatus("Opening inventory");
			}
			return;
		}

		Widget widget = inventory.getSlotWidget(slot);
		if (widget != null && input.click(widget))
		{
			cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
			setStatus("Eating sardine");
		}
	}

	private boolean openDoor(ScriptContext context)
	{
		GameInput input = context.getInput();
		if (input.isBusy())
		{
			return false;
		}

	/**
	 * @return true if the object is currently inside the game viewport
	 */
	public boolean isVisible(TileObject object)
	{
		if (object == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Shape clickbox = object.getClickbox();
		if (clickbox != null && isInViewport(clickbox))
		{
			return true;
		}

		Polygon tilePoly = object.getCanvasTilePoly();
		return tilePoly != null && isInViewport(tilePoly);
	}

	private boolean isInViewport(Shape shape)
	{
		if (shape == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		int width = client.getViewportWidth();
		int height = client.getViewportHeight();
		if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
		{
			return true;
		}

		// Do not use Shape.intersects here. RuneLite's SimplePolygon only
		// reports an intersection when the viewport edges cross the polygon,
		// which is false for a target that is fully inside the viewport.
		Rectangle bounds = shape.getBounds();
		if (bounds == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Rectangle viewport = new Rectangle(
			client.getViewportXOffset(), client.getViewportYOffset(), width, height);
		if (bounds.width <= 0 || bounds.height <= 0)
		{
			return viewport.contains(bounds.getLocation());
		}

		return viewport.intersects(bounds);
	}

	private boolean isInViewport(int x, int y)
	{
		int width = client.getViewportWidth();
		int height = client.getViewportHeight();
		if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
		{
			return true;
		}

		int viewportX = client.getViewportXOffset();
		int viewportY = client.getViewportYOffset();
		return x >= viewportX && x < viewportX + width
			&& y >= viewportY && y < viewportY + height;
	}

	/**
	 * @return true while an arrow key is being held to rotate the camera
	 */
	public boolean isCameraBusy()
	{
		return cameraKey != -1;
	}

	/**
	 * @return true while the mouse wheel is being scrolled to zoom the camera
	 */
	public boolean isZooming()
	{
		return zooming;
	}

	/**
	 * Scrolls the mouse wheel down to zoom the camera out, one notch at a
	 * time with a small human-like delay between notches.
	 *
	 * @param notches number of wheel notches to scroll
	 * @return true if zooming was started
	 */
	public boolean zoomOut(int notches)
	{
		if (notches <= 0)
		{
			return false;
		}

		if (zooming)
		{
			return true;
		}

		Canvas canvas = client.getCanvas();
		if (canvas == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Dimension size = canvas.getSize();
		if (size.width <= 0 || size.height <= 0)
		{
			return false;
		}

		final int x = size.width / 2;
		final int y = size.height / 2;
		zooming = true;

		SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() ->
		{
			canvas.requestFocusInWindow();
			zoomStep(canvas, x, y, notches);
		});

		return true;
	}

	private void zoomStep(Canvas canvas, int x, int y, int remaining)
	{
		if (remaining <= 0)
		{
			zooming = false;
			return;
		}

		canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseWheelEvent(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_WHEEL,
			System.currentTimeMillis(), 0, x, y, 0, false, MouseWheelEvent.WHEEL_UNIT_SCROLL, 3, 1));

		Timer timer = new Timer(80 + random.nextInt(70), event -> zoomStep(canvas, x, y, remaining - 1));
		timer.setRepeats(false);
		timer.start();
	}

	/**
	 * Starts turning the camera toward a world position by holding the
	 * appropriate arrow key, exactly as a player would. The key is released
	 * automatically after a short hold, or immediately with
	 * {@link #stopCamera()}.
	 *
	 * @return true if the camera is already turning or a turn was started,
	 * false if the camera already faces the position
	 */
	public boolean turnCameraToward(WorldPoint worldPoint)
	{
		if (cameraKey != -1)
		{
			return true;
		}

		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
		if (player == null || worldPoint == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		WorldPoint origin = player.getWorldLocation();
		if (origin == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		int dx = worldPoint.getX() - origin.getX();
		int dy = worldPoint.getY() - origin.getY();
		if (dx == 0 && dy == 0)
		{
			return false;
		}

		int desired = (int) Math.round(Math.atan2(-dx, dy) * CAMERA_YAW_UNITS / TAU)
			& (CAMERA_YAW_UNITS - 1);
		return turnCameraToYaw(desired);
	}

	/**
	 * Starts turning the camera toward an absolute yaw by holding the
	 * appropriate arrow key, using the direction learned from earlier pulses.
	 *
	 * @param desiredYaw target yaw in JAU14 units
	 * @return true if the camera is already turning or a turn was started,
	 * false if the camera already faces the target yaw
	 */
	public boolean turnCameraToYaw(int desiredYaw)
	{
		if (cameraKey != -1)
		{
			return true;
		}

		int desired = desiredYaw & (CAMERA_YAW_UNITS - 1);
		int current = client.getCameraYawTarget() & (CAMERA_YAW_UNITS - 1);
		int delta = normalizeYaw(desired - current);
		if (Math.abs(delta) <= CAMERA_DEADBAND)
		{
			return false;
		}

		boolean useLeft = delta > 0 ? cameraLeftSign > 0 : cameraLeftSign < 0;
		cameraPulseYaw = current;
		return holdKey(useLeft ? KeyEvent.VK_LEFT : KeyEvent.VK_RIGHT, CAMERA_HOLD_MS);
	}

	/**
	 * Briefly holds the left or right arrow key to rotate the camera a small
	 * amount, like a player idly nudging the view. Used for anti-idle.
	 *
	 * @param left true to hold the left arrow key, false for the right one
	 * @param holdMillis how long to hold the key
	 * @return true if the nudge was started, false if the camera is already
	 * turning or the canvas is unavailable
	 */
	public boolean nudgeCamera(boolean left, int holdMillis)
	{
		if (cameraKey != -1)
		{
			return false;
		}

		// Record the starting yaw so the pulse still calibrates the arrow
		// key directions used by turnCameraToYaw.
		cameraPulseYaw = client.getCameraYawTarget() & (CAMERA_YAW_UNITS - 1);
		return holdKey(left ? KeyEvent.VK_LEFT : KeyEvent.VK_RIGHT, holdMillis);
	}

	private MenuEntry findBankMenuEntry(int itemId, String withdrawOption)
	{
		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();
		MenuEntry[] entries = menu == null ? null : menu.getMenuEntries();
		if (entries == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		MenuEntry optionMatch = null;
		for (MenuEntry entry : entries)
		{
			if (entry == null
				|| (entry.getType() != MenuAction.CC_OP
					&& entry.getType() != MenuAction.CC_OP_LOW_PRIORITY)
				|| !matchesOption(entry.getOption(), withdrawOption))
			{
				continue;
			}

			// Bank item entries carry the item id; prefer the entry that
			// belongs to the slot we right-clicked.
			if (entry.getItemId() == itemId
				&& entry.getParam1() == InterfaceID.Bankmain.ITEMS)
			{
				return entry;
			}

			if (optionMatch == null)
			{
				optionMatch = entry;
			}
		}

		return optionMatch;
	}

	/**
	 * Finds the Take entry for a ground item in the currently open menu.
	 */
	private MenuEntry findGroundItemMenuEntry(int itemId, int sceneX, int sceneY)
	{
		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();
		MenuEntry[] entries = menu == null ? null : menu.getMenuEntries();
		if (entries == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		int id = itemId & 0xFFFF;
		MenuEntry fallback = null;

		for (MenuEntry entry : entries)
		{
			if (entry == null || !isGroundItemAction(entry.getType())
				|| !matchesOption(entry.getOption(), "Take", "Pick up", "Pickup")
				|| (entry.getIdentifier() & 0xFFFF) != id)
			{
				continue;
			}

			// The menu only contains items from the tile that was
			// right-clicked, but prefer an entry with matching coordinates.
			if (entry.getParam0() == sceneX && entry.getParam1() == sceneY)
			{
				return entry;
			}

			if (fallback == null)
			{
				fallback = entry;
			}
		}

		return fallback;
	}

	private static boolean isGroundItemAction(MenuAction type)
	{
		if (type == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		int id = type.getId();
		return id >= MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_FIRST_OPTION.getId()
			&& id <= MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_FIFTH_OPTION.getId();
	}

	private static boolean matchesOption(String option, String... actions)
	{
		if (option == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		for (String action : actions)
		{
			if (action != null && option.trim().equalsIgnoreCase(action.trim()))
			{
				return true;
			}
		}

		return false;
	}

	private MenuEntry[] currentMenuEntries()
	{
		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();

	public boolean closeMenu()

		if (!client.isMenuOpen())

	/**
	 * Picks up a ground item by right-clicking its tile and then clicking the
	 * Take entry in the context menu.
	 */
	public boolean takeGroundItem(int sceneX, int sceneY, int itemId, String itemName)
	{
		if (client.isMenuOpen())
		{
			MenuEntry entry = findGroundItemMenuEntry(itemId, sceneX, sceneY);
			if (entry != null)
			{
				return clickMenuEntry(entry);
			}

			closeMenu();
			return false;
		}

		LocalPoint localPoint = LocalPoint.fromScene(sceneX, sceneY, client.getTopLevelWorldView());
		if (localPoint == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Polygon tilePoly = Perspective.getCanvasTilePoly(client, localPoint);
		Point point = randomPoint(tilePoly);
		return point != null && click(point, MouseEvent.BUTTON3);
	}

	public boolean walkTo(WorldPoint worldPoint)
	{
		if (worldPoint == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		LocalPoint localPoint = LocalPoint.fromWorld(client, worldPoint);
		if (localPoint == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Polygon tilePoly = Perspective.getCanvasTilePoly(client, localPoint);
		return tilePoly != null && click(tilePoly);
	}

	/**
	 * Clicks a row in the client's currently open context menu. The client
	 * lays the menu out with a 19px header and 15px rows, with the array's
	 * last entry at the top.
	 */
	public boolean clickMenuEntry(MenuEntry entry)
	{
		if (entry == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();
		MenuEntry[] entries = menu == null ? null : menu.getMenuEntries();
		if (!client.isMenuOpen() || entries == null || entries.length == 0)
		{
			return invokeMenuEntry(entry);
		}

		int index = -1;
		for (int i = 0; i < entries.length; i++)
		{
			if (entries[i] == entry)
			{
				index = i;
				break;
			}
		}

		if (index < 0 || client.isMenuScrollable())
		{
			return invokeMenuEntry(entry);
		}

		int row = entries.length - 1 - index;
		int x = menu.getMenuX() + Math.max(8, menu.getMenuWidth() / 2);
		int y = menu.getMenuY() + 19 + row * 15 + 7;
		return clickMenuPoint(new Point(x, y));
	}

	private boolean invokeMenuEntry(MenuEntry entry)
	{
		client.menuAction(entry.getParam0(), entry.getParam1(), entry.getType(),
			entry.getIdentifier(), entry.getItemId(), entry.getOption(), entry.getTarget());
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Runs a context-menu entry directly. This lets callers use an option that
	 * is not the default left-click action without opening the menu, and it
	 * never falls back to a plain click, so nothing unexpected is triggered.
	 */
	public boolean invokeMenu(MenuEntry entry)
	{
		return entry != null && invokeMenuEntry(entry);
	}

	/**
	 * Finds an entry in the client's current context menu. The menu is built
	 * from whatever the mouse is hovering, so callers must hover the target and
	 * wait a frame before asking.
	 *
	 * @param option option text, colour tags ignored
	 * @param itemId item id to require, or -1 to accept any
	 */
	public MenuEntry findMenuEntry(String option, int itemId)
	{
		if (option == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		MenuEntry untyped = null;
		int untypedCount = 0;

		for (MenuEntry entry : currentMenuEntries())
		{
			if (entry == null || entry.getOption() == null
				|| !stripTags(entry.getOption()).equalsIgnoreCase(stripTags(option)))
			{
				continue;
			}

			if (entry.getItemId() == itemId)
			{
				return entry;
			}

			if (entry.getItemId() <= 0)
			{
				untyped = entry;
				untypedCount++;
			}
		}

		// Fall back only when there is exactly one candidate, so an ambiguous
		// menu can never be resolved to the wrong item.
		return untypedCount == 1 ? untyped : null;
	}

	/**
	 * Lists the options in the current context menu, for logging when an
	 * expected option is missing.
	 */
	public List<String> describeMenu()
	{
		List<String> options = new ArrayList<>();

		for (MenuEntry entry : currentMenuEntries())
		{
			if (entry == null || entry.getOption() == null)
			{
				continue;
			}

			String target = stripTags(entry.getTarget() == null ? "" : entry.getTarget());
			options.add(stripTags(entry.getOption()) + (target.isEmpty() ? "" : " " + target));
		}

		return options;
	}

package net.runelite.api;

/**
 * The client minimenu.
 */
public interface Menu
{
	/**
	 * Create a new menu entry
	 * @param idx the index to create the menu entry at. Accepts negative indexes eg. -1 inserts at the end.
	 * @return the newly created menu entry
	 */
	MenuEntry createMenuEntry(int idx);

	/**
	 * Gets the current mini menu entries.
	 *
	 * @return array of menu entries
	 */
	MenuEntry[] getMenuEntries();

	/**
	 * Sets the array of menu entries.
	 * <p>
	 * This method should typically be used in the context of the {@link net.runelite.api.events.MenuOpened}
	 * event, since setting the menu entries will be overwritten the next frame
	 *
	 * @param entries new array of open menu entries
	 */
	void setMenuEntries(MenuEntry[] entries);

	/**
	 * Remove a menu entry
	 * @param entry the menu entry
	 */
	void removeMenuEntry(MenuEntry entry);

	/**
	 * Get the menu x location. Only valid if the menu is open.
	 *
	 * @return the menu x location
	 */
	int getMenuX();

	/**
	 * Get the menu y location. Only valid if the menu is open.
	 *
	 * @return the menu y location
	 */
	int getMenuY();

	/**
	 * Get the menu width. Only valid if the menu is open.
	 *
	 * @return the menu width
	 */
	int getMenuWidth();

	/**
	 * Get the menu height. Only valid if the menu is open.
	 *
	 * @return the menu height
	 */
	int getMenuHeight();
}

	/**
	 * Finds the Take entry for a ground item in the currently open menu.
	 */
	private MenuEntry findGroundItemMenuEntry(int itemId, int sceneX, int sceneY)
	{
		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();
		MenuEntry[] entries = menu == null ? null : menu.getMenuEntries();
		if (entries == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		int id = itemId & 0xFFFF;
		MenuEntry fallback = null;

		for (MenuEntry entry : entries)
		{
			if (entry == null || !isGroundItemAction(entry.getType())
				|| !matchesOption(entry.getOption(), "Take", "Pick up", "Pickup")
				|| (entry.getIdentifier() & 0xFFFF) != id)
			{
				continue;
			}

			// The menu only contains items from the tile that was
			// right-clicked, but prefer an entry with matching coordinates.
			if (entry.getParam0() == sceneX && entry.getParam1() == sceneY)
			{
				return entry;
			}

			if (fallback == null)
			{
				fallback = entry;
			}
		}

		return fallback;
	}

	private static boolean isGroundItemAction(MenuAction type)
	{
		if (type == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		int id = type.getId();
		return id >= MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_FIRST_OPTION.getId()
			&& id <= MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_FIFTH_OPTION.getId();
	}

	private static boolean matchesOption(String option, String... actions)
	{
		if (option == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		for (String action : actions)
		{
			if (action != null && option.trim().equalsIgnoreCase(action.trim()))
			{
				return true;
			}
		}

		return false;
	}

	/**
	 * Clicks a row in the client's currently open context menu. The client
	 * lays the menu out with a 19px header and 15px rows, with the array's
	 * last entry at the top.
	 */
	public boolean clickMenuEntry(MenuEntry entry)
	{
		if (entry == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();
		MenuEntry[] entries = menu == null ? null : menu.getMenuEntries();
		if (!client.isMenuOpen() || entries == null || entries.length == 0)
		{
			return invokeMenuEntry(entry);
		}

		int index = -1;
		for (int i = 0; i < entries.length; i++)
		{
			if (entries[i] == entry)
			{
				index = i;
				break;
			}
		}

		if (index < 0 || client.isMenuScrollable())
		{
			return invokeMenuEntry(entry);
		}

		int row = entries.length - 1 - index;
		int x = menu.getMenuX() + Math.max(8, menu.getMenuWidth() / 2);
		int y = menu.getMenuY() + 19 + row * 15 + 7;
		return clickMenuPoint(new Point(x, y));
	}

	private boolean invokeMenuEntry(MenuEntry entry)
	{
		client.menuAction(entry.getParam0(), entry.getParam1(), entry.getType(),
			entry.getIdentifier(), entry.getItemId(), entry.getOption(), entry.getTarget());
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Runs a context-menu entry directly. This lets callers use an option that
	 * is not the default left-click action without opening the menu, and it
	 * never falls back to a plain click, so nothing unexpected is triggered.
	 */
	public boolean invokeMenu(MenuEntry entry)
	{
		return entry != null && invokeMenuEntry(entry);
	}

	/**
	 * Finds an entry in the client's current context menu. The menu is built
	 * from whatever the mouse is hovering, so callers must hover the target and
	 * wait a frame before asking.
	 *
	 * @param option option text, colour tags ignored
	 * @param itemId item id to require, or -1 to accept any
	 */
	public MenuEntry findMenuEntry(String option, int itemId)
	{
		if (option == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		MenuEntry untyped = null;
		int untypedCount = 0;

		for (MenuEntry entry : currentMenuEntries())
		{
			if (entry == null || entry.getOption() == null
				|| !stripTags(entry.getOption()).equalsIgnoreCase(stripTags(option)))
			{
				continue;
			}

			if (entry.getItemId() == itemId)
			{
				return entry;
			}

			if (entry.getItemId() <= 0)
			{
				untyped = entry;
				untypedCount++;
			}
		}

		// Fall back only when there is exactly one candidate, so an ambiguous
		// menu can never be resolved to the wrong item.
		return untypedCount == 1 ? untyped : null;
	}

	/**
	 * Lists the options in the current context menu, for logging when an
	 * expected option is missing.
	 */
	public List<String> describeMenu()
	{
		List<String> options = new ArrayList<>();

		for (MenuEntry entry : currentMenuEntries())
		{
			if (entry == null || entry.getOption() == null)
			{
				continue;
			}

			String target = stripTags(entry.getTarget() == null ? "" : entry.getTarget());
			options.add(stripTags(entry.getOption()) + (target.isEmpty() ? "" : " " + target));
		}

		return options;
	}

	private MenuEntry[] currentMenuEntries()
	{
		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();
		if (menu != null)
		{
			MenuEntry[] entries = menu.getMenuEntries();
			if (entries != null && entries.length > 0)
			{
				return entries;
			}
		}

		MenuEntry[] entries = client.getMenuEntries();
		return entries == null ? new MenuEntry[0] : entries;
	}

	/**
	 * Closes the currently open right-click menu, if any.
	 */
	public boolean closeMenu()
	{
		if (!client.isMenuOpen())
		{
			return false;
		}

		return pressKey(KeyEvent.VK_ESCAPE);
	}

	/**
	 * Picks up a ground item by right-clicking its tile and then clicking the
	 * Take entry in the context menu.
	 */
	public boolean takeGroundItem(int sceneX, int sceneY, int itemId, String itemName)
	{
		if (client.isMenuOpen())
		{
			MenuEntry entry = findGroundItemMenuEntry(itemId, sceneX, sceneY);
			if (entry != null)
			{
				return clickMenuEntry(entry);
			}

			closeMenu();
			return false;
		}

		LocalPoint localPoint = LocalPoint.fromScene(sceneX, sceneY, client.getTopLevelWorldView());
		if (localPoint == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Polygon tilePoly = Perspective.getCanvasTilePoly(client, localPoint);
		Point point = randomPoint(tilePoly);
		return point != null && click(point, MouseEvent.BUTTON3);
	}

	public boolean walkTo(WorldPoint worldPoint)
	{
		if (worldPoint == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		LocalPoint localPoint = LocalPoint.fromWorld(client, worldPoint);
		if (localPoint == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Polygon tilePoly = Perspective.getCanvasTilePoly(client, localPoint);
		return tilePoly != null && click(tilePoly);
	}

	/**
	 * Clicks a point inside the already-open context menu. The cursor is
	 * moved there in a single event, because animated movement across the
	 * game world can close the menu before the click lands.
	 */
	private boolean clickMenuPoint(Point gamePoint)
	{
		if (gamePoint == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Canvas canvas = client.getCanvas();
		if (canvas == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Point canvasPoint = toCanvasPoint(gamePoint);
		if (!canvas.contains(canvasPoint))
		{
			return false;
		}

		stopCamera();
		stopMovement();
		busy = true;
		SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() ->
		{
			canvas.requestFocusInWindow();
			lastMousePoint = canvasPoint;
			mouseLocation = new Point(gamePoint);
			dispatch(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_MOVED, canvasPoint, MouseEvent.NOBUTTON, 0, 0);

			Timer timer = new Timer(45 + random.nextInt(45), event ->
			{
				long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
				clickLocation = new Point(gamePoint);
				clickStartedAt = now;
				clickButton = MouseEvent.BUTTON1;
				addClickEffect(new Point(gamePoint), MouseEvent.BUTTON1, now);

				dispatch(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_PRESSED, canvasPoint, MouseEvent.BUTTON1, 1,
					InputEvent.BUTTON1_DOWN_MASK);
				dispatch(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_RELEASED, canvasPoint, MouseEvent.BUTTON1, 1, 0);
				dispatch(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_CLICKED, canvasPoint, MouseEvent.BUTTON1, 1, 0);
				busy = false;
			});
			timer.setRepeats(false);
			timer.start();
		});
		return true;
	}

	private void loot(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Inventory inventory = context.getInventory();

		if (inventory.isFull())
		{
			state = State.WALK_TO_BANK;
			setStatus("Inventory full");
			return;
		}

		GroundLoot loot = findGroundLoot(context);
		if (loot == null)
		{
			context.getInput().closeMenu();
			state = State.HUNT;
			setStatus("Hunting");
			return;
		}

		GameInput input = context.getInput();
		if (input.isBusy())
		{
			setStatus("Moving mouse");
			return;
		}

		if (!java.util.Objects.equals(lootTarget, loot.worldLocation)
			|| lootTargetItemId != loot.itemId)
		{
			lootTarget = loot.worldLocation;
			lootTargetItemId = loot.itemId;
			lootAttempts = 0;
			lootTargetTicks = 0;
		}

		if (++lootTargetTicks > LOOT_TARGET_TIMEOUT_TICKS && loot.worldLocation != null)
		{
			// The drop is probably behind an obstacle or otherwise
			// unreachable. Ignore it so the script does not get stuck.
			ignoredLoot.add(loot.worldLocation);
			lootTarget = null;
			lootTargetItemId = -1;
			lootAttempts = 0;
			lootTargetTicks = 0;
			state = State.HUNT;
			setStatus("Skipping unreachable loot");
			return;
		}

		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		WorldPoint location = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
		if (location != null && loot.worldLocation != null
			&& location.distanceTo(loot.worldLocation) > 2)
		{
			walkTowards(context, loot.worldLocation);
			lootAttempts = 0;
			setStatus("Walking to loot");
			return;
		}

		Client client = context.getClient();
		String itemName = getItemName(client, loot.itemId);
		input.takeGroundItem(loot.sceneX, loot.sceneY, loot.itemId, itemName);
		cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;

		if (++lootAttempts > LOOT_ATTEMPT_LIMIT && loot.worldLocation != null)
		{
			ignoredLoot.add(loot.worldLocation);
			lootTarget = null;
			lootTargetItemId = -1;
			lootAttempts = 0;
			lootTargetTicks = 0;
			state = State.HUNT;
			setStatus("Skipping unreachable loot");
			return;
		}

		setStatus(itemName.isEmpty() ? "Looting" : "Looting " + itemName);
	}

	private void walkToBank(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		WorldPoint location = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
		if (location == null)
		{
			return;
		}

		if (!isInDungeon(location))
		{
			if (location.distanceTo(WEST_VARROCK_BANK) <= 8)
			{
			}
		}

		return true;
	}

	private static long distanceSquared(int x, int y, WorldPoint target)
	{
		long dx = (long) x - target.getX();
		long dy = (long) y - target.getY();
		return dx * dx + dy * dy;
	}

	private GroundLoot findGroundLoot(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Client client = context.getClient();
		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		WorldPoint playerLocation = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
		WorldView worldView = client.getTopLevelWorldView();
		if (worldView == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		Scene scene = worldView.getScene();
		if (scene == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		Tile[][][] tiles = scene.getTiles();
		int plane = worldView.getPlane();
		if (tiles == null || plane < 0 || plane >= tiles.length)
		{
			return null;
		}

		Tile[][] planeTiles = tiles[plane];
		if (planeTiles == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		GroundLoot best = null;
		int bestDistance = Integer.MAX_VALUE;

		for (Tile[] row : planeTiles)
		{
			if (row == null)
			{
				continue;
			}

			for (Tile tile : row)
			{
				if (tile == null)
				{
					continue;
				}

				java.util.List<TileItem> groundItems = tile.getGroundItems();
				if (groundItems == null || groundItems.isEmpty())
				{
					continue;
				}

				for (TileItem groundItem : groundItems)
				{
					if (groundItem == null)
					{
						continue;
					}

					int id = groundItem.getId();
					if (!isLootItem(id))
					{
						continue;
					}

					// Do not chase drops that belong to another player.
					if (groundItem.getOwnership() == TileItem.OWNERSHIP_OTHER)
					{
						continue;
					}

					net.runelite.api.Point sceneLocation = tile.getSceneLocation();
					if (sceneLocation == null)
					{
						continue;
					}

					WorldPoint itemLocation = tile.getWorldLocation();
					int distance = playerLocation == null || itemLocation == null
						? Integer.MAX_VALUE
						: itemLocation.distanceTo(playerLocation);

					if (distance > MAX_DISTANCE || distance >= bestDistance)
					{
						continue;
					}

					if (itemLocation != null && ignoredLoot.contains(itemLocation))
					{
						continue;
					}

					bestDistance = distance;
					best = new GroundLoot(id, sceneLocation.getX(),
						sceneLocation.getY(), itemLocation);
				}
			}
		}

		return best;
	}

	private Optional<NPC> findHillGiant(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Optional<NPC> byName = context.getTargets().findNpc(NPC_NAME, null, MAX_DISTANCE);
		if (byName.isPresent())
		{
			return byName;
		}

		Client client = context.getClient();
		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		WorldPoint playerLocation = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
		WorldView worldView = client.getTopLevelWorldView();
		if (worldView == null)
		{
			return Optional.empty();
		}

		return worldView.npcs().stream()
			.map(npc -> (NPC) npc)
			.filter(npc -> !npc.isDead())
			.filter(npc -> isHillGiantId(npc.getId()))
			.filter(npc -> playerLocation == null || npc.getWorldLocation() == null
				|| npc.getWorldLocation().distanceTo(playerLocation) <= MAX_DISTANCE)
			.min(java.util.Comparator.comparingInt(npc ->
				playerLocation == null || npc.getWorldLocation() == null
					? Integer.MAX_VALUE
					: npc.getWorldLocation().distanceTo(playerLocation)));
	}

	private static boolean isHillGiantId(int id)
	{
		return id == NpcID.GIANT || id == NpcID.GIANT2 || id == NpcID.GIANT3
			|| id == NpcID.GIANT4 || id == NpcID.GIANT5 || id == NpcID.GIANT6;
	}

	private boolean isInDungeon(WorldPoint location)
	{
		return location != null && location.getY() >= 9000;
	}

	private static String getNpcName(NPC npc)
	{
		if (npc == null)
		{
			return "";
		}

		net.runelite.api.NPCComposition composition = npc.getComposition();
		String name = composition == null ? npc.getName() : composition.getName();
		return name == null ? "" : name;
	}

	private static String getItemName(Client client, int itemId)
	{
		net.runelite.api.ItemComposition composition = client.getItemDefinition(itemId);
		String name = composition == null ? null : composition.getName();
		return name == null ? "" : name;
	}

	private static final class GroundLoot
	{
		private final int itemId;
		private final int sceneX;
		private final int sceneY;
		private final WorldPoint worldLocation;

		private GroundLoot(int itemId, int sceneX, int sceneY, WorldPoint worldLocation)
		{
			this.itemId = itemId;
			this.sceneX = sceneX;
			this.sceneY = sceneY;
			this.worldLocation = worldLocation;
		}
	}
}
