	private Color getClickColor(Color start, Color end, long time)
	{
		if (time < 5)
		{
			return ColorUtil.colorLerp(start, INTERACT_CLICK_COLOR, time / 5f);
		}
		else if (time < 10)
		{
			return ColorUtil.colorLerp(INTERACT_CLICK_COLOR, end, (time - 5) / 5f);
		}
		return end;
	}

	private MenuEntry hoveredMenuEntry(final MenuEntry[] menuEntries)
	{
		final int menuX = client.getMenuX();
		final int menuY = client.getMenuY();
		final int menuWidth = client.getMenuWidth();
		final Point mousePosition = client.getMouseCanvasPosition();

		int dy = mousePosition.getY() - menuY;
		dy -= 19; // Height of Choose Option
		if (dy < 0)
		{
			return menuEntries[menuEntries.length - 1];
		}

		int idx = dy / 15; // Height of each menu option
		idx = menuEntries.length - 1 - idx;

		if (mousePosition.getX() > menuX && mousePosition.getX() < menuX + menuWidth
			&& idx >= 0 && idx < menuEntries.length)
		{
			return menuEntries[idx];
		}
		return menuEntries[menuEntries.length - 1];
	}
}

/**
 * Sends mouse and keyboard input to the game canvas and invokes menu actions.
 * <p>
 * Clicks are dispatched as AWT events on the canvas, so they go through
 * RuneLite's normal input pipeline (including stretched-mode translation).
 * Mouse movement is animated along a slightly curved path with variable speed,
 * small jitter, and a short press/release delay to look less mechanical.
 */
public final class GameInput
{
	private static final int RANDOM_POINT_ATTEMPTS = 25;
	private static final double TAU = Math.PI * 2.0;
	private static final long CLICK_EFFECT_LIFETIME_MS = 1000L;

	private static final int CAMERA_YAW_UNITS = 16384;
	private static final int CAMERA_HALF_TURN = CAMERA_YAW_UNITS / 2;
	private static final int CAMERA_DEADBAND = 128;
	private static final int CAMERA_HOLD_MS = 800;

	private final Client client;
	private final Random random = new Random();

	private Point lastMousePoint;
	private Timer movementTimer;
	private boolean busy;
	private volatile boolean fastClicking;

	private volatile Point mouseLocation;
	private volatile Point clickLocation;
	private volatile long clickStartedAt;
	private volatile int clickButton = MouseEvent.NOBUTTON;
	private final List<ClickEffect> clickEffects = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();

	private volatile int cameraKey = -1;
	private volatile Timer cameraKeyTimer;
	private volatile int cameraPulseYaw;
	private int cameraLeftSign = 1;
	private int cameraRightSign = -1;
	private volatile boolean zooming;

	public GameInput(Client client)
	{
		this.client = client;
	}

	/**
	 * @return true while a simulated mouse movement or click is in progress
	 */
	public boolean isBusy()
	{
		return busy || fastClicking;
	}

	/**
	 * @return the last simulated mouse position in game canvas coordinates
	 */
	public Point getMouseLocation()
	{
		Point location = mouseLocation;
		if (location != null)
		{
			return new Point(location);
		}

		net.runelite.api.Point actual = client.getMouseCanvasPosition();
		return actual == null ? null : new Point(actual.getX(), actual.getY());
	}

	/**
	 * @return the position of the most recent simulated click in game canvas
	 * coordinates, or null if nothing has been clicked yet
	 */
	public Point getClickLocation()
	{
		Point location = clickLocation;
		return location == null ? null : new Point(location);
	}

	/**
	 * @return the wall-clock time at which the most recent click was pressed
	 */
	public long getClickStartedAt()
	{
		return clickStartedAt;
	}

	/**
	 * @return the mouse button of the most recent click
	 */
	public int getClickButton()
	{
		return clickButton;
	}

	/**
	 * @return recent simulated clicks, oldest first
	 */
	public List<ClickEffect> getRecentClicks()
	{
		long cutoff = System.currentTimeMillis() - CLICK_EFFECT_LIFETIME_MS;
		clickEffects.removeIf(effect -> effect.startedAt < cutoff);
		return new ArrayList<>(clickEffects);
	}

	public boolean click(Point gamePoint)
	{
		return click(gamePoint, MouseEvent.BUTTON1);
	}

	public boolean click(Shape shape)
	{
		Point point = randomPoint(shape);
		return point != null && click(point);
	}

	public boolean click(Rectangle bounds)
	{
		Point point = randomPoint(bounds);
		return point != null && click(point);
	}

	public boolean click(TileObject object)
	{
		return click(object, MouseEvent.BUTTON1);
	}

	public boolean click(TileObject object, int button)
	{
		if (object == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Shape clickbox = object.getClickbox();
		if (clickbox != null)
		{
			Point point = randomPoint(clickbox);
			return point != null && click(point, button);
		}

		Polygon tilePoly = object.getCanvasTilePoly();
		if (tilePoly != null)
		{
			Point point = randomPoint(tilePoly);
			return point != null && click(point, button);
		}

		net.runelite.api.Point canvasLocation = object.getCanvasLocation();
		return canvasLocation != null
			&& click(new Point(canvasLocation.getX(), canvasLocation.getY()), button);
	}

	public boolean click(NPC npc)
	{
		if (npc == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Shape hull = npc.getConvexHull();
		if (hull != null)
		{
			return click(hull);
		}

	private static double cubic(double a, double b, double c, double d, double t)
	{
		double u = 1.0 - t;
		return u * u * u * a + 3.0 * u * u * t * b + 3.0 * u * t * t * c + t * t * t * d;
	}

	private void stopMovement()
	{
		if (movementTimer != null)
		{
			movementTimer.stop();
			movementTimer = null;
		}
	}

	private void dispatch(Canvas canvas, int id, Point point, int button, int clickCount, int modifiers)
	{
		MouseEvent event = new MouseEvent(canvas, id, System.currentTimeMillis(), modifiers,
			point.x, point.y, clickCount, false, button);
		canvas.dispatchEvent(event);
	}

	private Point toCanvasPoint(Point gamePoint)
	{
		if (!client.isStretchedEnabled())
		{
			return gamePoint;
		}

		Dimension realDimensions = client.getRealDimensions();
		Dimension stretchedDimensions = client.getStretchedDimensions();
		if (realDimensions == null || stretchedDimensions == null
			|| realDimensions.width <= 0 || realDimensions.height <= 0)
		{
			return gamePoint;
		}

		return new Point(
			gamePoint.x * stretchedDimensions.width / realDimensions.width,
			gamePoint.y * stretchedDimensions.height / realDimensions.height);
	}

	private Point toGamePoint(Point canvasPoint)
	{
		if (!client.isStretchedEnabled())
		{
			return new Point(canvasPoint);
		}

		Dimension realDimensions = client.getRealDimensions();
		Dimension stretchedDimensions = client.getStretchedDimensions();
		if (realDimensions == null || stretchedDimensions == null
			|| stretchedDimensions.width <= 0 || stretchedDimensions.height <= 0)
		{
			return new Point(canvasPoint);
		}

		return new Point(
			canvasPoint.x * realDimensions.width / stretchedDimensions.width,
			canvasPoint.y * realDimensions.height / stretchedDimensions.height);
	}

	private Point randomPoint(Shape shape)
	{
		if (shape == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		Rectangle bounds = shape.getBounds();
		if (bounds == null || bounds.isEmpty())
		{
			return null;
		}

		double centerX = bounds.getCenterX();
		double centerY = bounds.getCenterY();

		for (int i = 0; i < RANDOM_POINT_ATTEMPTS; i++)
		{
			int x = (int) Math.round(centerX + (random.nextDouble() * 2.0 - 1.0) * bounds.width * 0.36);
			int y = (int) Math.round(centerY + (random.nextDouble() * 2.0 - 1.0) * bounds.height * 0.36);
			if (shape.contains(x, y) && isInViewport(x, y) && !isCoveredByInterface(x, y))
			{
	public boolean hover(Shape shape)
	{
		Point point = randomPoint(shape);
		return point != null && moveTo(point);
	}

	/**
	 * Animates the mouse to a point in game canvas coordinates without
	 * pressing a button.
	 *
	 * @return true if a movement was started
	 */
	public boolean moveTo(Point gamePoint)
	{
		if (gamePoint == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Canvas canvas = client.getCanvas();
		if (canvas == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Point canvasPoint = toCanvasPoint(gamePoint);
		if (!canvas.contains(canvasPoint))
		{
			return false;
		}

		busy = true;
		SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> beginMove(canvas, canvasPoint));
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * @return true if the simulated mouse is currently inside the shape
	 */
	public boolean isMouseOver(Shape shape)
	{
		if (shape == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Point location = getMouseLocation();
		return location != null && shape.contains(location);
	}

	@Subscribe
	public void onClientTick(ClientTick event)
	{
		if (!config.collapseEntries())
		{
			return;
		}

		final MenuEntry[] menuEntries = client.getMenuEntries();
		final List<MenuEntryWithCount> newEntries = new ArrayList<>(menuEntries.length);

		outer:
		for (int i = menuEntries.length - 1; i >= 0; i--)
		{
			MenuEntry menuEntry = menuEntries[i];

			MenuAction menuType = menuEntry.getType();
			if (menuType == MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_FIRST_OPTION || menuType == MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_SECOND_OPTION
				|| menuType == MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_THIRD_OPTION || menuType == MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_FOURTH_OPTION
				|| menuType == MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_FIFTH_OPTION || menuType == MenuAction.EXAMINE_ITEM_GROUND)
			{
				for (MenuEntryWithCount entryWCount : newEntries)
				{
					if (entryWCount.getEntry().equals(menuEntry))
					{
						entryWCount.increment();
						continue outer;
					}
				}
			}

			newEntries.add(new MenuEntryWithCount(menuEntry));
		}

		Collections.reverse(newEntries);

		client.setMenuEntries(newEntries.stream().map(e ->
		{
			final MenuEntry entry = e.getEntry();
			final int count = e.getCount();
			if (count > 1)
			{
				entry.setTarget(entry.getTarget() + " x " + count);
			}

			return entry;
		}).toArray(MenuEntry[]::new));
	}

	/**
	 * Clicks a widget option while ignoring colour tags, so an action stored as
	 * {@code Create <col=ff9040>Buy</col> offer} can be matched with plain
	 * {@code Create Buy offer}.
	 */
	public boolean interactStripped(Widget widget, String action)
	{
		if (widget == null || widget.isHidden() || action == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		String[] actions = widget.getActions();
		if (actions == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		for (int i = 0; i < actions.length; i++)
		{
			if (actions[i] != null && stripTags(actions[i]).equalsIgnoreCase(stripTags(action)))
			{
				client.menuAction(-1, widget.getId(), MenuAction.CC_OP, i + 1, -1, actions[i], "");
				return true;
			}
		}

		return false;
	}

	private static String stripTags(String value)
	{
		return value.replaceAll("<[^>]*>", "").trim();
	}

	/**
	 * Interacts with a tile object by opening its right-click menu and then
	 * clicking the matching option in that menu. Using the real context menu
	 * avoids relying on synthesised menu actions, which the client does not
	 * always resolve for tile objects.
	 */
	public boolean interact(TileObject object, String... actions)
	{
		if (object == null || actions == null || actions.length == 0)
		{
			return false;
		}

		if (client.isMenuOpen())
		{
			MenuEntry entry = findObjectMenuEntry(object, actions);
			if (entry != null)
			{
				return clickMenuEntry(entry);
			}

			// The menu is open for something else or does not contain the
			// requested option. Close it so the next attempt can start over.
			closeMenu();
			return false;
		}

		// Right-click the object to open its menu. The next tick picks the
		// matching option from the menu.
		return click(object, MouseEvent.BUTTON3);
	}

	private MenuEntry findObjectMenuEntry(TileObject object, String... actions)
	{
		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();
		MenuEntry[] entries = menu == null ? null : menu.getMenuEntries();

		{
			return null;
		}

		ObjectComposition composition = client.getObjectDefinition(object.getId());

		int objectId = object.getId() & 0xFFFF;

		// The first option is what a normal left click selects. Using a real

	public boolean interact(Widget widget, String action)
	{
		if (widget == null || widget.isHidden())
		{
			return false;
		}

		int actionIndex = findAction(widget.getActions(), action);
		if (actionIndex < 0)
		{
			return false;
		}

		client.menuAction(-1, widget.getId(), MenuAction.CC_OP, actionIndex + 1, -1, action, "");
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Finds the visible bank widget for an item in the main bank tab.
	 */
	public Widget findBankItemWidget(int itemId)
	{
		Widget items = client.getWidget(InterfaceID.Bankmain.ITEMS);
		if (items == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		Widget[] children = items.getChildren();
		if (children == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		for (Widget child : children)
		{
			if (child == null || child.isSelfHidden() || child.getItemId() != itemId)
			{
				continue;
			}

			return child;
		}

		return null;
	}

	/**
	 * Withdraws an item from the bank by right-clicking its bank slot and
	 * clicking the requested withdraw option in the real context menu.
	 */
	public boolean withdrawBankItem(int itemId, String withdrawOption)
	{
		if (client.isMenuOpen())
		{
			MenuEntry entry = findBankMenuEntry(itemId, withdrawOption);
			if (entry != null)
			{
				return clickMenuEntry(entry);
			}

			closeMenu();
			return false;
		}

		Widget widget = findBankItemWidget(itemId);
		return widget != null && click(widget, MouseEvent.BUTTON3);
	}

	private MenuEntry findBankMenuEntry(int itemId, String withdrawOption)

	private void reset()
	{
		highlightedItems = new ItemList(Text.fromCSV(config.getHighlightItems()));
		hiddenItems = new ItemList(Text.fromCSV(config.getHiddenItems()));

		// Cache colors
		ImmutableList.Builder<PriceHighlight> priceCheckBuilder = ImmutableList.builder();

		if (config.insaneValuePrice() > 0)

			priceCheckBuilder.add(new PriceHighlight(config.insaneValuePrice(), config.insaneValueColor()));

		if (config.mediumValuePrice() > 0)

			priceCheckBuilder.add(new PriceHighlight(config.mediumValuePrice(), config.mediumValueColor()));

		{

	public void onMenuEntryAdded(MenuEntryAdded event)
	{
		MenuAction type = MenuAction.of(event.getType());
		final boolean hotKeyPressed = client.isKeyPressed(KeyCode.KC_SHIFT);
		if (type == MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_FIRST_OPTION || type == MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_SECOND_OPTION ||
			type == MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_THIRD_OPTION || type == MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_FOURTH_OPTION ||
			type == MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_FIFTH_OPTION || type == MenuAction.WIDGET_TARGET_ON_GROUND_ITEM)
		{
			final int itemId = event.getIdentifier();
			final int sceneX = event.getActionParam0();
			final int sceneY = event.getActionParam1();

			MenuEntry lastEntry = event.getMenuEntry();
			WorldView wv = client.getWorldView(lastEntry.getWorldViewId());

			final WorldPoint worldPoint = WorldPoint.fromScene(wv, sceneX, sceneY, wv.getPlane());
			GroundItem groundItem = collectedGroundItems.get(worldPoint, itemId);

			updateItemColor(groundItem);

			int quantity = groundItem.getQuantity();
			final boolean canBeRecolored = groundItem.highlighted || (groundItem.hidden && config.recolorMenuHiddenItems());

			if ((config.itemHighlightMode() == ItemHighlightMode.MENU || config.itemHighlightMode() == ItemHighlightMode.BOTH) &&
				(canBeRecolored && !groundItem.color.equals(config.defaultColor())))
			{
				final MenuHighlightMode mode = config.menuHighlightMode();

				if (mode == BOTH || mode == OPTION)
				{
					lastEntry.setOption(ColorUtil.prependColorTag(lastEntry.getOption(), groundItem.color));
				}

				if (mode == BOTH || mode == NAME)
				{
					// <col=ff9040>Logs
					// <col=00ff00>Telekinetic Grab</col><col=ffffff> -> <col=ff9040>Logs
					String target = lastEntry.getTarget();

					int i = target.lastIndexOf('>');
					lastEntry.setTarget(target.substring(0, i - 11) + ColorUtil.colorTag(groundItem.color) + target.substring(i + 1));
				}
			}

			if (config.showMenuItemQuantities() && groundItem.isStackable() && quantity > 1)
			{
				lastEntry.setTarget(lastEntry.getTarget() + " (" + quantity + ")");
			}

			if (groundItem.hidden && !groundItem.highlighted && config.deprioritizeHiddenItems())
			{
				lastEntry.setDeprioritized(true);
			}
		}

			submenu.createMenuEntry(-1)
				.setOption("Pick")
				.setType(MenuAction.RUNELITE)
				.onClick(e ->
					SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() ->
					{
						RuneliteColorPicker colorPicker = colorPickerManager.create(client,
							color != null ? color : Color.decode("#FFFFFF"), "Item color", true);
						colorPicker.setOnClose(c -> setItemColor(itemId, c));
						colorPicker.setVisible(true);
					}));

			var colors = Stream.concat(
					collectedGroundItems.values().stream()
						.map(GroundItem::getColor)

package net.runelite.api;

import java.util.function.Consumer;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;
import net.runelite.api.widgets.Widget;

/**
 * A menu entry in a right-click menu.
 */
public interface MenuEntry
{
	/**
	 * The option text added to the menu. (ie. "Walk here", "Use")
	 */
	String getOption();
	MenuEntry setOption(String option);

	/**
	 * The target of the action. (ie. Item or Actor name)
	 * <p>
	 * If the option does not apply to any target, this field
	 * will be set to empty string.
	 */
	String getTarget();
	MenuEntry setTarget(String target);

	/**
	 * An identifier value for the target of the action.
	 */
	int getIdentifier();
	MenuEntry setIdentifier(int identifier);

	/**
	 * The action the entry will trigger.
	 */
	MenuAction getType();
	MenuEntry setType(MenuAction type);

	/**
	 * An additional parameter for the action.
	 */
	int getParam0();
	MenuEntry setParam0(int param0);

	/**
	 * A second additional parameter for the action.
	 */
	int getParam1();
	MenuEntry setParam1(int param1);

	/**
	 * If this is true and you have single mouse button on and this entry is
	 * the top entry the right click menu will not be opened when you left click
	 *
	 * This is used  for shift click
	 */
	boolean isForceLeftClick();
	MenuEntry setForceLeftClick(boolean forceLeftClick);

	int getWorldViewId();
	MenuEntry setWorldViewId(int worldViewId);

	/**
	 * Deprioritized menus are sorted in the menu to be below the other menu entries.
	 * @return
	 */
	boolean isDeprioritized();
	MenuEntry setDeprioritized(boolean deprioritized);

	/**
	 * Set a callback to be called when this menu option is clicked
	 * @param callback
	 * @return
	 */
	MenuEntry onClick(Consumer<MenuEntry> callback);

	/**
	 * Get the callback called when the menu option is clicked
	 * @return
	 */
	Consumer<MenuEntry> onClick();

	/**
	 * Test if this menu entry is an item op. "Use" and "Examine" are not considered item ops.
	 * @return
	 */
	boolean isItemOp();

	/**
	 * If this menu entry is an item op, get the item op id
	 * @return 1-5
	 */
	int getItemOp();

	/**
	 * Get the item id
	 * @return
	 * @see net.runelite.api.gameval.ItemID
	 */
	int getItemId();

	/**
	 * Set the item id
	 * @param itemId
	 * @return
	 */
	MenuEntry setItemId(int itemId);

	/**
	 * Get the widget this menu entry is on, if this is a menu entry
	 * with an associated widget. Such as eg, CC_OP.
	 * @return
	 */
	@Nullable
	Widget getWidget();

	/**
	 * Get the {@link NPC} this menu entry is targeting, if any.
	 * @return
	 */
	@Nullable
	NPC getNpc();

	/**
	 * Get the {@link Player} this menu entry is targeting, if any.
	 * @return
	 */
	@Nullable
	Player getPlayer();

	/**
	 * Get the {@link Actor} this menu entry is targeting, if any.
	 * @return
	 */
	@Nullable
	Actor getActor();

	/**
	 * Get the submenu for this menu entry.
	 * @return the submenu, or null if one doesn't exist
	 * @see #createSubMenu()
	 */
	@Nullable
	Menu getSubMenu();

	/**
	 * Create a new submenu for this menu entry.
	 * This will erase any previous submenu.
	 * @return the new submenu
	 */
	@Nonnull
	Menu createSubMenu();

	/**
	 * Remove the submenu from this menu entry.
	 */
	void deleteSubMenu();
}

package net.runelite.api;

import org.intellij.lang.annotations.MagicConstant;

/**
 * Represents an item inside an {@link ItemLayer}.
 */
public interface TileItem extends Renderable
{
	int OWNERSHIP_NONE = 0;
	int OWNERSHIP_SELF = 1;
	int OWNERSHIP_OTHER = 2;
	int OWNERSHIP_GROUP = 3;

	/**
	 * @return the ID of the item
	 * @see net.runelite.api.gameval.ItemID
	 */
	int getId();

	int getQuantity();

	/**
	 * Get the time, in server ticks, when the item becomes visible to other players
	 * @see Client#getTickCount()
	 * @return
	 */
	int getVisibleTime();

	/**
	 * Get the time, in server ticks, when the item despawns
	 * @see Client#getTickCount()
	 * @return
	 */
	int getDespawnTime();

	/**
	 * Get the item ownership
	 * @return
	 */
	@MagicConstant(intValues = {OWNERSHIP_NONE, OWNERSHIP_SELF, OWNERSHIP_OTHER, OWNERSHIP_GROUP})
	int getOwnership();

	/**
	 * Test whether the item is private
	 * @return
	 */
	boolean isPrivate();
}

package net.runelite.api;

import java.util.List;
import net.runelite.api.coords.LocalPoint;
import net.runelite.api.coords.WorldPoint;

/**
 * Represents a tile in the game.
 */
public interface Tile
{
	/**
	 * Gets the decoration on the tile.
	 *
	 * @return the tile decoration
	 */
	DecorativeObject getDecorativeObject();

	/**
	 * Gets all game objects on the tile.
	 *
	 * @return the game objects
	 */
	GameObject[] getGameObjects();

	/**
	 * Gets the items held on this tile.
	 *
	 * @return the item
	 */
	ItemLayer getItemLayer();

	/**
	 * Gets the object on the ground layer of the tile.
	 *
	 * @return the ground object
	 */
	GroundObject getGroundObject();

	/**
	 * Sets the object on the ground layer of the tile.
	 *
	 * @param groundObject the ground object
	 */
	void setGroundObject(GroundObject groundObject);

	/**
	 * Gets the wall of the tile.
	 *
	 * @return the wall object
	 */
	WallObject getWallObject();

	/**
	 * Gets the scene paint of the tile.
	 *
	 * @return the paint
	 */
	SceneTilePaint getSceneTilePaint();

	/**
	 * Sets the scene paint of the tile.
	 * Must only be mutated during map load.
	 *
	 * @param paint the paint
	 */
	void setSceneTilePaint(SceneTilePaint paint);

	/**
	 * Gets the model of the tile in the scene.
	 *
	 * @return the tile model
	 */
	SceneTileModel getSceneTileModel();

	/**
	 * Sets the model of the tile in the scene.
	 * Must only be mutated during map load.
	 *
	 * @param model the tile model
	 */
	void setSceneTileModel(SceneTileModel model);

	/**
	 * Gets the location coordinate of the tile in the world.
	 *
	 * @return the world location
	 */
	WorldPoint getWorldLocation();

	/**
	 * Gets the location coordinate of the tile in scene coords
	 *
	 * @return the scene location
	 */
	Point getSceneLocation();

package net.runelite.api;

import org.intellij.lang.annotations.MagicConstant;

/**
 * Represents an object that can be rendered.
 */
public interface Renderable extends Node
{
	/**
	 * Gets the model of the object.
	 */
	Model getModel();

	/**
	 * Gets the height of the model.
	 */
	int getModelHeight();

	void setModelHeight(int modelHeight);

	int getAnimationHeightOffset();

	@MagicConstant(intValues = {RENDERMODE_DEFAULT, RENDERMODE_SORTED, RENDERMODE_SORTED_NO_DEPTH, RENDERMODE_UNSORTED, RENDERMODE_UNSORTED_NO_DEPTH})
	int getRenderMode();

	int RENDERMODE_DEFAULT = 0;
	int RENDERMODE_SORTED = 1;
	int RENDERMODE_SORTED_NO_DEPTH = 2;
	int RENDERMODE_UNSORTED = 3;
	int RENDERMODE_UNSORTED_NO_DEPTH = 4;
}

	private void hunt(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Inventory inventory = context.getInventory();

		// A menu left over from a previous loot/interaction would block
		// clicking giants and walking. Close it before hunting.
		if (context.getClient().isMenuOpen())
		{
			context.getInput().closeMenu();
			return;
		}

		if (inventory.isFull())
		{
			state = State.WALK_TO_BANK;
			setStatus("Inventory full");
			return;
		}

		GroundLoot loot = findGroundLoot(context);
		if (loot != null)
		{
			state = State.LOOT;
			setStatus("Looting");
			return;
		}

		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		NPC interacting = player != null && player.getInteracting() instanceof NPC
			? (NPC) player.getInteracting()
			: null;
		if (interacting != null)
		{
			// Any active NPC interaction blocks a new attack. Auto-retaliate
			// may have started a fight with something other than a hill
			// giant, so wait for that fight to finish instead of spamming
			// attack clicks that the game will reject.
			String interactingName = getNpcName(interacting);
			setStatus((interacting.isDead() ? "Finishing " : "Fighting ") + interactingName);
			return;
		}

		GameInput input = context.getInput();
		if (input.isBusy())
		{
			setStatus("Moving mouse");
			return;
		}

		Optional<NPC> target = findHillGiant(context);
		if (target.isPresent())
		{
			if (input.interact(target.get(), ATTACK_ACTION))
			{
				cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
				setStatus("Attacking " + NPC_NAME);
			}
			else
			{
				cooldown = 2;
				setStatus("Cannot attack " + NPC_NAME);
			}
			return;
		}

		openDoor(context);
		cooldown = 2;
		setStatus("No " + NPC_NAME + " nearby");
	}

	private void loot(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Inventory inventory = context.getInventory();

		if (inventory.isFull())
		{
			state = State.WALK_TO_BANK;
			setStatus("Inventory full");
			return;
		}

		GroundLoot loot = findGroundLoot(context);
		if (loot == null)
		{
			context.getInput().closeMenu();
			state = State.HUNT;
			setStatus("Hunting");
			return;
		}

		GameInput input = context.getInput();
		if (input.isBusy())
		{
			setStatus("Moving mouse");
		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		WorldPoint location = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
		if (location == null)
		{
			return;
		}

		if (!isInDungeon(location))
		{
			if (location.distanceTo(WEST_VARROCK_BANK) <= 8)
			{
				state = State.BANK;
				setStatus("Banking");
				return;
			}

			// After climbing up we are inside the shed with the brass-key
			// door shut behind us. Open it once, then walk away using the
			// minimap so the walk click cannot hit and toggle the door.
			if (!shedDoorOpen
				&& location.distanceTo(SURFACE_DOOR) <= 10
				&& openDoor(context))
			{
				setStatus("Opening door");
				return;
			}

			walkTowards(context, WEST_VARROCK_BANK, true);
			setStatus("Walking to bank");
		}
		else
		{
			if (location.distanceTo(DUNGEON_LADDER) <= 8)
			{
				climb(context, true, LADDER_ID);
			}
			else
			{
				walkTowards(context, DUNGEON_LADDER);
			}
			setStatus("Walking to bank");
		}
	}

	private void bank(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Inventory inventory = context.getInventory();
		GameInput input = context.getInput();

		Widget bankUniverse = context.getTargets().findWidget(InterfaceID.Bankmain.UNIVERSE).orElse(null);
		if (bankUniverse == null)
		{
			bankStage = null;
			bankAttempts = 0;

			if (input.isBusy())
			{
				setStatus("Moving mouse");
				return;
			}

			Optional<GameObject> booth = context.getTargets().findObject(BANK_BOOTH_ID, 10);
			if (booth.isEmpty())
			{
				booth = context.getTargets().findObject("Bank booth", "Bank", 10);
			}
			if (booth.isPresent())
			{
				if (input.interact(booth.get(), "Bank"))
				{
					cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
					setStatus("Opening bank");
				}
				return;
			}

			Optional<NPC> banker = context.getTargets().findNpc("Banker", "Bank", 10);
			if (banker.isPresent())
			{
				if (input.interact(banker.get(), "Bank"))
				{
					cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
					setStatus("Opening bank");
				}
				return;
			}

			cooldown = 2;
			setStatus("No bank nearby");
			return;
		}

		if (bankStage == null)
		{
			bankStage = BankStage.DEPOSIT;
			bankAttempts = 0;
		}

		if (input.isBusy())
		{
			setStatus("Moving mouse");
			return;
		}

		// The withdraw stages handle their own context menus. Any other menu
		// would swallow the click on the deposit button.
		if (context.getClient().isMenuOpen()
			&& bankStage != BankStage.WITHDRAW_KEY
			&& bankStage != BankStage.WITHDRAW_SARDINES)
		{
			input.closeMenu();
			return;
		}

		switch (bankStage)
		{
			case DEPOSIT:
			{
				Widget deposit = context.getTargets()
					.findWidget(InterfaceID.Bankmain.DEPOSITINV)
					.orElse(null);
				if (deposit != null && input.click(deposit))
				{
					bankStage = BankStage.WAIT_DEPOSIT;
					bankAttempts = 0;
					cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
				}
				else
				{
					++bankAttempts;
					cooldown = 1;
				}
				setStatus("Depositing loot");
				return;
			}
			case WAIT_DEPOSIT:
			{
				if (inventory.getEmptySlots() >= Inventory.SIZE)
				{
					bankStage = BankStage.WITHDRAW_KEY;
					bankAttempts = 0;
					setStatus("Withdrawing brass key");
					return;
				}

				if (++bankAttempts > BANK_STAGE_ATTEMPTS)
				{
					// The deposit click did not register. Try the button
					// again instead of waiting forever.
					bankStage = BankStage.DEPOSIT;
					bankAttempts = 0;
				}
				setStatus("Depositing loot");
				return;
			}
			case WITHDRAW_KEY:
			{
				if (inventory.countItem(BRASS_KEY_ID) >= BRASS_KEY_AMOUNT)
				{
					bankStage = BankStage.WITHDRAW_SARDINES;
					bankAttempts = 0;
					setStatus("Withdrawing sardines");
					return;
				}

				if (++bankAttempts > BANK_STAGE_ATTEMPTS)
				{
					// No key available in the bank. Continue with the food
					// instead of retrying forever.
					bankStage = BankStage.WITHDRAW_SARDINES;
					bankAttempts = 0;
					setStatus("No brass key in bank");
					return;
				}

				if (input.withdrawBankItem(BRASS_KEY_ID, "Withdraw-1"))
				{
					cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
				}
				else
				{
					cooldown = 1;
				}
				setStatus("Withdrawing brass key");
				return;
			}
			case WITHDRAW_SARDINES:
			{
				if (inventory.countItem(SARDINE_ID) >= SARDINE_AMOUNT)
				{
					bankStage = BankStage.LEAVE;
					bankAttempts = 0;
					setStatus("Leaving bank");
					return;
				}

				if (++bankAttempts > BANK_STAGE_ATTEMPTS)
				{
					bankStage = BankStage.LEAVE;
					bankAttempts = 0;
					setStatus("No sardines in bank");
					return;
				}

				if (input.withdrawBankItem(SARDINE_ID, "Withdraw-5"))
				{
					cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
				}
				else
				{
					cooldown = 1;
				}
				setStatus("Withdrawing sardines");
				return;
			}
			case LEAVE:
			{
				if (context.getClient().isMenuOpen())
				{
					input.closeMenu();
					return;
				}

				input.pressKey(java.awt.event.KeyEvent.VK_ESCAPE);
				cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
				ignoredLoot.clear();
				bankStage = null;
				bankAttempts = 0;
				returningFromBank = true;
				shedDoorOpen = false;
				state = State.WALK_TO_GIANTS;
				setStatus("Returning to hill giants");
				return;
			}
		}
	}


	private void walkToGiants(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		WorldPoint location = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
		if (location == null)
		{
			return;
		}

		if (isInDungeon(location))
		{
			returningFromBank = false;

			if (location.distanceTo(HILL_GIANTS) <= 8)
			{
				state = State.HUNT;
				setStatus("Hunting");
				return;
			}
			walkTowards(context, HILL_GIANTS);
			setStatus("Walking to hill giants");
		}
		else
		{
			boolean nearShed = location.distanceTo(SURFACE_DOOR) <= 3
				|| location.distanceTo(SURFACE_LADDER) <= 3;

			// Coming back from the bank the shed door is normally shut and
			// blocks the ladder inside. Always open it before targeting the
			// ladder, even when the collision map still looks walkable.
			if (!shedDoorOpen && returningFromBank && nearShed && openDoor(context))
			{
				setStatus("Opening door");
				return;
			}

			boolean ladderReachable = canReach(context, SURFACE_LADDER);
			boolean canClimb = ladderReachable || shedDoorOpen
				|| location.distanceTo(SURFACE_LADDER) <= 2;

			if (location.distanceTo(SURFACE_LADDER) <= 8 && canClimb)
			{
				climb(context, false, LADDER_ID);
				setStatus("Climbing down");
				return;
			}

			if (!shedDoorOpen
				&& !ladderReachable
				&& location.distanceTo(SURFACE_DOOR) <= 10
				&& openDoor(context))
			{
				setStatus("Opening door");
				return;
			}

			// Walk to the open door with the minimap so the walk click
			// cannot toggle it, then approach the ladder inside.
			WorldPoint target = !shedDoorOpen && (returningFromBank || !ladderReachable)
				? SURFACE_DOOR
				: SURFACE_LADDER;
			walkTowards(context, target, true);
			setStatus("Walking to hill giants");

	/**
	 * Finds the Take entry for a ground item in the currently open menu.
	 */
	private MenuEntry findGroundItemMenuEntry(int itemId, int sceneX, int sceneY)
	{
		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();
		MenuEntry[] entries = menu == null ? null : menu.getMenuEntries();
		if (entries == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		int id = itemId & 0xFFFF;
		MenuEntry fallback = null;

		for (MenuEntry entry : entries)
		{
			if (entry == null || !isGroundItemAction(entry.getType())
				|| !matchesOption(entry.getOption(), "Take", "Pick up", "Pickup")
				|| (entry.getIdentifier() & 0xFFFF) != id)
			{
				continue;
			}

			// The menu only contains items from the tile that was
			// right-clicked, but prefer an entry with matching coordinates.
			if (entry.getParam0() == sceneX && entry.getParam1() == sceneY)
			{
				return entry;
			}

			if (fallback == null)
			{
				fallback = entry;
			}
		}

		return fallback;
	}

	private static boolean isGroundItemAction(MenuAction type)
	{
		if (type == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		int id = type.getId();
		return id >= MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_FIRST_OPTION.getId()
			&& id <= MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_FIFTH_OPTION.getId();
	}

	private static boolean matchesOption(String option, String... actions)
	{
		if (option == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		return pressKey(KeyEvent.VK_ESCAPE);
	}

	/**
	 * Picks up a ground item by right-clicking its tile and then clicking the
	 * Take entry in the context menu.
	 */
	public boolean takeGroundItem(int sceneX, int sceneY, int itemId, String itemName)
	{
		if (client.isMenuOpen())
		{
			MenuEntry entry = findGroundItemMenuEntry(itemId, sceneX, sceneY);
			if (entry != null)
			{
				return clickMenuEntry(entry);
			}

			closeMenu();
			return false;
		}

		LocalPoint localPoint = LocalPoint.fromScene(sceneX, sceneY, client.getTopLevelWorldView());
		if (localPoint == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Polygon tilePoly = Perspective.getCanvasTilePoly(client, localPoint);
		Point point = randomPoint(tilePoly);
		return point != null && click(point, MouseEvent.BUTTON3);
	}

	public boolean walkTo(WorldPoint worldPoint)
	{
		if (worldPoint == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		LocalPoint localPoint = LocalPoint.fromWorld(client, worldPoint);
		if (localPoint == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Polygon tilePoly = Perspective.getCanvasTilePoly(client, localPoint);
		return tilePoly != null && click(tilePoly);
	}

	Color getItemColor(int itemId)
	{
		return configManager.getConfiguration(GroundItemsConfig.GROUP, HIGHLIGHT_COLOR_PREFIX + itemId, Color.class);
	}

	void setItemColor(int itemId, Color color)
	{
		configManager.setConfiguration(GroundItemsConfig.GROUP, HIGHLIGHT_COLOR_PREFIX + itemId, color);
	}

	void unsetItemColor(int itemId)
	{
		configManager.unsetConfiguration(GroundItemsConfig.GROUP, HIGHLIGHT_COLOR_PREFIX + itemId);
	}

	/*
	 * All      -> none | self | other | group
	 * Drops    -> self | group
	 * Takeable -> none | self | group | (if a main then other)
	 */
	boolean shouldDisplayItem(OwnershipFilterMode filterMode, int ownership, int accountType)
	{
		switch (filterMode)
		{
			case DROPS:
				return ownership == OWNERSHIP_SELF || ownership == OWNERSHIP_GROUP;
			case TAKEABLE:
				return ownership != OWNERSHIP_OTHER || accountType == 0; // Mains can always take items
			default:
				return true;
		}
	}
}

		if (widget != null && input.click(widget))

			cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
			setStatus("Eating sardine");
		}
	}

Updated the Hill Giant script.

**Loot**
- Only picks up **Big bones**, **Body talisman**, and **Uncut diamond**.
- Loots them from the ground even if another player killed the NPC.
- Failed/unreachable loot is retried after 60 seconds instead of being ignored forever.

**Ground item fix**
- The exact ground item menu entry is now invoked directly using its tile coordinates and item id.
- It no longer clicks a menu row, so overlapping drops cannot make it pick the item above the intended one.
- It works even if the right-click menu is not visibly open, and right-clicks lower on the tile so nearby item models do not steal the click.
- The pickup also retries instead of getting stuck when no matching menu entry exists yet.

**Bank**
- Deposits the inventory and withdraws **only the brass key**, then heads back to the hill giants.
- Sardine withdrawal was removed.

`./gradlew :rsbuddy:check` and `:rsbuddy:installPlugin` both pass. Restart the client once because `GameInput` changed; after that, script-only edits can use the Reload button.

	private void walkTowards(ScriptContext context, WorldPoint target)
	{

	private void walkTowards(ScriptContext context, WorldPoint target, boolean useMinimap)
	{
		GameInput input = context.getInput();
		if (input.isBusy())
		{
			return;
		}

		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		WorldPoint location = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
		if (location == null || location.distanceTo(target) <= 2)
		{
			lastWalkLocation = location;
			stationaryTicks = 0;
			return;
		}

		// Do not click again while the player is still moving. Re-clicking
		// every tick interrupts the client's own path and makes it run into
		// walls.
		if (lastWalkLocation == null || !lastWalkLocation.equals(location))
		{
			lastWalkLocation = location;
			stationaryTicks = 0;
			return;
		}

		if (++stationaryTicks < 2)
		{
			return;
		}

		List<WorldPoint> path = findPath(context, target);
		if (path.size() <= 1)
		{
			stationaryTicks = 0;
			return;
		}

		// Click a point a few tiles along the collision-checked path.
		int index = Math.min(path.size() - 1, 10);

		// Minimap clicks never hit objects, so routes that pass a door
		// (the shed door in particular) cannot accidentally toggle it.
		if (useMinimap && clickMinimap(context, path.get(index)))
		{
			stationaryTicks = 0;
			return;
		}

		for (int i = index; i >= 1; i--)
		{
			if (input.walkTo(path.get(i)))
			{
				stationaryTicks = 0;
				return;
			}
		}

		clickMinimap(context, path.get(index));
		stationaryTicks = 0;
	}

	private boolean clickMinimap(ScriptContext context, WorldPoint point)
	{
		Client client = context.getClient();
		net.runelite.api.coords.LocalPoint localPoint = net.runelite.api.coords.LocalPoint.fromWorld(client, point);
		if (localPoint == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		net.runelite.api.Point minimapPoint = net.runelite.api.Perspective.localToMinimap(client, localPoint);
		if (minimapPoint == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		return context.getInput().click(new java.awt.Point(minimapPoint.getX(), minimapPoint.getY()));
	}

	/**
	 * Removes a CustomMenuOption from the list of managed menu options.
	 *
	 * @param customMenuOption The custom menu to add
	 */
	public void removeManagedCustomMenu(WidgetMenuOption customMenuOption)
	{
		for (int id : customMenuOption.getWidgetIds())
		{
			managedMenuOptions.remove(id, customMenuOption);
		}
	}

	private static boolean menuContainsCustomMenu(MenuEntry[] menuEntries, WidgetMenuOption customMenuOption)
	{
		for (MenuEntry menuEntry : menuEntries)
		{
			String option = menuEntry.getOption();
			String target = menuEntry.getTarget();

			if (option.equals(customMenuOption.getMenuOption()) && target.equals(customMenuOption.getMenuTarget()))
			{
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	@Subscribe
	public void onMenuEntryAdded(MenuEntryAdded event)
	{
		if (client.isWidgetSelected() || event.getType() != MenuAction.CC_OP.getId())
		{
			return;
		}

		int widgetId = event.getActionParam1();
		Collection<WidgetMenuOption> options = managedMenuOptions.get(widgetId);
		if (options.isEmpty())
		{
			return;
		}

		MenuEntry[] menuEntries = client.getMenuEntries();

		// Menu entries are sorted with higher-index entries appearing toward the top of the minimenu, so insert older
		// managed menu entries at higher indices and work backward for newer entries so newly-added entries appear at
		// the bottom
		int insertIdx = -1;
		for (WidgetMenuOption currentMenu : options)
		{
			// Exit if we've inserted the managed menu entries already
			if (menuContainsCustomMenu(menuEntries, currentMenu))
			{
				return;
			}

			client.createMenuEntry(insertIdx--)
				.setOption(currentMenu.getMenuOption())
				.setTarget(currentMenu.getMenuTarget())
				.setType(MenuAction.RUNELITE)
				.setParam1(widgetId)
				.onClick(currentMenu.callback);
		}
	}

	public void addPlayerMenuItem(String menuText)
	{
		Preconditions.checkNotNull(menuText);

		int playerMenuIndex = findEmptyPlayerMenuIndex();
		if (playerMenuIndex == IDX_UPPER)
		{
			return; // no more slots
		}

		addPlayerMenuItem(playerMenuIndex, menuText);

	private void hunt(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Inventory inventory = context.getInventory();

		// A menu left over from a previous loot/interaction would block
		// clicking giants and walking. Close it before hunting.
		if (context.getClient().isMenuOpen())
		{
			context.getInput().closeMenu();
			return;
		}

		if (inventory.isFull())
		{
			state = State.WALK_TO_BANK;
			setStatus("Inventory full");
			return;
		}

		GroundLoot loot = findGroundLoot(context);
		if (loot != null)
		{
			state = State.LOOT;
			setStatus("Looting");
			return;
		}

		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		NPC interacting = player != null && player.getInteracting() instanceof NPC
			? (NPC) player.getInteracting()
			: null;
		if (interacting != null)
		{
			// Any active NPC interaction blocks a new attack. Auto-retaliate
			// may have started a fight with something other than a hill
			// giant, so wait for that fight to finish instead of spamming
			// attack clicks that the game will reject.
			String interactingName = getNpcName(interacting);
			setStatus((interacting.isDead() ? "Finishing " : "Fighting ") + interactingName);
			return;
		}

		GameInput input = context.getInput();
		if (input.isBusy())
		{
			setStatus("Moving mouse");
			return;
		}

		Optional<NPC> target = findHillGiant(context);
		if (target.isPresent())
		{
			if (input.interact(target.get(), ATTACK_ACTION))
			{
				cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
				setStatus("Attacking " + NPC_NAME);
			}
			else
			{
				cooldown = 2;
				setStatus("Cannot attack " + NPC_NAME);
			}
			return;
		}

		openDoor(context);
		cooldown = 2;
		setStatus("No " + NPC_NAME + " nearby");
	}

	private void loot(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Inventory inventory = context.getInventory();

		if (inventory.isFull())
		{
			state = State.WALK_TO_BANK;
			setStatus("Inventory full");
			return;
		}

		GroundLoot loot = findGroundLoot(context);
		if (loot == null)
		{
			context.getInput().closeMenu();
			state = State.HUNT;
			setStatus("Hunting");
			return;
		}

		GameInput input = context.getInput();
		if (input.isBusy())
		{
			setStatus("Moving mouse");
			return;
		}

		if (!java.util.Objects.equals(lootTarget, loot.worldLocation)
			|| lootTargetItemId != loot.itemId)
		{
			lootTarget = loot.worldLocation;
			lootTargetItemId = loot.itemId;
			lootAttempts = 0;
			lootTargetTicks = 0;
		}

		if (++lootTargetTicks > LOOT_TARGET_TIMEOUT_TICKS && loot.worldLocation != null)
		{
			// The drop is probably behind an obstacle or otherwise
			// unreachable. Ignore it so the script does not get stuck.
			ignoreLoot(loot.worldLocation);
			lootTarget = null;
			lootTargetItemId = -1;
			lootAttempts = 0;
			lootTargetTicks = 0;
			state = State.HUNT;
			setStatus("Skipping unreachable loot");
			return;
		}

		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		WorldPoint location = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
		if (location != null && loot.worldLocation != null
			&& location.distanceTo(loot.worldLocation) > 2)
		{
			walkTowards(context, loot.worldLocation);
			lootAttempts = 0;
			setStatus("Walking to loot");
			return;
		}

		Client client = context.getClient();
		String itemName = getItemName(client, loot.itemId);
		input.takeGroundItem(loot.sceneX, loot.sceneY, loot.itemId, itemName);
		cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;

		if (++lootAttempts > LOOT_ATTEMPT_LIMIT && loot.worldLocation != null)
		{
			ignoreLoot(loot.worldLocation);
			lootTarget = null;
			lootTargetItemId = -1;
			lootAttempts = 0;
			lootTargetTicks = 0;
			state = State.HUNT;
			setStatus("Skipping unreachable loot");
			return;
		}

		setStatus(itemName.isEmpty() ? "Looting" : "Looting " + itemName);
	}

	private void eatIfNeeded(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Client client = context.getClient();
		Inventory inventory = context.getInventory();

		int current = client.getBoostedSkillLevel(Skill.HITPOINTS);
		int max = client.getRealSkillLevel(Skill.HITPOINTS);
		if (max <= 0 || current * 100 > max * EAT_THRESHOLD_PERCENT)
		{
			return;
		}

		int slot = inventory.findSlot(ItemID.SARDINE);
		if (slot < 0)
		{
			return;
		}

		// Clicking a sardine while the bank is open deposits it instead of
		// eating it, so wait until the bank is closed. A context menu also
		// swallows the first click, so wait for it to close as well.
		if (context.getTargets().findWidget(InterfaceID.Bankmain.UNIVERSE).isPresent()
			|| context.getClient().isMenuOpen())
		{
			return;
		}

		GameInput input = context.getInput();
		if (input.isBusy())
		{
			return;
		}

		// The inventory tab might not be open; the food slot has no widget
		// until it is, which would otherwise make the player stand there and
		// die without eating.
		if (!inventory.isOpen())
		{
			if (inventory.open())
			{
				setStatus("Opening inventory");
			}
			return;
		}

		Widget widget = inventory.getSlotWidget(slot);
		if (widget != null && input.click(widget))
		{
			cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
			setStatus("Eating sardine");
		}
	}

	private boolean openDoor(ScriptContext context)
	{
		GameInput input = context.getInput();
		if (input.isBusy())
		{
			return false;
		}

		Optional<TileObject> door = context.getTargets().findTileObject(DOOR_ID, 10);
		if (door.isEmpty())
		{
			return false;
		}

		boolean menuOpen = context.getClient().isMenuOpen();
		if (input.interact(door.get(), "Open", "Unlock"))
		{
			if (menuOpen)
			{
				// The Open/Unlock row was clicked, so the door is now open.
				shedDoorOpen = true;
			}
			cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
			setStatus("Opening door");
			return true;
		}

		if (menuOpen)
		{
			// The door's own menu has no Open/Unlock entry, which means it
			// is already open. Stop right-clicking it.
			shedDoorOpen = true;
		}

		return false;
	}

	private void climb(ScriptContext context, boolean up, int objectId)
	{
		GameInput input = context.getInput();
		if (input.isBusy())
		{
			return;
		}

		Optional<TileObject> object = context.getTargets().findTileObject(objectId, 10);
		if (object.isEmpty())
		{
			// Fall back to a named ladder if the id is not present.
			object = context.getTargets().findObject("Ladder", null, 10).map(ladder -> (TileObject) ladder);
		}
		if (object.isEmpty())
		{
			return;
		}

		String[] actions = up
			? new String[] {"Climb-up", "Climb up", "Exit", "Climb"}
			: new String[] {"Climb-down", "Climb down", "Enter", "Climb"};

		if (input.interact(object.get(), actions))
		{
			// Climbing moves us to the other side of the shed door, so the
			// next surface visit has to evaluate the door again.
			shedDoorOpen = false;
			cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
			setStatus(up ? "Climbing up" : "Climbing down");
		}
	}

	private void walkTowards(ScriptContext context, WorldPoint target)
	{
		walkTowards(context, target, false);
	}

	private void walkTowards(ScriptContext context, WorldPoint target, boolean useMinimap)
	{
		GameInput input = context.getInput();
		if (input.isBusy())
		{
			return;
		}

		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		WorldPoint location = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
		if (location == null || location.distanceTo(target) <= 2)
		{
			lastWalkLocation = location;
			stationaryTicks = 0;
			return;
		}

		// Do not click again while the player is still moving. Re-clicking
		// every tick interrupts the client's own path and makes it run into
		// walls.
		if (lastWalkLocation == null || !lastWalkLocation.equals(location))
		{
			lastWalkLocation = location;
			stationaryTicks = 0;
			return;
		}

		if (++stationaryTicks < 2)
		{
			return;
		}

		List<WorldPoint> path = findPath(context, target);
		if (path.size() <= 1)
		{
			stationaryTicks = 0;
			return;
		}

		// Click a point a few tiles along the collision-checked path.
		int index = Math.min(path.size() - 1, 10);

		// Minimap clicks never hit objects, so routes that pass a door
		// (the shed door in particular) cannot accidentally toggle it.
		if (useMinimap && clickMinimap(context, path.get(index)))
		{
			stationaryTicks = 0;
			return;
		}

		for (int i = index; i >= 1; i--)
		{
			if (input.walkTo(path.get(i)))
			{
				stationaryTicks = 0;
				return;
			}
		}

		clickMinimap(context, path.get(index));
		stationaryTicks = 0;
	}

	private boolean clickMinimap(ScriptContext context, WorldPoint point)
	{
		Client client = context.getClient();
		net.runelite.api.coords.LocalPoint localPoint = net.runelite.api.coords.LocalPoint.fromWorld(client, point);
		if (localPoint == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		net.runelite.api.Point minimapPoint = net.runelite.api.Perspective.localToMinimap(client, localPoint);
		if (minimapPoint == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		return context.getInput().click(new java.awt.Point(minimapPoint.getX(), minimapPoint.getY()));
	}

	private static boolean matchesOption(String option, String... actions)
	{

	/**
	 * Clicks a row in the client's currently open context menu. The client
	 * lays the menu out with a 19px header and 15px rows, with the array's
	 * last entry at the top.
	 */
	public boolean clickMenuEntry(MenuEntry entry)
	{
		if (entry == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();
		MenuEntry[] entries = menu == null ? null : menu.getMenuEntries();
		if (!client.isMenuOpen() || entries == null || entries.length == 0)
		{
			return invokeMenuEntry(entry);
		}

		int index = -1;
		for (int i = 0; i < entries.length; i++)
		{
			if (entries[i] == entry)
			{
				index = i;
				break;
			}
		}

		if (index < 0 || client.isMenuScrollable())
		{
			return invokeMenuEntry(entry);
		}

		int row = entries.length - 1 - index;
		int x = menu.getMenuX() + Math.max(8, menu.getMenuWidth() / 2);
		int y = menu.getMenuY() + 19 + row * 15 + 7;
		return clickMenuPoint(new Point(x, y));
	}

	private boolean invokeMenuEntry(MenuEntry entry)
	{
		client.menuAction(entry.getParam0(), entry.getParam1(), entry.getType(),
			entry.getIdentifier(), entry.getItemId(), entry.getOption(), entry.getTarget());
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Runs a context-menu entry directly. This lets callers use an option that
	 * is not the default left-click action without opening the menu, and it
	 * never falls back to a plain click, so nothing unexpected is triggered.
	 */
	public boolean invokeMenu(MenuEntry entry)
	{
		return entry != null && invokeMenuEntry(entry);
	}

	/**
	 * Finds an entry in the client's current context menu. The menu is built
	 * from whatever the mouse is hovering, so callers must hover the target and
	 * wait a frame before asking.
	 *
	 * @param option option text, colour tags ignored
	 * @param itemId item id to require, or -1 to accept any
	 */
	public MenuEntry findMenuEntry(String option, int itemId)
	{
		if (option == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		MenuEntry untyped = null;
		int untypedCount = 0;

		for (MenuEntry entry : currentMenuEntries())
		{
			if (entry == null || entry.getOption() == null
				|| !stripTags(entry.getOption()).equalsIgnoreCase(stripTags(option)))
			{
				continue;
			}

			if (entry.getItemId() == itemId)
			{
				return entry;
			}

			if (entry.getItemId() <= 0)
			{
				untyped = entry;
				untypedCount++;
			}
		}

		// Fall back only when there is exactly one candidate, so an ambiguous
		// menu can never be resolved to the wrong item.
		return untypedCount == 1 ? untyped : null;
	}

	/**
	 * Lists the options in the current context menu, for logging when an
	 * expected option is missing.
	 */
	public List<String> describeMenu()
	{
		List<String> options = new ArrayList<>();

		for (MenuEntry entry : currentMenuEntries())
		{
			if (entry == null || entry.getOption() == null)
			{
				continue;
			}

			String target = stripTags(entry.getTarget() == null ? "" : entry.getTarget());
			options.add(stripTags(entry.getOption()) + (target.isEmpty() ? "" : " " + target));
		}

		return options;
	}

	private MenuEntry[] currentMenuEntries()
	{
		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();
		if (menu != null)
		{
			MenuEntry[] entries = menu.getMenuEntries();
			if (entries != null && entries.length > 0)
			{
				return entries;
			}
		}

		MenuEntry[] entries = client.getMenuEntries();
		return entries == null ? new MenuEntry[0] : entries;
	}

	/**
	 * Closes the currently open right-click menu, if any.
	 */
	public boolean closeMenu()
	{
		if (!client.isMenuOpen())
		{
			return false;
		}

		return pressKey(KeyEvent.VK_ESCAPE);
	}

package net.runelite.api;

/**
 * The client minimenu.
 */
public interface Menu
{
	/**
	 * Create a new menu entry
	 * @param idx the index to create the menu entry at. Accepts negative indexes eg. -1 inserts at the end.
	 * @return the newly created menu entry
	 */
	MenuEntry createMenuEntry(int idx);

	/**
	 * Gets the current mini menu entries.
	 *
	 * @return array of menu entries
	 */
	MenuEntry[] getMenuEntries();

	/**
	 * Sets the array of menu entries.
	 * <p>
	 * This method should typically be used in the context of the {@link net.runelite.api.events.MenuOpened}
	 * event, since setting the menu entries will be overwritten the next frame
	 *
	 * @param entries new array of open menu entries
	 */
	void setMenuEntries(MenuEntry[] entries);

	/**
	 * Remove a menu entry
	 * @param entry the menu entry
	 */
	void removeMenuEntry(MenuEntry entry);

	/**
	 * Get the menu x location. Only valid if the menu is open.
	 *
	 * @return the menu x location
	 */
	int getMenuX();

	/**
	 * Get the menu y location. Only valid if the menu is open.
	 *
	 * @return the menu y location
	 */
	int getMenuY();

	/**
	 * Get the menu width. Only valid if the menu is open.
	 *
	 * @return the menu width
	 */
	int getMenuWidth();

	/**
	 * Get the menu height. Only valid if the menu is open.
	 *
	 * @return the menu height
	 */
	int getMenuHeight();
}

	public boolean click(NPC npc)
	{
		if (npc == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Shape hull = npc.getConvexHull();
		if (hull != null)
		{
			return click(hull);
		}

		Polygon tilePoly = npc.getCanvasTilePoly();
		return tilePoly != null && click(tilePoly);
	}

	public boolean click(Widget widget)
	{
		return click(widget, MouseEvent.BUTTON1);
	}

	public boolean click(Widget widget, int button)
	{
		if (widget == null || widget.isHidden())
		{
			return false;
		}

		Rectangle bounds = widget.getBounds();
		if (bounds == null || bounds.isEmpty())
		{
			return false;
		}

		Point point = centerPoint(bounds);
		return point != null && click(point, button);
	}

	/**
	 * Moves the mouse onto an NPC without clicking it, using the same curved
	 * path as a click.

	 * @return true if a movement was started

	public boolean hover(NPC npc)
	{
		if (npc == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Shape hull = npc.getConvexHull();
		if (hull != null)
		{
			return hover(hull);
		}

		Polygon tilePoly = npc.getCanvasTilePoly();
		return tilePoly != null && hover(tilePoly);
	}

	/**
	 * Moves the mouse onto a widget without clicking it, using the same curved
	 * path as a click. The point is the widget's centre, matching
	 * {@link #click(Widget)}.

	 * @return true if a movement was started
	 */
	public boolean hover(Widget widget)
	{
		if (widget == null || widget.isHidden())
		{
			return false;
		}

		Rectangle bounds = widget.getBounds();
		if (bounds == null || bounds.isEmpty())

	public boolean hover(TileObject object)
	{

		Shape clickbox = object.getClickbox();

	}

	/**
	 * Clicks a point inside the already-open context menu. The cursor is
	 * moved there in a single event, because animated movement across the
	 * game world can close the menu before the click lands.
	 */
	private boolean clickMenuPoint(Point gamePoint)
	{
		if (gamePoint == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Canvas canvas = client.getCanvas();
		if (canvas == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Point canvasPoint = toCanvasPoint(gamePoint);
		if (!canvas.contains(canvasPoint))
		{
			return false;
		}

		stopCamera();
		stopMovement();
		busy = true;
		SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() ->
		{
			canvas.requestFocusInWindow();
			lastMousePoint = canvasPoint;
			mouseLocation = new Point(gamePoint);
			dispatch(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_MOVED, canvasPoint, MouseEvent.NOBUTTON, 0, 0);

			Timer timer = new Timer(45 + random.nextInt(45), event ->
			{
				long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
				clickLocation = new Point(gamePoint);
				clickStartedAt = now;
				clickButton = MouseEvent.BUTTON1;
				addClickEffect(new Point(gamePoint), MouseEvent.BUTTON1, now);

				dispatch(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_PRESSED, canvasPoint, MouseEvent.BUTTON1, 1,
					InputEvent.BUTTON1_DOWN_MASK);
				dispatch(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_RELEASED, canvasPoint, MouseEvent.BUTTON1, 1, 0);
				dispatch(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_CLICKED, canvasPoint, MouseEvent.BUTTON1, 1, 0);
				busy = false;
			});
			timer.setRepeats(false);
			timer.start();
		});
		return true;
	}

	private boolean click(Point gamePoint, int button)
	{
		if (gamePoint == null)

		Canvas canvas = client.getCanvas();

		{

		Point canvasPoint = toCanvasPoint(gamePoint);
		if (!canvas.contains(canvasPoint))
		{
			return false;
		}

		stopCamera();
		busy = true;
		SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> beginClick(canvas, canvasPoint, button));

	private void fastClickNext(Canvas canvas, List<Point> gamePoints, List<Point> canvasPoints, int index)
	{
		if (index >= gamePoints.size())
		{
			fastClicking = false;
			return;
		}

		Point gamePoint = gamePoints.get(index);
		Point canvasPoint = canvasPoints.get(index);

		canvas.requestFocusInWindow();
		lastMousePoint = canvasPoint;
		mouseLocation = new Point(gamePoint);
		dispatch(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_MOVED, canvasPoint, MouseEvent.NOBUTTON, 0, 0);

		// Give the client one frame to update its hover target before
		// pressing, then immediately move on to the next click.
		Timer timer = new Timer(15 + random.nextInt(20), event ->
		{
			long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
			clickLocation = new Point(gamePoint);
			clickStartedAt = now;
			clickButton = MouseEvent.BUTTON1;
			addClickEffect(gamePoint, MouseEvent.BUTTON1, now);

			dispatch(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_PRESSED, canvasPoint, MouseEvent.BUTTON1, 1,
				InputEvent.BUTTON1_DOWN_MASK);
			dispatch(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_RELEASED, canvasPoint, MouseEvent.BUTTON1, 1, 0);
			dispatch(canvas, MouseEvent.MOUSE_CLICKED, canvasPoint, MouseEvent.BUTTON1, 1, 0);

			fastClickNext(canvas, gamePoints, canvasPoints, index + 1);
		});
		timer.setRepeats(false);
		timer.start();
	}

	private void addClickEffect(Point gamePoint, int button, long startedAt)
	{
		clickEffects.add(new ClickEffect(new Point(gamePoint), button, startedAt));

		long cutoff = System.currentTimeMillis() - CLICK_EFFECT_LIFETIME_MS;
		clickEffects.removeIf(effect -> effect.startedAt < cutoff);
	}

	private void beginClick(Canvas canvas, Point target, int button)
	{
		Point start = beginMovement(canvas);
		if (start == null)
		{
			busy = false;
			return;
		}

		List<MouseStep> steps = buildMoveSteps(start, target);
		appendClickSteps(steps, target, button);
		playSteps(canvas, steps);
	}

	private void beginMove(Canvas canvas, Point target)
	{
		Point start = beginMovement(canvas);
		if (start == null)
		{
			busy = false;
			return;
		}

		playSteps(canvas, buildMoveSteps(start, target));
	}

	private void playSteps(Canvas canvas, List<MouseStep> steps)
	{
		final long startedAt = System.nanoTime();
		final int[] index = {0};

		Timer timer = new Timer(5, null);
		timer.addActionListener(event ->
		{
			long elapsedMs = (System.nanoTime() - startedAt) / 1_000_000L;

			while (index[0] < steps.size() && elapsedMs >= steps.get(index[0]).delayMs)
			{
				MouseStep step = steps.get(index[0]++);
				dispatch(canvas, step.id, step.point, step.button, step.clickCount, step.modifiers);
				mouseLocation = toGamePoint(step.point);

				if (step.id == MouseEvent.MOUSE_MOVED)
				{
					lastMousePoint = step.point;
				}
				else if (step.id == MouseEvent.MOUSE_PRESSED)
				{
					clickLocation = toGamePoint(step.point);
					clickStartedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
					clickButton = step.button;
					addClickEffect(clickLocation, clickButton, clickStartedAt);
				}
			}

			if (index[0] >= steps.size())
			{
				timer.stop();
				if (movementTimer == timer)
				{
					movementTimer = null;
					busy = false;
				}
			}
		});

		movementTimer = timer;
		timer.start();
	}

	private List<MouseStep> buildMoveSteps(Point start, Point target)
	{
		List<MouseStep> steps = new ArrayList<>();

		double dx = target.x - start.x;
		double dy = target.y - start.y;
		double distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);

		if (distance < 2.0)
		{
			steps.add(new MouseStep(MouseEvent.MOUSE_MOVED, target, MouseEvent.NOBUTTON, 0, 0, 0));
		}
		else
		{
			int moveSteps = Math.max(12, Math.min(50, (int) (distance / 11.0) + 9));
			double length = Math.max(1.0, distance);
			double perpX = -dy / length;
			double perpY = dx / length;

			// A mild curve makes straight-line teleporting look less robotic.
			double bend = (random.nextDouble() * 2.0 - 1.0) * Math.min(70.0, distance * 0.11);
			double control1X = start.x + dx * 0.32 + perpX * bend;
			double control1Y = start.y + dy * 0.32 + perpY * bend;
			double control2X = start.x + dx * 0.68 + perpX * bend * 0.55;
			double control2Y = start.y + dy * 0.68 + perpY * bend * 0.55;

			long delay = 0;
			for (int i = 1; i <= moveSteps; i++)
			{
				double progress = (double) i / moveSteps;
				double eased = 1.0 - Math.pow(1.0 - progress, 2.2);

				if (i < moveSteps && random.nextInt(6) == 0)
				{
					eased = Math.min(1.0, Math.max(0.0, eased + (random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 0.035));
				}

				double x = cubic(start.x, control1X, control2X, target.x, eased);
				double y = cubic(start.y, control1Y, control2Y, target.y, eased);

				if (i < moveSteps)
				{
					double jitter = (1.0 - progress) * Math.min(5.0, Math.max(1.0, distance * 0.012));
					x += (random.nextDouble() * 2.0 - 1.0) * jitter;
					y += (random.nextDouble() * 2.0 - 1.0) * jitter;
				}
				else
				{
					x = target.x;
					y = target.y;
				}

				delay += 12 + random.nextInt(10);
				if (i < moveSteps && random.nextInt(12) == 0)
				{
					delay += 25 + random.nextInt(50);
				}

				steps.add(new MouseStep(MouseEvent.MOUSE_MOVED,
					new Point((int) Math.round(x), (int) Math.round(y)),
					MouseEvent.NOBUTTON, 0, 0, delay));
			}
		}

		return steps;
	}

	private void appendClickSteps(List<MouseStep> steps, Point target, int button)
	{
		long pressDelay = steps.get(steps.size() - 1).delayMs + 30 + random.nextInt(70);
		int downMask = button == MouseEvent.BUTTON3
			? InputEvent.BUTTON3_DOWN_MASK
			: InputEvent.BUTTON1_DOWN_MASK;

		steps.add(new MouseStep(MouseEvent.MOUSE_PRESSED, target, button, 1, downMask, pressDelay));
		long releaseDelay = pressDelay + 45 + random.nextInt(75);
		steps.add(new MouseStep(MouseEvent.MOUSE_RELEASED, target, button, 1, 0, releaseDelay));
		steps.add(new MouseStep(MouseEvent.MOUSE_CLICKED, target, button, 1, 0,
			releaseDelay + 15 + random.nextInt(35)));
	}

	/**
	 * Sends a key press/release pair to the game canvas.
	 */
	public boolean pressKey(int keyCode)
	{
		Canvas canvas = client.getCanvas();
		if (canvas == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() ->
		{
			canvas.requestFocusInWindow();

			long when = System.currentTimeMillis();
			dispatchKey(canvas, KeyEvent.KEY_PRESSED, keyCode);

			char keyChar = keyCode == KeyEvent.VK_SPACE ? ' ' : KeyEvent.CHAR_UNDEFINED;
			if (keyChar != KeyEvent.CHAR_UNDEFINED)
			{
				canvas.dispatchEvent(new KeyEvent(canvas, KeyEvent.KEY_TYPED, when, 0,
					KeyEvent.VK_UNDEFINED, keyChar));
			}

			canvas.dispatchEvent(new KeyEvent(canvas, KeyEvent.KEY_RELEASED, when + 45, 0, keyCode, keyChar));
		});

		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Learns which way each arrow key turns the camera from the actual yaw
	 * change, so the mapping does not have to be assumed.
	 */
	private void finishCameraPulse(int keyCode)
	{
		int change = normalizeYaw(
			(client.getCameraYawTarget() & (CAMERA_YAW_UNITS - 1)) - cameraPulseYaw);
		if (Math.abs(change) < 8)
		{
			return;
		}

		int sign = change > 0 ? 1 : -1;
		if (keyCode == KeyEvent.VK_LEFT)
		{
			cameraLeftSign = sign;
			cameraRightSign = -sign;
		}
		else if (keyCode == KeyEvent.VK_RIGHT)
		{
			cameraRightSign = sign;
			cameraLeftSign = -sign;
		}
	}

	private void releaseCameraKey(int keyCode)
	{
		if (cameraKey != keyCode)
		{
			return;
		}

		cameraKey = -1;
		cameraKeyTimer = null;
		finishCameraPulse(keyCode);

		Canvas canvas = client.getCanvas();
		if (canvas != null)
		{
			dispatchKey(canvas, KeyEvent.KEY_RELEASED, keyCode);
		}
	}

/**

 * talismans, and uncut diamonds, and banks the loot at the west Varrock bank
 * before returning.
 */
public final class HillGiantScript extends Script
{
	private static final String NPC_NAME = "Hill Giant";

	private static final int BRASS_KEY_ID = ItemID.EDGEVILLEDUNGEONKEY;
	private static final int BRASS_KEY_AMOUNT = 1;
	private static final int BANK_STAGE_ATTEMPTS = 20;

	private static final int EAT_THRESHOLD_PERCENT = 50;

	// Loot that could not be reached is retried after this delay instead of
	// being ignored for the whole trip. This also gives drops that are still
	// private to another player time to become takeable.
	private static final long IGNORED_LOOT_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000L;

	/**
	 * Only the requested hill giant drops are picked up.
	 */
	private static boolean isLootItem(int itemId)
	{
		switch (itemId)
		{
			case ItemID.BIG_BONES:
			case ItemID.BODY_TALISMAN:
			case ItemID.UNCUT_DIAMOND:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
		}
	}

	private enum State
	{
		HUNT,
		LOOT,
		WALK_TO_BANK,
		BANK,

	}

	{
		DEPOSIT,
		WAIT_DEPOSIT,
		WITHDRAW_KEY,

	}

	public HillGiantScript()
	{
		super("Hill Giant (Edgeville)", "Kills hill giants in the Edgeville Dungeon and banks loot.");
	}

	@Override
	protected void onStart()
	{
		// onStart runs on the Swing thread, so it must not touch the client.
		// The initial state is chosen on the first game tick instead.
		cooldown = 0;
		state = null;
		lastWalkLocation = null;
		stationaryTicks = 0;
		lootTarget = null;
		lootTargetItemId = -1;
		lootAttempts = 0;
		lootTargetTicks = 0;
		bankStage = null;
		bankAttempts = 0;
		returningFromBank = false;
		shedDoorOpen = false;
		ignoredLoot.clear();
		setStatus("Ready");
	}

	@Override
	protected void onGameTick()
	{
		ScriptContext context = getContext();

		if (!context.isLoggedIn())
		{
			setStatus("Waiting for login");
			return;
		}

		if (state == null)
		{
			WorldPoint location = context.getPlayerLocation();
			if (location != null && location.getY() < 9000)
			{
				// Starting on the surface means the shed door is between
				// us and the ladder, so approach the door first.
				returningFromBank = true;
				state = State.WALK_TO_GIANTS;
			}
			else
			{
				state = State.HUNT;
			}
		}

		if (cooldown > 0)
		{
			--cooldown;
			return;

		eatIfNeeded(context);

		switch (state)
		{
			case HUNT:
				hunt(context);
				break;
			case LOOT:
				loot(context);
				break;
			case WALK_TO_BANK:
				walkToBank(context);
				break;
			case BANK:
				bank(context);
				break;
			case WALK_TO_GIANTS:
				walkToGiants(context);
				break;
		}
	}

	private void bank(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Inventory inventory = context.getInventory();
		GameInput input = context.getInput();

		Widget bankUniverse = context.getTargets().findWidget(InterfaceID.Bankmain.UNIVERSE).orElse(null);
		if (bankUniverse == null)
		{
			bankStage = null;
			bankAttempts = 0;

			if (input.isBusy())
			{
				setStatus("Moving mouse");
				return;
			}

			Optional<GameObject> booth = context.getTargets().findObject(BANK_BOOTH_ID, 10);
			if (booth.isEmpty())
			{
				booth = context.getTargets().findObject("Bank booth", "Bank", 10);
			}
			if (booth.isPresent())
			{
				if (input.interact(booth.get(), "Bank"))
				{
					cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
					setStatus("Opening bank");
				}
				return;
			}

			Optional<NPC> banker = context.getTargets().findNpc("Banker", "Bank", 10);
			if (banker.isPresent())
			{
				if (input.interact(banker.get(), "Bank"))
				{
					cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
					setStatus("Opening bank");
				}
				return;
			}

			cooldown = 2;
			setStatus("No bank nearby");
			return;
		}

		if (bankStage == null)
		{
			bankStage = BankStage.DEPOSIT;
			bankAttempts = 0;
		}

		if (input.isBusy())
		{
			setStatus("Moving mouse");
			return;
		}

		// The key withdraw stage handles its own context menu. Any other menu
		// would swallow the click on the deposit button.
		if (context.getClient().isMenuOpen()
			&& bankStage != BankStage.WITHDRAW_KEY)
		{
			input.closeMenu();
			return;
		}

		switch (bankStage)
		{
			case DEPOSIT:
			{
				Widget deposit = context.getTargets()
					.findWidget(InterfaceID.Bankmain.DEPOSITINV)
					.orElse(null);
				if (deposit != null && input.click(deposit))
				{
					bankStage = BankStage.WAIT_DEPOSIT;
					bankAttempts = 0;
					cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
				}
				else
				{
					++bankAttempts;
					cooldown = 1;
				}
				setStatus("Depositing loot");
				return;
			}
			case WAIT_DEPOSIT:
			{
				if (inventory.getEmptySlots() >= Inventory.SIZE)
				{
					bankStage = BankStage.WITHDRAW_KEY;
					bankAttempts = 0;
					setStatus("Withdrawing brass key");
					return;
				}

				if (++bankAttempts > BANK_STAGE_ATTEMPTS)
				{
					// The deposit click did not register. Try the button
					// again instead of waiting forever.
					bankStage = BankStage.DEPOSIT;
					bankAttempts = 0;
				}
				setStatus("Depositing loot");
				return;
			}
			case WITHDRAW_KEY:
			{
				if (inventory.countItem(BRASS_KEY_ID) >= BRASS_KEY_AMOUNT)
				{
					bankStage = BankStage.LEAVE;
					bankAttempts = 0;
					setStatus("Leaving bank");
					return;
				}

				if (++bankAttempts > BANK_STAGE_ATTEMPTS)
				{
					// No key available in the bank. Leave instead of
					// retrying forever.
					bankStage = BankStage.LEAVE;
					bankAttempts = 0;
					setStatus("No brass key in bank");
					return;
				}

				if (input.withdrawBankItem(BRASS_KEY_ID, "Withdraw-1"))
				{
					cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
				}
				else
				{
					cooldown = 1;
				}
				setStatus("Withdrawing brass key");
				return;
			}
			case LEAVE:
			{
				if (context.getClient().isMenuOpen())
				{
					input.closeMenu();
					return;
				}

				input.pressKey(java.awt.event.KeyEvent.VK_ESCAPE);
				cooldown = COOLDOWN_TICKS;
				ignoredLoot.clear();
				bankStage = null;
				bankAttempts = 0;
				returningFromBank = true;
				shedDoorOpen = false;
				state = State.WALK_TO_GIANTS;
				setStatus("Returning to hill giants");
				return;
			}
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Clicks a widget option while ignoring colour tags, so an action stored as
	 * {@code Create <col=ff9040>Buy</col> offer} can be matched with plain
	 * {@code Create Buy offer}.
	 */
	public boolean interactStripped(Widget widget, String action)
	{
		if (widget == null || widget.isHidden() || action == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		String[] actions = widget.getActions();
		if (actions == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		for (int i = 0; i < actions.length; i++)
		{
			if (actions[i] != null && stripTags(actions[i]).equalsIgnoreCase(stripTags(action)))
			{
				client.menuAction(-1, widget.getId(), MenuAction.CC_OP, i + 1, -1, actions[i], "");
				return true;
			}
		}

		return false;
	}

	private static String stripTags(String value)
	{
		return value.replaceAll("<[^>]*>", "").trim();
	}

	/**
	 * Interacts with a tile object by opening its right-click menu and then
	 * clicking the matching option in that menu. Using the real context menu
	 * avoids relying on synthesised menu actions, which the client does not
	 * always resolve for tile objects.
	 */
	public boolean interact(TileObject object, String... actions)
	{
		if (object == null || actions == null || actions.length == 0)
		{
			return false;
		}

		if (client.isMenuOpen())
		{
			MenuEntry entry = findObjectMenuEntry(object, actions);
			if (entry != null)
			{
				return clickMenuEntry(entry);
			}

			// The menu is open for something else or does not contain the
			// requested option. Close it so the next attempt can start over.
			closeMenu();
			return false;
		}

		// Right-click the object to open its menu. The next tick picks the
		// matching option from the menu.
		return click(object, MouseEvent.BUTTON3);
	}

	private MenuEntry findObjectMenuEntry(TileObject object, String... actions)
	{
		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();
		MenuEntry[] entries = menu == null ? null : menu.getMenuEntries();
		if (entries == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		ObjectComposition composition = client.getObjectDefinition(object.getId());
		String name = composition == null ? null : composition.getName();
		int objectId = object.getId() & 0xFFFF;
		MenuEntry optionOnly = null;
		boolean multipleOptions = false;

		for (MenuEntry entry : entries)
		{
			if (entry == null || !matchesOption(entry.getOption(), actions))
			{
				continue;
			}

			if ((entry.getIdentifier() & 0xFFFF) == objectId)
			{
				return entry;
			}

			String target = entry.getTarget();
			if (target != null && name != null && target.equalsIgnoreCase(name))
			{
				return entry;
			}

			if (optionOnly == null)
			{
				optionOnly = entry;
			}
			else if (optionOnly != entry)
			{
				multipleOptions = true;
			}
		}

		// Some wall objects use a packed identifier rather than the object
		// id. If there is exactly one entry with the wanted option, use it.
		return multipleOptions ? null : optionOnly;
	}

	public boolean interact(NPC npc, String action)
	{
		if (npc == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		NPCComposition composition = npc.getComposition();
		if (composition == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		int actionIndex = findAction(composition.getActions(), action);
		if (actionIndex < 0)
		{
			return false;
		}

		// The first option is what a normal left click selects. Using a real
		// click makes the cursor visibly travel to the NPC instead of the
		// action appearing out of nowhere.
		if (actionIndex == 0)
		{
			return click(npc);
		}

		// Other options need a right-click menu in game. Move onto the NPC
		// like a player would, then invoke the exact option. Hovering keeps
		// the pointer movement visible while avoiding a menu left open
		// across ticks.
		hover(npc);
		client.menuAction(npc.getIndex(), 0, npcMenuAction(actionIndex), npc.getIndex(), -1, action, npc.getName());
		return true;
	}

	public boolean interact(Widget widget, String action)
	{
		if (widget == null || widget.isHidden())
		{
			return false;
		}

		int actionIndex = findAction(widget.getActions(), action);
		if (actionIndex < 0)
		{
			return false;
		}

		client.menuAction(-1, widget.getId(), MenuAction.CC_OP, actionIndex + 1, -1, action, "");
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Finds the visible bank widget for an item in the main bank tab.
	 */
	public Widget findBankItemWidget(int itemId)
	{
		Widget items = client.getWidget(InterfaceID.Bankmain.ITEMS);
		if (items == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		Widget[] children = items.getChildren();
		if (children == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		for (Widget child : children)
		{
			if (child == null || child.isSelfHidden() || child.getItemId() != itemId)
			{
				continue;
			}

			return child;
		}

		return null;
	}

	/**
	 * Withdraws an item from the bank by right-clicking its bank slot and
	 * clicking the requested withdraw option in the real context menu.
	 */
	public boolean withdrawBankItem(int itemId, String withdrawOption)
	{
		if (client.isMenuOpen())
		{
			MenuEntry entry = findBankMenuEntry(itemId, withdrawOption);
			if (entry != null)
			{
				return clickMenuEntry(entry);
			}

			closeMenu();
			return false;
		}

		Widget widget = findBankItemWidget(itemId);
		return widget != null && click(widget, MouseEvent.BUTTON3);
	}

	private MenuEntry findBankMenuEntry(int itemId, String withdrawOption)
	{
		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();
		MenuEntry[] entries = menu == null ? null : menu.getMenuEntries();
		if (entries == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		MenuEntry optionMatch = null;
		for (MenuEntry entry : entries)
		{
			if (entry == null
				|| (entry.getType() != MenuAction.CC_OP
					&& entry.getType() != MenuAction.CC_OP_LOW_PRIORITY)
				|| !matchesOption(entry.getOption(), withdrawOption))
			{
				continue;
			}

			// Bank item entries carry the item id; prefer the entry that
			// belongs to the slot we right-clicked.
			if (entry.getItemId() == itemId
				&& entry.getParam1() == InterfaceID.Bankmain.ITEMS)
			{
				return entry;
			}

			if (optionMatch == null)
			{
				optionMatch = entry;
			}
		}

		return optionMatch;
	}
