	/**
	 * Clicks several widgets one after another using the animated mouse path.
	 * The speed multiplier scales the movement and click timing, so a value of
	 * 2.0 makes the whole sequence twice as fast as normal clicking.
	 *
	 * @return true if the click sequence was started
	 */
	public boolean clickEach(List<Widget> widgets, double speedMultiplier)
	{
		if (widgets == null || widgets.isEmpty())
		{
			return false;
		}

		Canvas canvas = client.getCanvas();
		if (canvas == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		List<Point> gamePoints = new ArrayList<>();

		for (Widget widget : widgets)
		{
			if (widget == null || widget.isHidden())
			{
				continue;
			}

			Rectangle bounds = widget.getBounds();
			if (bounds == null || bounds.isEmpty())
			{
				continue;
			}

			Point point = centerPoint(bounds);
			if (point == null)
			{
				continue;
			}

			Point canvasPoint = toCanvasPoint(point);
			if (!canvas.contains(canvasPoint))
			{
				continue;
			}

			gamePoints.add(point);
		}

		if (gamePoints.isEmpty())
		{
			return false;
		}

		stopCamera();
		busy = true;
		final double speed = Math.max(0.1, speedMultiplier);
		final List<Point> targets = gamePoints;
		SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> beginClickEach(canvas, targets, speed));
		return true;
	}

	private void beginClickEach(Canvas canvas, List<Point> targets, double speed)
	{
		Point start = beginMovement(canvas);
		if (start == null)
		{
			busy = false;
			return;
		}

		List<MouseStep> steps = new ArrayList<>();
		Point cursor = start;
		long offset = 0;

		for (Point target : targets)
		{
			List<MouseStep> segment = buildMoveSteps(cursor, target);
			appendClickSteps(segment, target, MouseEvent.BUTTON1);

			for (MouseStep step : segment)
			{
				long delay = Math.round(step.delayMs / speed);
				steps.add(new MouseStep(step.id, step.point, step.button,
					step.clickCount, step.modifiers, offset + delay));
			}

			offset += Math.round(segment.get(segment.size() - 1).delayMs / speed);
			cursor = target;
		}

		playSteps(canvas, steps);
	}

	public void rightClick(NPC npc)
	{
		if (npc == null)
		{
			return;
		}

		Shape hull = npc.getConvexHull();
		Point point = hull != null ? randomPoint(hull) : null;
		if (point != null)
		{
			rightClick(point);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * @return true if the NPC's model is currently inside the game viewport
	 */
	public boolean isVisible(NPC npc)
	{
		if (npc == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Shape hull = npc.getConvexHull();
		if (hull != null && isInViewport(hull))
		{
			return true;
		}

		Polygon tilePoly = npc.getCanvasTilePoly();
		return tilePoly != null && isInViewport(tilePoly);
	}

	private Point toCanvasPoint(Point gamePoint)
	{
		if (!client.isStretchedEnabled())
		{
			return gamePoint;
		}

		Dimension realDimensions = client.getRealDimensions();
		Dimension stretchedDimensions = client.getStretchedDimensions();
		if (realDimensions == null || stretchedDimensions == null
			|| realDimensions.width <= 0 || realDimensions.height <= 0)
		{
			return gamePoint;
		}

		return new Point(
			gamePoint.x * stretchedDimensions.width / realDimensions.width,
			gamePoint.y * stretchedDimensions.height / realDimensions.height);
	}

	private Point toGamePoint(Point canvasPoint)
	{
		if (!client.isStretchedEnabled())
		{
			return new Point(canvasPoint);
		}

		Dimension realDimensions = client.getRealDimensions();
		Dimension stretchedDimensions = client.getStretchedDimensions();
		if (realDimensions == null || stretchedDimensions == null
			|| stretchedDimensions.width <= 0 || stretchedDimensions.height <= 0)
		{
			return new Point(canvasPoint);
		}

		return new Point(
			canvasPoint.x * realDimensions.width / stretchedDimensions.width,
			canvasPoint.y * realDimensions.height / stretchedDimensions.height);
	}

package net.runelite.rsbuddy.target;

import java.awt.Polygon;
import java.awt.Rectangle;
import java.awt.Shape;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import java.util.stream.Stream;
import net.runelite.api.Client;
import net.runelite.api.GameObject;
import net.runelite.api.NPC;
import net.runelite.api.NPCComposition;
import net.runelite.api.ObjectComposition;
import net.runelite.api.Player;
import net.runelite.api.Scene;
import net.runelite.api.Tile;
import net.runelite.api.TileObject;
import net.runelite.api.WorldView;
import net.runelite.api.coords.WorldPoint;
import net.runelite.api.widgets.Widget;

/**
 * Finds nearby game objects, NPCs, and widgets by name or id.
 */
public final class TargetLocator
{
	private static final Pattern TAGS = Pattern.compile("<[^>]*>");

	private final Client client;

	public TargetLocator(Client client)
	{
		this.client = client;
	}

	public Optional<GameObject> findObject(String name, int maxDistance)
	{
		return findObject(name, null, maxDistance);
	}

	public Optional<GameObject> findObject(String name, String action, int maxDistance)
	{
		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
		WorldPoint playerLocation = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();

		return objects()
			.filter(object -> matchesName(object, name))
			.filter(object -> action == null || action.isEmpty() || hasAction(object, action))
			.filter(object -> withinDistance(object.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation, maxDistance))
			.min(Comparator.comparingInt(object -> distance(object.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation)));
	}

	public Optional<GameObject> findObject(int objectId, int maxDistance)
	{
		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
		WorldPoint playerLocation = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();

		return objects()
			.filter(object -> object.getId() == objectId)
			.filter(object -> withinDistance(object.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation, maxDistance))
			.min(Comparator.comparingInt(object -> distance(object.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation)));
	}

	/**
	 * Finds the nearest matching object that is currently visible on screen.
	 */
	public Optional<GameObject> findVisibleObject(int objectId, int maxDistance)
	{
		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
		WorldPoint playerLocation = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();

		return objects()
			.filter(object -> object.getId() == objectId)
			.filter(object -> withinDistance(object.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation, maxDistance))
			.filter(this::isVisible)
			.min(Comparator.comparingInt(object -> distance(object.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation)));
	}

	/**
	 * Finds the nearest matching object of any tile-object type. This includes
	 * game objects, ground objects such as fires, wall objects, and decorative
	 * objects.
	 */
	public Optional<TileObject> findTileObject(int objectId, int maxDistance)
	{
		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
		WorldPoint playerLocation = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();

		return tileObjects()
			.filter(object -> object.getId() == objectId)
			.filter(object -> withinDistance(object.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation, maxDistance))
			.min(Comparator.comparingInt(object -> distance(object.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation)));
	}

	/**
	 * Finds the nearest matching tile object that is currently visible on
	 * screen.
	 */
	public Optional<TileObject> findVisibleTileObject(int objectId, int maxDistance)
	{
		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
		WorldPoint playerLocation = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();

		return tileObjects()
			.filter(object -> object.getId() == objectId)
			.filter(object -> withinDistance(object.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation, maxDistance))
			.filter(this::isVisible)
			.min(Comparator.comparingInt(object -> distance(object.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation)));
	}

	/**
	 * Finds every tile object within the given radius of a world position.
	 */
	public List<TileObject> getTileObjects(WorldPoint location, int radius)
	{
		if (location == null)
		{
			return Collections.emptyList();
		}

		return tileObjects()
			.filter(object ->
			{
				WorldPoint objectLocation = object.getWorldLocation();
				return objectLocation != null
					&& objectLocation.getPlane() == location.getPlane()
					&& objectLocation.distanceTo(location) <= Math.max(0, radius);
			})
			.collect(Collectors.toList());
	}

	public List<GameObject> getObjects(String name)
	{
		return objects().filter(object -> matchesName(object, name)).collect(Collectors.toList());
	}

	public Optional<NPC> findNpc(String name, int maxDistance)
	{
		return findNpc(name, null, maxDistance);
	}

	public Optional<NPC> findNpc(String name, String action, int maxDistance)
	{
		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
		WorldPoint playerLocation = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();

		return npcs()
			.filter(npc -> matchesName(npc, name))
			.filter(npc -> action == null || action.isEmpty() || hasAction(npc, action))
			.filter(npc -> withinDistance(npc.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation, maxDistance))
			.min(Comparator.comparingInt(npc -> distance(npc.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation)));
	}

	public Optional<NPC> findNpc(int npcId, int maxDistance)
	{
		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
		WorldPoint playerLocation = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();

		return npcs()
			.filter(npc -> npc.getId() == npcId)
			.filter(npc -> withinDistance(npc.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation, maxDistance))
			.min(Comparator.comparingInt(npc -> distance(npc.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation)));
	}

	/**
	 * Finds the nearest matching NPC that is currently visible on screen.
	 */
	public Optional<NPC> findVisibleNpc(int npcId, int maxDistance)
	{
		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
		WorldPoint playerLocation = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();

		return npcs()
			.filter(npc -> npc.getId() == npcId)
			.filter(npc -> withinDistance(npc.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation, maxDistance))
			.filter(this::isVisible)
			.min(Comparator.comparingInt(npc -> distance(npc.getWorldLocation(), playerLocation)));
	}

	public Optional<Widget> findWidget(int componentId)
	{
		return Optional.ofNullable(client.getWidget(componentId))
			.filter(widget -> !widget.isHidden());
	}

	public Optional<Widget> findWidget(int interfaceId, int childId)
	{
		return Optional.ofNullable(client.getWidget(interfaceId, childId))
			.filter(widget -> !widget.isHidden());
	}

	private Stream<GameObject> objects()
	{
		return tiles().flatMap(tile ->
		{
			GameObject[] gameObjects = tile.getGameObjects();
			return gameObjects == null ? Stream.empty() : Arrays.stream(gameObjects);
		})
			.filter(Objects::nonNull);
	}

	private Stream<TileObject> tileObjects()
	{
		return tiles().flatMap(tile ->
		{
			List<TileObject> objects = new ArrayList<>();
			GameObject[] gameObjects = tile.getGameObjects();
			if (gameObjects != null)
			{
				Collections.addAll(objects, gameObjects);
			}
			if (tile.getGroundObject() != null)
			{
				objects.add(tile.getGroundObject());
			}
			if (tile.getWallObject() != null)
			{
				objects.add(tile.getWallObject());
			}
			if (tile.getDecorativeObject() != null)
			{
				objects.add(tile.getDecorativeObject());
			}

			return objects.stream().filter(Objects::nonNull);
		});
	}

	private Stream<Tile> tiles()

package net.runelite.rsbuddy.input;

import java.awt.Canvas;
import java.awt.Dimension;

import java.awt.Polygon;

import net.runelite.api.Client;
import net.runelite.api.MenuAction;

import net.runelite.api.NPC;

/**
 * Sends mouse and keyboard input to the game canvas and invokes menu actions.
 * <p>
 * Clicks are dispatched as AWT events on the canvas, so they go through
 * RuneLite's normal input pipeline (including stretched-mode translation).
 * Mouse movement is animated along a slightly curved path with variable speed,
 * small jitter, and a short press/release delay to look less mechanical.
 */
public final class GameInput

	private static String stripTags(String value)

	/**
	 * Interacts with a tile object by opening its right-click menu and then
	 * clicking the matching option in that menu. Using the real context menu
	 * avoids relying on synthesised menu actions, which the client does not
	 * always resolve for tile objects.
	 */
	public boolean interact(TileObject object, String... actions)
	{
		if (object == null || actions == null || actions.length == 0)
		{
			return false;
		}

		if (client.isMenuOpen())
		{
			MenuEntry entry = findObjectMenuEntry(object, actions);
			if (entry != null)
			{
				return clickMenuEntry(entry);
			}

			// The menu is open for something else or does not contain the
			// requested option. Close it so the next attempt can start over.
			closeMenu();
			return false;
		}

		// Right-click the object to open its menu. The next tick picks the
		// matching option from the menu.
		return click(object, MouseEvent.BUTTON3);
	}

	private MenuEntry findObjectMenuEntry(TileObject object, String... actions)
	{
		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();
		MenuEntry[] entries = menu == null ? null : menu.getMenuEntries();

			return null;
		}

		String name = composition == null ? null : composition.getName();
		int objectId = object.getId() & 0xFFFF;

		return null;
	}

	public boolean withdrawBankItem(int itemId, String withdrawOption)

			{
				return clickMenuEntry(entry);
			}

			closeMenu();

		Widget widget = findBankItemWidget(itemId);

	public boolean invokeMenu(MenuEntry entry)

	private void dispatch(Canvas canvas, int id, Point point, int button, int clickCount, int modifiers)
	{
		MouseEvent event = new MouseEvent(canvas, id, System.currentTimeMillis(), modifiers,
			point.x, point.y, clickCount, false, button);
		canvas.dispatchEvent(event);
	}

	private Point toCanvasPoint(Point gamePoint)
	{
		if (!client.isStretchedEnabled())
		{
			return gamePoint;
		}

		Dimension realDimensions = client.getRealDimensions();
		Dimension stretchedDimensions = client.getStretchedDimensions();
		if (realDimensions == null || stretchedDimensions == null
			|| realDimensions.width <= 0 || realDimensions.height <= 0)
		{
			return gamePoint;
		}

		return new Point(
			gamePoint.x * stretchedDimensions.width / realDimensions.width,
			gamePoint.y * stretchedDimensions.height / realDimensions.height);
	}

	private Point toGamePoint(Point canvasPoint)
	{
		if (!client.isStretchedEnabled())
		{
			return new Point(canvasPoint);
		}

		Dimension realDimensions = client.getRealDimensions();
		Dimension stretchedDimensions = client.getStretchedDimensions();
		if (realDimensions == null || stretchedDimensions == null
			|| stretchedDimensions.width <= 0 || stretchedDimensions.height <= 0)
		{
			return new Point(canvasPoint);
		}

		return new Point(
			canvasPoint.x * realDimensions.width / stretchedDimensions.width,
			canvasPoint.y * realDimensions.height / stretchedDimensions.height);
	}

	private Point randomPoint(Shape shape)
	{
		if (shape == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		Rectangle bounds = shape.getBounds();
		if (bounds == null || bounds.isEmpty())
		{
			return null;
		}

		double centerX = bounds.getCenterX();
		double centerY = bounds.getCenterY();

		for (int i = 0; i < RANDOM_POINT_ATTEMPTS; i++)
		{
			int x = (int) Math.round(centerX + (random.nextDouble() * 2.0 - 1.0) * bounds.width * 0.36);
			int y = (int) Math.round(centerY + (random.nextDouble() * 2.0 - 1.0) * bounds.height * 0.36);
			if (shape.contains(x, y) && isInViewport(x, y) && !isCoveredByInterface(x, y))
			{
				return new Point(x, y);
			}
		}

		int x = (int) Math.round(centerX);
		int y = (int) Math.round(centerY);
		return shape.contains(x, y) && isInViewport(x, y) && !isCoveredByInterface(x, y)
			? new Point(x, y)
			: null;
	}

	/**
	 * @return true if the inventory or chat interface covers the given canvas
	 * point, so a click there would hit the interface instead of the game
	 * world
	 */
	private boolean isCoveredByInterface(int x, int y)
	{
		return isWithinWidget(InterfaceID.Inventory.ITEMS, x, y)
			|| isWithinWidget(InterfaceID.Chatbox.UNIVERSE, x, y);
	}

	private void walkToBank(ScriptContext context)
	{
		Player player = context.getPlayer();
		WorldPoint location = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
		if (location == null)
		{
			return;
		}

		if (!isInDungeon(location))
		{
			if (location.distanceTo(WEST_VARROCK_BANK) <= 8)
			{
				state = State.BANK;
				setStatus("Banking");
				return;
			}

			// After climbing up we are inside the shed with the brass-key
			// door shut behind us. Open it once, then walk away using the
			// minimap so the walk click cannot hit and toggle the door.
			if (!shedDoorOpen
				&& location.distanceTo(SURFACE_DOOR) <= 10
				&& openDoor(context))
			{
				setStatus("Opening door");
				return;
			}

			walkTowards(context, WEST_VARROCK_BANK, true);
			setStatus("Walking to bank");
		}
		else
		{
			if (location.distanceTo(DUNGEON_LADDER) <= 8)
			{
				climb(context, true, LADDER_ID);
			}
			else
			{
				walkTowards(context, DUNGEON_LADDER);
			}
			setStatus("Walking to bank");
		}
	}

	private void bank(ScriptContext context)

			if (input.interact(target.get(), ATTACK_ACTION))

			}
			else
			{
				cooldown = 2;
				setStatus("Cannot attack " + NPC_NAME);
			}
			return;
		}

		openDoor(context);
		cooldown = 2;
		setStatus("No " + NPC_NAME + " nearby");
	}

package net.runelite.api;

import java.awt.Graphics2D;
import java.awt.Polygon;
import java.awt.Shape;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;
import net.runelite.api.coords.LocalPoint;
import net.runelite.api.coords.WorldPoint;

/**
 * Represents an object on a Tile
 */
public interface TileObject
{
	int HASH_PLANE_SHIFT = 14;

	/**
	 * A bitfield containing various flags:
	 * <pre>{@code
	 * worldView = bits >> 52 & 4095
	 * id = bits >> 20 & 0xffffffff
	 * wall = bits >> 19 & 1
	 * type = bits >> 16 & 7
	 * plane = bits >> 14 & 3
	 * scene y = bits >> 7 & 127
	 * scene x = bits >> 0 & 127
	 * }</pre>
	 * Type 0 = player, 1 = npc, 2 = game object, 3 = item, 4 = world entity
	 */
	long getHash();

	/**
	 * Gets the x-axis coordinate of the object in local context.
	 *
	 * @see LocalPoint
	 */
	int getX();

	/**
	 * Gets the y-axis coordinate of the object in local context.
	 *
	 * @see LocalPoint
	 */
	int getY();

	/**
	 * Gets the vertical coordinate of this object
	 */
	int getZ();

	/**
	 * Gets the plane of the tile that the object is on.
	 */
	int getPlane();

	/**
	 * Gets the WorldView this TileObject is a part of.
	 */
	WorldView getWorldView();

	/**
	 * Gets the ID of the object.
	 *
	 * @see net.runelite.api.gameval.ObjectID
	 */
	int getId();

	/**
	 * Get the world location for this object. For objects which are larger than 1 tile, this is the
	 * center most tile, rounded to the south-west.
	 * @return
	 */
	@Nonnull
	WorldPoint getWorldLocation();

	/**
	 * Get the local location for this object. This point is the center point of the object.
	 * @return
	 */
	@Nonnull
	LocalPoint getLocalLocation();

	/**
	 * Calculates the position of the center of this tile on the canvas
	 */
	@Nullable
	Point getCanvasLocation();

	/**

	private Point toGamePoint(Point canvasPoint)
	{
		if (!client.isStretchedEnabled())
		{
			return new Point(canvasPoint);
		}

		Dimension realDimensions = client.getRealDimensions();
		Dimension stretchedDimensions = client.getStretchedDimensions();
		if (realDimensions == null || stretchedDimensions == null
			|| stretchedDimensions.width <= 0 || stretchedDimensions.height <= 0)
		{
			return new Point(canvasPoint);
		}

		return new Point(
			canvasPoint.x * realDimensions.width / stretchedDimensions.width,
			canvasPoint.y * realDimensions.height / stretchedDimensions.height);
	}

	private Point randomPoint(Shape shape)
	{
		if (shape == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		Rectangle bounds = shape.getBounds();
		if (bounds == null || bounds.isEmpty())
		{
			return null;
		}

		double centerX = bounds.getCenterX();
		double centerY = bounds.getCenterY();

		for (int i = 0; i < RANDOM_POINT_ATTEMPTS; i++)
		{
			int x = (int) Math.round(centerX + (random.nextDouble() * 2.0 - 1.0) * bounds.width * 0.36);
			int y = (int) Math.round(centerY + (random.nextDouble() * 2.0 - 1.0) * bounds.height * 0.36);
			if (shape.contains(x, y) && isInViewport(x, y) && !isCoveredByInterface(x, y))
			{
				return new Point(x, y);
			}
		}

		int x = (int) Math.round(centerX);
		int y = (int) Math.round(centerY);
		return shape.contains(x, y) && isInViewport(x, y) && !isCoveredByInterface(x, y)
			? new Point(x, y)
			: null;
	}

	/**
	 * @return true if the inventory or chat interface covers the given canvas
	 * point, so a click there would hit the interface instead of the game
	 * world
	 */
	private boolean isCoveredByInterface(int x, int y)
	{
		return isWithinWidget(InterfaceID.Inventory.ITEMS, x, y)
			|| isWithinWidget(InterfaceID.Chatbox.UNIVERSE, x, y);
	}

	@Subscribe
	public void onMenuEntryAdded(MenuEntryAdded event)
	{
		MenuAction type = MenuAction.of(event.getType());
		final boolean hotKeyPressed = client.isKeyPressed(KeyCode.KC_SHIFT);
		if (type == MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_FIRST_OPTION || type == MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_SECOND_OPTION ||
			type == MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_THIRD_OPTION || type == MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_FOURTH_OPTION ||
			type == MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_FIFTH_OPTION || type == MenuAction.WIDGET_TARGET_ON_GROUND_ITEM)
		{
			final int itemId = event.getIdentifier();
			final int sceneX = event.getActionParam0();
			final int sceneY = event.getActionParam1();

			MenuEntry lastEntry = event.getMenuEntry();
			WorldView wv = client.getWorldView(lastEntry.getWorldViewId());

			final WorldPoint worldPoint = WorldPoint.fromScene(wv, sceneX, sceneY, wv.getPlane());
			GroundItem groundItem = collectedGroundItems.get(worldPoint, itemId);

			updateItemColor(groundItem);

			int quantity = groundItem.getQuantity();
			final boolean canBeRecolored = groundItem.highlighted || (groundItem.hidden && config.recolorMenuHiddenItems());

			if ((config.itemHighlightMode() == ItemHighlightMode.MENU || config.itemHighlightMode() == ItemHighlightMode.BOTH) &&
				(canBeRecolored && !groundItem.color.equals(config.defaultColor())))
			{
				final MenuHighlightMode mode = config.menuHighlightMode();

				if (mode == BOTH || mode == OPTION)
				{
					lastEntry.setOption(ColorUtil.prependColorTag(lastEntry.getOption(), groundItem.color));
				}

				if (mode == BOTH || mode == NAME)
				{
					// <col=ff9040>Logs
					// <col=00ff00>Telekinetic Grab</col><col=ffffff> -> <col=ff9040>Logs
					String target = lastEntry.getTarget();

					int i = target.lastIndexOf('>');
					lastEntry.setTarget(target.substring(0, i - 11) + ColorUtil.colorTag(groundItem.color) + target.substring(i + 1));
				}
			}

			if (config.showMenuItemQuantities() && groundItem.isStackable() && quantity > 1)
			{
				lastEntry.setTarget(lastEntry.getTarget() + " (" + quantity + ")");
			}

			if (groundItem.hidden && !groundItem.highlighted && config.deprioritizeHiddenItems())
			{
				lastEntry.setDeprioritized(true);
			}
		}
		else if (hotKeyPressed && type == MenuAction.EXAMINE_ITEM_GROUND)
		{
			MenuEntry parent = client.createMenuEntry(-1)
				.setOption("Color")
				.setTarget(event.getTarget())
				.setType(MenuAction.RUNELITE);
			Menu submenu = parent.createSubMenu();
			final int itemId = event.getIdentifier();
			Color color = getItemColor(itemId);

			if (color != null)
			{
				submenu.createMenuEntry(-1)
					.setOption("Reset")
					.setType(MenuAction.RUNELITE)
					.onClick(e -> unsetItemColor(itemId));
			}

	/**
	 * Withdraws an item from the bank by right-clicking its bank slot and then
	 * running the requested withdraw option directly.
	 */
	public boolean withdrawBankItem(int itemId, String withdrawOption)
	{

	private static String stripTags(String value)
	{
		return value.replaceAll("<[^>]*>", "").trim();
	}

	/**
	 * Interacts with a tile object. When the wanted option is the object's
	 * default left-click action it is clicked directly, which avoids opening
	 * a context menu (and accidentally right-clicking whatever is drawn above
	 * the object). Other options are taken from the object's menu.
	 */
	public boolean interact(TileObject object, String... actions)
	{
		if (object == null || actions == null || actions.length == 0)
		{
			return false;
		}

		if (client.isMenuOpen())
		{
			MenuEntry entry = findObjectMenuEntry(object, actions);
			if (entry != null)
			{
				return invokeMenuEntry(entry);
			}

			// The menu is open for something else or does not contain the
			// requested option. Close it so the next attempt can start over.
			closeMenu();
			return false;
		}

		ObjectComposition composition = client.getObjectDefinition(object.getId());
		String[] objectActions = composition == null ? null : composition.getActions();
		if (objectActions != null && objectActions.length > 0
			&& objectActions[0] != null
			&& matchesOption(stripTags(objectActions[0]), actions))
		{
			return click(object);
		}

		// Right-click the object to open its menu. The next tick picks the
		// matching option from the menu.
		return click(object, MouseEvent.BUTTON3);
	}

	private MenuEntry findObjectMenuEntry(TileObject object, String... actions)
	{
		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();
		MenuEntry[] entries = menu == null ? null : menu.getMenuEntries();
		if (entries == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		ObjectComposition composition = client.getObjectDefinition(object.getId());
		String name = composition == null ? null : composition.getName();
		int objectId = object.getId() & 0xFFFF;
		MenuEntry optionOnly = null;
		boolean multipleOptions = false;

		for (MenuEntry entry : entries)
		{
			if (entry == null || !matchesOption(entry.getOption(), actions))
			{
				continue;
			}

			if ((entry.getIdentifier() & 0xFFFF) == objectId)
			{
				return entry;
			}

			String target = entry.getTarget();
			if (target != null && name != null && target.equalsIgnoreCase(name))
			{
				return entry;
			}

			if (optionOnly == null)
			{
				optionOnly = entry;
			}
			else if (optionOnly != entry)
			{
				multipleOptions = true;
			}
		}

		// Some wall objects use a packed identifier rather than the object
		// id. If there is exactly one entry with the wanted option, use it.
		return multipleOptions ? null : optionOnly;
	}

	public boolean interact(NPC npc, String action)
	{
		if (npc == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		NPCComposition composition = npc.getComposition();
		if (composition == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		int actionIndex = findAction(composition.getActions(), action);
		if (actionIndex < 0)
		{
			return false;
		}

		// The first option is what a normal left click selects. Using a real
		// click makes the cursor visibly travel to the NPC instead of the
		// action appearing out of nowhere.
		if (actionIndex == 0)
		{
			return click(npc);
		}

		// Other options need a right-click menu in game. Move onto the NPC
		// like a player would, then invoke the exact option. Hovering keeps
		// the pointer movement visible while avoiding a menu left open
		// across ticks.
		hover(npc);
		client.menuAction(npc.getIndex(), 0, npcMenuAction(actionIndex), npc.getIndex(), -1, action, npc.getName());
		return true;
	}

	public boolean interact(Widget widget, String action)
	{
		if (widget == null || widget.isHidden())
		{
			return false;
		}

		int actionIndex = findAction(widget.getActions(), action);
		if (actionIndex < 0)
		{
			return false;
		}

		client.menuAction(-1, widget.getId(), MenuAction.CC_OP, actionIndex + 1, -1, action, "");
		return true;
	}

package net.runelite.api;

import java.util.function.Consumer;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;
import net.runelite.api.widgets.Widget;

/**
 * A menu entry in a right-click menu.
 */
public interface MenuEntry
{
	/**
	 * The option text added to the menu. (ie. "Walk here", "Use")
	 */
	String getOption();
	MenuEntry setOption(String option);

	/**
	 * The target of the action. (ie. Item or Actor name)
	 * <p>
	 * If the option does not apply to any target, this field
	 * will be set to empty string.
	 */
	String getTarget();
	MenuEntry setTarget(String target);

	/**
	 * An identifier value for the target of the action.
	 */
	int getIdentifier();
	MenuEntry setIdentifier(int identifier);

	/**
	 * The action the entry will trigger.
	 */
	MenuAction getType();
	MenuEntry setType(MenuAction type);

	/**
	 * An additional parameter for the action.
	 */
	int getParam0();
	MenuEntry setParam0(int param0);

	/**
	 * A second additional parameter for the action.
	 */
	int getParam1();
	MenuEntry setParam1(int param1);

	/**
	 * If this is true and you have single mouse button on and this entry is
	 * the top entry the right click menu will not be opened when you left click
	 *
	 * This is used  for shift click
	 */
	boolean isForceLeftClick();
	MenuEntry setForceLeftClick(boolean forceLeftClick);

	int getWorldViewId();
	MenuEntry setWorldViewId(int worldViewId);

	/**
	 * Deprioritized menus are sorted in the menu to be below the other menu entries.
	 * @return
	 */
	boolean isDeprioritized();
	MenuEntry setDeprioritized(boolean deprioritized);

	/**
	 * Set a callback to be called when this menu option is clicked
	 * @param callback
	 * @return
	 */
	MenuEntry onClick(Consumer<MenuEntry> callback);

	/**
	 * Get the callback called when the menu option is clicked
	 * @return
	 */
	Consumer<MenuEntry> onClick();

	/**
	 * Test if this menu entry is an item op. "Use" and "Examine" are not considered item ops.
	 * @return
	 */
	boolean isItemOp();

	/**
	 * If this menu entry is an item op, get the item op id
	 * @return 1-5
	 */
	int getItemOp();

	/**
	 * Get the item id
	 * @return
	 * @see net.runelite.api.gameval.ItemID
	 */
	int getItemId();

	/**
	 * Set the item id
	 * @param itemId
	 * @return
	 */
	MenuEntry setItemId(int itemId);

	/**
	 * Get the widget this menu entry is on, if this is a menu entry
	 * with an associated widget. Such as eg, CC_OP.
	 * @return
	 */
	@Nullable
	Widget getWidget();

	/**
	 * Get the {@link NPC} this menu entry is targeting, if any.
	 * @return
	 */
	@Nullable
	NPC getNpc();

	/**
	 * Get the {@link Player} this menu entry is targeting, if any.
	 * @return
	 */
	@Nullable
	Player getPlayer();

	/**
	 * Get the {@link Actor} this menu entry is targeting, if any.
	 * @return
	 */
	@Nullable
	Actor getActor();

	/**
	 * Get the submenu for this menu entry.
	 * @return the submenu, or null if one doesn't exist
	 * @see #createSubMenu()
	 */
	@Nullable
	Menu getSubMenu();

	/**
	 * Create a new submenu for this menu entry.
	 * This will erase any previous submenu.
	 * @return the new submenu
	 */
	@Nonnull
	Menu createSubMenu();

	/**
	 * Remove the submenu from this menu entry.
	 */
	void deleteSubMenu();
}

	/**
	 * Clicks a row in the client's currently open context menu. The client
	 * lays the menu out with a 19px header and 15px rows, with the array's
	 * last entry at the top.
	 */
	public boolean clickMenuEntry(MenuEntry entry)
	{
		if (entry == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		net.runelite.api.Menu menu = client.getMenu();
		MenuEntry[] entries = menu == null ? null : menu.getMenuEntries();
		if (!client.isMenuOpen() || entries == null || entries.length == 0)
		{
			return invokeMenuEntry(entry);
		}

		int index = -1;
		for (int i = 0; i < entries.length; i++)
		{
			if (entries[i] == entry)
			{
				index = i;
				break;
			}
		}

		if (index < 0 || client.isMenuScrollable())
		{
			return invokeMenuEntry(entry);
		}

		int row = entries.length - 1 - index;
		int x = menu.getMenuX() + Math.max(8, menu.getMenuWidth() / 2);
		int y = menu.getMenuY() + 19 + row * 15 + 7;
		return clickMenuPoint(new Point(x, y));
	}

	private boolean invokeMenuEntry(MenuEntry entry)
	{
		client.menuAction(entry.getParam0(), entry.getParam1(), entry.getType(),
			entry.getIdentifier(), entry.getItemId(), entry.getOption(), entry.getTarget());

		// Running an entry directly skips the menu's own click handler, which
		// normally dismisses the menu. Leave a Cancel entry alone so closing
		// the menu cannot recurse.
		if (entry.getType() != MenuAction.CANCEL && client.isMenuOpen())
		{
			closeMenu();
		}

		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Runs a context-menu entry directly. This lets callers use an option that
	 * is not the default left-click action without opening the menu, and it
	 * never falls back to a plain click, so nothing unexpected is triggered.
	 */
	public boolean invokeMenu(MenuEntry entry)
	{
		return entry != null && invokeMenuEntry(entry);
	}

		MenuEntry untyped = null;
		int untypedCount = 0;

		return untypedCount == 1 ? untyped : null;

	/**

	 * matching entry. Use this when the direct path does not affect the object
	 * (for example wall objects whose menu identifier is packed differently).
	 */
	public boolean interactViaMenu(TileObject object, String... actions)
	{
		if (object == null || actions == null || actions.length == 0)
		{
			return false;
		}

		if (client.isMenuOpen())

	/**
	 * Clicks several widgets in quick succession without the animated mouse
	 * path. This is intended for rapid inventory actions such as
	 * power-dropping fish. The clicks are sequenced so each one lands after the
	 * client has processed the move to its target.
	 *
	 * @return the number of clicks scheduled
	 */
	public int fastClick(List<Widget> widgets)
	{
		if (widgets == null || widgets.isEmpty())
		{
			return 0;
		}

		Canvas canvas = client.getCanvas();
		if (canvas == null)
		{
			return 0;
		}

		List<Point> gamePoints = new ArrayList<>();
		List<Point> canvasPoints = new ArrayList<>();

		for (Widget widget : widgets)
		{
			if (widget == null || widget.isHidden())
			{
				continue;
			}

			Rectangle bounds = widget.getBounds();
			if (bounds == null || bounds.isEmpty())
			{
				continue;
			}

			Point point = randomPoint(bounds);
			if (point == null)
			{
				continue;
			}

			Point canvasPoint = toCanvasPoint(point);
			if (!canvas.contains(canvasPoint))
			{
				continue;
			}

			gamePoints.add(point);
			canvasPoints.add(canvasPoint);
		}

		if (gamePoints.isEmpty())
		{
			return 0;
		}

		stopCamera();
		final List<Point> targets = gamePoints;
		final List<Point> canvasTargets = canvasPoints;
		fastClicking = true;
		SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> fastClickNext(canvas, targets, canvasTargets, 0));
		return targets.size();
	}

	/**
	 * Clicks several widgets one after another using the animated mouse path.
	 * The speed multiplier scales the movement and click timing, so a value of
	 * 2.0 makes the whole sequence twice as fast as normal clicking.
	 *
	 * @return true if the click sequence was started
	 */
	public boolean clickEach(List<Widget> widgets, double speedMultiplier)
	{
		if (widgets == null || widgets.isEmpty())
		{
			return false;
		}

		Canvas canvas = client.getCanvas();
		if (canvas == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		List<Point> gamePoints = new ArrayList<>();

		for (Widget widget : widgets)
		{
			if (widget == null || widget.isHidden())
			{
				continue;
			}

			Rectangle bounds = widget.getBounds();
			if (bounds == null || bounds.isEmpty())
			{
				continue;
			}

			Point point = centerPoint(bounds);
			if (point == null)
			{
				continue;
			}

			Point canvasPoint = toCanvasPoint(point);
			if (!canvas.contains(canvasPoint))
			{
				continue;
			}

			gamePoints.add(point);
		}

		if (gamePoints.isEmpty())
		{
			return false;
		}

		stopCamera();
		busy = true;
		final double speed = Math.max(0.1, speedMultiplier);
		final List<Point> targets = gamePoints;
		SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> beginClickEach(canvas, targets, speed));
		return true;
	}

	private void beginClickEach(Canvas canvas, List<Point> targets, double speed)
	{
		Point start = beginMovement(canvas);
		if (start == null)
		{
			busy = false;
			return;
		}

		List<MouseStep> steps = new ArrayList<>();
		Point cursor = start;
		long offset = 0;

		for (Point target : targets)
		{
			List<MouseStep> segment = buildMoveSteps(cursor, target);
			appendClickSteps(segment, target, MouseEvent.BUTTON1);

			for (MouseStep step : segment)
			{
				long delay = Math.round(step.delayMs / speed);
				steps.add(new MouseStep(step.id, step.point, step.button,
					step.clickCount, step.modifiers, offset + delay));
			}

			offset += Math.round(segment.get(segment.size() - 1).delayMs / speed);
			cursor = target;
		}

		playSteps(canvas, steps);
	}

			rightClick(point);
		}
	}

	public boolean click(TileObject object, int button)
	{
		if (object == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		Shape clickbox = object.getClickbox();
		if (clickbox != null)
		{
			Point point = randomPoint(clickbox);
			return point != null && click(point, button);
		}

		Polygon tilePoly = object.getCanvasTilePoly();
		if (tilePoly != null)
		{
			Point point = randomPoint(tilePoly);
			return point != null && click(point, button);
		}

		net.runelite.api.Point canvasLocation = object.getCanvasLocation();
		return canvasLocation != null
			&& click(new Point(canvasLocation.getX(), canvasLocation.getY()), button);
	}
